entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: Tinokwazisana tose muZita raTenzi Jeso Kristu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tine mufaro wakanyanya kuungana zvakare after a long weekend, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] yebasa raMwari.Tinotenda kuti ikoko basa ririkuitwa chai…? [Congregation says, “chaizvo,"] chaizvo. Mwari vane nyasha. [Congregation says, “Amen,”] Saka-a hama dzedu tikaenda Svondo ino neinotevera ndofunga tinopedza. Saka tongo hoper [to hope ED] kuti Mwari anotibatsira tikwanise Hatigumbuke nekurega kukurumbidza kupedza, tinongo…Mwari varikutiratidza kuwanda kwegohwo, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ravakatiitira gore rino. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Saka let's take our courage, “Kunamata kushanda, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ende kushanda kudii...?” [Congregation says, “kunamata.”] Ndosaka Pauro akati, “Asingade kushanda ngaarege kudii...? [Congregation says ‘kudya’,] kudya”. The benefits of our farming are obvious and apparent before every...? [Congregation says, “everyone”] everyone.

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: Honai magariro edu atinoita, hatiremerwe nechekudya. Mwari varikutiitira nyasha chai...? [Congregation says, “chaizvo,”] chai-zvo, zvokuti dai taiita hupfu hwokudirirana handimboziva kuti tingadai tapapi nhasi uno. Dai taiita hupfu hwekuti mangwana tanotenga, mangwana tanotenga, mangwana tanotenga ah! Zvokuti kunyangwe ikokuku hwakapera ende hama hadzisati dza-a pura ende kwatove nenyaya yekuti chibage chibage chibage kwese kumuzinda uku. So, you might not be aware of what God is making you do nekuenda kwauri kuita kuMainga, but kuti you are supporting God's work greatly, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] tremendously. I don’t see you having [0:1:38:5 inaudible] financially in this place. Nekuti ndinofunga kuti ndikati hama ngatiitei macontributions ekutenga hupfu hwepano pamba pano. Handifungi tinozvikwanisa kana three months chaidzo.

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: Hupfu hwacho hatihugone. Three months uchitenga hupfu hwepano tichi contribut-a [ to contribute ED] semawandiro atakaita aya ngati contribut-eyi titenge hupfu hwepamba panapa [ Apostle laughs] unotiza. Because isu tinopedza tonne in maybe three weeks. Tonne haiite kana mwedzi pano. So, you can imagine the kind of uhhh hupfu hwunodyiwa pano. Pano togona kudya sadza kuseni, tigodya sadza masikati, tigodya sadza manheru tokanganganwa zvebreakfast izvi handi’maona. Kurirova chaizvo, izvo zvaraiitwa manyakare chaiwo ana Chaka Zulu. [Congregation laughs] Zviya zvekuti kuseni tinomborova chingwa e-hh this time there was a time when bread was almost unreachable. but still, it's steep seeing kuti everybody anopeyewa [to be paid ED] allowance yehundred eeh yusa [USA ED], ma [Congregation says, “Amen."] mateacher hundred yusa, masoldier hundred yusa, manurse hundred yusa. It’s terrible! Saka hataimbo zvikwanisa.

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: Manje panapa tikange ti-ine manugcu we have breafast maybe nema manugcu, masikati torova sadza, manheru sadza. Haa ini as you can see, anenge akaonda pano munyowani, [Congregation, “laughs,”] asi kana angoti ga…? [Congregation says, “garei,”] matama aya anodii...? anodzoka zvakare. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Saka totenda Mwari, kuti Mwari varikutiitira nyasha. Saka kuMaingaka while it is a strenuous thing [3.20 inaudible], but it could be even more strenuous if we were asking each one of us to contribute there. [Congregation says, “Amen".] Saka ngatitendei Mwari nearea iyoyo, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] yekukwanisa kuisa labour iyoyo. Saka never get tired and rega kudogder, rega kuremerwa and hauzo chengeti isusu chete. No tinobatsirana tiri vatendi. [Congregation says, “Amen".] It’s only that unotozoona kuti most brother’s kana vakawirwa nenhamo unovawona kuti vakutonetsaka handi’maona. Unotozviona kuti akutonetseka kuti ndiri kuremedza pastor or kuti kudii.Do you know why you feel that way, it’s panguva yawunenge uchikwanisa kuti utibatsire kazhinji haudii...? [Congregation says, “hauiti,”] hauiti.

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: It's only now when you are in disasters then you realize the importance of the Church. [Congregation says, “Amen".] That's a very bad way to...? [Congregation says, “to learn,”] to learn ha’moona. Saka utoona hama inenge yakutozeza ha’moona. Whereas in any condition ha’maona,even sister, kana wanga uri musikana anga achi supporter basa raMwari,uri uri mudzimai ano supporter basa raMwari, musi waunowirwa nenhamo. It's like an insurance policy. There shouldn’t be a problem abo…? [Congregation says, “about it,”] about it. But kana wanga usingaite zvinhu nemwoyo unodii...? Unoda wanga uchizviita mbimbi ndoga. That’s when you start feeling bad, you start feeling a complex, you start feeling kuti Pastor ndakuvanetsa, hanti’maona. But kana wanga uchiita zvinhu chaizvo, chaizvo would you ever think like that? No! Ha’moona. Ibasa reChe...? [Congregation says, “Chechi,”] reChechi hanti’maona. Ibasa reChechi kuti tibatsirane hanti’maona.

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: Saka if anybody would get into a situation where things are very tough for you, Church yedu inazvo, you know very well kuti una...? [Congregation says, “unazvo,"] unazvo.Thats why we find kuti there is nothing wrong, in supporting the Church hundrend per…? [Congregation says, “percent."] Haikona kumbofa wakanetseka ha’maona. KuChurch ndiko kwaunofanira kumhanyira ha’maona. That's why you find kuti our minds are young, and we are ...we are young we don’t think wide. But Church kana iri yawana Church, tetofanira kuve nema ophanages edu. [Congregation says, “mmm,"] right toita ma ophanages, tofanira kuva nema old people’s homes e...? [Congregation says, “edu,"] edu.

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: Then tofanira kuva nezvikoro zvedu,zvipatara zvedu. We should have all these things as a Church, handi’maona. So that kana kuri kuti Church yasimba like that, uri a real strong Church member you won’t have any problems hand’maona. Ndosaka kana mukaona kana ku- kuGweru Christian Midlands School, every person ari committed kuchurch kwavo handitika, pays a quarter of the fees that every other person pa...? Christian Midlands paya i knew that long ago. Nekuti ndamuziva murungu wacho aka- patanga Christian Midlands School kuGweru uku. Before isati yavakwa ndaigara ndichitaura naye tichiita argue. Aiti iye anoziva Brother Branham.

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: Then when there were starting kuvaka Midlands Christian School. Ndaitotaura naye achitoti, “Don’t you want to be a part of contributing we will accommodate your children?” But nguva iyoyoka hanti’munoona kuti kukura kunouya nembijana mbijana. [Congregation “laughs".] Had i gotten in ndingadei ndiri a big shareholder wepa Midlands. But ndakaramba at that time.Ndakati haa noo but look what he did, pakazo pedzisira popinda makambani. Ndikatozo sangana naye zvikanzi, “Mr Gumbura, where are your children going to school, you remember i Invited you?”. [Congregation laughs]

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: Saka ha’maona, saka the same thing kana paChurch pedu, mabrothers edu mazhinji eehh it’s a problem takamboiparidza mazuva apera. Mabrothers edu mazhinji mune problem yekuti mukaropafadzwa, munomhanya kunoita zvinhu zviri personal, hanti’murikupaona, but panguva yaunenge usisina mari ndopaunge wakutomuka tomuka manje kuda kuita kuzvinhu zvaMwari or even une mari hama dzinongobvisa mari yekuitiizvo eeehhh ti -tingooo… ndingonzi ndabvisa nekuti ndiri kungowonekwa kuti ndinayo. That’s not the way to support God’s work. [ Congregation says, “Amen".].

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: Basa raMwari support-wi sai…? [Congregation says, “saizvozvo”.] saizvozvo.Basa raMwari rino support-wa whole heartedly. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] You put everything to…? [Congregation says, “it”] to it, hant’maona ehe. You put everything to it. Now this Pastor why I’m saying ndinomuziva, aiva ane nemba yake kuuu Coby, kuCoby kuri iko kwaigara vana Brother Mhandu.Area yaigara vana Brother Mhandu vanoiziva.

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: This Pastor wepa Midlands Christian School anga aine imba ikoko. He sold his house to put the initial capital paMidlands Christian School. Could you imagine that achitondiudza takatoenda tikanoiona na Mother imba yacho achitoitengesa achiiti “I’m selling this we want to start a school, a Christian School, we are looking for donations and we want to start a school,but if you give us a major donation, your name will be put down and your children are guaranteed. But pa pasati patovova nechinhu, pasati pavane ground racho ravakanga vatenga. You know.

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: He sold his house ini handina kukwanisa kuitenga nguva iyoyo. Ndonguva yatai tsvaga, isu tai- taitotsvagawo kutengawo imba, ndobva tazowana Ridgemont iyi nguva iyoyo. His was much more, Ridgemont was uuuh fourty thousand, his was sixty-five thousand. It was bigger, bigger yard, bigger house yeah handi’moona. Murungu iyeye, But tatiri vana vadiki, tatichaitawo. Isu taitofunga kuti by that time tetaita zvedu.

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: Ndiani waiziva kuti muMessage mune hondo yakadai? MuMessage mune chaos isingadii…? [Congregation says, “isingaite,”] isingaite mu Message. Mu message makuda nyasha dzaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen”.] Vana Brother Chitsinde ava ha’maona, they could be running Schools neopportunity yavakawana muno muHarare, they could be running Schools vese vana Brother Jeremiah. To think kuti the only thing that they did is a building kuBelvedere. It’s an embarrassment. It’s really an embarrassment kuMe …? [Congregation says, “Message,”] Message.

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: They could have done much better than that, h’amaona.Why they haven’t, it still [Apostle claps his hands once] inini zvinotondi… I’m baffled h’amaona. Because i always believe kuti had I been given an opportunity like they have got handitika, ini ndingadai chikoro ndina…? [Congregation says, “ndinacho,”] ndinacho. I would have had it h’amaona. But it’s never too late to do what’s right, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ehe. Isu tichachiita chete chikoro icho…? [Congregation says, “ichocho,”] ehe zvipatara tichaita chete.

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: I will not care about how many setbacks i will have, but one day,chikoro tichadii…? [Congregation says, “tichaita,”] tichaita.Ndo problem yatikuita kana mukaona kana hama dzedu kunze. Hama dzikaenda kunze kana ku-u ku-u kuBritain, vano mhanya kunoita zvinhu zvavo first, before vaita zvinhu zvani…? [Congregation says, “zvaMwari,”] zvaMwari.

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: Handizivi kuti i insecurity iri mu Message here? I don’t know kana kuti vanhu vaka…handimboziviwo i- i- -i don’t know. Ha-atina that type of commitment yekuti vanhu vanotanga kuita zvinhu zvekuChurch. Even ukazonge wakuti ndinoda mari. Most of the time when you get money even from brothers ndinee ndatoita insist kuti brother itai so, ita so, itai so, itai so. Ukangonyarara, [Apostle laughs] hapana chinoi…? [Congregation says, “chinoitika,”] Chinoitika ehe. Saka ini normally i don’t, i don’t ask kana ndichiziva zvangu kuti aah zvinhu zviri comfortable.

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: But ndikaona kuti zvinhu zvaoma handititka ndopandinoti brother itai so, itai so, itai so, itai so, itai so, itai so it, itai so, then I put people [10:50:8 inaudible] handiti. Why do I do that? Because, that person iyeye kana akazowana trouble, anorangarira kuti iye waimbowomera? Anenge akutoda support yenyu. That’s all he will be requiring h’amaona [11:03:09 not audible]

entries.text: Cause, kugarika chaiko unonyatsoona kuti munhu agarika ha’maona.Kumba kwamai vake chaiye zvaari kuita pano hadii…? [Congregation says, “haaiti,”] haiti ha’maona. entries.text: Vaskana varipano vanoramba kana kurukana musoro. Munhu anoshaiwa munhu anomuruka musoro pano. Zvonzi ini handizi kuda, ini handizi ummm, ini handizi umm, ini handizi umm. entries.text: Kana aroorwa manje, aroorwa manje, anenge aroorwa nabrother, brother vanonamata, Brother Felix ava, Brother Felix ava vanoita garden handiti. Wazoona Felix manje haachaunza muriwo futi. entries.text: Vanhu ava vakagara mumba maPastor. Pamba paPastor panodyiwaka. Saka ivo vakudzimba dzavo chikafu changa chakudii…? chakunetsa nenhamo. entries.text: Vanenge vakuda kutokwikwidzana napo kana vabva pano. You see the mistake hee. You don’t do that. Hanzi, “Pay your tithe and offerings in my house kuti muwane zvokudii…? [Congregation says ‘zvokudya’] zvokudya.” [Congregation says, “Amen”.] Ende, we have proved kuti whenever we have, tinochengetana. [Congregation says, “Amen”.] Hatimbofa takaita mistake iyo…? entries.text: Hatimbofi takaita mistake yekuti munhu ano starv-a [to starve] ari pakati pedu. Hatiiti izvozvo. Ndosaka mukaona nanhasi Mai Gwemende tinavo but Vana Gwemende vakashaya kudha…? entries.text: Vanenge vatimukira vakateundeka tinoregerera, vana Shimei. Makavaona vana-a, vana-a Katewe. Ndosaka munhu kana akatadza kudzidza mukuona kuti Katewe anga ari officer. entries.text: Basa iroro rekuenda kuMainga riya isupport yebasa raMwari [Congregation says, “Amen”.] Manje ukaona masisters edu, iwo masister aya ukawona munhu aita problem, ivo vana Sister Shilla nana Sister Edna vaita problem yekuti tanyanyisa kusiiwa kuMainga hanti muri kuzviona. Ko hanti wakati,” KuMainga tagarisa takuda kubva kuMainga,” tikakubvisai kuMainga he! Takakuunzai kuno kutawundi makuti futi, “Kutawundi kwacho kwandiri kugara handidi ndoda kwakati.” Ko murikuona kuti munhu anenge aine problem haagutsikani. “Ndakuda kuenda kuChinhoyi ndigare hangu naSister Patty.” Ah-ah, ko iwe! entries.text: And ukaona uyu ndozvaakataura uyu hanti’maona. Then-n anonzani uyu, Ednar. entries.text: Even akaita president he’s a dictator. entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: Ndosaka isusu vanhu vaMwari kubata basa raMwari hakuzi kubata basa raMwari uri-i munhu uya wekutii unenge uchiita zvekugomera kubvisa mari, Ah ah. Dzimwe hama unonyastoona kuti anenge achitoda kuita kupfuura ipapo, but ndozvaakwanisawo panguva i…? Brother Gwendere vakati ndoita chakati, anogona kutora nguva yake pamwe mari ichimunetsa panguva iyoyo but he always keeps his pro…? [Congregation says, “promise.”] He always does, ha'maona.

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: Hanti’moona manhingi aya ndovakati ndikuda kunhingikira, roof vatoisa voga Brother Gwendere ka ku- kuKwekwe. Ndivo vaita futi izvi. Mapuranga e-ese atakaita e brand aya ndivo. Hanti’munoona ndivo variku… zvese, and ndivo vatenga futi zvima boards izvi. Saka ukazoona Gwendere next time ka ei a- a- a asimudzirwa handiti. Osiya vamwe vake kunyange vari veruzera rumwe chete, zvine mubvunzo izvozvo kuti why? “You cannot outgive God” [Congregation says, “Amen”.] But ukaenda kune dzimwe hama, dzimwe hama dzikangoita mari, ah-h kupakura! entries.text: Ndosaka mukaona kana kuBritain tichiti Brother haikona kudaro. Kune dzimwe hama dziri kuBritain dzisina kumbobvisa kana major contributions kubasa raMwari. Iyoyo unoi feel-a kuti ndakabvisa ndaka contribut-a [ to contribute ED] pakati, ndakabvisa pakati. Ndosaka mukaona hama dziri kuBritain, dzinongoita fluctuate growth yani…? [Congregation says, “yadzo”.] Vanoda kuita zvavanoda. Akada kukubatsirai nekako ka area kadiki ikako, okubatsirai ka area kadiki ikako. But chinondinakidza mabrother iwayo anoti ndoda kupa kuhama dzangu ndapa kuChurch too much ngaa wire mutrouble arikuno kuZimbabwe, Hama dzake hadzi…? [Congregation says, “hadzipo,”] hadzipo.

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: Ndisu tetichiita connection yedu, network yedu, tetichibata vana Kakunga kuMarawi, tichimuitira handitika.Tobata kunoku totora mari dzangu dzinenge dziri dze tithes ndichimupa, dzaanozodzora paanenge azowana, ndatozopopota futi, at times. Mu’kuona zvazvinoita. Manje unoropafadzwa zvakadii kana wakadaro. Munhu anoropafadzwa, munhu anobata basa raMwari nomwoyo unoda. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe! Kana uchibika, uripa duty rokubika “…do it as unto the Lord…” Yah! Ha’maona, kana uri kuMainga “…as unto the Lord…” Kana tichivaka panze apa “…as unto the Lord…” handi’moona. Kana tichiita basa rese raMwari, ukange wapfuma, wawana mamiriyoni kamura waka sununguka [Congregation says, “Amen,”] uchiisa kubasa rani…? [Congregation says, “raMwari,”] Huh. Haikona zvekupa kupa zvekunyengedzera zviya zviya moziva mapiro ekuti…?

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: Ndosaka nhasi uno munoona Pastor venyu vari zvavari nhasi. I don’t even remember how many people borrowed money from me and i don’t even remember how many did not return. But one thing that i know is I’m not missing it. Hanti’maona kunaka kwenyasha dzaMwari [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ehe.There are so many people who took away from me, so many people! Ha’maona, but i’m not missing it ha’maona. Saka so far so good pama officers edu atinawo, the new breed yema officers iyi irinani pane yekutanga yana Marisa.Ahh yana Marisa yanga isingapi chinhu, neyana Gusiwa. Ahh! Regai vaende vanhu vaya. They were parasites,ha’maona but mabrother edu ese mukaona vana Brother Nehohwa , vana Brother Chuma ava haaa. Vakange vanayo vanopa vana vaMwari ava. Vano supporter zvisina mubvunzo havana nhetemwa kana vana Brother Banda, vana Brother Garamukamwa, they really go out of their way to support God’s work. Ehe unoyatsoona kuti maofficers aya a- vave nekamwe ka vision kari nani. But I want that to be even greater than that pabasa rani…? [Congregation says raMwari,”] ehe.

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: More sacrificial kubasa raMwari, ngatipindei tiite more sacrifice, kubasa raMwari kupfuura zvatiri kuita izvozvizvi hamaona. It’s never enough, until Church yaself su…? [Congregation says, “sufficient,”] Yeah! The Church must be self-sufficient. Tofanira kuva nenzvimbo yakaita seinoi ine dzimba, maauditorium, makitchen kuti munoita michato ha’maona. You should have places like this two or three muHarare hamaona. Moziva kuti haa maavanhu vaMwari manje. Zvikoro, zvipatara, mabhazi, marori asiri ekubira hurumende. [Congregation laughs.] Hamutorere hurumende ayihwa. Toda Ruoko rwaMwari pahupenyu hwedu [Congregation says, “Amen”.]

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: Ehe vanhu vanoenda kunotorera hurumende vachiti tiri kuita dhiri, dhiri uchiuraya nyika yako! He! Ende munhu wose arikubira hurumende arikuzvidii…? [Congregation says, “arikuzvibira”.] arikuzvibira ha’maona. Ndosaka they put that structure in place yeku horesa vamwe soup,sugar vachiita outreach dzakasiyana siyana, migwagwa yokuenda kuma rural a…? [Congregation says, “areas,”] areas, ha’maona. Of course, you will get wicked ministers, vanoba. Izvo siyanai nazvo izvo ha’maona. Ndakazvibata kuti ukanzwa Mwari vachiti, “I will rebuke the devour...?” [Congregation says “devourer”.] Hakuna mwana wapresident anga ari corrupt anosara akagara zvakanaka pai…? [Congregation says, “panyika,”] panyika. Any President who’s corrupt look at his offspring. Inogaraa ichi ti…? [Congregation says, “tiza,”] tiza.

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: Kana mamuri va- vana VaChombe kuDRC uko munokugara ukokuya after nyaya iya. Unenge wakunotsvaga nyika dzese dzeku tetenderera. Wealth iya haina kwaino- inoparara yo…? [Congregation says, “yose,”] yose. Mwari anotevera mari yake. Maministers akazviita enrich nekutora mari dzevanhu handitika, dzinege dzichifanira kuenda kuchembere dziri kuGokwe iwe wodhya mari iyoyo urika mupfanha kadiki ke forty years karika Minister handiti. Uchaona kuti vana vako zvinovadii…? [Congregation says, “zvinovatevera”] zvinovatevera. Same mukunamata ukabata zvinhu zvaMwari nehunzenza, uchiita zvekuti zvinhu zvaMwari uchitora mari yaMwari uchidya uchienda uchinodya mari yaMwari kuSheratoni uchinyenga mahure. [Apostle laughs] He. Uchishayina nemari yaJehovha. Unoziva chinonzi kuzvisikira moto muziso.

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: Hanzi, “I will ‘rebu…?” [Congregation says, “rebuke,”]. Mwari vazoti votevera mwana wemufundisi uya uya ndopamunoona mwana wemufundisi achiita kudzedzereka kudaiwo, mapitikoti akarembera panze.Woti aah! Chii? Chii chaakabata i fanta? i coko? Haa, i ginger ale? Wotoona kuti aihwa, i milk stout chaiyo doro chairo. [Apostle laughs.] Kuti ndiyani mwana uyu. Zvikanzi aah kuti ndiye Esther? Woona akapenda akadai, “Bva zviya zviya izvi ini ndine hupenyu hwangu. Baba vangu vaiparidza ini ndino chaya beer. [Congregation laughs.] Ah-h, ndopaunozozviona kuti aah Mwari ndiitirei nyasha. But kana wainamata Mwari zvakanaka, izvozvo ndizvo zvinondidzora all the time. When I look at my children every day, i know kuti there Is nothing that i will do now, that God cannot make me pay, He will visit my children.

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: Now when he does visit your children, brother even if if when you are in your grave you will turn twice. Ndosaka munhu famba “Holy holy to the Lord God all…?” [Congregation says, “all mighty,”] ha’maona. Ukanamata zvakanaka Mwari vanotaura kuti ndichachengeta mbeu yako. [Congregation says, “Amen”.] I have always been touched neMagwaro akaudziwa Dhavidhi naMwari. Dhavhidhi akanzi naMwari, “Kana ukaita kuti vana vako vaterere Shoko, vana vako handivabvisi pachigaro, vakaita chivi ndichava tsiura neshamhu dzevanakomana veva…?” [Congregation says, “vevanhu.”] But pachigaro handivadii…? [Congregation says, “handivabvise”.] You see! Vapfanha vaya vaiti vakaita musikanzwa vonyatsoudzwa kuti, “For thy father’s, for thy father, David’s what…?” [Congregation says, “sake, Amen”.]

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: “I’m a jealous God, [Congregation says, ‘Amen’,] who visits the iniquity of the forefathers and the fathers unto the fourth and tenth what…?” [Congregation says “generation”.] [Apostle chuckles] Saka iwe usafunge kuti unobuda.Haubudi kana ukaita zvechitsotsi. Ndosaka kana mukaona, don’t worry about even these people. Hushe chaihwo chaihwo hwekutonga VaMugabe period yavo yavakapihwa ndiMwari akavapa. Whoever is going to come next, we don’t know but God does and Mwari vanenge vazvitend...? [Congregation says, “vazvitendera”.] Aka abuser vanhu munhu iyeye zvinodzoka kuvana vani? [Congregation says, “vake,”] vake. Never goes away. Ndosaka imo muno matiri mukunamata munomu uri kunamata Mwari here iwe? Mumweya nemuyi…? [Congregation says, “nemuzvokwadi”.] Namata Mwari mumweya nemuzvokwadi, munhu wese aripano ngaashandire Mwari. [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ehe. Uchiziva kuti you are answerable kunani…? [Congregation says, “kuna Mwari,”] kuna Mwari.

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: Tikange tiri mumunda tirikushandira Mwari, ini ipo pandinenge ndiri pano paMarlborough pano ndirikushandira ani…? [Congregation says, “Mwari”.] Mwari. Don’t you think kuti I’m not answerable to somebody hakuna zvakafanana nai…? [Congregation says, “naizvozvo,”] huh. Saka iwewe ukange wawana pfuma ziva kwayabva pfuma [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tenda Mwari nepfuma yako. [Congregation says, “Amen”.] Take a tenth, wabhadhara chegumi chako. Tora offering woisa apa pamberi apa, wapedza kutora offering yako, tora missionary fu…? [Congregation says, “fund,”] fund. Woisa apa, ehe. Paunotora offering yako woti, “Mwari offering yangu iyi,” ha'maona. Ndikuda kuti iyendewo kunherera dzino chengetwa pamba peMurevhi. brother aya, was aaah twenty-seven people handitika. Vana twenty-seven, do you know kuti isusu panapa, vana tine twenty-two. Hatisi kutaura ma adults. Acho atiri kuti ma adults ma ophans ndovana Precious ka ava. Precious baba namai haa…? [Congregation says, “haana,”] haana.Touya pana Pami, baba namai haa…? [Congregation says, “haana.”] Toenda pana Gift Matope baba namai haa…? [Congregation says, “haana”.] We are more than an orphanage here. [Congregation says, “Amen,”] Vamwe venyu mune maparents one, one, baba. Vamwe vanongori namai, vamwe vanongori nababa, vamwe vanongori namai. We are orphans here, handi maona.

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: Manje pano tino ranger up to almost kuma thirty so…? [Congregation says, “something,”] then woona munhu asingagoni kusupporter panhu pakadaro. Uno surpoter pakaita sei? Iti, Mwari ndibuditsei munyama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Heeemei! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndibuditsei munyama. Ndosaka Pauro akati, “Handikwanisi kutaura nemi nekuti muri munya…?” [Congregation says, “munyama,”] muri munyama. Ukutaura nemunhu ari munyama anoona sekuti uriku enricher Pastor. Just like somebody thinks his enriching Comrade Mugabe kana achibhadhara ta…? [Congregation says, “tax”] tax. That’s what they think these people. That’s not it. Now iye zvino tarirai muone sabotage yekusada kubhadhara tax muno muZimbabwe has been an ongoing scandal for years. Ini ndorangaraira inini kubva tichangobuda muRhodesia,vese vana- mabusiness man akaita sana (no audible 37:49:7)anga asinga bhadhari chii…? tax.They, they played with their books.

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: Now look what they have done to our country. Go to a hospital [Apostle claps once] hakuna chinhu, endai kuvana vechikoro mabhuku haku…? [Apostle claps his hands once] hakuna, madrugs [Apostle claps once] hakuna. Chifambai nemota dzenyuka dzamatenga dzakanaka idzi, dzinogara dzaka dambuka masho…? [Congregation says, “mashocks,”] mashocks handiti. Mastreet lights hamuna, phone macoper wires maba hamuna. Hatichionai mbavha zvadzinodii…? Zvadzinoita. Matransformer maba, hamuchisina. Mbavha dzakupinda mudzimba dzenyu dzichibvisa maradio, dzichibvisa matyre heee. Rottenness in a community backfires on the individual [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ha’maona.

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: Ndosaka kana uri munhu aka ngwara handitika, uri munhu akangwara haufi waka endorser munhu ari corrupt muhupenyu. Ukaona munhu achitaura corrupt language yekuba, unoziva kuti one day that guy will take tyres from your car. One day that guy will take your own t-shirt pa wire apa.That same guy will take away from you at night your own cell phone. Why do you think kuti mukaregera society ichi corrupter it will all - you will always be immune? It will get to you. Zvino iye zvino tarirai muone zvaita society yenyu. Who is not suffering? Takabvira kudhara kusada kubhadhara tax. Vanenge vachingo dodger kuda kuti tax yacho iite shoma isaende kuhurumende he tikupfumisa vakomana varikumhanya pano nemotorcade, vari kudii he-he-he taramba handitika. “Hee- variku tibira vaba, vaba zvadai, zvadai, zvadai.” Kuba kunogara kuripo [Congregation says, “Amen”.]

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: Imi mukureva kuti Bush paakabva pagovernment iyi iyoyi iripo iyi haana kuba? Saka mukureva kuti Obama paachabva haabi? Heh. But kuripo kuba kwakanaka munhu mutema haasati adzidza kuba ikoko. [Congregation laughs] Munhu mutema mabiro ake akapusa! But murungu anoba. Varungu vakagara vachiba kubvira kudhara, kubvira kudhara. Moziva varungu vai runner mahospital edu evana General kuGweru uku, ndakaudzwa, Brother Matapura ndovakandiudza. Kuti, “Pastor, varungu vaitenga zvitofu zvichinzi general hospital zvouya zviri ten, vopanana top grass yese five, kuGeneral hospital koenda five che…?” Chete but here is the good thing. While the white man would steal five stoves ano maker shuwa kuti facility iriku runner zvakadii…? [Congregation says, “zvakanaka”.] Zvino munhu mutema chaakaipira atora five zviya vanopanana handitika. Oudza foreman anova muzukuru wake pachipatara ichocho kuti atore chimwe chiya chadii……? [Congregation says, “laughs”.] Hanti’munoona munhu mutema. Muzukuru wake achatora chiya chiya, he, ende muzukuru wacho anosvika kumba kwasekuru vake oona chitofu chiri…? [Congregation says, “chiriko.”] Ndozvitofu zvakauya kuhospitoro kaizvi, ehe. Otanga kuvandalizer chiri kuya uku. Mukuona mabiro acho. Vanhu vatema vanoba zvine hubharanzi. Nzara, mombe yabva kusina chii…? [Congregation says, “sora”] sora, ha’maona.

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: But iwewe neni manje tiri vanhu voMweya [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chese chaunenge uchiita uri paimba yaMwari, uri kuitira Mwari. [Congregation says, “Amen”.] Ngatigarei takadzidza izvo…? [Congregation says, “izvozvo”.] Ehe! Ndosaka title yemessage yedu takaiti God’s training! God’s training, character is not a gi…? [Congregation says, “a gift”] a gift! ha’maona. Character hachisi chipo ha’maona, Musikana ane character unomuona achimira mira oga haavati, haana hunyope handi’maona. Manje mukaona vekurara ivava vanhu vekuti mukagara navo pasi mukavabvunza kuti Pastor [40:35:0 inaudible] unomuona kana kutsvaira chaiko mumba kuno munetsa, kuwacha ano wacha hembe dzake che…? [Congregation says, “chete.”]

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: Haadi vana, haadi kuichinja napukeni,huh. Mwana akaita poo unoona vachitiza vese, kuti vanhuhwirwa mmm mmm mmm mmm, but ivo vanoita poo vachigeza vese vakagara imomo yemunhu mukuru. [Congregation laughs] Havabudi heh hanti’moona kuti mweya yesvina kaiyi. Kamwana kakaita poo toti, “Haa ahhh mwana aita poo uyu ahh, dirai freshener eeeh dirai freshener haa,” But mumwe wavo anenge ari mutoilet ari apa iye achigeza apa anotiza? [Congregation laughs] Ndopandakabata kuti mweya uyu kauyu., vanhu vanosema va…? [Congregation says, “vana,”] havadi mabasa heh. Poo inonhuhwa yemwana neye munhu mukuru ndeyipi? [Congregation laughs] Hamaona. Saka unenge uchi nyatsowona kuti haaa iyi i feck yevana ava. Behaviour haina kumira zvakadii…? [Congregation says, “zvakanaka,] zvakanaka iyi, handi maona ehe. Vanhu vangori vain. Zvavanowana, iye zvino munoziva kuti kuwana mang’cu chaiwo, mealie rice yaive neprize imwe chete nemupunga handitika. Just because iri available, havaide.

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: Zvikangowanda zvinhu, kana ari mang’cu, awandirei and hatichaadi. Beans dzikawanda, hatidzide. Beans brother chikafu chinodyiwa everywhere, beans is top notch iyo, heh. It’s always incorporated in what they call British breakfast handiti ndizvozvo.Tinned beans dzinenge dziri…? But unoona masister achiti haa beans, haa beans, haa beans, haa beans, beans, beans, haa beans, beans, beans . Unoona vachikutaurira kuti usavi hwapera, usavi hwapera, ukanovhura fridge unoona misoro yehuku yaakazara kuti pa, half yesaga yemusoro. Woti, “Aah, koimi mati husavi hapana sei?” Voti, “Hapana misoro.” Yet kwaaakabva aitetena misoro zvisingaiti. [Congregation laughs.]

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: Havachadi misoro, havachadi nzondora, mukuona- hanzi vanhu kana vari munyama ha’maona. Misoro yaitengeswa mu- mu muma dish pamabhawa, ichipera kuti hwamu. Baba vakatozouya vakadhakwa vaine packet yeplastic ine musoro mairwirana imi vana imi. [Congregation laughs.] Asi nhasi musoro uyu havachadyi misoro kana nzondora havachabata, handi maona. Ndozvinonzi, “Handigone kukutaurirai zvinhu zvomweya nokuti muri munyama” [Congregation says, “Amen”] ha-maona. Hatichiendai kuno jeka. Mukaona magariro atiri kuita panapa, there are…magariro anonzi ari o…? Opener.Magariro e eye opener. Unoona munhu achitaura brother kuti handisi kuona progress yatiri kuita paChurch. Brother, he doesn’t know how many people have gone through school. He doesn’t know kubva kunherera, mainfants atenge tichichengeta. Primary level, secondary level, tertiary level he, tinenge tanavo ve…? [Congregation says, “vese”] vese. Anenge achiti vanhu ivavo vari kudyei? Ari kuti vari kudyei vanhu ivava ende vari kurarara kupi ? Ari kubhadhara mabhiri emvura nemagetsi ndiyani ? Tigovaka kwese heh.

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: Kumbira Mwari manheru anhasi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Iti Mwari make me aware. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Make me awa…? [Congregation says, “aware”.] Ehe! Make me aware of my responsibilities, make me aware of how much committed I should be hamaona. Ndopanouya nyaya yekufurirana nesha…? [Congregation says, neshamwari”.] Ukaita zvekutamba neshamwari , shamwari dzinokubvisa padestiny yako. [Congregation says, “Amen”] Shamwari inokubvisa pa de…? [Congregation says, “destiny”.] Ehe. Unobviswa pa destiny nefriend. You will lose your destiny because of a friend, huh. Each one of us hanzi naMwari, “Muka bhadhara zvegumi zvenyu, muchibvisa missionary fund yenyu, muchibvisa maofferings enyu ndinozaririra window rede…?” [Congregation says, “redenga”] kusvika tinoshaya pekuisa mai…? [Congregation says, “maropafadzo”.] maropafadzo. Thus says the Scripture [Congregation says, “Amen”]

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: But ukawona hama isingabvise manje, hama inenge isinga bvise kana chinhu inoramba iripa nzvimbo imwe…? [Congregation says, “imwe chete”] imwe chete.Anenge achingo gomera. “Haa brother Gumbura vanopfuma sterek brother,” but haasikuziva kuti kugara kwakatoita Brother Gumbura ikokoko zvatomurerukira iye. Munoziva kuti vamwe vanhu havatombotarisi kana vakadzi vavanorara navo mumachira kuti, how did these gerls- girls become what- their wives huh? If you would think you would not even be burdened, kusupporter basa rani…? [Congregation says, “raMwari”.] Vanhu vazhinji havazvifungi. Munhu uyaaa ari munyama, ha’maona. “Ndingago tauraseiko zvinhu zvomweya kumunhu ari munyama.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Munhu ari munyama haanzi bisa mari. Ndosaka unoona munhu a- kana ari munyama anotanga kukubvuzai kuti, “Moda kuti ndiende kuChechi, kuChechi kwenyu kunobviswa chegumi here? Heh, moda kuti ndiende kuChechi yenyu… Pastor wenyu ane motikari ngani? Moda kuti ndiende kuchurch anogara kupi Pastor wenyu?” handitika.Pastor wenyu anogara akapfeka ma suit,” Ahh. Handi’moona, kuti this guy is in the flesh [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: Ar- ari munyama murume uyu hand’moona. Haugoni kumutaurira zvinhu zvoMwe…? [Congregation says, “zvoMweya,”] but mupfanha anenge akabarwa patsva! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe mupfanha anenge akabarwa pai...? [Congregation says, “patsva,”] patsva. Akatendeuka mupfanha uyu. Ndowaunotanga kutaurira kuti, “Shamwari hatisi kuita competition nedzimwe church. Tine Ministry yaMwari” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengei hedu rugwaro rwedu VaKorinde vekutanga, kurefresher memory yedu, so that we get in the same spirit. 1 Corinthians chapter 3: verse 1: Hanti’muchaziva title yedu. [Congregation says, “Amen”.] Hativerengei verse One tese, tese: And I, brethren, could not speak unto you as unto spiritual, but as unto carnal, even as unto babes in Christ.

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: Murikupaona [Congregation says, “Amen”.] Ndiri kutaura nevanhu vari munya…? [Congregation says, “munyama”.] Ndohama dzino remerwa nekutsvaga mari yebasa raMwari. Basa raMwari rinoda vanhu vanonyatsori supporter nemwoyo inodii…? [Congregation says, “inoda”.] Kureva kuti munhu anoisa first priority muzvinhu zvaMwari, iye ozviisa number two. But mabrothers mazhinji i don’t know why, anongo mhanya kuda kunonotenga imba yake.Omhanya oenda onoona kunoita zvinhu zvake, mota yake yakanaka handitika, omhanya oenda onotenga dish oisa katelevision but chimutarisa kuti kuChechi aka contributor here zvinoenderana here nezvaaita ipapo, zero. But arikuda kuti ropafadzo rekutenga madish iroro, rekutenga motokari rekutenga rese ribve ikoko kwaarikudi…? “Your action speaks louder, than your words.”

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: Munhu wese anotenda kuti hutano hwake hwunobva kuna Mwari, anoisa chunk yakakura kuna Mwari. [Congregation says, “Amen”.] Hanti’muku panzwisisa ipapo? [Congregation says,“Amen,”] ehe. Hanti’moda kuti musimudzirwe kuma basa, murikuda kuti status ichinje, murikuda kuti hutano hwenyuka huite come to you speedily, murikuda kuti light renyu riite as assured as the morning light handiti. Who is going to assure all that? Ndi Mwari, saka ngatifadzei Mwari kutanga. [Congregation says, “Amen”.] Ndosaka Bhaibheri rakati, “Seek ye what…? [ Apostle and Congregation say, ‘first’.] first.” Tingaita Ameni here ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi, “Seek ye what …? [Congregation says, ‘first,’] the Kingdom of…? [Congregation says, ‘God,’] and all these things.” Hemeni [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “…All these things shall be…? [Congregation says, ‘added.’] “All these things shall be added” [Congregation says, “Amen”.] But manje vazhinji vedu kunamata kwacho ndokwavanenge vachi zengurira, anozeza maservice, mari anoisa nhetemwa, but anoti Mwari ndikomborerei ndiwane mari yakawanda, ootora ka one dollar oisa kuna Mwari, zhinji oenda onotenga zvaanodii…? [Congregation says, “zvaanoda”.] zvaanoda. Kana kuendesa kumabasa enya…? [Congregation says, “enyama,”] kana kumaproblems emhuri yani…? [Congregation says, “yake,”] Dzi- yekwake, kwaMwari kuya kuya kwongo sendeka, asi ari kuda kuti Mwari amupe yakawanda yekuti akwanise kusupporter kumba kwake.

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: Vazjinji venyu hurombo hwamunawo ndoanonzi mavanga enyo…? [Congregation says, “enyora,”] mazvokuda mavanga ei…? [Congregation says, “enyora.”] Kana wakuda pfuma munhu waMwari, pfuma hainetse kuuya. [Congregation says, “Amen”.] Pfuma yakataurwa naMwari mauiro ainodii…? [Congregation says, “ainoita”.] Hanti ndakakutaurirai takatora maseries aya ha’maona ehe. Takatora ma series aya. Ekuti, pfuma inotsvakwa sei…? [Congregation says, “Amen”.] Hauite dhiri, haubatani nema Nigerians, haubatani nevatadzi, haubatani nema corrupt people. Pfuma inotsvakwa nekutsvaka Mwari kuta… ? [Congregation says, “kutanga,”] Ndapota mumwe nemumwe wedu manheru anhasi, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] iti Baba ndiburitsei munyama. [Congregation says, “Amen”.] He-emeni! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba ndiburitsei pai…? [Congregation says, “munyama.”] Ehe, ndibisei munyama ndikwanise kuoona zvinhu zvomwe…? [Congregation says, “zvomweya,”] zvomweya.

entries.title: God's Training Character Is Not A Gift
entries.text: Munhu wese ano supporter basa raMwari can never go wrong. [Congregation says, “Amen”.] Every brother, every sister ano supporter basa raMwari, “you can never out give God.” [Congregation says, “Amen”.] Impossible! But zvisupporte uone uchiunganidza uone kuti unopera zvakadii? Unongoti broom- broom- broom-broom- broom, broom- broom,bom- bom , broom- broom- broom- broom- broom, broom- broom, boom- boom, but vanoita kusupporter raMwari the sky is the li…? [Congregation says,“the limit”.] Tamirirwa hama dzakawanda funny ku broker kaisu kwemako……….
