entries.text: Then vakadzi vaine pamuviri tanga tisinganzwisisi. Takanetsa mukadzi waaa Brother…? [Bro Makaza says, ‘‘Kaseke.’’] Kaseke aine nhumbu, imi kaimi. Ini ndichibatana kuti inini, Noah Chawanza, Richard Musharu takasangana tiri vatatu tikamu persecut-a mukadzi iyeye, akaona rima. [Congregation laughs] Tiri vatatu, ndozvataidii izvozvo…?

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Taidzidziswa izvozvo but as time goes on uchiramba uchiverenga Spoken Word neBhaibheri, Mweya waMwari wakauya! [Congregation says, ‘‘Amen/Hallelujah.’’] Hee iye zvino I’m human huh, ndinotoseka ahh huh…? Kutsanya kwedu kwaiva komweya yesvina. Forty days, thirty days, twenty-nine days, ten days, fifteen days; ndomatsanyiro edu.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Takazoti taverenga Bhuku rinonzi, Enticing spirits takaona kuti handii…? [Congregation says, ‘‘handizvo.’’] Haaah! Ini zvababa vaya I’ve had enough of him. [Congregation laughs] I’ve had enough of him. Mwari ngavandiregerere ipapo. I’ve just had enough of him ha-moona ehe. I’ve just had enough of him, ha-moona! Hameno zvavo vasinga mudii…? Vasinga muzive kana kuti vanoti achinja. Ende vanoti achinja vanenge vachiti achinja pachii. Vanofanira ku judg-a kuchinja kwake ndivanani? Ndisu. The man hasn’t.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndopakapinzwa vana Sister Vimbai ava, Gumbura ava ikokoko. Vana Sister ehh… Munaki, Patricia Munaki vana andi-i-andi-i the list is endless. The list is endless, you just cannot finish ha-maona. Then ndobva vati muno muchurch munomu hatiparidze Serpent Seed nokuti hakuna chinonzi serpent seed.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Do you know why? Why? Why would a man refuse serpent what…? [Congregation says, “seed."] Ndopa ndakabata chizaruro changu ipapo. Ehe, iwe kana uri munhu woMweya unochibata futi ipapo. [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation laugh] Why would a man refuse serpent seed, hamuona? Ndopandakabata chinhu one kuti aiwa i-nga-ngatingosiyanai nazvo zvinhu izvi.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: If a man couldn’t see serpent seed ka, I can’t see him achiona Marriage and what…? [Congregation says, “and Divorce."] It’s impossible! It’s just literally, practically impossible. Ende muchaona kuti as he realises his more threatened than what he thought, the persecution gets grea…? [Congregation says, “greater,"] greater.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Iye zvino the hatred is serious. Iri pa level yekuti tichahayirwa ma assassins ha-maona. Because he has taken as many people as he has wanted, but the Church has never f… closed or folded up and that’s worrying him. He thought by that move, Chechi yekuno ichavha…? [Congregation says, “ichavhara."] Vanhu vachienda kwaani…? [Congregation says, “kwaari."]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndichingopinda muHarare Mwari avakufumura ivo manje, kutotisimbisa ku…? [Congregation says, “kuno."] Hatinyengeterei varanda vaMwari [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Change of status iyi ka iyi, kwandiri inini it’s a ni- it’s a matter of survival. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] It’s a matter of life and what….? [Congregation says, “death."] Change of status, ndoda kuona munhu wese achidairwa neropafadzo remari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ropafadzo rehutano hwakadii…? [Congregation says, “hwakanaka."] Ropafadzo remba yakanaka, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] mota yakanaka. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatidi kugara zvinonzwisa tsitsi muno muHarare. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndinoaziva mafangiro ani…? [Congregation says, “avo,"] avo. Would be called every name known. KuGweru we could do with anything. Munomu ka umu tino inva-dwa even one day, nema-nema nhingi, nema paid up reporters. But I want him to come handitika. Vanhu vomuno muHarare, vanhu venyama vanoremekedza zvinhu zvenya…? [Congregation says, “zvenyama."]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ehe ndoda kuti vachisvika, vakasvika vakaona kunenge kwakarara ma brother acho, havana chananodii…? Chavanosvora. Vakasvika vakaona patinodyira… All I’m doing this; I’m preparing for a war because I know one day that war will go public. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ende anotitengesa public vamwe ve….? [Congregation says, “vedu."] Vamwe vedu ma brothers aya.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ichabuda chete nyaya one day sometime kunzi, ‘endai munoona magariro aanoita nevasikana vaanogara navo nevakamana vaanogara navo. Endai munoona magariro acho ari unhealthy. ano breed-a ehh chorera. Hationei zvatingaite pachiri padhuze, let’s stop this ehh menace’. Varivo vabhadhara ma reporters. You will wake up one morning muchizviverenga. But I want that time when it does come, Mwari vakatipa warning ka…? [Congregation says, “kare, Amen."]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: I don’t want to be caught unawares like I don’t know what I’m doing. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handidi! Ndoda kunyatsomeka shuwa, ha-maona, kuti kana vakauya vakandiwanira mhosva ngavandiwanirowo dzimwe. But magariro ande ndakaita whether ndine vana forty, magariro anenge akaita vana ivavo even the best schools; private schools don’t look after children that way. [Congregation says, “Amen."]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: We don’t leave no stene untorned panyaya iyi! Ndosaka kuteura kwandiri kuita ka uku, ndiri kuteura ndakatarisana nekuziva kuti we have plenty enemies in here. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ma enemies acho akadii…? [Congregation says, “Akawanda”.] Akawanda vanhu vaMwari. Akawandisa ma enemies acho! Hazvipe-haapere ha-moona, ndosaka ndoda kuti brother vamwe nevamwe vati, ‘Mwari status yangu ngaisanduke.’ [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndoda kuva nemari, Mwari tsurai mweya yemai…? [Congregation says, “yemadzinza, Amen."] Mwari tsurai mweya yemadzinza. Mwari tsurai kusanamata. Mwari tsurai hudheni. Mwari tsurai, mweya yetsvina.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndosaka ma sisters edu ndapota vana vaMwari rega kuunza mweya wetsvina muKereke! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mudzimai wese ane potential yekuunza mweya wetsvina muKereke kana akadanana nemunhu wemui…? [Congregation says, “wemunyika."] Muri kupanzwisisa ipapo? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndopanonzi, “God’s word calls for total…?” [Congregation says, “separation.”] Ha-maona.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Mukadzi wese akadanana nemunhu wemunyika unounza spirit pa Church, yeku rebel-a kuShoko raani…? [Congregation says, “raMwari."] Ende unogona kunetseka kuzobatsirika hupenyu hwako hwese. Vazhinji vakadzi vanozopedzisira vahedhuka, kana vaapaa ma spirit mediums muhupenyu hwavo; ma secret affairs avanenge va conduct-a nevanhu venyi…? [Congregation says, “venyika."] Ma secret affairs avano conduct-a nevanhu venyika. Mwana waMwari anonamata mirira zuva rako rokuroorwa! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Rinouya chete zuva iro…? [Congregation says, “iroro."]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Huh, like a great poet one time who was a sympathizer of polygamy wrote these great words, “there shall be no widows in the land for I’ll marry them all, [Congregation laughs] and there shall be no fatherless orphans because I will father them all.” Hamukuona kutenda kunoita munha waMwari handiti ehe? [Congregation says, “mmm.”] That was a poet handitika. I think he was called Tennyson kuma 15th ce…? [Congregation says, “century."]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: He was a sympathizer of polygamy, “the-there will be no widows” zvikanzi, reason of widows in the land handitika it’s mono…? [Congregation says, “monogamy,"] monogamy. If he didn’t preach me-monogamy, there will be no widows in the land because we will-I’ll marry them all. Ha-moona, and there will be no orphans, fatherless one because I’ll father them all ha-moona. Ende ndo policy yedu yatinayo pa…? [Congregation says, “pano."] Hakuna sister vanofa vasina ehh murume mu Church inoparidza ba…? [Congregation says, “barika,"] barika.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: No, that’s why you find vana Sister Gwemende vagara vasina varume kwenguva. Reason it’s because ehh matendero edu. One; chokwadi chiri kunyatsobuda pachena tiri kuchiona chese chokwadi but tiri kutya kupinda mai…? [Congregation says, “machiri,”] machiri nemoyo unoda. As a result, progress yedu yava s-eh-eh retarded. Vanogoroora vakadzi vaviri sei, iye munhu kana pekuisa mukadzi one asi…? [Congregation says, “asina."] Hmm? Kuti uti brother ndiudzei papi, tika-tikabvisa hedu vana takatopinda kare mubarika ka isu. Vana Brother… Chuma varimo kudhara, vana Brother Nehohwa varimo kudhara, ini ndirimo kudhara.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Tikatora zvifana zviripo izvi angaroore ehhh Sr Chipo Chipato ndiani? Patrick angazvigone? [Congregation laughs] Kureba chete ka uku handitika ehe…? [Congregation laughs] But mufana ka uyu handitika. Angazvigone Patrick, ha-moona…? Ende Chipo manje nekudzidza nekugonawo kutenga zvinhu zvake zvakanaka, ane kahupenyu kake kaanako mupfungwa dzake. Kekuti ka, anotoka maintain-a ari woga than with a brother because kuroorwa nabrother kutodzorerwa pai…? [Congregation says, “pasi,”] pasi pane zvaanoziva. 101Zvandiri kukudzidzisai pano kuti unotenga mubhedha wako, base nemattress iye anozvidii? [Congregation says, “anozviziva.”] Kuti kunotengwa masheets, iye anozviziva. Saka unenge wododzidziswa iwewe naChipo kunzi, masheets edu haachakwana. [Apostle Gumbura laughs] Ha-moona kuti manje, saka zvinenge nani zvake Chipo akazvigarira akanamata. Handi muona mamiriro azvinenge zvakaita [Congregation says, “mmm.”] Ehe zvotori nani ha-moona. ende vacho ma brother anenge achikwanisa kuti aroore, vari kuto strugg-ula nevava navo ka…? [Congregation says, “kare."]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Mukanzwa ndichiti vanhu vaMwari ropafadzwai handisi kumbozviitira inini. [Congregation says, “Amen/mmm."] Hatidi kuti… toda kuti paChurch pano paite crisis yevasikana vachipereredza. But iye zvino ndo crisis iri pano? [Congregation says, “mmm-mmm."] Havana kwokuenda vanhu vese ava. Havana kwokuenda ava ha-moona. Havana kwokuenda vanhu ava. Ukaona munhu achiti, ‘ndogona kuvaroora, ndogona kuvaroora.’ Ini handi… even munhu anoda kuita barika handitika. Kana uchida kuti barika rako riite, unogona kuti mukadzi wako ouya otaura na pastor, woti, ‘ndoda kuti kuuyewo mumwe mukadzi’. Handitika.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Inini ndinoterera izvozvo ndogamuchira handitika. But ndikaona mukadzi iyeye owonda ndoita sei? Achi lo-za weight, achinyepera kusekerera kuti ‘ngavauye vamwe ii ngavauye’. But mwana achipera; kupera, kupera, kupera. Handi munhu akangwara unoona. [Congregation says, “mmm.”] Kuti haaa ahh ahh, I don’t think this girl is meaning it, mmm. Pane pressure iri…? [Congregation says, “iripo."] Mukadzi akaita saMai Zane zvikanzi, akati, ‘ndiri kuda kuti uuye uite ehh kana concu ra-ra raPastor’. Uno doubt-a kuti mai ava vari kufara? Handi vaka kubvunzai pabhavhudheyi pano, kuti handimuri kuona kuti ini ndiri kufara, hee.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: But kwete kuti, ‘ndoda kuti mainini vangu vauye, ndoda mainini, ndoda mainini kuti vauye.’ Wotarisa mwana, changa chiri chivhindikiti handitika? Chiri kudii…? Ukamuvhunza, ‘iwe unorevesa here kuti oda kuti mainini vauye?’ ‘Ehe ii, ehe ehh.’ Unozofunga kuti izum zumu ka. [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation laugh]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Munhu ngaadzidze kuita honest handitika ehe. zvauri kutaura ngazvienderane nemataridzikiro aunodii…? [Congregation says, “aunoita,"] ehe. Ndoda kuona munhu aka-chivhindikiti handiti ehe, chichifara uchinyatsoona chichifara nemurume wacho, vachiseka, vachiita sport. Even ukava spy-a so vari vega, uchinyatsoona vanhu vachijamba jamba, vachisekerera. Unogona kuona kuti that could be a good addition, that would be a happy family.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: But kana ukaona vanhu vacho, hautombo vaoni pavano pavano jamba jamba kana pavanotamba. Hauvaoni, haa. Hauvaoni pavanojamba jamba. Mumwe munongomuona. [Apostle Gumbura illustrates] Achipinda muchechi handiti…? Waona murume wachowo. [Apostle Gumbura illustrates and Congregation laughs] Aah ini ndiregerei.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Aah handi ndiro basa revafundisi iroro? Iwe unenge wakatarisa zvako wakamira kudai uchiti, ‘haaa izvi ka izvi hee’. Izvi kwazvava kuda, kwazvava kuda kuenda handi…? [Congregation says, “handiko."] Ha-moona, toda ha-happy couple! Happy couple you don’t, you don’t publicize it. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] ndoda-toda one accord pakati pemudzimai nemuru…? [Congregation says, “nemurume."] And I don’t want kuita yekutaurirwa kuti, ndiri kufara. Don’t tell me that! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Pari kufariwa panonzi, ‘ndiri kufara?’ [Congregation says, “mmm-mmm."] Unoona woga. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hazvimbonetsi kuti uone kuti vanhu vari kufa handiti. ini ndinoona ndoga. Ukatarisa iye zvino zvakaita, muri kuona Mai Chuma ava vakuru avo, naMai Chuma vadiki ava, iye zvino vari kufara vanhu ava. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Haumbozvi… hazvimbonetsi kuo…? [Congregation says, “kuona."]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ukaona Mai Chuma vakauya panapa vachisekerera munhu wese vachimhorosana nevanhu ‘mhoroi, mhoroi…’ woziva kuti… Wotarisa Mai Chuma vadiki. Avo ka Mai Chuma avava is srow [slow-ED] ka avo. Vanongouya vachimhorosa zvavo, ‘makadii henyu, makadii hee hevoi.’ Vombomira zvadzo uchinyatsokuona kuti mudzimai ane muviri wake akasimba. Then kouya vamwe vanenge vakabata ka handbag kavo manje. [Congregation laughs]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Vachisvika kumoto kwese uko. [Apostle Gumbura chuckles] Avo vanosvika kwese, kumoto kwese vanenge vachisvika, vaenda kwana gogo vadzoka vava mu kitchen uko handitika ehe wonya... Idzo dzichifamba dzichita…dzichitarisa tarisa zvadzo handiti, woziva kuti this woman is free. [Congregation laughs] But kana pasina freedom unozvidii…? [Congregation says, “unozviona."] Vakadzi havanetse ku reveal-a kuti hupenyu hausi kutidii…? [Congregation says, “kutiitira,"] hupenyu hausi kutiitira. Vakadzi havanetse, unotozviona kuti uyu mukadzi akasuwa uyu. Uyu mukadzi haazi kufara uyu, uyu mukadzi uyu akasuwa uyu, uyu mukadzi haazi kufara.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Pakatanga kusuwa vakadzi vangu, Mai Tito ava naMai Kim asina kuzviona ndiani? Let’s be honest, pavakanga vari kuKadoma uko hamuna kuzviona mese? Vakaonda ka vanhu ava, zvakaonekwa nemunhu we…? [Congregation says, “wese."] Ndopa ndavatora ndikavaunza panapa ha-moona. Vakapera vese kuonda, kupera vese kupera kuita mabhonzo. Mai… Chionai Mai Tito naMai Kim nhasi mukaona vachifamba apa. Vaingoda kugara padhuze nababa. [Congregation laughs] Takatorapa chirwere ichocho kudha…? [Congregation says, “kudhara,"] kudhara ha-moona ehe.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ukaenda ukanoona iye zvino, right now as we are talking madzimai aGwendere ese ari maviri avo. Havazi kufara here madzimai aya? Madzimai aGwendere aya, haazi kufara? Mukaona Mai Gwendere vakuru kusununguka kwavanga vakaita pa-pa-pa party handitika. Ehe vachibatana nemumwe wavo, vachitova nyorera zvipepa zvekuti endai munotenga zvakati, endai munotenga zvakati. Mhemba iyi ichifara. Unonyatsoziva kuti kumba kuri ri…? [Congregation says, “kuri right,"] kuri right. Kwete kuti Brother Gwendere vouya vondiudza kuti, ‘ehh ndiri kugona barika’. Ndinotarisa mhuri, mhuri inotarisa yo…? Yoga.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Until pavakanga vari mu lounge umu, handi manga muri vaviri mu-mu mu lounge umu. Makasvitsa Shoko here kumunhu waMwari? Makasvitsa? Ehe ndikati o-o vanga vakachena and they were happy. Sister ava vaiita, vaishanda naBrother Chuma ava handitika. Uchinyatsoona kuti mwana akasununguka ari kufara achiseka akaenda kuvana uku akaseka achifara. Wotarisa Mai Gwe vaine murume vachienda vachinotenga zvinhu vachingo revers-a vachidzoka. Zvokuti Brother Gwendere va… vakadzi vavo vakawuya vakati, ‘taiichikumbira kuti mutiwedzere mukadzi wechitatu pakati pedu’, unonetseka?

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Unenge wakungomakirira munhu, unotaura kuti, ‘ahh brother vakadzi vako hutano kwakanaka vana...? [Congregation says, “nahwo."] Ende pane… patinenge tiri pachechi vari kudii…? [Congregation says, “vari kufara,"] vari kufara.’ Ko ukaona munhu anenge achifamba akadai…? [Apostle Gumbura illustrates and Congregation chuckles] ‘Makadii sister?’ ‘Makadii Pastor?’

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation laugh] Woti, ‘uyu munhu ka uyu ari kutivhara uyu, there is something wrong so…? [Congregation says, “somewhere."] Yeah!’ Iwewe unenge uchitadza kuchi plac-a manje inini handisi munhu wokuti uno… ndinopaparika, I take my time. I’m a really chameleon panyaya dzakafanana nai…? [Congregation says, “naidzodzo,"] naidzodzo. Ndotarisa kuti chii ha-moona, moona.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Until ndozoenda manje kuma mothers aya ndoti, ‘imi ma mothers imi ndimi mainditi ohh tarirai mhemba iyi yaifarira barika iyi handiti ko chovaonza chii? Why is she losing wei…? [Congregation says, “weight,"] weight. When she gave us another story just a few weeks a…?” [Congregation says, “ago."] Anokupai story yake akasimba handitika, achingopedza kutaura nyaya yake, muviri wava kudii…? Todzorera here ku New Start Centre? [Apostle Gumbura chuckles]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Handi muri kuzviona vanhu vaMwari handiti? Ndosaka kana vanhu vachidanana brother, panouya munhu wechitatu iwewe nemukadzi wako iwawo wiriranai! [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ha-moona. Unozviona kuti madzimai arikufara aya, ha-moona. Brother Nehohwa mudzimai wavo mukuru akandi text-ira woga zvikanzi, ‘Pastor I’ve been helped greatly’. Vakandinyorera tsa…? [Congregation says, “tsamba."]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: ‘I’ve since changed my being and everything zvekuti ndinotonyara kuti ndaimborwisa.’ Ivo havatombozviziva kuti vakandinyorera tsamba ha-moona hamuzvizive…? Zvikanzi, ‘Pastor mungadei muchifunga kuti ndichiri zvandanga ndiri. I have since changed and I’m asking your prayers kuti ndirambe ndichichinja. Handicharwisa, handichadai handichadai, handichadai, handichadai.’ I never told the brother.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndozvamusingazive vakadzi manje, vakadzi ava vanhu ava, haikona kumumanikidza kuita zvinhu kana kumubata nehungwaru nekuti vanomhan’ara zvokuti dhuu. Ende vano assess-a, ndashama nhasi ndataura naMai Chibvura ava.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: VaChibvura vakandifonera nezuro manheru zvikanzi, ‘mudzimai wangu ahh aita stubborn, andirambira kuti ndamuti udzokere kwaMakoni mangwana’. Akati ‘ndiwe uri kundikonzera kuita stubborn, uri kundidzidzisa stubbornness. Ini handisi kudzokera kwaMakoni ikoko.’ ‘Ndikati sister munoziva zvamuri kutaura here?’ Hanzi ndikanzi, ‘ehe!’

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: ‘Saka vati varikuuya kwamuri saka ndangovati endai.’ Hama yandiudza handitika. Saka sister vauya vasvika vagara pano ndikati, ‘ko nhai hanzvadzi zvino zvomoramba kutumwa kwaMakoni.’ Zvikanzi, ‘ahh handina kuramba kutumwa kwaMakoni, kwaMakoni i one hour kuenda, one hour kudzo…? [Congregation says, ‘kudzoka,’] kudzoka netsoka. Saka ndakati kana muchida kuti ndiende kwaMakoni rwendo rwuno, mondisiira mari yechii…? Yebhazi, nekuti kuti ndidzokere futi netsoka uko ndigodzoka.’ Ndikati, ‘hoo?’ Zvikanzi ‘ehe saka ndaizeza kudzokerako because Pastor pane mufambo.’

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndikati, ‘horaiti.’ Ndikati, ‘ko zvino nyaya ye stubbornness yamuri kuti, vanondidzidzisa kuita stubborn?’ Zvikanzi, ‘Pastor nyaya inodzokera muchaziva paya patanga kukanganisika munhu waMwari? Waingogara ari mu alter call achingoti, ‘kunamata kana kwakadaiwo unoregera. Kunamata kana kwakadai unoregera’. Zvokuti ndakaa ndofunga kuti, ‘munhu waMwari uyu akuhedhuka ende ada kuhedhuka nesu te…? Ipapo ndopa ndakatanga kuita stubborn ndaaku guard-a nyaya yekudzokera kumai…?’

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Handi muri kuona vanhu vakangwara ka ava…? [Congregation laughs] Ndikati makamboudza here murume wenyu kuti izvozvo maizvi observ-a zvese izvozvo, mmm? Zvikanzi, ‘handina kumbovataurira.’ Ndikati, ndopamava…. endai munogara pasi muvaudze kuti you used to observe all those things,’ ha-maona ehe. Zvikanzi, ‘manje vakazoti mumwe musi wavabva kuMaenga uko. Vakadzoka vakasvi… ‘Ndaperera pano,’ [Congregation laughs] hanzi ‘zvokunamata, ndaperera pano!’ [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation laugh]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Handi muri kuona ehe…? Ma sister anenge aine record aya, vamwe vano observ-a zvisingaite zvekuti ne… Munoziva kuti e-akatanga kugamuchira Message ndiBrother Chibvura, avo avakazonzi huyai kuChurch vachinetswa nemhuri yavo ne family yavo. I was mesmerized ne observation yavo. Vanotoziva nema times acho kuti ‘patakaenda kumuchato waBrother Chigova avo’ ha-moona…? Vakatodzoka kumba vakati, ‘munhu waMwari akundivenga.’ Ndikati, ‘ahh sei?’ Zvikanzi, ‘ndava simudzira ruoko kudai, havana ku respond-a.’ Ini, I don’t remember kureva kuti handina kuzvio…? [Congregation says, “kuzviona”,] handina kuzviona. But ivo va… Zvikanzi, ‘aah’ ha-moona. Vanenge vachi observ-a zvese sister ava. Vachi observ-a ha-maona aihwa.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Saka ukaona mukadzi akuita stubborn fanga mu Church munomu, haikona kumhanya kunofunga kuti haachade kunamata. Tanga waita self ex…? [Congregation says, “examination.”] Saka ndaichiti kuna Brother Chibvura, ‘Brother Chibvura imbogarai pasi nemhuri yenyu iyi, muva bvunze kuti iyo stubbornness yavari kutsanangura iyi inotangira ku…? [Congregation says, ‘kupi.’] Inotangira kupi, ha-maona?’ Zvinhu zvaanenge anga achi observ-a ha-maona…?

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Zvikanzi, ‘iye zvino Pastor ndinoda kunamata zvekuti ndinototya kuti stubbornness iyoyo mweya iwoyo.’ Hanzi, ‘ini ndakasvika pandakaoma moyo zvakau-nyanya kunyanya tichitanga kupinda mu Message ndakambokuudzai.’ Ende zveshuwa vakataura. Zvikanzi, ‘takachinja machechi asingapere naBrother zvokuti ndaakuda kuti ndichizorora hangu ndinamate pano.’ Vakauya vakandiona nguva idzodzo ha-moona…? Saka zvikanzi, ‘taka-ti saka inini zvokuchinja machechi handichadii…? Handichadi ini ha-moona…? Saka ndakai ndongonetseka, ndakaoma moyo nguva iyoyo.’

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Saka handimoona kuti hama ndoinofanira kuva ne healing process yainounza kumukadzi wayo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] But she’s more than a willing partner, kuti atungamirirwe nehama iyi. ‘Pastor chindinamatirai. Handidi kuita stubborn kumurume wangu. Zvinongoerekana zvangouya Pastor, zvokuti ndoshaya kuti chii? Ende ndiri kuona ndokwa zviri kubva. Dai ndikanamata, ndikapinda panzvimbo yangu.’ But handi moona kuti kuti ava vanyotsokwana panzimbo yavo, vanofana kutora yavo ndiani…? Hama.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Taizviparidza kubvira kudhara kuti musoro wechitima ukabuda mui…? [Congregation says, “munjanji,"] munjanji. Ma troc anodii…? [Congregation says, “ano turn-a.”] Kazhinji ma troc unozoasiya mudo…? mudondo, ha-maona. Unonyatsoona kuti mwana uyu kunamata a-a arikuda kutodzidzawo, nekudzidziswa nehama.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Now, that’s what all women are like ha-maona but unogona kuva munhu ari intelligent. Some brothers are so intelligent like me, handimunoona kuti ndakangwara chaizvo…? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvekuti you can make a woman do what you want her to do, but not that she wants to do it. Handi muri kuona zvauri kutaura, ehe. You can make her do what you want her to d… or say what you want her to say but not to say she wa…? [Congregation says, “she wants.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Now don’t be that oppressive. Let’s not be that oppressive! Let’s give our wives room, handi tiri kupabata ka varanda vaMwari handiti, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ngatipei vakadzi vedu room yokuti tifambe navo. Kana uchida kuvaita coerce into something, let’s make them come to a well–informed decision handiti ka…? Rather than kuvaita outwit out of their simplicity, I don’t think that’s fair. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha-moona.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Hatitorei vakadzi vedu zvakanaka tichimuvha navo, tichi muvha navo, tichi muvha navo, tichi muvha navo. Now I’ll teach you kuti inini that’s what I’ll do. I’ll give you examples every time when my-my-my life, handi forc-ekedze munhu chinhu. I don’t force anybody, anything. It’s only that now example yandoda kupa it’s not yet mature but it will mature. Ndichaku remind-ai kuti that day ndakakutaurirai kuti example iyi i-it’s in the process, it’s not yet ma…? [Congregation says, “mature.”] Ndotora nguva yangu handi-handi coerc-ese munhu, handi force-ekedze munhu, ndoda kuti munhu aone oga. Akaona oga, munowirirana.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Nyaya yandaakuparidza yema concubines iyi handitika. I was actually forced by situation kuti ndiiparidze iye zvino. This wasn’t the time I wanted to preach it. Ndaida kuvapa…kukuparidza nyaya iyi ndapedza kuva…? [Congregation says, “kuvaka,”] kuvaka panapa. That was my intention, but conditions got out of control. Satan akawana paakapinda nani…? [Congregation says, “napo,”] napo and I had to quickly address the subject or-o zvainetsa vanhu mukuna…? [Congregation says, “mukunamata,”] mukunamata.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Then I was forced kuenda kuno i address-a prematurely, I never wanted to ha-maona. But ndaida zvangu ndimboiregera yakadaro, ndoiregera yakadaro, then ndapedza kuvaka panapa zvandiri kuita zvese izvi. I wanted to do these-all these things before tambo mention-a not even one word about concubines ha-maona. But brother chandaakukutaurirai ndechekuti Satan ariko and anorwa. Ende anouya nenzira dzausinga dii…? [Congregation says, “dzausingatarisire.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndakazoibufura ndaona kuti ehhh, kwandaiswa kwacho kwadii…? Zvino ndorasikirwa nemakwai kwawo, cause any genuine man ka anongonzwisisa kuti wazvidii…? Wazviitirei, you have to go and address a situation. So, I quickly went and addressed that situation not that it was ripe, no! Taida kutovaka Convention Centre. Tipedze kuvaka Convention Centre, ti develop-e kuKadoma. Then totaura nyaya yema concubines.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Maybe, pa 65 years apa ndopanda ndaka target-a inini. I’d given myself 65 years even in prayer kuti Mwari pa 65 years. I never wanted to talk about it now but, you never do what you want. Maybe Mwari vari kuziva kuti handirarame kusvika 65 years idzodzo. Nobody knows ha-maona. Saka unogona kunzi now, itaure izvozvi ha-maona.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Saka mumwe nemumwe wedu why did I take that long? Ndakabvira… Ndikakutaurirai kuti nyaya yema concubines takaitanga tichitanga kutenga imba kuRedcliff kwa Pastor Chuma. Bvunzai vana Mai… Zane ava nana Mai… Bati handiti…? Ndiani wandaive naye tichitenderera kuRedcliff ndichikuudzai nyaya iyi? Tai… Ndiani aivepo paye? Imimi nani? Paive naMai Tito, Mai Kim nani futi? Who was there? Maive two chete? Ahh, musi uya taive two chete uya, maive two chete?

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Iwewe naMai Kim na-na-naMai Tito muri two? Patakatenderera Redcliff iya, tichitaura nyaya iyi, maive two chete? I can’t remember, remember that. But then tapedza ipapo ndakangabvira kuitaura kubvira kare but you see how I’ve kept my promise, I’d never say it. [Congregation says, “mmm.”] Ndaivaudza ava kuti, ‘ayihwa, hatina chatati taita. Taparidza barika, barika taparidza but taparidza barika, pa… rinoita complete kana taparidza nyaya yemai…?’ [Congregation says, “concubines.”] ‘Ko munodii kuiparidza?’

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: I’d tell them my reasons, this is this reason, this is the reason. ‘Chechi haizi ready tarirai hondo yatinayo pabarika.’ But muri kuona kuti iye zvino barika tanga takurihwina? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Pakapinda vana Jeremiah mu-k-mumu scandal idzi, vana Mpofu mu scandal idzi tanga tangosara ne one bastion of resistance, yaVaChitsinde ndobva kwapinda nyaya dzema ferti-raiza idzi. Saka muri kuona tatahwina? [Congregation says, “mmm.”] Saka ndopatati taidei takuisa chapter iyi kumasu…? [Congregation says, “kumashure,”] tomuvha ku next cha…? [Congregation says, “chapter.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Unomirira Mwari, Mwari kuti vazarure mukana! [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ha-maona. I wanted my wives to accept it bit by bit, bit by bit, bit by bit, bit by bit, but vakanga vaigamuchira here madzimai angu? As mmm… ehh… ndavaudza background vese vana Mai Zane vanozviziva ndichivatsanangurira background iyi. But patakauya panapa, tava panapa paaa Marlborough panapa you could see kuti they are still resisting nyaya yema co…? They didn’t want. Zvakuita sekuti uri kutova dzidziso ipapo but wanga uchizvitaura all the…? They didn’t want!

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Vese vana Amanda vanga vasingade they were not ready for it. Vese vana Mai Tito vanga vasingadi. Vese vana Mother ava vanga vasingadi. Wotoona but I have spoken for over five years they are not ready. But ukazviita manje munhu pfungwa yake yagamuchira handiti…? Anotadza kunamata? Anouya mu Church akafara maona. Ndosaka ndikaku… mu-mu-mukaona haikona ku force-ekedza mudzimai kugamuchira zvinhu zvaasingadi, it’s not a solution ha-maona.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ende haikona kumhanya kungonoroora, kuroora it’s not a so…? [Congregation says, “solution.”] Ehe, ende kana uri mwana muduku very dangerous kuti kana uri mupfanha ari below thirty years upinde mubarika kazhinji.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: You have to be very careful because vapfanha vane tendency yekuti vakarara nevasikana, mukuona problem ine vapfanha? Akarara nevasikana anofinhiwa nani…? Vapfanha vanofinihwa nevakadzi. Akarara naye two-three times, haachamuda aakuda chii…? Aakuda mumwe. Oenda kune mumwe two-three times, haachamuda. Haazive kunonzi kugara nemukadzi. Anokurumidza kurakwa, kudhinhiwa, pride, immaturity.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Zvemunhu anopisa dura munguva yemaguta asingazive kuti drought iriko gore rinodii…? [Congregation laughs and says, “rinotevera.”] Ndozviri vapfanha vazhi…? [Congregation says, “vazhinji.”] Ehe, ndosaka muchiona vapfanha anonyenga musikana nhasi, ku-ku-ku-ku-ku kuHatfield. Odanana naye three-four months, [Apostle Gumbura claps hands once] osiya. Aanomumwe kuHigh-firidzi, odanana naye three-four months, [Apostle Gumbura claps hands once] osiya. Aanomumwe kunhingi, eh ku-ku-ku-ku-ku kuMebhoraini three-four months, [Apostle Gumbura claps hands once] osiya.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Mweya wekuti munhu unorara nemusikana womusema, mweya waAmnon. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] That is not Biblical! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Murau wekuna Deuteronomy, waiti munhu kana ukabata musikana mhandara handiti ka…? Ukaiii deflower mhandara iyoyo unofanira kubhadhara mubereki wake how many…? [Congregation says, “50 shekels,”] and haufanire kumura…? [Congregation says, “kumuramba/kumurasa.”] Saka musikana wese murume aimu deflower equals to marriage. Munhu aku deflower equals to marriage ndoMurau waani iwoyo…? [Congregation says, “waMwari.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Is that what is there now? No! They deflower ha-maona, you deflower a virgin handitika. Wokaramba kasikana kaya kaya apa, wakadzidzisa varume, handitika. Kachagona here kurarama kasina? Kakunotorwa nemu….? Uya uya mumwe okadii futi, okasiya. Konotorwa futi nemu…? Uya mumwe futi okadii…? Until the woman becomes a woman without shame, haa. Any woman who undresses before ten men achafa akanyara…? Ten men, uchanyarei haa?

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Kuona musikana achifamba akashama kubva pano kuenda kunotora bhurukwa rake raasiya uko, haa. Opfeka ikoko odzoka, ouya otora hembe yakandwa uko handitika, odzoka pana aMarange handitika. Svondo inouya ari kuita the same kunaani…? Kuna Edgar handitika. Svondo inouya ari kuita the same kuna VaMukodzi. Svondo inouya ari kuita the same kuna Silas. Waona Svondo inouya ari kuna Chibvura, Svondo inouya ari kuna VaKakunga ha-moona. Inotevera yacho ari kuneni, haa mu-mukanyatsotaura naye zvakanaka muchimu nyengetedza kuti mira apo wakashama anodii…? [Congregation says, “anomira,”] anomira. [Apostle Gumbura claps hands once. Congregation laughs]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ahh wavindisa ka uyu handitika ehe, ehe mukati chiuya umire panapa chingomira chete haa iye zvino hauzi kudii…? Hauna zvauri kuitwa, toda kuti Ungomira chete. Ndosaka uchiona vasikana vachibuda pa front page ye magazine, those are not virgins. Kuchitariswa nenyika yose akashama hazvimunetse because she has undressed to so ma…? [Congregation says, “so many,”] so many. Over twenty, over forty men, what difference does it make mmm?

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: But mhandara brother, kuii-kuikururusa kuti bvisa hembe chete hembe/ munonetsana. Bvisa hembe tione wanzwa, ‘handidi, handidi, handidi, handidi, handidi’ chibvisa to… ‘handidi, handidi’ hee. Moita zvekuto bvarurirana handitika but kana aziva manje, akabva apa, akabva apa, akabva apa, akabva apa. Kanouya panapa tanana. Ndosaka mukaona manje tuzhinji twacho tu-tu-tu tuma hure utwu tunopfeka mini inosvika uko, half pant kadrezi kachitangira apa ma bum ese ari pai…? Panze, kongoperera panapa guvhu riri pai…? [Congregation says, “panze.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ka body top kanoperera apa, mazamu ese ari pai…? panze. Musana uri panze ende kagorova high hiri irefu kudaiwo kuti tee tee Harare yose ichidii…? Vari mumota vanenge vachicheuka, bhe-pee bhe- bhe ma-va Pedestrian mbee, vemabhasikoro nde-nde-nde. [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation laugh] Kuratidza kuti mwana uyu zvaaita handi…? [Congregation says, “handizvo.”] Vanhu tatojaira iye zvino ne society yatiri kugara mai…? [Congregation says, “mairi,”] ha-maona. But isusu panapa we are believers in Divine Marriage. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Prostitution hatidi zvacho…? [Congregation says, “zvachose.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ehe, Mwari vanofanira kuti daira nekuti ropafadza ha-maona right, ma brother edu ngaachiropafadzwa ka aite mari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ende gona kuchengeta mukadzi wawui...? [Congregation says, “wauinaye.”] Ndinoona vakadzi vaunavo, haikona kumbozvinetsa nekuuya kuzondiudza kuti ndoda kuroora mukadzi wechipiri, ndoda kuroora mukadzi wechitatu. Gona pane wekudii iyeye…? [Congregation says, “wekutanga.”] Mmm, toda kumuona aine majuzi ake maviri, mabhachi woitawo mangani, maviri. Bhutsu dake oitawo ngani, mbiri handimunoona zvinoita munhu ehe, madre-zi ake oitawo kana kuti matatu.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Zvino ukaona mukadzi handitika. Aine tudrezi twenha…? [Congregation says, “twenhamo.”] Tumajuzi twei…? Tumabachi twei…? Baba vacho voti ndoda kuwedzera, iwe uri Pastor, does that make sense? [Congregation says, “no.”] Ngatione mukadzi wako zvaanenge akarova nhasi. Nhasi akarova mink coat yake yaasonesa. Ahh, mangwana ari mu outfit-i inoyi. Ahh, mangwana ane kabhutsu kakati rebererei, mangwana ane kamwe kaflat. Nhasi ane human hair yeblack mangwana ane tsvuku handitika, ehe? Nhasi ane kabhachi kake ke purple, mangwana ane kamwe ke katema ehka waona arova kajuzi kake handimunoona.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ende mukadzi anobatwa zvakanaka ane confidence. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tingaita Amen akadarika Amen here? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Waona mukadzi ane confidence achifamba apa, brother vouya voti taurai na sister, hUh. Don’t send skeletons to talk to me! [Congregation laughs]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ha-maona. If she’s a skeleton I don’t want to talk to her. Ndopa ndakamuudza kuti, ‘iwe, iwe zvawakawonda kudai chiri kukuonza chii? Sadza muna…? [Congregation says, “munaro,”] munaro, imba muna…? [Congregation says, “munayo,”] mota muna…? [Congregation says, “munayo.”] Uri kuonda nei?’ Ngaatsanangure chiri kumuonza. Kana mukadzi aakufara haubvunze, face inotaura yo…? [Congregation says, “yoga.”] Unoona achisekerera kudai achiita confidence kudai akadai, hembe yakafita yakabata zvakanaka naka. Waona achifamba apa. And the one who gives the confidence is you, my brother. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Nhasi zuva redu reChishanu iri, rataka… dedi-keta [dedicate-ED] kustatus, ini handizi kuzogutsikana kusvika ndaona status yevanhu vari kutsanya ndichiparidzira every day, yasanduka! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Aihwa ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akapfuura ipapo! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mari yavapo, pfuma yadii…? [Congregation says, “yavapo.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Tovaka chechi dzedu panapa toda kuva vanhu… Iye zvino ndaita kana tikadai, nzvimbo ino taigadzira zvakanaka, it will be senseless to destroy a place like this. So, what are we going to do? In the event yekuti tapuhwa license yedu, we let this one be a boardroom, tongoiregera yakadii…? [Congregation says, “yakadaro.”] Or-o ma small practice anenge achiita evanhu e birthday, vana whatever, whatever they want to do.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Then tovaka imwe kuseri uko, yekupinda from Monday to Fri…? [Congregation says, “Friday.] Then kana tava nema conventions tovaka zi…ratinozendemura kusvika uko. Ratinovaka uko tinokwana tese Monday to Friday neSunday, inouya vanhu vekuGweru kana vekuKwekwe handitika. [Congregation says, “mmm.”] Then kana tava nema combined meeting ko convention yedu yatinodaidza nediaspora toenda pane bigger church. Space tina…? [Congregation says, “tinayo.”] Jahwi ha-maona. Toda kunamatira mari yekuvaka! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda mari yokudii…? [Congregation says, “yekuvaka.”] Ehh toda mari yekuvaka. 157Vanhu vaMwari kana muchiita wear off mumunamato, isu tisati tawana mhinduro kudai. Iwewo hunhu hwako chaihwo husati hwachinja. Tiri kutanga neku status yako. Tiri kutanga nokudzinga poverty mauri. Tiri kutanga nekutsi-dzinga mweya yemai…? [Congregation says, “yemadzinza,”] madzinza. Ende as far as polygamy is concerned it’s a forgone conclusion, we are a polygamous Church! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] We believe in Divine Ma…? [Congregation says, “Marriage.”] But hatidi manje poverty, handidi munhu ano strugg-ula pa Divine Marriage, no! Saka ma brother angu ngaasimudzirwe kuta…? [Congregation says, “kutanga,”] zviri zvimajaya.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ngaasimudzirwe even nekurima. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe ngaasimudzirwei even nezvimwe zvinhu zvese zvakawanda wanda. Ngatiitei mari pakati pedu yokuti kunyangwe iwewe ukasasimudzirwa uri individual, mari ngaiwande pano zvokuti hapana anotambura [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndopfungwa yatiinayo! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tovaka panapa. Honai ini ndakakumbira kuti Mwari ngatinamatei handitika. Mwari vakafara sterek nenyaya yedu yokunamata neChishanu. Tarirai progress yatiri kuita pano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Are we making progress? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Moziva takatanga kuvaka zvese zvatiri kuvaka izvi, munaaa muna March. Vana vangu vachivhara chikoro vachienda kuma holidays. Ndichiti ndoda kuti vadzoke ku second term tapedza kuvawedzerera two rooms dzokurara, muchaziva? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vakadzoka second term yacho uku two rooms dzisati tadii…? tapedza. Tikabva ikoko, tikauya muno mu church, tikabva ikoko tikaenda ku-ku kuRose. Tikabva ikoko tika layer zvidhina zvese izvi zvese tikagadzira kwose kwakusati tapedza ku complet-a uko. We... and that is only March, April, May, June, July that’s five what? [Congregation says, “months.”] All this, then you talk about God not answering prayer. Doesn’t He? [Congregation says, “He does.”] Mwari vanodaira munamato! [Congregation says, “Amen/Hallelujah.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ehe, hatipindei pakuteura kusati kwakamboitwa pakati pedu panapa [Congregation says, “mmm.”] Jaya rimwe nerimwe ngariti, ‘Baba, ndinotsiura dzinza rekwedu! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndinotsiura hurombo!’ [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ende kumbira Mwari. Ma sisters ese haikona kufunga pamusoro pe marriage dzine hurombo mukati. Ahh ahh, toda marriage chai…? [Congregation says, “chaiyo.”] Ehe toda marriage yekuti munhu kana aine murume wake, munodada. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Munhu wese anonamata pano akaenda kurudzi rwekake kune vanhu vezera rake, “…you shall always be the head, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] and never the…?” [Congregation says, “the tail.”] That’s what we want, “…you shall always be the head and never the tail…” Ha-maona. Ndosaka mukaona Moses akaudza vana veIsiraeri kuti mirai neShoko, ibvai kuvakomana vomunyika, ibvai kuvasikana vemunyika, ibvai kumudzimu, ibvai pakubatirira pahama zvakanyanyisa. [Congregation says, “mmm.”] Unoenda kun’anga, unorova makuva, unopira mudzimu nazvo izvi. God’s Word calls for total…? [Congregation says, “separation.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Topinda pakunyengetera ha-maona. Ndosaka nhasi uno toda kunamata takanangana nenyaya yekutsvaka ma…? [Congregation says, “mari,”] mari. Toda kunamata takanangana ne… don’t look at Belvedere nezviriko ikoko, Mwari ngavadzorere status yedu! [Congregation says, “Hallelujah/Amen.”] Toda double-portion chai…? [Congregation says, “chaiyo, Amen.”] Zvinotaurwa naVaChitsinde siyanai nazvo, [Congregation says, “mmm,”] vari kutaurira congregation yaani…? [Congregation says, “yavo,”] and we don’t mind about what he says to his congregation, we will never go there. [Congregation says, “mmm.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Handi muri kupanzwisisa ipapo. We will never go there, never! Ha-maona, ngatinamatei takanangana nekuti Mwari sandurai status yedu isusu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari dairai miteuro yedu isusu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda double-portion pakati pedu. Tipedze kuvaka pano tiende muKadoma tivake, tiende muKwekwe tivake. Tione vana brother vari kuzvikoro vachi qualif-aya, vachiita mabasa akanaka, vachitenga motokari, vachitenga dzimba vachibereka vana. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vachipinda mu Divine Marriage yakaguta! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Mhuri imwe neimwe ichiita one accord. Hatitangei kugadzira mhuri dzedu. Ha-moona kunaka kwemazuva ata… mungati kudii imimi. Imagine nhasi handiti, ha-maona kuti Mai Chibvura ndaindichitaura navo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha-moona kuti Mwari anodaira munamato. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chinangwa chaMwari ndechekuti padii pakati paaChibvura nemukadzi wavo? [Congregation says, “paite one accord.”] Handi muri kuzviona. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha-maona kuti Mwari akuda kuti paite oneness, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] He’s already answering pra…? [Congregation says, “prayer.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: ‘Pastor ini ndoda kuita mukadzi akanaka, ndoda kuzviisa pasi pemurume wangu. Ndaka ndapindwa nezimweya iri, ndoda kuti zimweya iri ripere zvachose, handicharida zvachose.’ Isn’t that an answer to the prayer of one a…? [Congregation says, “one accord, Amen.”] Muri kuona nyasha dzaMwari here varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tiri kuona nyasha here ipapo? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] How we would wish every home would be like that. [Congregation says, “mmm.”] Imba imwe neimwe ichisununguka handiti…? [Congregation says, “mmm.”] Kuti murume nemukadzi hapana chinenge chichiri pakati paani…? [Congregation says, “pavo.”] Vanenge vane oneness, [Apostle Gumbura claps hands twice] yakanaka.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Touya kuChechi, VaMarange nemudzimai wavo vachifara, VaMukodzi nemudzimai wavo vachifara, VaChibvura nemudzimai wavo vachifara. Ha-maona zvinenge zvakanaka muChechi? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe, VaNyaude nemudzimai wavo vachifara ha-maona. Toenda pana VaChigova nemudzimai wavo vachifara, VaGumbura nemudzimai wavo vachifara muri kuona. VaNyabeza nemudzimai wavo vachifara. VaGaramukanwa nemudzimai wavo vachifara, VaHokonya nemudzimai wavo vachifara ha-maona. Topinda kuma officer. Then tine ma single sisters asingatye intimidation from the married. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] 167Zvino ma brother edu hatidi kuita vana mwari mudzimba dzedu, you are the god in your home. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Don’t be vindictive to your wife. Rega kuti mukadzi wako akutye never make that mistake kuti mukadzi wako akutye ha-maona. Mudzidzise kuku respect-a [Congregation says, “Amen,”] kwete kukutya! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Maona, ini ndotenda kuti gore rino Mwari vatodaira halfway! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ma request edu o…? [Congregation says, “ose,”] ose ha-maona. Asara mashomana...? [Congregation says, “mashomanana,”] mashomanana, ende anodairwa here asara aya? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Haa ese varanda vaMwari [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ese, Mwari vanodaira e…? [Congregation says, “ese.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndosaka iye zvino tichipinda pakuteura apa; one accord, double portion. kutsiura mweya wemadzinza, kutsiura poverty, handi muri kuona zvatenge tichiku-kumbira. Kuchinjwa kwenzvimbo ino from commercial… handiti from residential to commercial, mari yekuvaka Kwekwe, Kadoma, Harare ha-maona.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Kudzoreredzwa kweMwenga, ku igno-wa zvinobva ku Bherevhedhiya uko zvevanhu vakaramba Message kudha…? [Congregation says, “kudhara.”] Haa vakaramba Message kudhara vakuru vaya, havatende Message zvacho…? [Congregation says, “zvachose.”] Hameno kuti program ye Message yavanayo ndeyeyi? Bro Branham taught that every local assembly, every local assembly, is sovereign and the highest authority in a local assembly is the pa…? [Congregation says, “pastor,”] outside of the Ho…? [Congregation says, “the Holy Ghost.”] But have you ever seen that kwese kunoitika problem ma brother aya anoda kunotora chechi dzacho? Mweya wemuMessage iwoyo?

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: That’s a denominational spirit! Huh, it’s a denomina… vakanzwa kuti Mupaikwa aita problem, vada kuno mutorerai church. Vakanzwa kuti Jeremiah aita problem, vada kuno mutorerai church. What kind of a spirit is that hee? Iwe hauparidzi kwako ikoko ukaguta? Mweya wana Murandu wokutiza Harare kuuya kuzotsvaga chechi yeGweru. Nhai ungaone munhu achitiza kuHarare, kutiza ku capital city uchienda ku provincial city? What’s the normal way to do things? [Congregation says, “from provincial to capital,”] from provincial to capital. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe ndingatize kuno kuenda kunotora chechi yoku Hwange? Zvinoreva izvi kuparidza kwara…? [Congregation says, “kwaramba.”] Hatitsiurei Satan varanda vaMwari! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nguva yekunamata Mwari ndiyo ino varanda vaShe. [Congregation says, “Amen/Hallelujah.”] Tinofanira kuropafadzwa chete! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Handei tinoona kuna Deuteronomy, topedza hedu naikoko. Handei kuna Deuteronomy, ndongo nhonga nhonga hangu ma verse mashomanana. Ndoda Deuteronomy 30, ndo condition yatiri mairi seMwenga iyi. But here’s the promise of God if we follow God’s Word handitika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tasvika here 10? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Deuteronomy 30 vs 1, Condition for Restoration of Blessings, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ndo Message ye….? [Congregation says, “yedu,”] yedu handitika. Here’s why I say that. Verse 1 hativerengei tose, tese! And it shall come to pass, when all these things are come upon thee, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before thee, and thou shalt call them to mind among all the nations, whither the Lord thy God hath driven thee,

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Handimaona ndatora cha… Deuteronomy chapter 30 ka? Hanzi zvandakataura zvose zvikange zvaitika kwamuri, mukaona zvaitika mu Message. Pane chichaitika muMessage chisina kuitika? Maropafadzo acho takaaona, kutukwa kwacho takakuona. Hanzi kana zvaitika zvese izvi, muri pama rudzi amunenge muri iwoyo mucharangarira, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ha-moona kunaka kwenyasha dzaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe. Kana zvoitika kwamuri zvose izvi, zvii zvichaitika?

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Mabamurana, matukana, mashaudhana, maita vafundisi vanoramba Message. Maita vanhu vanorambana, maita vanhu ramba Serpent Seed, maita vanhu vanoramba barika, maita varombo muchinamata for five years, maita varombo muchinamata for ten years. Ma curses ese, you will call to remembrance what I told you. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Kana maakuda ropafadzo racho! Vazhinji vedu iye zvino mukatarisa vanhu vaMwari, vamwe taakutochembera tiri mu Message ka, but ropafadzo hati…? [Congregation says, “hatina.”] Asi taakuchembera tiri mu Message, five years uri mu Message, you are not answered. Twenty years uri mu Message, hauna imba yako. Fifteen years uri mu Message, uri murombo. Ten years uchinamata uri jaya, hauna basa rakati tsvikiti, hauna income. Ma curses aya, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ekubata Shoko raMwari nemi…? [Congregation says, “neminwe.”] But nguva yekubata Shoko raMwari nemazvo ndeino! [Congregation says, “Amen/Hallelujah.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Hatiiti, ‘Baba tidzoreredzei kunotsanya! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tidzoreredzei mumunamato chai…?’ [Congregation says, “chaimo.”] Ini ndinotenda kuti ma brothers ese even kana uchirwara nemukondombera, ukatenda muna Mwari unorarama che…? [Congregation says, “chete.”] Kana wanga uri murombo usina basa, iye zvino right now ukatora Shoko raMwari seriously, saizvozvi tichingopedza kunamata kudai, tichipinda mumuteuro, uchidana paZita raMwari, [Congregation says, “Amen/Hallelujah,”] I tell you my brother a lot can happen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handei mberi tione, verse 2 tese. And shalt return unto the Lord thy God, and shalt obey His voice according to all that I command thee this day, thou [Apostle Gumbura reads with Congregation] and thy children, with all thine heart, and with all thy soul; That then the Lord thy God will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the nations, whither the Lord thy God hath scattered thee. If any of thine be driven out unto the outmost parts of heaven, from thence will the Lord thy God gather thee, and from thence will He fetch thee: And the Lord thy God will bring thee into the land which thy fathers possessed, and thou shalt possess it; and He will do thee good and multiply thee above thy fathers.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika Amen apo! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika ipapo! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handisi kumunzwa Amen iyeye! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Hanzi kana mukangodzoka chete handitika. [Congregation says, “mmm.”] Chisiyana nezve kunyenga vasikana venyi…? [Congregation says, “venyika.”] Siya nezvekurova maku…? [Congregation says, “makuva.”] Siya zvekuda nyika netsika dzaani…? [Congregation says, “dzayo.”] Hatidzokororei nemoyo unoda. Ndosaka kutsanya kwatiri kuita vanhu vaMwari, tiri kuti God return to us again! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Takanzwa Message tikaibata nemadii…? Nemadiro, neminwe.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndizvo zvataitaura ka izvi, takaenda pasi pe Message nana Brother Chitsinde. Takaziva Message? Takaziva chiSengwayo. Hunhu hwemunhu, influence yemunhu ndoyatakasvika pairi. Message hatina kuizi…? [Congregation says, “kuiziva.”] But mira ndikutaurire Bhaibheri iri brother iShoko raMwari ende Bhaibherei ibenyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kana munhu achirwara zvakasimba chaizvo ukatendeuka hupenyu hwako hwese, ukaiswa maoko pamusoro, unorarama! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: We have “…to die what…?” [Congregation says, “daily,”] and grow from “…glory to…?” [Congregation says, “to glory.”] Kana vanhu vachitora zvikwambo vachipfuma. Vana Mhunga, vachichekeresa vachiita mabhazi anodhura akanaka muMasvingo, ziva kuti zvese izvozvo hazvina simba, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] pane Bhaibheri rawakavhura pamberi pako. [Congregation says, “Amen/Hallelujah.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika Amen ipapo! [Congregation says, “Amen!”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Bhaibheri rine simba kudarika izvo…? [Congregation says, “izvozvo.”] Majaya anoda mabasa, wana mabasa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] But ukapinda mu Church brother ukatanga kuti unouuya ku Church uchinyenga vasikana vemunyika, unouuya mu Church uchiviga zvivi, hanzi, “…hasha dzaMwari dziri pamusoro pavose vanobata zvokwadi yake mukudiii…” [Congregation says, “mukusarurama.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Hakuna ngozi futi, inodarika munhu ari kutsiurwa ne curse yaani…? [Congregation says, “yaMwari.] Tamba hako uri muKereke yaMwari uchiita zvaunodii…? [Congregation says, “zvaunoda.”] Ehe, tamba, nyenga vasikana uchiuya mu Church, nyenga vamwe vari mu Church imomo, viga zvinhu zvako, ita musikanza yako, one day you will reap! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ha-maona, I couldn’t help thinking kuti ahh but Brother Kudzai vakauya vakataura neni vakatendeuka but nyaya yavo yanga iri yemusikana wemunyika wavakanga vamititsa handitika. But I thought his accident, muchaziva here story ya Brother Branham vachiti vakanamatira munhu. Vakamupupurira vaenda ku hunting naye handitika. Vamupupurira Brother ava, vaive ne problem ye cigarette smo…? [Congregation says, “smoking,”] ndobva vamunamatira, ndobva vamubhabhatidza handitika.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Brother vaya ndobva vaenda ku hunting na Brother Branham, behind Bro Branham’s back handitika. Ndobva vaita sei? [Congregation says, “vasmok-a.”] What-what happened to him? [Bro Makaza says, “aka break-a back.”] He broke his back, muri kuona zvinoitika…? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Pandakaona Brother Kudzai vachiburuka mumota, vachidaiwo. [Apostle Gumbura illustrates] Ndakati, ‘ahh I hope the young man what he told me was all,’ because kana akasiya ka, iyi warning isingadii…? [Congregation says, “isingaite,”] isingaite iyi. The young man will find himself one day in a wheelchair, mmm.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: That man akaenda akanobhabhatidzwa mu Jorodhani apupurirwa na Brother Branham, zvikanzi, ‘cigarette smoking chiregera, chirega kutora fodya futi’ zvikanzi, ‘I will not take it’. Ndokuenda na Brother Branham ku hunting, vari ku hunting kuya ndobva ango mhanya museri mechidondo ndokubatidza. Kureva kuti akatotakura fodya mu bag rake, aine muporofita. Ndipo pamunoti vanhu pano nhasi vanorega aah-aah-aah-ahh. [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation laugh] Akatakura bag rine fodya nemuporofita [Congregation says, “Amen,”] kwakuenda naro aine muporofita kunyatsodherera kuti Mwari hamuko, kuparidza ma funny, hakuna chinonzi kunamata, ndinoita zvandinodii…? [Congregation says, “zvandinoda,”] heyi!

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ini ndava kuziva kuti Mwari vanotsiura. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe. Ndakakuturirai wani kuti ini ndakaita musikanzwa sanhasi handitika. Ndaita musikanzwa sanhasi ndokudzoka pamba pano, ndandatova pano, ndobva ndadzoka pano pamba apa ndobva ndarara apa handitika. Ndobva ndamuka kuseni Benz yakabiwa, tape recorder, handikutaurirei musikanzwa wandakaita. Ndakapinda ndega ndikabata shaya yangu so ndakatarisa Benz yangu yapwanyiwa window ndikaziva kuti Jehovah vadii…?

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: I just went quietly in the-y… my bedroom ndikati, ‘Mwari I got your message, message yenyu ndaidii? [Congregation says, “ndaibata.”] I will not repeat that, I will not repeat that, whether I like it or not Lord, ndazvibata Jehovah! Ndapota ngazvichimirira pano!’ Masikati acho, ndakandatukwa nemapurisa kuti, ‘iwe mudhara iwe, buda mu road umo, ndip-pfutseke! Zimbwa romunhu!’ Ha-moona zvinoita Jehovah. Ini handizive kuti sei vamwe musinga… Ukaona usingataurirwe ka, ukaona Mwari asingakutsure une chivi kana kukunetsa mukati memoyo wako, don’t you worry, you don’t belong here. Uri kupfu…? [Congregation says, “uri kupfura.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Herino Shoko De-Deuteronomy chapter 30, hanzi, ‘muchaona ndichakuregerai. Ndakuregerai, muchaona ma curses achishanda pane vamwe vanhu. Muchaona ma blessings achishanda pane vamwe vanhu. Pamuchaona zvichiitika imi ndopa muchadzidza kuti kuteerera Mwari kunokosha!’ [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akapfura ipapo! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Hanzi, ‘ndopa muchadzidza kuti kuteerera Mwari kunodii?’ [Congregation says, “kunokosha.”] Ehe muchazvionera moga nemaziso enyu kuti, ‘ohh uyu akaita zvakati curse yake yakapera yakadai, uyu akaita zvakati ropafadzo racho rakauya rakadai, uyu akaita zvakati Mwari akazopindira akadai, uyu akaita zvakati Mwari vakazodai. Muchazviona moga kana mazviona moga muchadzoka kwandiri, [Congregation says, “mmm/Amen,”] muchitsvaga kunamata Mwari muMweya neMuzvokwadi [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi ipapo manje, ndopa ndichakuropafadzai.’

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Dai tainzwa manheru ano vanhu vaMwari mumwe nemumwe wedu. Ugere ipapo you don’t need any more provocation than the preaching of the Word. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Iti, ‘Mwari ndoda ropafadzo rangu Mwari.’ [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Igore re double chii…? [Congregation says, ‘portion.’]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Handei mberi tione, what will happen verse 5, hativerengei tose verse 5 tese, hativerengei tose. And the Lord thy God will bring thee into the land which thy fathers possessed, and thou shalt possess it; and He will do thee good and multiply thee above thy fathers.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Right, ndoda Amen akadarika Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handisi kumunzwa Amen iyeye! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handisi kumunzwa Amen iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen!”] I want you to read verse 6 with understanding, handei ku verse 6 tichi understand-a tese, verse 6 hativerengei tese. And the Lord thy God will circumcise thine heart, and the heart of thy seed, to love the Lord thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, that thou mayest live.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika Amen hama! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ameni iyeye ngapfuure ipapo! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Hanzi, ‘ndichadzingisa moyo wako, nemoyo wevana vani? [Congregation says, “vako.”] Kuti mude Mwari nemoyo ye…?’ [Congregation says, “yese/yedu.”] Brother ukada Mwari, “…to them that love God all things work together for…?” [Congregation says, “for good.”] “…to them that…” what? [Congregation says, “…love God...”] “…to them that…?” [Congregation says, “love God.”] Handisi kunzwa, “to them that…?” [Congregation says, “love God.”] Muri kupanzwisisa ipapo, [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ida Shoko raMwari naMwari [Congregation says, “Amen,”] nemoyo wako we…? [Congregation says, “wese.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Hakuna chausingagone kuita panyika pano, brother kukumbira kwatiri kuita Mwari toda kuti nzvimbo ino iite co..iii..commercial, we are doing this for the glory of God. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ende hazvisi kuzoitirwa isusu chete nema offsprings e…? [Congregation says, “edu.”] Nevamwe vatisiri kuzi…? [Congregation says, “kuziva.”] Vanorambirei Mwari, tiri kuda mari yekuvaka ma church, achasara achipindwa nevanhu isu tafa [Congregation says, “mmm.”] There is no way God can stand in our way [Congregation says, “Amen,”] but vane character yavanoda kuisa pauri. [Congregation says, “mmm.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Hatichemerei character iyoyo manheru ano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handei mberi tione, verse 7 tone where He will put curses now. Verse 7 hationei tese verse 7 tese. And the Lord thy God will put all these curses upon thine enemies, and on them that hate thee, which persecuted thee. Verse 8. And thou shalt return and obey the voice of the Lord, and do all His commandments which I command thee this day.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: And there, when you do that what will happen? Verse 9, ngatiitei Amen tese, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengei tese verse 9 tese. [Congregation reads] And the Lord thy God will make thee plenteous in every work of thine hand, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy land, for good: for the Lord will again rejoice over thee for good, as He rejoiced over thy fathers:

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tingaita Amen akadarika Amen here! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Mwari vakafarira here vana Brother Branham munguva yavo? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndobva Vavaropafadza ka? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ko isu takazorasikirwa nazvo papi? Where did we go wrong? Kutaura chokwadi mweya uri mu Message uyu, hauzi wedenga. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Igahena chai…? [Congregation says, “chairo.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Hatred iri mu Message igahena, hatred inoparidzwa nana Brother Chitsinde iya ndeye gahena iya. The man has been proven wrong nokuda kwekushaiwa ru…? [Congregation says, “rudo,”] rudo. I want you to ask a good question vanhu vaMwari handitika. If Brother Chitsinde is justified zvavari kuita kutuka Mwenga wese nokuvenga vanhu vachiIta mataura mazita ekuti, ‘nhingi is… ndiSatani, eehh dhevhuru mupurupiti’ handitika.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Until tavakutoziva vanhu vavanovenga handitika. [Congregation says, “mmm.”] Chimbondiudzaiwo enemy yaikweshwa na Brother Branham like that. Kuti muone kuti baba ava vane maitiro avo asiri e Spoken Wo…? [Congregation says, “Word.”] He wants us to submit to him, he can’t submit to the man he professes to believe in, Brother Branham.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Pamakambonzwa Brother Branham vachidaro munhu ndepapi? So, you mean Brother Branham had no persecutors or vanhu vaimunetsa? Muri kuzviona kuti murume uya ane maitiro ake asiri eShoko raMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Huh, Brother Branham would never talk like that! I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore, choose life, that both thou and thy seed may live:

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi sarudzai hupenyu nha…? [Congregation says, “nhasi.”] Kusarudza hupenyu kuita ma commandments amakapuhwa nani? That thou mayest love the Lord thy God, and that thou mayest obey His voice, and that thou mayest cleave unto Him: for He is thy life, and the length of thy days: that thou mayest dwell in the land which the Lord sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.

entries.text: Ndoda Amen varanda vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi Ndiye simba raani? entries.text: “Confess your sins one to a…?” [Congregation says, “another.”] We should die what…? [Congregation says, “daily,”] and grow from glory to…? entries.text: Murume mumwe nemumwe ndi pastor mumba make, [Congregation says, “mmm,”] toda Amen kuhama! [Brothers say, “Amen.”] Dzidzisa gwai rako iro, mukadzi wako i reflection yaani…? entries.text: Ini handineti ndikaona kuti pane mweya wandisiri kuda pamukadzi wangu. Ndinongoramba ndinaye chete. entries.text: So that I enjoy her, and we spend the rest of our lives toge…? entries.text: Maiona condition huru yeropafadzo [Congregation says, “Amen,”] tenda muShoko raani? [Congregation says, “raMwari.”] Hatibatei nemoyo ye…? entries.text: Iti, ‘Baba ndoda kutendeuka kuchiva, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ndoda kutendeuka pride, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ndoda kutendeuka back-biting, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ndoda kutendeuka murmuring. entries.text: Mwari vari pano kuti vakuponese. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari vari pano kuti vakupe Mweya Mutsvene. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari vari pano kuti vakusuke nemvura dzeShoko. entries.text: Ndoda kuita one neShoko raMwari. entries.text: Inguva yekusunungurwa mumunamato, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] munhu wese anotenda muna Mwari manheru ano, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] walk free in Jesus’ Name. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatisimudzei tese maoko edu. entries.text: Uri temberi yeMweya Mutsvene. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Dzinga mweya we pride. entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Iti, ‘Mwari ndoda kubuda muno ndabatwa chimwe chinhu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba ndoda ku embra-sa [to embrace-ED] Shoko Renyu. entries.text: Baba wedu tinouya pachigaro Chenyu. entries.text: Mwari ndinotenda pakadzika dzika pemoyo wangu, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] kuti ndava kuparidza vhangeri iri ndariona Mandiitirawo. entries.text: Tenzi tiri kuzvitsaura Baba tinototenda. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda kutenda nenzvimbo yatiri kupindira, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] a comfortable place of worship. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.text: Toda kuisa vatsvene vese Baba wakanaka, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] vachafamba muno muZimbabwe. entries.text: Toda kupedza kuvaka kuKwekwe neku Kadoma. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari tiitirei ngoni mukati memba ino. entries.text: Kana pane ari kurwara ndiyo nguva yake izvozvi. entries.text: Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatikotamisei hedu musoro yedu. Ishe tinokutendai manheru ano. entries.text: Mwari vakuiitirei nyasha to them that believe all things are…? [Congregation says, “possible.”] Ukanamatirwa unopora nhaika hama? entries.text: It's a busy Lomagundi road there, then toyambuka hedu toenda mhiri, then toita ma service edu handitika. entries.text: Ehe, ndofunga mabhiridha arikunzwa chinhu chiri kudya uko, icho! Nezuro chaiva apa handitika. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Makachinzwa ka? [Congregation says, “mmm.”] Saka hama dzazvinzwa handitika. [Congregation says, “mmm.”] So, we need doom filling as yesterday… as of yesterday. Tichazoti tichinamata munomu tichinzwa chichiti, ‘roor roor’ achimhanya umo zvaari kuita kumba kwedu kuMainhouse uko. Pano makonzo aripo nekuti chikafu chiripo. entries.text: So, there we are kune vasina kubhadhara handitika. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] We need our money handitika. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kuti kutenga kuchipedzisiwa makuseni handitika. Then the rest of maybe accommodation maybe tinoitira ikoko mangwana handiti? God bless you, hatisimukei hedu. Let’s finish our song second stanza handitika. They Come from The East and West tanga taa ... I look on the great white throne, (Oh yeah) Before it the ransomed stand. (Oh yeah) No longer are tears, no sorrow …

entries.text: Let’s… let’s get a higher note a bit. It’s a dismissal song we won’t make noise to anybody. Iwoyo maimbiro atatichiita ndo akanaka aya not iyo iya, for neighbours sake handitika.
