entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Tikotamise tose musoro yedu. Hanzi, “Pane vaviri kana vatatu muZita Rangu, [Congregation says, ‘Amen,’] ipapo ndiripowo.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vanokuyeuchidzai kuti, “Gugudza unodii…? [Congregation says, ‘unozarurirwa,’] tsvaka unoita sei…? [Congregation says, ‘unowana,’] kumbira unodii…?” [Congregation says, “unopihwa.”] Hanzi, “Regai munhu wese, ave murevi weyi…? [Congregation says, ‘wenhema,’] wenhema, Mwari vareve chii…?” [Congregation says, “chokwadi/zvokwadi.”] Kune vanotenda Mwari vakati, “All things are possible.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kune vanotenda, “All things are…?” [Congregation says, “are possible.”] Handi’moona kutaura kweShoko raMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Hanzi, “Kumbirai neZita Rangu, kuti mufaro wenyu uza…?” [Congregation says, “uzadziswe.”] Usanzi, “Wakaita chivi ndakusiya.” Mwari akati, “Ndinewe kusvika kumagumo enyika.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Ende ndakakuponesa unconditionally.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Iva nokutenda kwakazara pane chishuvo chaunacho manheru ano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari vanokuitira pakuguma kweshuma… (Inaudible 0:00:56) [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Baba wedu tinotenda manheru ano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda kunaka Kwenyu mukati memba ino. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda kuunganidzwa kwataitwa Nemi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Makati, “Pane vaviri kana vatatu muZita Renyu, [Congregation says, ‘Amen,’] Imi muripowo ipapo.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Makati, “Vaviri venyu vakabvumirana pachinhu, [Congregation says, ‘Amen,’] Imi munochiita kudenga.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tabvumirana kudzinga Satan pano, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] muZita raJeso Kristu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Makativimbisa kuti, “…We possess the gates of the enemy.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Makativimbisa kuti pataisa tsoka ndepedu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Satan come out of everybody! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ungava mumweya wehurombo, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] mumweya wohurwerwe, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] mumweya webopoto pakati pevanhu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toutsuura muZita raJeso! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Come out of everybody Satan! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Batsirai Tenzi wakarurama muyenzi umwe neumwe ari pakati pedu, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] abve pano ajekerwa neShoko Renyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba makanaka vese vangadei vaine pfungwa mbiri pane chokunamata, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] vajekeserei Shoko Renyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba kune vatadza kuva pano tinovaisa muMaoko Enyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba tichiisa umwe neumwe wedu kunyangwe hama dzedu dzisipo pano, ngativei vamwe chete pakunamata. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Kuuya kwataita chitaurai nemweya yedu Baba. Tigobuda muno tichiti, “Zvanga zvakanaka kuti tive mumba Menyu.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Taurai nesu, “Mudzoze maziso edu ne eye salve. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Dzingisai zvipfuva zvedu.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tiropafadzei Mwari wekururama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ivai nevatsvene Baba vari mu diaspora vese. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ivai nevatsvene vari Botsvana. Ivai nevatsvene vari Joni. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ivai nevatsvene kumaguta ose, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] avo tinonamata navo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Tinotenda nekuunganidzwa kwataita muno Baba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Taurai pakati pedu Mwari wekururama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tigobuda muno tichifara, kutenda kwedu kwakazembera paShoko Renyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinokudza Imi manheru ano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Namatwai nekusingapere Baba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Pindirai pamharidzo yezuva ranhasi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] MuZita raTenzi Jeso Kristu, Amen and Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Aiwa tinotenda Mwari. Tinokwazisana tose muZita raTenzi Jeso Kristu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tichikwazisa vayenzi vese vari pakati pedu. Nhasi ndine hanzvadzi yangu, uhm…Mai Muyambo. Takakura tose. Ndovatai va…vaive mudiki kwandiri havo ne two years, handiti? One year? [Mai Muyambo says, “Haa, akawanda.”] Akawanda? [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation laugh—ED] Handichaziva kuti mangani. Ndovandakakura navo avo, nevamwe vanonzi Sisi… Nyembesi naSisi Morina. Ava vainzi Sisi Naomi ava. Saka ndinofara kuti nhasi vandi… (Inaudible 0:03:19) ndichiparidza Vhangeri. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mufaro wangu chai…? [Congregation says, “chaizvo,”] chaizvo, handi’moona.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Then nhasi tina…tina mukwasha Chatima, nemwanasikana wangu Grace. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tine mufaro kuva navo muKereke yaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vaita zvakanaka chai…? [Congregation says, “chaizvo,”] chaizvo. Then tina Sister Brenda, vauya nema lab tech. Vari kuita ma lab tech nevamwe vavo ve…? [Congregation says, “vese,”] vese. Tinovagamuchira muZita raTenzi Jeso Kristu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mufaro wedu kuva muimba yaani…? [Congregation says, “yaMwari,”] yaMwari.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Zvagara hazvo muimba yaMwari hamuna muye…? [Congregation says, “muyenzi.”] Hamuna muyenzi, ha’moona. Rinenge rangovawo zuva rako rokutanga kupinda nesu, saka tinozviremekedza chai…? [Congregation says, “chaizvo,”] chaizvo, ha’moona. Saka toda kuenda mberi nokuparidzirana iVhangeri. Shoko raMwari rinoti iro, “You can never pray too…? [Congregation says, ‘too much,’] too much.” Handi’moona. Hapana. Ukanamata twenty-four seven, it’s never too much and it’s never enou…? [Congregation says, “enough,”] enough. Nekuti toda kugara tiri pamberi paMwari zuva rimwe nei…? [Congregation says, “nerimwe.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndaitoti kana Mwari vakandiitira nyasha, ndiri kuda kutoti kana dai zvaibvira, tikwanise kuita ma early morning se…? [Congregation says, “service,”] services. Tikwanise kuita ma early morning services. Tokwanisa kuita lunch hour services. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tokwanisa kuita futi manheru. Ko handi’ndomadyiro awunoita panyama? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe, ngaingovawo same staira payi…? [Congregation says, “pamweya.”] Ehe. Breakfast, lunch and what…? [Congregation says, “supper,”] supper.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Saka when the work becomes much less than what it is now…Iye zvino tiri kugadzira pokuti tinyatsokwanisa kupindira takatambanuka. When things are normal, ndendichitoda ma services anoitwa kuseni. Before everyone aenda kubasa, vanenge vachikwanisa vaya, na six touya topinda chii… church. Ha’moona? Seven-thirty tapedza vanhu va’akumhanya kuenda kumai…? Kumabasa. Muchiuya pa lunch hour, exactly one o’clock ndaakuparidza. Handi’mukuona ehe. Quarter to two, [Apostle Gumbura claps once—ED] tapedza, todzokera kumabasa, handiti. Touya [Apostle Gumbura claps once—ED] manheru. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: “…Pray without ceasing.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handi’moona. Ndochinangwa chandakagara ndinacho every day muhupenyu. I’ve never been able to do that. Now Mwari nenyasha Dzake manje muri kuona kuti kuno kuHarare zvinenge zvichakwanisika kaizvi? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe. Saka ndozvatakagara tichida kuti ndoita morning, afternoon, evening. Ende ini handina hunyope hwokuparidza. Aah ipapo handina, hunyope handina.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Panguva yandakanga ndisingaparidze hakusi kuti ndakanga ndiine hunyope kana ndaka’andisina chekuparidza. Munoziva munhu unogomera kusvika papoindi yekuti unenge uchiti, kana kufa zvako kuri nani? [Congregation says, “mm-hm.”] Kuti, “Handichada kana kuparidza kwacho! Handichada!” Ndomweya wandaive nawo kudhara kwaya after October 2000. Ndomweya wandaive nawo. Ndosaka ndaigona kuita kana, three weeks ndisingatore ma service ndiri kumba zvangu. Kuti...

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndaitoti pamberi paMwari, “Ko, ichiri kuitei Chechi yacho? Why is the Church there? Dai yanga yadii…? Dai yanga yaparara. Vari kundipa conscience vanhu ava, kana vakaramba vachiungana kwavari uko…” [Apostle Gumbura laughs--ED]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndopfungwa yandakanga ndinayo. Kuti, “Dai wo—kwangoshaikwa kana munhu one, tongoita natural death zvobva zvangopera.” Because muna 2000 I was very discouraged. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] I had put my all mukumhanya kwandaiita kuya kuya uku, pana… just before 2000. I put my all. Kuparidza Early Church Structure, kuparidza Marriage and Divorce, and the Church was going on nicely.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Then just like that, [Apostle makes a sound to illustrate something being destroyed] Ndakagara pasi apa, kupererwa nesimba. Zvinodarikira—zvinodarika eh…kufirwa, nekuti kufirwa unenge uchiti inzira yedu te…? [Congregation says, “tese.”] Ndikati, “What? He? Ko Mwari…?” I was angry at God. I was angry at people that I have trusted. I did not trust even my wives. I did—I did not trust anybody. Ndosaka mukaona nanhasi, zvondinetsa kuita shamwari.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndonetseka kuti ndiite shamwari zviri serious. Kuti ndiite munhu wandinoti uyu, ndingaise faith yangu mandiri. Handizati ndamuwana kusvika nanhasi. Wandinoti uyu I—I really trust. Ndakabruis-iwa [I was bruised—ED] zvakaoma panguva iyo iya. Zvokuti munhu wese nde’ndakamutarisa kudai ndichiti, “Ah, VaMakaza ava? [Congregation laughs—ED] Aah, hameno,” handiti. Paya patinenge tichiimba, [Apostle Gumbura sings this next line—ED] Tinotenda zvedu…

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndendakatarisa VaRusono kuti, “Zvino haachafunga kuti ndo’omweya manhingi nenziyo yake iyoyi?” [Congregation laughs—ED] Handi’moona zvande’ndichifunga? Munhu wese ari under suspicion with Pastor Gumbura. Everybody is under suspicion, handitika ehe. Ukaona vana Brother Gwendere vaane matumbu nemotokari dzakanaka woti, “Ah vafanha ava, he? Havachaita arrogant nemari ava, nekufunda vafanha ava? Zvakaita vamwe vaani…? [Congregation says, ‘vavo.’] He? I think this young, man I hope he doesn’t get arrogant.”

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Saka munhu wese, I question, huh. Satiya akavaka imba yangu ikabuda zvakanaka ndoti, “But I hope mupfanha uyu ka uyu…” [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation laugh—ED] Handi’moona kuti munhu wese ari under fire? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe. The good thing about me I just don’t say it, handitika ehe. But that’s what goes on in my head almost every…? [Congregation says, “every time,”] every time, handiti, ehe.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Kuti, “Haa, mupfana uyu, he? Haa mupfan—” Unenge uchingoti ukaona munhu—Iye zvino ndaita kune hama… Murikuona ma drawings aya? [Congregation says, “mm.”] Ha’moona. Just before these drawings came, brother ava vakarotewa, Brother… [Apostle Gumbura snaps his fingers once trying to remember the brother’s name] vahedhuka vachikanganisika kunamata. Brother Keith. But Brother Keith ka, kutanga ku drawer chaiko ndini ndaitomuencourage-a, achidraw-a patumakadhibhodi kudai.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndichiti, “No, chengeta mhuri yenyu.” He was the first born, baba hapana. Ndikati, “No, tengesa mbijana mbijana,” turi tuma…tuduku duku. Now he is drawing, zvokuti munhu wese akauya, handitika, anenge achingoti…Nhasi ndandine vamwe ma friends angu auya muno umu, two. Zvikanzi, chinhu chokutanga vachipinda munomu. Zvikanzi, “VaGumbura ndaka…” Ndiye abvunza oga. “Ndakasiya muchigadzira horo iyo, muchiti moda kuiita chechi. Ndoda kunoona kuti yapera here.” Nemuchinda wangu woku Eurotec uya uya anonzi Nyamadzawo. Ndikati, “Haa, shamwari ukapinda uko unorohwa nehana. Kwanaka manje.” Zvikanzi, “Haa, dambonoona. Ndoziva kuti imimi you are always a busy man. Pandafonerwa ndanzwa kuti manga muri kure uko, ha’moona.” Achingopinda muno abva ati, zvikanzi, “Ndiani akadraw-a?” Zvikanzi, “No hakuzi kudraw-a uku. Hm? i -drawing here?” Ndikati, “i -drawing.” Zvikanzi, “Haa. Haa! Ndoda kumuona mupfanha uyu, handiti.”

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: [Apostle Gumbura laughs—ED] Ha’moona, ehe. Ndikati, “Mupfanha uyu achapedzesera a—a—azvikudza nenyaya iyi, handiti?” [Congregation laughs—ED] Handi’moona zvaunenge uchiita ehe? Baba vangu vaona drawing vadzoka zvikanzi, “Ndandichikumbira kuti andidraw-ewo.” [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation laugh—ED] Handi’moona. Ndobva kwauya mukomana watotengesa naye, anotengesa he—hembe ya—mupfanha, mu—muchi—brother vatinoi—ha—muchinda wechipostori anobva ku China wuya. Zvikanzi, “Haa, iwe, muri kuti i-drawing iyo Pastor?” Abva auya ndokubata so zvikanzi, “I-drawing iyi?” Ndikati, “I-drawing.” Zvikanzi, “Haa.”

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Saka munhu wese akangopinda, anobva aona drawing. Ukashaiwa nyasha dzaani…? [Congregation says, “dzaMwari.”] You go straight munyika straight. Because vemunyika vanenge vachitaura handiti? Iyewo womunyika a—a—a—akugara achisangana navo, huh. Hanzi one of the whites men vari mu gallery. Handitika? Hanzi, “Aaah, Keith draws like a demon.” [Congregation laughs—ED] Moziva vanhu vemunyika handiti. Vanhu vemunyika hanzi, “Keith draws like a demon.” Handiti. [Apostle Gumbura laughs—ED] Vanhu vemunyika, kwaari anenge achitokupa compliment akadaro. [Congregation says, “mmm.”] Kuti madraw-ero acho haazi natu…? [Congregation says, “haazi natural,”] haazi natural, ha’moona.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ende zveshuwa unenge uchiona kuti munhu ari ku—saka unenge uchiziva zvinhu zvese izvi ka izvi… I’ve seen people that I’ve raised from nothing. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] After vaitwa something naMwari, they end up being too argume…? [Congregation says, “argumentative,”] argumentative, ehe. Vanenge vaa too argumentative zvekuti unenge wa’akushaya kuti manje ndomudzora sei mupfanha uyu? Mari yavapo, ava netarenda rake ka…? [Congregation says, “kare,”] kare. Hauna chauchagona kumuita. He can be anything, ha’moona.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: But, chinhu one chandoda kuti mugare makarangarira mukati moupenyu hwavo. Haikona kufa wakafunga kuti Mwari akakusimudza, haagone kukukoromora kubva ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Izvozvo gara uchizviziva hupenyu hwako hwe…? [Congregation says, “hwese.”] Even inini Pastor venyu nhasi uno. Ndikada kungoregera kunamata, munondinzwira tsitsi me…? Mese.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndikangoda kuregera kunamata chete ndikatanga kuda kuita zvinhu zvemusoro wangu, you will all feel sorry for me. Zvinopera zvo…? That supernatural touch inodii iyo iya…? Inopera, inodepart-a supernatural touch iya. Inobva zvacho…? Zvachose, that supernatural touch. Unosara wangova iwe wega, zvekuti vanhu vanenge vachiona kuti apa raa-aa…churu chakapinda nyo…? [Congregation says, “nyoka.”] Kuti, “Pakapinda zinyoka zihombe apa, but zinyoka rakatama ka…? Kare.” Ha’moona.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndosaka mumwe nemumwe wedu vanhu vaMwari handiti, the more God blesses you, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ita sei kana Mwari achikuropafadza? [Congregation says, “be humble.”] The humbler you become. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] The way up, what does Brother Branham teach? Hanzi, “The way what…?” [Congregation mumbles inaudible responses—ED] “The way up is the way…?” [Congregation says, “down.”] Mm. Iva munhu uya anenge ari munyoro. Mwari ngavakuropafadze uchiramba uchizvininipisa.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Wawana mota yakanaka, break down. Wawana imba yakanaka, break down. Wawana murume ane mari, break down. Don’t be arrogant, handi’moona ehe. Wawana basa rakanaka rine authority, ita humble handitika. Wapuhwa property naMwari, ita humble. Haikona kuita show off nezvinhu zvaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvinhu zvaMwari hazvidi show off zvacho…? [Congregation says, “zvachose,”] zvachose, handi’moona ehe. Hazvidi show off zvachose.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Now that is the downfall of my partners. [Congregation says, “mm-hm.”] Ma brothers andakatanga kushanda nawo ose, they were humble people when I started with them. But apo Mwari a’akutisimudzira manje, mapoka edu a’akudi…? A’akukura. Vana Brother Marisa va’akuuya mberi kwepurupiti kudaiwo, vakatanga kuzviona sekuti they don’t need their Pastor any…? [Congregation says, “anymore,”] anymore.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: That’s what they felt. They felt the Pastor has no relevance anymore. They were now a…? [Congregation says, “arrogant,”] arrogant. Zvikanzi, “We can go it alone. We don’t need the man anymore.” If you go now, you can see their state now. Huh. Varume vatakatanga navo… Moziva takatanga navo kuvaka, vana Brother ava—va—va…vazukuru vangu vana Mukavhi ava, vatakatanga kuvaka navo?

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Aivaka like a demon. [Congregation laughs—ED] (Inaudible 0:13:19) Ndiye akandivakira imba yangu kuMaenga ka uku, handitika ehe. [Congregation says, “mm-hmm.”] Manje Mukavhi ndiye atrain-a ani…? [Congregation says, “Satiya,”] Satiya. But manje Satiya ovaka kudarika ani manje…? [Congregation says, “Mukavhi.”] Handi’moona zvinoita hupenyu? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Saka unenge wa’akufunga kuti zvakazoita Mukavhi, akazokanganisika at the last minute. Iye zvino, takachema neimwe hama. Taitinana Brother Leo, tine vakomana veeku City Council kuGweru. Ndichi…ndadraw-esa plan ye extension yemba yangu yekuGweru, handi’moona. Ndobva paita umwe mupfanha anga ari engineer wandaida kuhaya. [to hire—ED] Zvikanzi, “But munhu aisimbogona kuvaka so ka, wokuti mukamuona iyeye Pastor, iyi imba anoiburitsa iyi. Mupfanha anonzi Mukavhi so. Anogona kuvaka imba iyi.” Saka umwe ndi architecture, mumwe ndiye anopasisa ma plan ku City Council. Zvikanzi neumwe wacho, zvikanzi “Ah, uya a’akuba kauya. [Congregation laughs—ED] Haapedze bhiridhini.” [Apostle Gumbura laughs—ED] Tatakamira ipapo nehama idzi. Tikati, “Ah!” Zvikanzi, “Wuya aakuba. Ndiye akaisa building yanhingi iya. Anongoita building, ongochera chera odii… Osiya.” Zvikanzi, “Haa, imi muri mufundisi wuya anokuche—anokuchemedzai wuya.” Vapedza kutaura ndobva ndavaudza ndikati, “Aiwa, inini haangandidaro. Kungoti chete handichamutora.” Zvikanzi, “Hindava?” Ndikati, “Ndi…Akadzidzira kuvaka pano.” Zvikanzi, “Hoo momuziva?” Ndikati, “Ah stereki. Wakatanga nekuvaka kumusha kwangu kunonzi kuKenzamba.”

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: [Apostle Gumbura laughs—ED] Handi’mukuona. Unenge waraise-a munhu from no…? [Congregation says, “nothing.”] Aitokumbira kubva kuKenzamba kuuya kuzonyora ma tests ake kuGweru e building, e class one. Aidzidzira pamba pangu nesimendi yangu, handi’moona. But always what happens when people grow…? Ukateerera zvinotaura vanhu too…? [Congregation says, “too much.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: “You draw like a demon.” Handiti, he? Mupfanha anobva afunga kuti, “Haa…?...” Because unenge wa’akudraw-a manje ma—ma nude pictures emadzimai. Ma nude pictures evarume vanenge vakadaiwo. [Apostle Gumbura illustrates and Congregation laughs—ED] Aya anobhadharwa nokudiii iwayo…? [Congregation says, “nokukasira.”] Ehe, anokurumbidza kukupa twenty thousand rands one ti…? [Congregation says, “one time.”] Warasa faith yako. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha’moona kuti warasa faith yako? [Congregation says, “mm.”] Ndosaka ukaropafadzwa ramba uchidzikira. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: VaMarisa as long as he was under instruction he was a perfect guy. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha? Aiti ukamudzidzisa kuti, “Paridza chakati.” Ainyatsopari—mazu… But paakatanga kuparidza vana Cave of Machpelah. Munoziva imimi vanhu munofurira vanhu chaizvo? Munhu akauya pano ane chizaruro chake muchiziva kuti Pastor vanoparidza kuti… “No, no, no. Haikona ku teacher zvako.”

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Unonyatsoona mumwe mupfanha anenge ada kukufurira kuti upanduke achiti, “Heee.” [Apostle Gumbura claps three times—ED] Anenge achiona kuti warasika handiti. [Apostle Gumbura claps three times and Congregation laughs—ED] Arikuombera kuti warasika, iwe wofunga kuti ndiri kugona. [Congregation laughs—ED] Vaya vaya vanenge vari genuine ndovanoti, “Ah-ah. Iyi Cave of Machpelah iyi munhu waMwari haana kumboidii…?” [Congregation says, “kumboiparidza.”] Haana kumboiparidza. But vamwe vanenge vachiti, “It’s good, it’s good.” Zvonzi, “Ah, Brother Gumbura varikuda kundidzvanya pa revelation, ndinopihwa revelation yangu naMwari.”

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Unogozopuhwa revelation kuvanhu vanoparidzirwa neumwe munhu se…? [Congregation says, “sei?”] Hm? Kana Mwari achikupa revelation, anokutuma kwako we…? [Congregation says, “wega.”] Enda uko Jesu Kristu asina kumbodaidzwa ipa…? [Congregation says, “ipapo.”] But ndikakuremekedza ndikati, “Brother Enoch I want you to help me preach. Ndoda kukudzidzisa kuparidza.” Haikona kuparidza zvako muno.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Regera ministry yako ikure zvakadii…? [Congregation says, “zvakanaka,”] zvakanaka. Wanyatsozvimirira wokura, iswa maoko pai... [Congregation says, “pamusoro.”] Wotumwa kunze, wonotanga uri kuGokwe uko, pa Growth Point. Taura zvaunodii ikoko…? [Congregation says, “zvaunoda,”] nokuti vanhu vaurikuparidzira vahedheni ende havauye kuzokumhan’ara kwandiri. [Congregation laughs—ED] Ini izvozvo handizvidii izvozvo izvo…? Handizvizivi ehe.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Taura Cave of Machpelah uri kuGokwe uko. Ha’moona. Then wotanga kuona basa rako richimira, richi blossomer handitika. Wokumbira kuti, “Pastor ndokumbira sovereignty.” Moona zvinoita mupfanha anetsika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe. “Nda’andichikumbira kuti ndiite, go it alone.”

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ha’moona. Hakuna munhu anenge amisa boka, anokumbira kuita, go it alone anorambidzwa, on the basis of Scri…? [Congregation says, “Scripture.”] That pastor is if a man of God, he will always give you three years. Anokuti, “Horaiti munhu waMwari I am going to give you three years muri mo…? [Congregation says, “moga.”] Ndo time ino testiwa [to be tested—ED] mi…? [Congregation says, “ministry.”] Endai munoita tione munhu waMwari.’’

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Anokupa three years. Hakuna arikukwa…. anokwanisa kuti a… Haagone kukurambidza. Akakuti usaite, handiti, ask for the reasons. If they are Scriptural obey, if there are not rebel. It will not be considered as rebe…? [Congregation says, “rebellion,”] pamberi paMwari. Ha’moona kunaka kwenyashaka? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe, ndokunonzi kunaka kwenyasha ikoko.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndosaka muchiona, handiti. Mukanoona where do I get this method I’m telling you. Ndo method yakatora Paul. Pouro akaenda mudondo ku Arabia desert akapuhwa chizaruro. Ndobva adzoka, ndobva anochiparidza? [Congregation says, “mm-mh.”] Ndobva amhanya kune vakanga vari munaShe kutanga kwaani...? Ndobva va—ati ndono kunotaura nani…? [Congregation says, “navo.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Murikuzviona zvaakaita? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndokunotaura navo kuti, “Inini maonero anguka ndiri kutumwa kuma Gentiles, imi makatumwa kuma Juta. Imi munongoenda kune vakadzingiswa, ini ndanzi ndiende kune vasina kudzingiswa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Saka ndiri kuona zvinhu izvi.” Murikuona zvakaita? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Ndirikuona izvi nezvizvi, nezvizvi, nezvizvi, neizvi.” Ndokumbofamba navo, achifamba navo, achifamba navo, ha’moona.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndobva azoti, “…I withstood Peter…” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nokuti a— ndakagara naye pasi. Ndikamuratidza revelation yandakapuhwa naMwari. Akagamuchira, kuti ma Gentiles haafaniri kudzi…? [Congregation says, “kudzingiswa.”] Kwazouuya vanhu vanobva kune vakadzingiswa akabva amira, kuenda parutivi. Ndikati, “Behaviour yako haina kumira zvakadii…?” [Congregation says, “zvakanaka.”] Peter ndokuzotendeuka kuma Epistles of Peter. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvikanzi, “Vanhu vanorwisa vanhu naPouro they do that to their own de…?” [Congregation says, “destruction.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Murikuona kunaka kwenyasha dzaMwarika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mupfanha akanga ari mu order yake chai…? [Congregation says, “chaiyo.”] Ndo order yaunofanira kukopa iyoyo. But ukawona manje munhu achibamura chechi iripo kudhara, ah-ah, you never get that way no—no—nowhere. Hauna Shoko… hauna chechi yaunodii…? Yaunoita. You don’t build a church by splitting a church. You don’t do it that way. Chechi haibamurwe, ha’moona.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndosaka October 2000 yedu yekuGweru. That was a landmark to me. And a very painful landmark, handi’moona. Yakandirwadza chai…? [Congregation says, “chaizvo,”] chaizvo. Until I said… Ndosaka makanzwa ndichitaura kuti, “This time around, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] this Church won’t split again.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chikonzero ndecheyi? Nda’akudzidzisa vatsvene Shoko raani…? [Congregation says, “raMwari.”] Ehe, ndonzira yeShoko raMwari iri. Unoenda wonoparidza paGokwe. Woenda wonoparidza kuBhohera.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Wotondidaidzawo rimwe zuva kuti, “Mufundisi, ndaane two years ndichienda out. Basa randiri kubata ikoko hamusati mamboridii…? [Congregation says, “mamboriwona.”] Paya pandakati kune vanhu varikuda kubhabhatidzwa. Eeh… makatumira ma deacon akanotibhabhatidzira vanhu. Ivo varikukuudzai vana aNehohwa nana aGwendere nana aChuma kuti kwakamira sei? Ndovanhu vaya vamurikuona varikuuya, pama Combined Meeting edu e month end ega e…? [Congregation says, “ega.”] Taichikumbira kuti mumbouya mozoona zvataita.”

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndosvika ikoko, ndosvika kwakavakwa imba yemusasa yakanaka naka, yeuswa yakafurikwa. Ehe, ndopinda imomo ndonzwa vanhu varikuimba, Machiona, Masungurwa nhasi

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: [Congregation laughs—ED] Amen, handitika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosvika ndotarisa, ndotarisa ndoona ndoona haaya, ndoona order irimo zvakanaka naka. Ndoona madeacon akamira padoor. “Ehe, ava mukuru wamurikuona akatendeuka iyi ndiye sabhuku weraini rinoiri. Ehe…” [Congregation laughs—ED]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Aihwa Mwari haavharwe. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] You don’t have to fight for God to manifest himse…? [Congregation says, “himself.”] Mukaona vanhu vanorwira kuda kuita shumiro ava. Shumiro dzacho hava…? [Congregation says, “havana,”] havana! Varipo chete kuti vakanganise zviri kuitwa neva…? [Congregation says, “nevamwe,”] nevamwe, ehe. “Kouyo ndiyani uyo?” “Ah uyu mudhara uyu kauyu anga achitori, ndi counsellor iyeyuyu. Ehe ndiye counsellor wemuno mu area uyu.” “Hoo?” “Ehe.” “Ko uyu ndi…?” “Ehe. Ava mai ava ndovakadai vakadai vakadai. Avava ndovakadai vakadai. Ava—ava ndova…” “Ah, hoo ndafara kukuzivai.” “Tafara kukuziva mufundisi.” “Takanga tazvinzwa nezvenyu. Ehe. Takanzwa nezvenyu ne—nem—namufundisi.”

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Isu tenge tichikuti brother kunoku. [Congregation laughs—ED] Kunoku unenge uri Brother Notice. [Congregation laughs—ED] But ikoko handiti eh, ikokoko, ikoko kwako unenge wa’amufundisi chai…? [Congregation says, “chaiye.”] Ehe ndozvionera ndega handitika. Ehe togona kusvika tonyarara zvedu. Wazoona tozotaura mumwe musi. Ah waon… “Vanhu vaMwari zvamunoona hama iri apa iyi ehe. Munovati Brother Jowe, [Congregation laughs—ED] but ndiMufundisi Musasa uyo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] [0:21:27 inaudible] [Congregation laughs—ED]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ha’moona kuti Shumiro yadii…? Ehe shumiro yatanga. Handiti. Ndomatangirwo anoitwa shumiro chai…? [Congregation says, “chaiwo.”] You don’t go into a Church wotora vanhu twenty wonotanga Shumiro. It’s a curse that I cannot take off from a person. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Curse iyoyo yakaipa chai…? [Congregation says, “chaizvo.”] Don’t start your Ministry tha...? [Congregation says, “that way.”] Every brother who started a ministry by splitting, is an embarrassment to the Message. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handiwo matangiro anofanira kuita Chur…? [Congregation says, “Church,”] Church iwayo. Church haitange neku—tuka kuu… baba vako pamwe…? [Congregation says, “pamweya.”] Church haitangi nokurwadzisa baba vako paMweya.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndosaka muchivanhu chaimo chaimo pasina maGwaro, Bhaibhiri rinoti iro, “Natsa kwaunodii…? [Congregation says, ‘kwaunobva,’] kwaunoenda chii…?” [Congregation says, “usiku.”] “Kudza baba namai kuti mazuva ako awande pai…? [Congregation says, “panyika.”] Huh?

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Now wouya mu Church wotanga kutukana nevafundisi. “Havana kudanwa, havazi munhu waMwari, handivaterere. Hee, vakarasika chakati. Vakara…” Yet muBhaibhiri Mwari vataura kuna Souro kuti, “Iwe handichakuda ndaita appoint king, who is your neighbour.” Dhavhidha akaita disrespect? [Congregation says, “mm-mh.”] Huh? Dhavhidha aingoenda ikoko achinozvininipisa. Asi atoudzwa kuti murume uyu pachigaro abvi…? [Congregation says, “abviswa.”] Achitoziva kuti, Sameri andiga…? [Congregation says, “andigadza,”] andigadza. Ha’moona.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndosaka mumwe nemumwe wedu vanhu vaMwari. Haikona kuita shumiro yekuchemera. “He who ascended [Congregation says, ‘Amen,’] is the one who…? [Congregation says, “descended,”] and He gave gifts unto …?” [Congregation says, “men.”] Ha’moona. Saka haikona kuita shumiro yekuchemera. Ha’moona. Ndosaka nhasi uno, unochemera shumiro iwewe, ukazosangana na October 2000 unoita sei?

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ukasangana na October 2000 ndopano perera kuparidza kwako ipa…? [Congregation says, “ipapo.”] Hm? But kana Mwari vakakudana, aaah! Hazvina basa kuti wasiirwa vanhu. Unogona kusara nema—ne—nema sister aya. Raini repamberi iri. Wosara nema brother aya raini repamberi apa. Vanhu ndevaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kunouya va…? [Congregation says, “vamwe.”] Kunouya vamwe! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Don’t you worry iwe ramba wakamira panzvimbo yako chete iwewe. Ramba uchizvi humbler zuva rimwe nei…? [Congregation says, “nerimwe.”] Ehe.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndosaka Message yenguva inoyi yazara renegadism. Chii chiri kukonzera izvozvo? Vatsvene vakawanda mu Message matsotsi! Chechi dzavanadzo vakadzitora nemadhiri ya. Chidhira chinenge chechi Nigerian. Hazvinei naMwari muka…? [Congregation says, “mukati.”] Mwari havamo mu programme iyi.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Vanhu vakaenda kunobvuta machechi vakatanga kutsonda, kuita character assassination munhu anga ari pabasa raMwari. Vachiita character assassination kuvahedheni. Kuvahedheni venzvimbo idzodzo. Vachinoudzwa kunzi murume uyu akaipa, but ndiye akavabhabhatidza. Ndiye akavadzidzisa Spoken Word. Ndiye akavachatisa. Ndiye aka dedicator vana vavo. Maropafadzo aanavo vose akabva kumunhu iye…? [Congregation says, “iyeye.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Vane nzeve dzekunzwa inzwai varanda vaShe. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Ameni akadarika Amen ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen handisikumunzwa iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha’moona. Ndosaka mukaona manje, Mwari ini ndakazozviona kuti haikona kufa wakache— waka—wakarwadzirwa Mwari. Mwari ega aona kuti varume vaya vakanganisa veGweru tarirai ho—ngozi yavakuripa vari ve…? [Congregation says, “vari vega.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Haiperi ngozi ye type iya. Brother inoenda kuvana, igoenda kuvazukuru. Igoenda nekuvazukuru ngozi iyo iya. Haina kunaka. Nekuti ukatadzira Mwari, unonochema kunani? Kana watadzira Mwari, ugochema kunani? Zvi—kanganisira munhu. Nokuti Mwari vakakuregerera munhu anogona kungo igno-wewa. [to be ignored—ED] But ukakanganisira Mwari wodii? Hah? Saka ndiri kukutii vanhu vaMwari chizvarwa chino chatiri kurarama chinochi, bata mweya waMwari muKereke. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndosaka Message yedu yatiri kuparidza inonzi The Reve…? [Congregation says, “…lation.”] Ha’moona. Ndo revelation iyoyiyi. Inonzi The Revelation. Revelation yekuziva kuti muChechi… mu framework ye Church, from Sunday handitika. Mune ma spirits mangani…? [Congregation says, “maviri,”] maviri. One iri right, one iri wro…? [Congregation says, “wrong.”] In the framework of the Church and wherever there is a revival there are twins. One mweya uri correct, one uri wro…? [Congregation says, “wrong.”] And unenge uri mu framework.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Manje mistake yakaitwa mu Message ndeyekufunga kuti mweya iyi kaiyi. Mu Message takangotora kuti munhu wese anenge aine Spoken Word, munhu wese anotenda Brother Branham ane mweya wakanaka. Munhu ane mweya wakaipa munhu wuya wuya anenge ariku Methodist kana kuti ku Baptist kana kuAngrican, nokuti ndiko ku denomination. Saka Message yakauya ichiti come out kubva ku denomination. Ndobva tatadza kuziva kuti kwete. Ku Ephesus kwaPauro, mweya wetsvina waitova mumakwai aPauro iwayo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Handi’murikuona mamiriro azvazvakaita? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe. Ndosaka mukaenda kuna Acts kuya munonosviko nowona mweya wetsvina uri muna Pauro achiita… Mweya waMwari uchitaura muna Pauro kuti, “Pakati penyu pane vanhu vachasimuka, vachiita draw disciples unto the…?” [Congregation says, “themselves.”] Ndosaka tirimo, imo muno mu Church imo munomu. Taive tiriku Gweru kuya uko. Chindiudzai kuti mweya mumwe chete here wakasimuka mune vamwe vedu muna October 2000? NeMweya waka—wakasara uri mune vakasara. Was that the same spirit? [Congregation says, “no.”] Ma’amune mweya yakadii mu church muya …? [Congregation says, “yakasiyana.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Mukuona kuti manga mume two spirits? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] But iri Message Church imwe….? [Congregation says, “imwe chete.”] Inoparidzirwa na Pastor mumwe…? [Congregation says, “mumwe chete.”] But manga mune mweya mingani muya? [Congregation says, “miviri.”] Tingaita Amen akadarika Amen here hama? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handisikumunzwa Amen iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndosaka izvozvi ndichiparidza imo munomu, mune mweya mingani muno…? [Congregation says, “miviri.”] Murikuona revelation yandiri kutaura iyi? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mune mweya wakanaka waMwari. Ende mune mweya wakaipa waani…? [Congregation says, “waSatani.”] Ndouya vamunoona manje, vagosimuka vachitora ma table vachikudubura vachiita sei. “Hee, yeyi yeyi.” And that spirit has always wanted to get into the Church.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndosaka mukaona nezuro takaratidzana kuti mweya uyu wakauya panguva yekuti Church yedu yepa Ephesus yakanga iri yakanzi, “Aiming at.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Yaita aim at, ndobva yaita rela…? [Congregation says, “relax.”] It is at that time of relaxation, that Sant—Satani planted a seed. [Congregation says, “mm-mm.”] Yakazonodzima cha—chaedza chose mu fourth Church age. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] MuTiyatira. Handi’mukuzviona? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Tasvika mu Tiyatira manje ch—ch—chadzera chiya chabva chadzima cho…? [Congregation says, “chose.”] Ndosaka isusu ipo pano patiri ipo pano. Pakasimuka mweya uya wa 2000 uya waida kuzoparadza Church. Moziva chinangwa changa chiri pamweya uya? Kuti Church iparare zvacho…? [Congregation says, “zvachose.”] Ndosaka muchiona patiri panapa takaita sei pano? Ndokunonzi kukunda Satani. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Takamukunda here varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tikaramba tichinamataka varanda vaShe? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndokukunda kwatakamudii ikoku…? [Congregation says, “kwatakamuita.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: But don’t you lax. Nokuti mweya uwoyo unogara wakavandira kuti udii… upinde. Unogara uchida kupinda mweya iwoyu. Unogara wakavanda handi’moona. Ndezve kugara wakangwarira zuva rimwe nei…? [Congregation says, “nerimwe,”] nerimwe. Kuti mweya uyu kana wouya ndoda kuukunda. Mweya uyu kana wauya ndoda kuukunda. But muChechi munogara mune mweya muviri iyo…? [Congregation says, “iyoyo.”] Hatichidzokerai kuna Revelation chapter 1 tiverenge ruGwaro Revelation chapter 1. Revelation chapter 1 tasvika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kana tasvika hatiiti Ameni tese. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengei… Revelation chapter 1 verse 1 tese: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave unto him, to shew unto His servants things which must shortly come to pass; and He sent and signified it by His angel unto His servant John:

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Chizaruro chakauya kuna Johani. Chichibva kuna… kuna Mwari, kuna Ishe Jeso Kristu. Zvinhu zvanga zvichazoitika. Ndoda kuti mubatisise ipapo handitika. Hanzi, “Things which must shortly come to…?” [Congregation says, “to pass.”] Saka pakapuhwa John chizaruro ichi. Zvinhu izvi zva’azvisati zvaiti…? [Congregation says, “zvaiitika.”] Zvinhu zvaizoitika, John ndobva afanonyorwa—anyora zvinhu zviya zviya izvi. Handei muone pa verse ya 2 tese, verse 2 tese: Who bare record of the Word of God, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, and of all things that he saw.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Handei mberi tese: Blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein: for the time is at hand.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: “Akaropafadzwa anonzwa! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Anoverenga…” Kungonzwa kwauri kuita Message iyoyi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kungonzwa kwauri kuidii…? [Congregation says, “kuiita.”] Hanzi, wakaita sei…? [Congregation says, “wakaropafadzwa; Amen.”] Ndosaka mukaona Bhuku iri takakura kuma denomination, Bhuku iri. Hakuna aida kuriverenga zvacho…? [Congregation says, “zvachose.”] Tinongoziva vachiverenga, “Jesu amire pamukova unogugudza.” Ndopanoperera vanhu paBhuku reZvakazarurwa iri. Rinobatwa neKereke yaMwa…? [Congregation says, “yaMwari.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: And munhu anenge awuya kuzorizarura, munhu anenge aine ka prophetic insight. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Anokwanisa kujoinidza maGwa…? [Congregation says, “maGwaro.”] Haazi munhu chero chero. Ndosaka rakatomirira muporofita, Malachi 4…? [Congregation says, “5.”] William Marrion Bra…? [Congregation says, “Branham.”] “Maiona here nyeredzi yazvi…?” [Congregation says, “yazvino.”] “Machiona here Chokwadi cha…?” [Congregation says, “chazvino.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndovakauya, ndokutanga kutora zvinhu zviya zviya ndokutanga kutiratidza manje. Saka John apa anotaipa Mwenga, nokuti Mwenga ndoucharatidzwa zvinhu izvi; zvakanzi zvichadii…? Zvichauya. Tarisai muone panapa, handei muone verse 4. Handei pa verse 4 tese: John to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace be unto you, and peace, from Him which is, and which was, and which is to come; and from the seven Spirits which are before His throne.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Murikupaona? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mukaona pese pata’akuyenda apa, ha’moona. Taku descrai-bhirwa [describe—ED] Jeso Kristu. Muri kupaona? Apa tiri kunzi atiita madzishe, atiita maprista, verse 6 verengai muone. Or horaiti verse 6. “And had made us kings and…?” [Congregation says, “and priests unto God His Father.”] Murikupaona? [Congregation says, “mm.”] Right ndiyani uyu? Verse 8 tese: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord,

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Muri kumuona uyu? NdiMwari arikuudza John zvinhu zvese izvo…? [Congregation says, “izvozvo.”] Ha’moona ehe. Handei pa verse 9: I John, who also am your brother, and companion in tribulation, and in the kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ, was in the isle that is called Patmos, for the Word of God, and for the testimony of Jesus Christ.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Verse 10: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s Day, and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet, Saying, I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last: and, What thou seest, write in a book, and send it unto the seven churches which are in Asia; unto Ephesus, and unto Smyrna… Muri kuona akutaurirwa. “Nyora utumire kumakereke ese ari mu Asia. Now, kuma ma Church age manomwe iwayo. Tumira zvinhu zvaunenge waona zvese izvozvo nyora utore, uyendese ikokoko.”

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: John ndobva atendeuka kuti anzwe inzwi rarira sehwamanda riya riya. Ndokunoona pakati paya paya, taakudhiscrai-bhirwa Ishe Jeso Kri…? [Congregation says, “Kristu.”] Saka ayitaura ndiyani apa? [Congregation says, “Jeso Kristu.”] Ayitaura ndiJeso Kristu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Pakati payapaya takudhiscrai-bhirwa Ishe Jeso Kristu manje, ha’moona. Mukatarisa pese ya’a description yaJeso Kristu. Verse 12 muone ehe, hativerengei tose: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me. And being turned, I saw seven golden candlesticks.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Handei mberi: And in the midst of the seven candlesticks one like unto the Son of man, clothed with … Aha! Murikuona kauyu? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Verse 14: His head and His hairs were white like wool, … Tiri kupaona? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Verse 15: And his feet like unto brass, … Tirikupaona apo? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] And when I saw Him, I fell at His feet (ha’moona) as dead. And He laid His right hand upon me, saying unto me, Fear not; I am the first and the last:

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Murikuona? Right, verse 19 hativerengei tose Commandment, tese: Write the things which thou hast seen, and the things which are, and the things which shall be hereafter; Muri kupaona zvaanzi nyora izvi? [Congregation says, “mm; Amen.”] Right verse 20 tese: The mystery of the seven stars which thou sawest in My right Hand, and the seven golden candlesticks. The seven stars are the seven angels of the seven churches: and the seven candlesticks which thou sawest are the seven churches.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Awudzwa kunzi, “Manje ma stars awawona ari manomwe aya, ndovatumwa.” (Maiwona) masunungurwa nhasi, (Maiwona) maiona nyeredzi yazvino. Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha’moona ehe. Maiona nyeredzi yechi-yechino…? [Congregation says, “yechinomwe.”] The seven stars. Then ma seven stars aya, vanenge varikuma Church ages awa. Umwe neumwe Church age yaani…? [Congregation says, “yake,”] yake. handi’moona.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndosaka makaona ku back uko hatisati tapedza kudra-wa na Brother Keith ku back uko. Panema square akashama handitika. Muka averenga iseven kaaya. One, two, three, four, five, six, se…? [Congregation says, “seven.”] Pari kuuya ma seven Church age me…? [Congregation says, “messengers.”] Handi’murikupaona ipapo? [Congregation says, “Amen; mm.”] Ndo the seven sta…? [Congregation says, “stars,”] dzakatumwa kunyika yo…? [Congregation says, “yose,”] yose.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndosaka hakuchauya futi vana Deuschle. [Congregation laughs—ED] Kana vana Rima hakuchisina. Kana vana Pastor Chris hakuchina. Kana vana T.B Joshua hakuchina. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vakanga vaonekwa naMwari ndeavavava. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Take your pick, but vakaonekwa naMwari ndeva…? [Congregation says, “ndevava; Amen.”] Hazvina basa vamunozoona achiunganidza vanhu thirty mirion. Pastor Chris vari pama seven Church age messengers apa? [Congregation says, “mm-mm.”] Brother T.B Joshua vari apa? [Congregation says, “no.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Pananiko apa? Pana Brother Branham apa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Pane mutumwa wechino…? [Congregation says, “wechinomwe.”] Dai vanga vari Brother T.B Joshua ndova ndingadei ndakaisa apa. Tingadei takava dra-wa nemunhu waMwari handitika. [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation laugh—ED] Takavaisa apa. But mukaona tisina kuvaisa zvoreva kuti havapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Now tiri kuisa uko. Tiri kuisa Paul, Iraneus, St. Martin, Columba, Wesley, Luther, Branham. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Branham ndowenguva yaani…? [Congregation says, “ino iyi.”] Ndosaka muchiona tichiti kana uriku chechi ipi neipi zvako yaunopinda tinoti, “Ko hwamanda yenguva yako wakainzwa here?!” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hwamanda yenguva yako wakainza here?! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “He, ndiri muSavadha.” Hongu. MaSavadha kunamata. “Tiri ma Methodist.” Hongu. But ma Methodist, ndeve church age yechi six. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Nguva yavo yakapfu…? [Congregation says, “yakapfuura.”] MaSavadha haana chizvarwa. [Congregation laughs—ED] Handizivi. Hameno chizvarwa chavo ndechipi. Handivazive ndongoziva kuti kune munhu anonzi Ellen G White. Mumwe mudzimai akapindwa noMweya waMwari ndobva atanga kupa…? [Congregation says, “kuparidza.”] Ehe kunyangwe Mwari vakanga vamuudza kuti, “Inini kuti madzimai aparidza handidii…?” [Congregation says, “handizvidi.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Hameno kuti vachanotaurirana sei panyaya iyoyo? But pakutaura kwavo Mwari vakanga vati, “Madzimai ngaasadii…?” [Congregation says, “ngaasaparidza.”] But kune madzimai akaita church. Chizvarwa chino chakaoma. Kunana Joyce Meyer. Kana kuti Mayor kana kuti Joyce Mercer handichanyatsoziva zvakanaka. [A brother says, “Meyer.”] Joyce Meyer handiti? Ehe. Vazere vakadzi vanoparidza. Matutu nematutu, emadzimai anoparidza. Handi’moona?

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: But Mwari, pama seven Church age messenger ake, dai akanga ari Mwari anoda kuti vakadzi vaparidze hapaimboshaikwa one. [Congregation says, “mm; Amen.”] Kubva kunguva yaana Pouro kusvika nguva ya Brother Branham kokushaya kuiswawo eh… Amai Katrini Krumen. [Congregation laughs—ED] Handi’muri kuzviona kuti handizvo here vanhu vaMwari? Mwari akaisa vatumwa vano…? [Congregation says, “vanomwe.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndosaka I get surprised at even brothers, vanotaura kuti, “Handei tinonamatirwa kwa Pastor Chris.” “Handei tinonamatirwa kwa T.B Joshua.” “Hatikumbirei Holy water ikoko.”

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: I don’t understand people who …?… Nokuti zvamunazvo imimi zviri pamberi paizvozvo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndopaya patiri kupa munamato zuva rimwe nerimwe kuti Jehovah dzoreredzai status yeMwe…? [Congregation says, “yeMwenga.”] Mwenga urege kusvorwa zvauri kudii izvi…? [Congregation says, “zvauri kuitwa.”] zvauri kuitwa izvi. Tidzoreredzei status yeMwenga Baba mutidzoreredze paya pa status yeMwenga paya. Ndochishuwo chatina…? [Congregation says, “chatinacho,”] chatinacho. Handi’moona. Kuti tirege kuva vanhu vanoshoreka. Tirege kukundwa nana Deuschle. Aiwa.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Hatingavakupedze hedu pama building kana pane zvimwe zvinhu, but power ye presence yaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Paupenyu huri above si…? [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation say, “sin.”] Hupenyu huri above repro…? [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation say, “reproach.”] “Holy, holy, to the Lord God Al…?” [Congregation says, “Almighty.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndoda kuti kana musikana… Munhu achitsvaga mukadzi wokuroora, anoziva kuti ukaroora musikana wemu Message, waroora. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Waroora mudzimai chai…? [Congregation says, “chaiye.”] Mukadzi asinga hure. Mukadzi asingaite zvema boyfriends. Mukadzi asingapfuhwire! Mukadzi anoziva kuti kumurume wake chii…? [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation say, “shewe: Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Mukadzi ane shame fa…? [Congregation says, “facedness.”] Kana akatendeuka, ari musikana, akapedzisira kuita vakomana asati aziva ani…? [Congregation says, “Mwari.”] Kubva zvaakaziva Mwari zvakabva zvapera izvo…? [Congregation says, “izvozvo.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Kwete kuita vakomana uri mu Chur…? [Congregation says, “mu Church,”] mu Church. “God’s Word calls for total …?” [Congregation says, “separation.”] Handi’mukupaona ipapo? Ehe. Kana riri jinda, toda kuti ku Message kusiiwe kune vatsvene vanenge vasina mukondombera ikoko chete ikokoko. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Regai nyika irohwe nemukondombera tinozova batsira ndisu tichivaviga. But hatitarisire mukondombera pakati pe…? [Congregation says, “pedu; Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika Amen hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatisikumunzwa Amen iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Hanzi, “God’s Word calls for total…?” [Congregation says, “separation,”] and “Marriage is honou…? [Congregation says, ‘honourable,’] and the bed undefi…?” [Apostle Gumbura claps once—ED] [Congregation says, “undefiled.”] Hati hure!

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Regai titukwe hedu nenyaya yekuti tinowanzwa madzimai kana kuti ndaroora vakadzi four, kana kuti five, kana kuti six, kana kuti seven. I’m better off than the monogamous men you respect. [Congregation says, “mm.”] Nekuti ivo vanosiya vana vavo vaine nzara vachihu…? [Congregation says, “vachihura.”] Vanogara vari muma avenue umu.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Imimi munoti sei ndisanga bude? Handibve pamba pangu, ukauya kuseni unondiona ndiri pano. Ukauya pa runch [lunch—ED] unondiona ndiri pano. Ukauya manheru uno… Ndobuda ndichienda kupi? Chinoburitsa varume tinochiziva payadhi. Hakusi kunotenga chingwa, unoreva nhema iwe. [Congregation laughs—ED] Hama inenge ichienda kunotenga chingwa? [Congregation says, “uh-huh.”] Ha? Ehe kuenda kubhawa ? Wonzwa, “Ndichambonotandara nevamwe kubhawa tichingonwa hedu doro.” Iwe, iwe, taura chokwadi chako. Ha? Ukaona murume achibva pamba, kubuda pamba kudaio, kudaio. ‘‘Tichadzoka.’’

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Achiti akango uyo… anodzoka iwe warara. Paanodzoka, anodzoka iwe warara. Achidzoka, anodzoka iwe warara, every day. That man is up to no…? [Congregation says, “no good.”] Ndosaka zvinenge zvakanaka, munhu roora madzimai ako aunodii…? [Congregation says, “aunoda.”] Unoenda kupi? Unenge una Mai Zane ava, woenda kuna Mai Bati. Ukangotarisa i variety yakangozvikwanirawo yakagarawo ipapa yakadai. [Congregation laughs—ED] Saka ndoenda kuno—ndino—ndinganovawana vakadai ku—ku—ku—ku ku Avenue? Unomuwana akaita saMai Zane uyu ku Avenue? Womuwana tepi akaita saMai Bati uyu. [Congregation laughs—ED]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Kana waremerwa nevatsvuku handitika ehe, woenda kunana Mai Tito uko, nana Mendi. Vana Amanda vatema handitika? [Congregation laughs—ED] Muri kuona kuti ini ndinosarudza zvandinoziva zvandiri kuita? [Congregation laughs—ED] Pavatsvuku ndendine… vakati simbei, nevakati tetepeyi. Toendawo kuva tema vakatisimbei, vatatitete…ndiri kuda zvese. [Congregation laughs—ED] Varefu nevapfupi futi ipapo. [Congregation laughs—ED]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Saka zvino, ndogobuda ndoenda panze kunotsvakeiko? He? Unonotsvagei panze? Kunotora tsvina iyi. Kuuya wouraya vakadzi vako vose. Kubuda panze kuenda kunotora tsvina iyo, vakadzi vako vakakumirira. Ndosaka, unenge wasarirwa nechinhu one chete. Kuvashandira kuti vadye, vagu…? [Congregation says, “vagute.”] Vawane pekugara pakadii…? [Congregation says, “pakanaka.”] Vapfeke zvakadii…? [Congregation says, “zvakanaka.”] Vana vako vaende kuchiko…? [Congregation says, “kuchikoro.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndoinenge ya’apfungwa yako. That becomes your priority. Wakriyeta kingdom yako kudha…? [Congregation says, “kudhara.”] Ha? Haubudi, but ukaona ma brother anoswera achingobuda ayaya, he? Ukangoona brother vese vatanga game yekududa handitika? Get this from me, you have a started a syndrome to die a poor man. You will never gather any…? [Congregation says, “anything.”] Because ukawana ka four hundred dollars… Four hundred dollars it’s enough, handiti, kuti utenge zvidhinha zvekuwedzera two room.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: But unoziva unoti kana… Unosangana na Raiza womupa fifty. Wosangana na Jestina womupa fifty. [Congregation laughs—ED] Mukuona zvaunenge uchiita mu road mese umo? He? Woenda wonosangana nani? Wonosangana naViora, twenty-five dollars. Vanenge vachipuhwa nekudiwa kwavo. Vamwe vachipuhwa twenty-five. Vamwe vachipuhwa fifteen. Vamwe vachipuhwa ten. But chaunozongoona ndechekuti paunodzokera kupamba, hausisina. Yasara yose kunana Jestina ikoko. Brother Branham vakati, “Ukapota uchidaro unoshandira… pfuma yako inoenda kuma strangers.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Now I’m talking to you with the privilege, isusu kurudzi kwedu isusu varume veko, naturally zvevakadzi vanozvidii…? Vanoda zvemafaro, zvevakadzi nekunwa doro, kutenderera vachitamba. Ndakavaona vese vachifa vasina zvinhu. And vazhinji vacho vanenge vaine nhaka inopuhwa kune munhu wese anopinda pinda vakadzi vausina kuroora, mukondombera.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Unofa pasina munhu anoda kupinda mu spare bedroom yaurere iwe. Vanhu vanoitisana ku—ku—kut—kuti, “Ini ndaendesa tea kuseni [Congregation laughs—ED] imi chii…?... Imi chiendesai sadza.” Vanoramba kupinda mu bedroom makoka. Mweya unenge urimo unenge usina kumira zvakadii…? [Congregation says, “zvakanaka.”] Mataridzikiro ako anoita kuti vamwe vanhu vata—varare vasina kudya chikafu chavo zvakadii…? Anoita nharo, kuti, “Ha, ikoko hatisi kupinda. Ehe.” “But nhingi haana kumbopinda. Nhingi ngaambodii…? Ehe.”

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Vanhu—vanhu vanokwikwidzana kukusu—kukugezesa. But ini zvandakaona manje ndarati—zarurirwa naMwari. Kunzi, no madzimai anoroora aunodii…? [Congregation says, “aunoda.”] Ndosaka tichinamata Mwari webarika! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handi’mo… [0:45:49-inaudible] watinonamata? Ini handinamate Mwari anonamatwa nema Methodist. Kwete! Iyeye handimudii iyeye! Handidi Mwari wemaSavadha anoti barika chivi! Ah-ah!

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Anotora vakadzi varoorwa zvakanaka, ovati mahu…? [Congregation says, “mahure.”] Otora vana vakaita sana Kombo ava, ovati, ma bastards. Ahaziye Mwari wandinonamata. Iyeye mwari handimude iyeye. Handidi kana kumuona. Ehe, ende agara haazi Mwari. Ndi Iswara na Isis. Madonna and what…? And son. Ndosaka ukapinda imomo vanobva vatanga kuti, “MuZita raBaba, noroMwanakomana, noroMweya Mutsveneee.” [Congregation laughs—ED] Ha’moona zvavanenge vachiita?

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Can you go and sit under people who worship three go...? [Congregation says, “three gods.”] When we know, “Behold Oh, Israel the Lord your God is…?” [Congregation says, “one God.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “The Lord your God is…? [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation say, “one God.”] Ndosaka vapfana vedu iye zvino, mupfanha akangwara iye zvino handitika? Iti, “Mwari ndipeiwo pfuma!” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hee? Murume anotsvaka chii…? [Congregation says, “pfuma,”] pfuma. You are nothing, kana Mwari vakasakupa pfuma. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hee? Hanzi naJehovah, “Sirivhera nendarama ndezvaani…?” [Congregation says, “ndezvangu,”] ndezvangu.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: What do women look for? Honour. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Virtue. [Congregation says, “mm.”] Vakadzi vanozviba…? [Congregation says, “vanozvibata.”] Vakadzi vane tsika, vanozvibata. A woman fights to be a lady. Hee? Not a toilet. Any woman anochinjanisa varume, waramba kuva mukadzi, waita to…? [Congregation says, “toilet.”] Hee?

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ungati, Brother Lloyd vouya vokusevenzesa, voenda. Edgar wouya okusevenzesa, woenda. Chibvura vouya okusevenzesa, woenda. Mukodzi wouya okusevenzesa, oenda. Marange ouya okusevenzesa, oenda. Chigova ouya okusevenzesa, woenda. Iwe uri chii uchiitwa zvese izvozvo? Uri kuti vanhu ava vari kukudira mukaka? [Congregation laughs—ED] Aaah! Kufazve uku, masikati mai…? [Congregation says, “machena.”] …?... Kana uri mukaka [0:48:03 inaudible] Handiti. Eh? Nokuti izvozvo vamwe vasikana ndeve kutotaurira, zvituta handiti. Ay—ya—ya—ya!

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Uri kuti vari kuuya vachikupa hupenyu? Itsvinazve iyi! Handitika iyi? Itsvina yauri kudirwa kaiyi handitika? Vamwe vane marwariro avo, vane bhirihaziya. Vamwe vane sifirisi. Vamwe vane gonorrhoea. Vamwe hameno zvirwere zviri muropa raani…? [Congregation says, “ravo,”] ravo. Then tabva ikoko, vese unenge uchikisana nani…? [Congregation says, “navo.”] Imboimajena variety yemate yaunodii…? [Congregation laughs—ED] Kunoti mate ane mbanje. Mate ane nicotine—nicotine. Mate ane sese, mate ane black label.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Haa! Iti, “Mwari ndiitireiwo nyasha,” handiti. Mate ose anouya aine content yaani…? [Congregation says, “yawo.”] He? Ndovamwe ava, handiti. Mamwe mate anodyawo matatya. Vamwe vanodya kamba. Vamwe vanodyawo eh, dzvinyu. Vamwe vanodya nyoka. Ende dzinenge dzirimo uchidya dzese! Saka what have you become?

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ha-a! Hanzi na Brother Branham mu Marriage and Divorce, the best word he put across, he says, “A sass pool, of dirty.” Handi’muri kuzvinzwa zvataura Brother Branham? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vanoti, “A sass pool, of dirty.” Vonyatsotaura kuti, “Toilet inenge iri na…?” [Congregation says, “iri nani,”] iri nani. Ndosaka mwanasikana anozvibata, ehe, mwanasikana anozvibata izvozvo haadi…? [Congregation says, “haaite,”] haaiti.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndosaka tingadaro hedu vanasikana handitika? Ko iye, ukamuona munhu achidhibha mutoireti unofungei iwe? Ko iye unodhibhawo imo…? [Congregation says, “imomo.”] Unofungei ukasvika pa market square woona mumwe munhu achitotora mvura iya iya achidii… achigeza so? [Congregation laughs—ED] Otora handkerchief yake… [Apostle Gumbura laughs—ED] Hanzi … Yepa market square iya handitika? Ehe. Handi’mese munorohwa nehana. Kuti, “H’aa!” Munobuda kumhanya kunosa—kuti “Muri kuona murume uyu? Kuona kugeza? Ageza mutoireti iyeye uyu.” Ko ukazosvika kune anenge achimwa? [Congregation says, “mm!”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Saka varume ponai manheru anhasi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi, “Salvation is what…? [Congregation says, ‘free.’] Why don’t you what…?” [Congregation says, “come.”] Hatiitei Ameni varanda vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatiite Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Salvation is what…?” [Congregation says, “free.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndosaka Jesu akaona kumagumo enyika, ndobva vaona varume vakaita sesu nevakadzi vakaita semi so. Zvikanzi, “Vana vangu vakasaziva, vachangoziva culture ka ava? Kupira mudzimu nokurova makuva. Ndozvavachadii ava…? Kuenda kumadhindindi nekuenda kumabhawa, ndozvavachaziva vana vangu ava. Regai ndivatumire nyeredzi yechinomwe.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Kuenda kunonamata uri mu Salvation Army kana kunonamata uri ku Baptist. Uchiita muZita raBaba, noMwanakomana noMweya Mutsvene. Muchibhabhatidza tuvana tuduku mumadishi, zvakangofanana nokupira mudzi…? [Congregation says, “mudzimu.”] Roman Catholic is the beginning of ancestor wor…? [Congregation says, “worship.”] Ndosaka vese vanoita ancestor worship kuRoma vanodii…? [Congregation says, “vanoenda.”] Handi’muri kuona mamiriro azvakaita? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndosaka chizvarwa chino chine, “Come out from among them!” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosaka vanhu vainamata, kunamata chaiko chaiko munguva ye Ephesus iyi, vanhu vakanga vari pasi, paPauro. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndovaidii ivavo? [Congregation says, “vainamata.”] Then vanhu vari kunamata Mwari chaiye chaiye, panguva ino yedu ino iyi, vanhu vari pasi pa Brother Bra…? [Congregation says, “Branham; Amen.”] Mwari akaisa plan yake yekunamata muma Spoken Words! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika Amen ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kumwe kwese hai…? [Congregation says, “haiko.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ukasvika kunyangwe kune… Kupi kwaunoona kwakaungana vanhu vachinamata, vachinamata ikoko. Plan yekunamata ikoko hakuna. Mutumwa wechinomwe ndi Brother Bra…? [Congregation says, “Branham.”] Ndosaka ndakuratidzai panapa. Akatarisa kudai, akaona seven golden ca…? [Congregation says, “candles.”] Zvikanzi, “Chirega ndikuudze zvakavanzika. Ma candlesticks awawona seven anomirira ma C hurch ages aya.” Zvikanzi, “Ma stars auri kuona ari pamusoro ipo paya apa, ma stars aya ndoma messengers a… ?” [Congregation says, “acho.”] Zvikanzi, “Ndovanhu vachataura zvinhu manje.”

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Nokuti inini pandiri kutaura, muchaona kwese kwatinotarisa kwese uko, Mwari anongotaura ku angel yechizvarwa icho… ? [Congregation says, “ichocho.”] Vese vanhu vari muchizvarwa ichocho vanofanira kuteerera ku angel iyo…? [Congregation says, “iyoyo.”] Ndoda Ameni akadarika Ameni ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Angel iyi, yakati, “Madzimai ngaasacheka bvudzi raani…?” [Congregation says, “ravo.”] Angel iyi, yakati, “Madzimai ngaasapfeka matara…?” [Congregation says, “rmatrauzi.”] Angel iyi, yakati, “Madzimai ngaasapa…?” [Congregation says, “paridza.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndizvo here varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ukapinda mune munhu ane vanhu two million; madzimai akacheka bvudzi, akaisa make-up, akapfeka ma trouser ari ku pulpit, waenda pasi pechikara. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatiite Amen anodarika Amen ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Waenda pasi pechikara chai…? [Congregation says, “chaicho.”] Ha’moona. Ndosaka kuti, pachizvarwa chino i Come out te…? [Congregation says, “tese,”] tese.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndosaka mukatarisa pano, hachitarisai muone pa chapter 2. Tongopedza naipapapa. Tozokontinya hedu Mwari achititendera. Muri kuona pa verse hwani iyo. Iri kuti unto the angel of the Church of…? [Congregation says, “Ephesus.”] Murikuzviona? [Congregation says, “mm.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Yaenda kumutumwa che…? [Congregation says, “chete.”] Mutumwa uyo ndiye ane plan yechi—yechizvarwa icho…? [Congregation says, “ichocho.”] Munhu wese anoparidza muchizvarwa ichocho kana asingatore pamutumwa iyeye, ari ku—ari kuparidza do…? [Congregation says, “dondo.”] Tingaita Amen here varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kunyangwe vaka chechi ine ma double storo mangani...? Matatu. Kana asiri angel wechizvarwa ichocho.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndosaka the only person anga aine true Message munguva ye Ephesus ndiPa…? [Congregation says, “ndiPauro.”] Toenda pa next Church age iyo. Verse 8, hatitarisei verse 8 toone. Tese hativerengei verse 8 tese: And unto the angel of the church in Smyrna write;… Mazvionaka? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Unto the angel of the church in Smy…” [Congregation says, “Smyrna.”] Pakanzi, “Unto the brothers in Smyrna?” [Congregation says, “mm-mm.”] “Unto the brothers who will split the churches in Smyrna?” “Unto the brothers who will uprise and revolt…” Zvanzi, “Unto the angel…” Kwakatumwa angel che…? [Congregation says, “chete.”] Handei pa verse 12 muone. Tarisai verse 12, tese iri kuti kudii: And to the angel of the church in Pergamos write;… Murikuzviona? [Congregation says, “mm.”] Handei pa verse 18: And unto the angel of the church in Thyatira write;… Ya’a fourth church age ka iyi? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handei pa verse 3… pa chapter 3 tese: And unto the… Verse 1. Chapter 3 verse 1 tese: And unto the angel of the church in Sardis write;… Murikuzviona? Verse 14: An… Verse 14 tese: And unto the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write:… Verse 22, chinzwayi. Verse 22 hativerengei tese. Ndoda kuti munhu wese ati, “Ameni,” ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen!”] Hativerengei tose: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: [Congregation says, “Amen.”] That’s a Scriptural exhortation. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kune munhu anozvarwa asina nzeve here? Hanzi, “Uyo ane chii…?” [Congregation says, “ane nzeve.”] Hanzi ngaadii…? [Congregation says, “ngaanzwe.”] Zvinotaura chii…? [Congregation says, “Mweya.”] Saka inzeve here iyi yatinobata neruoko iri? [Congregation says, “mm-mm.”] Ya’a nzeve yoMwe…? [Congregation says, “yoMweya.”] Aha! Handi’muri kupaona? Kureva kuti vamwe nzeve vanadzo but havadii…? [Congregation says, “havanzwe.”] Ha’moona.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Now, kusvika pana… verse 22 ya chapter 3. Iyoyo iyo; munogona kutonyora manje kuti, “From Revelation chapter 2,” handitika? “Verse 1 to eeh Revelation chapter 3,” handitika? “Verse 22 is the Gentile dispe…?” [Congregation says, “dispensation.”] Or “The Fullness of the Gen…?” It’s one and the sa…? Gentile dispensation, or the Fullness of the Gentiles. Ha’moona, this is how you should understand Bhuku iri.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Mukachitanga kuenda kuno verenga manje ma Church ages. Moziva kuti kuri kutaurwa kuma Gentiles che…? Akadaidzwa pa space ye seven Church a…? [Congregation says, “ages,”] ages. Ndopaakadaidzwa ipapa. Ndo Fullness yema Gentiles. Ma Gentiles adanwa. Ma Gentiles ndisu. As opposed kuma Juta, ku Israel.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Tikange tangopedzwa isusu pana Revelation 22 iyo, Mwari va’akutena kuma Jews…? [Congregation says, “Jews.”] Tingaite Amen here ipapa hama? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handi’moona kuti iShoko raMwari rechokwadi kairi. Handika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Right, kuti muone kuti ndiri kureva zvokwadi. Tarisai Revelation chapter 4 yenyu. Muone. Tarisai Revelation chapter 4 yenyu verse 1. Tarisai verse 1 muone. Hativerengei verse 1 muone: After this I looked, and, behold, a door was opened in heaven: and the first voice which I heard was as it were of a trumpet talking with me; which said, Come up hither, and I will shew thee things which must be hereafter.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ah-ah! Mazvibata? Chii chiri pana Revelation chapter 4 verse 1 izvi? Murikuona kuti i rapture iyi? Revelation chapter 4, one. Verse 1, hazvichaitika panyika pano zviitiko. Denga radii…? Door richatarisa mudenga so. A’akunzwa i—inzwi riya riya ranga richitaura sehwamanda riri pasi apa, in the midst of seven golden ca…? [Congregation says, “candlesticks.”] Ra’akutaura riri kupi manje? Ra’akuti, “Come up hi…?” [Congregation says, “hither.”] Nguva yema Gentile yape…? [Congregation says, “yapera.”] Murikuzvionaka varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Yaa rapture time! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndosaka chizvarwa chino chatiri kurarama. I don’t care what people say or how many people argue. This Church age is the last Church age. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika Ameni ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tiri pa the last chur…? [Congregation says, “Church age.”] And Brother Branham is the last Church age messenger. Handi’muri kuzviona zvandiri kutaura vanhu vaMwari? Ehe.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Zvese zvakange zvichitaurwa ma seven Church ages umu, kufumura mweya wechikara che…? [Congregation says, “chete,”] chete. Ha’moona? Tarirai muone, chapter 5. Ndoda kungokuratidzai. Right, murikuona pa chapter 5? Verse 1. Ndiri kungokuratidzai ma verse 1 chete. Hatitarisei vere 1 muone. Muone kuti a’akudenga. Verse 1 hativerengei: And I saw in the right hand of Him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the backside, sealed with seven seals.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: A’akuona kuti—chii kumusoro kudenga uko? Throne. Murikuona ari kuona throne? [Congregation says, “mm-mm.”] Handi’muri kuzviona kuti ari kuona throne? Ha’moona? Now, ndoda kuti muchibata the tricky part of this whole thing. Ha’moona pandakuverengerai Revelation chapter 1 verse 2, ndiri kukutaurirai history? Ndo history maitikiro azvaiita panyama zvinhu izvi. But zvinhu pazvaiitika panyama apa, kudenga zvaiitika pamwe…? [Congregation says, “pamweya.”] Handi’murikupaona?

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Saka iye manje aona zvinhu panyama, anga achinyatsozviona nemaziso kudai zvichiitika iri history, achinyo…? [Congregation says, “achinyora.”] Ta’akuenda pabhuku riya riya manje rakabatwa, rine Munhu akagara pachigaro paya paya. A’akuudzwa mweya uri mune zvinhu zvaanga achidii…? [Congregation says, “achiona.”] Tingaite Amen here ipapapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Wa’amweya wanga uchishanda muzvinhu izvo…? [Congregation says, “izvozvo.”] Kuti zvaiwana simba razvo ku…? [Congregation says, “kupi.”] Handi’mukuzviona? Ndosaka mukaenda pana chapter 6 manje apa. Mukuona kuti pana chapter 6 apa, ver—hativerengei verse 1 muone: And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seals,…

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Akunzi ma seals. Ta’ane ma seven seals, akaviga mweya wanga uchishanda muma Church age…? [Congregation says, “ages.”] Mweya wanga uchishanda muma Church ages. Ari kuratidzwa John zviri kuitika kuti, “Simuka uuye kudenga,” aende kudenga. Akuona kuya kuya kune Munhu akagara pachigaro, ane bhuku raanaro rine mweya, yanga ichishanda muchizvarwa chese chaanga achinhingirikirawo handiti.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: A'akuratidzwa manje kuti honai makundiro amakaita. Hamuna kukunda nekugona kwenyu. Pane mweya wanga uri…? [Congregation says, “uripo.”] A’akuratidzwa manje. Mukaona chapter 6, ma seals aya. Chapter 7 tatova kumaJuta. Mukuona chapter 7, yava hundred and forty-four thousand? Murikuona kuti maJu-maJuta kaaya? Ha’moona.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Mukaenda pana chapter 8, ine part ma Gentile pakuburuka kwaM—kwaMwari achibvuta vatsvene. Yabva yakontinya, a’ama trumpets, avamaJu...? Handi’muri kuzviona zvarinenge richiita. Yabva yangokontinya ari ma trumpets ava maJuta. Ha’moona. Harimborasa ehh, Bhuku iri handitika. Handei pa chapter 10 muchiona. Handei pa chapter 10 muchiona, ndopa ndoda kuti tione napo pa chapter 10 apo. Handi’maona, hativerengei verse 4—verse 1: And I saw another mighty Angel come down from heaven, clothed with a cloud: and a rainbow was upon His head, and His face was as it were the sun, and His feet as pillars of fire:

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Tamuona here pana Revelation chapter 1 Munhu ari kudescribwa apa? Maionaka pillar of fire iyo? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ma feet anenge brass kaaya handitika. Tawonaka kuna Revelation chapter 1? [Congregation says, “Amen,”] Ndiye Munhu mumwe chete iye...? [Congregation says, “iyeye.”] Uyu auya pano manje akuvhura bhuku riya iri. Handei muone pana verse 2 apa, handei muone: And He had in His hand a little book open: and He set His right foot upon the sea, and His left foot on the earth, Verse 3: And cried with a loud voice, as when a lion roareth: and when He had cried, seven thunders uttered their voices. Verse 4: And when the seven thunders had uttered their voices, I was about to write: and I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Seal up those things which the seven thunders uttered, and write them not. Verse 5: And the Angel which I saw stand upon the sea and upon the earth lifted up His hand to heaven, And sware by Him that liveth for ever and ever, who created heaven, and the things that therein are, and the earth, and the things that therein are, and the sea, and the things ...

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Verse 7 ndoda kuti munhu wese ati Amen ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengei verse 7 tese: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he shall begin to sound, the mystery of God should be finished, as He hath declared to His servants the prophets.

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi, “Ma seals iwayaya, bhuku riye rata’atichiona rine ma seals ayaya richivhurwa, roita symbol form, wo—toona ma symbols ari mu seal yekutanga. Toona symbol iri mu seal yechipiri, yonzi mweya iyoyiyi yanga ichishanda muma seven Church ages atabva kukuratidza pasi apa.”

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Zvikanzi, “But haikona kunetseka kuvanhu va-panotanga kurira hwamhanda yemutumwa wechinomwe anova ndiye mutumwa weRaudhokiya iyi, paanotanga kurira iyeye mystery dzose idzi dzauri kuona kumachurch ages idzi nema symbols [Apostle Gumbura knocks several times on the pulpit] ose iwaya anobva abuda payi...?” [Congregation says, “pachena. Amen.”] Hatiite Amen akadarika Amen ipapa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen iye hatisi kumunzwa iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: THE REVELATION (PART 3)
entries.text: Ndosaka takagamuchira Brother Bra...? [Congregation says, “Branham.”] Ha’moona magamuchiriro atakavaita? Nokuti ndiye mutumwa wacho iyeye. Akanga... Muri kuona pakanzi pachatanga kurira mutumwa wechinomwe. Mutumwa wechinomwe iyeye ndivo Bro Branham ava. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndiye mutumwa wacho iye...? entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Tinokwazisana tose muZita raTenzi Jeso Kristu. [Congregation says “Amen.”] Tichikwazisa vatsvene vese vauya, pazuva ranhasi. [Congregation says “Amen.”] Tine mufaro kuva nemi mukati meimba yaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tikuona hama dzeGweru. Saka tine mufaro kuva nadzo chaizvo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hama dzeKwekwe, tinofara kuva nemi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Tichitenda Mwari nokuimba kwakanaka chai… ? [Congregation says, “chaizvo.”] Kuimba kwedu kuri kunakidza. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] I trust by God’s grace it gets better and…? [Congregation says, “better,”] better. Hama dza’akugona kutungamira nziyo zvakanaka chai…? [Congregation says, “chaizvo,”] chaizvo. Unopinda muMweya. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Dai zvaramba zvakadii…? [Congregation says, “zvakadaro,”] zvakadaro, Mwari vachitiitira nyasha. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mufaro wedu chaiwo, kuti tive muKereke makadii…? [Apostle and Congregation say, “makadai.”] Hatirambei tichinamata.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: I want to remind you again, let’s not forget October. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Today is a day of fas…? [Congregation says, “fasting,”] fasting. I want us to put October, very much in pra…? [Congregation says, “in prayer.”] Ehe, October hausi mwedzi wakanaka. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kana muhope unenge uchingozviona kuti haah… [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha’moona?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Saka unenge uchingorarama like you’re expecting something. Maybe it’s psychological, one doesn’t know. Saka unenge uchiita seku expecter something. Unongoona, it’s just …?... Unenge usinganyatsofara zvakanaka. Saka ukambogara unotoona mind yako yadii... ya drifter, handitika?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Watobata shaya usingadii…? [Congregation says, “usingazive.”] Ehe. Wotozoudzwa nevamwe kunzi, “What’s going on?” Wozoziva kuti, “No, mind yangu yadii…? Yakanganisika.” [Congregation says, “mm.”] But today, I want everybody pa day re fasting, to pray rebuking that spirit. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handika? Kuti tiwukurire, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] mweya uyu handitika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ehe, tibude… October na November. Zvagara November kuvanhu vatema hausi mwedzi wakadii…? [Congregation says, “wakanaka,”] wakanaka. So, let’s really pray for this period. Particularly this year. This year has been extra wonderful. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ranga riri gore rakanaka chai…? [Congregation says, “chaizvo,”] chaizvo, muzvinhu zvose. Ha’moona?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Most people would expect a double portion, panyama chete. [Congregation says, “mm.”] But I was talking to Brother… Ndichitaura na Brother… aah, Nyathi pavasvika masikati. Ndikati, “Double portion iyika, it wasn’t so much gore rino panyama. [Congregation says, “mm.”] The double portion, Mwari vakatanga va dealer nesu pamweya.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Hatisati takambo enjoyer kunamata nekuparidza, sezvatakaita gore …? [Congregation says, “gore rino.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] And I go back, all the Messages when I listen to them, atakaparidzirana gore rino iri. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] I even bemoan, ma Messages atisina ku taper, atakatanga panapa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] They were so wo…? [Congregation says, “wonderful.”] Ha’moona? Zvokuti that’s when we realise kuti, “Ahh, vamwe vari kuma out uku, havana chavari kudii...? [Congregation says, “chavari kunzwa,”] chavari kunzwa.”

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Mwari vakatanga ku dealer nesu muma Messages. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] The type of Messages we were getting, were wonderful Messages. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvekuti it’s impossible kuti munhu aregere kupona ipa…? [Congregation says, “ipapo,”] ipapo. Takaita ma Messages anovhangera, eh ano reviver, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] eh anopa munhu commitment, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] anoita kuti uite look forward to the next service. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari vakanga vachitiitira nyasha chai...? [Congregation says, “chaizvo.”] Until coming for services… Ndozvaizvichitaura VaNyathi kuti, “It doesn’t become a struggle any…?” [Congregation says, “anymore.”]
