entries.text: Mukuona kuti i curse iyi? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Uku ari kusasavara kuti, “Ndakadanwa.” Mukuona zvaanange achiita? Ari kusasavara kuti “Ndakadanwa.” Heh? Akadanwa here mukomana uya? [Congregation says, “aiwa/ah-ah.”] Moona zvinoita Mwari ka? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Dai mupfanha uya ari pano, nhamo dzese dzaari kuona idzodzo angade asina. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Muri kuona pattern yehupenyu huri kurarama Omega? [Congregation says, “mm.”] Munhu akabuda mu will yaani…? [Congregation says, “yaMwari.”] Tingaita Amen here ipapo hama? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika ipapo? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ndaka’a ndichiona muzukuru wangu achiuya panapa, Crosby, nemudzimai wake Flo. Vachiuya panapa vari kubva kwaChitsinde uko, handiti? Unonyatsoona vanhu vari out of the will of what…? [Congregation says, “of God.”] Havana chavakura pamweya. Haana chaanoziva pamweya, kunze kwenha…? [Congregation says, “kwenharo.”] Hapana. Hanzi, “Sekuru musanditemewo kani mazuva ano.” Ndikati, “Handimboregi! Nekuti iwe unokuti kutema, asi ini ndinokuti kudzidzi…?” [Congregation says, “kudzidzisa.”] Hm?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Handimboziva kudanwa kwemunhu anodanwa out of controversy. Unobva paChechi pauri kushaudhana nevanhu, woenda wonoita ministry. Ende ministry yacho ino flourisher under a pastor, ari kuda kuparadza ku Church kwawakadii…? [Congregation says, “kwawakabva.”] Is that a ministry? [Congregation says, “no.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: I’ve never seen a ministry like that in my whole wildlife! Heh? Unoenda kune mufundisi ane—anovenga Pastor vawakabva kwawu… Ari kuda ku prover a point kuna pastor ivavo. Hah? Hanzi, ari kukususumidza. Ende chinondinakidza, hechi. Ko, ivo pastor ivava havana here vanhu vavowo here ikoko vavakakudzawo? Vanotora vapfanha vanobva kune Chechi dzomumwe murume, wavanoti ndiSatani murume iye…? [Congregation says, “iyeye.”] Asi otora vana vake vaakaparidzira, ovaita vafundisi muchechi maani…? [Congregation says, “make,”] mako.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Vanoparidzirwa na Crosby. Imagine kuti i ministry idzodzo? Vapedza kuparidzirwa na Crosby, vanoparidzirwa na Innocent Nehohwa. Vapedza kuparidzirwa na Innocent, izvezviso Omega akauya nemukadzi wake akatyoka gumbo, vanomupa service ne Sunday. [Congregation laughs—ED] “Beware of false prophets…!” [Apostle knocks pulpit twice—ED; Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika ipapo! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Unoona zvipfanha zvedu zvakabva patiri because… Iye makwai akadaro haa…? [Congregation says, “haana.”] Haakwanise kudzidzisa vanhu kusvika pa level i…? [Congregation says, “iyoyo.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Unoona zvichimupukuta eh, marara kudai, zvichimupukuta marara eh, parufu kudai. Mupfanha akamira zvake …?... maihwe. Handidi kumbokunyeperai, maitiro anoita hama dzedu dzimwe dzemu Message, ndeesha…? [Apostle and Congregation say, “shaisano.”] Ndeekuda kuparadza kwakabva vanhu. Pfungwa yaivepo ndeyekuti vapfanha vakaonekwa vachisimudzwa …?... zvichaita kuti tikwezve vanhu variko, vaine pfungwa dzekuti tinouya todai. Kute… Kurarama kwedu kwatiri kuita panapa, tiri kurarama nekuti Mwari vanoda kuti tivepo! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ngatiite Amen akadarika Amen hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: But varume vakaedza kutiparadza variko. Kutitadzirira kwavakadii uku…? [Congregation says, “kwavakaita.”] Ende ndoda kuti ndikutaurirei chokwadi, takatovakunda vanhu ivavo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hadzisi nhema. Takavaita sei vanhu ava…? [Congregation says, “takavakunda.”] Vaifunga kuti vana Innocent vakanzi va’a vaparidzi, vana Bernard vakanzi va’a vaparidzi, vana Omega va’a vaparidzi, mese muchamhanya, kidi kidi, kunoitwa vaparidzi. Vaifunga kuti zvinobata, heh?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: But vapfanha vacho yava headache manje kwavari ikoko. Matangiro ezvinhu akaita seaya aya anoti netseyi. Havambofa vakavagona vapfanha ivo vaya. Pachauya imwe cli—chao—creation ichaita kuti iye atange kutaura kuti, “Vanhu ivava takavatora kwakati.” Nekuti zvinenge zvamusha…? [Congregation says, “zvamushatira.”] Origin yechinhu… But isu tinobva tabata kuti; “Aah ah, aah ah, aah ah, mukuru uyoyoyo, une chinangwa chisina Mweya waMwari muka…?” [Congregation says, “mukati, Amen.”] Zvino ini ndo’zvandakanakira vanhu vaMwari. Handimbofa ndakatora munhu anobva kune any church, ndichimuita pastor pano ini. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] I’m not mad. Ndosaka vana Brother Chatima nana Brother Innocent vakauya vakagara panapa. Most of you thought nekuti mupfanha wangu, ndichangoyerekana ndamupa pulpit mangwa…? [Congregation says, “mangwana.”] Ndakamupa? Haana kudzimara vakatiza vachi comprainer nyaya iyoyo? Handitambe nepurupiti [pulpit—ED] zve type iyo…? [Congregation says, “iyoyo, Amen.”] Moreso now, after October 2…? [Congregation says, “2000.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Mweya wekungosimudza chero munhu wawaunza panapa, uno regretter rimwe gore, a’akuzvivakira hushe hwaani…? [Congregation says, “hwake.”] Dzidziso akuunza yani…? [Congregation says, “yake.”] Ende ari muzodziwa wenhe…? [Congregation says, “wenhema.”] “Beware of false prophets.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatinyengeterei takatarisana nenyaya iyoyo Chishanu chanhasi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Mwari ndoda kuziva kuti mutumwa ndiani?” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari vakatiratidza kuti tinoziva sei kuti vatumwa ndivanani. Hatitarisei ...?... Verse… hativerengei tose: Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Muri kupaona? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Muchavaziva nezvibereko zvaani…?” [Congregation says, “zvavo.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika Amen ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handisikumunzwa Amen iyeye! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Haapfure ipapo Amen iyeye! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda kuti ndikuudzei kuti, nhasi VaChitsinde vanoparidza vachiti, “Brother Gumbura is a fa—false anointed.” Handitika? But vanoti Kiro, [Crosby—ED] Innocent, Omega vaparidzi handitika? Vagoti, Mudekwa, Musharu vana Mai Mlambo handitika? Vamwe vacho ndatovakanganwa, vanopinda i…? [Congregation says, “ikoko.”] Vavakatora kupi? [Congregation says, “pano.”] Hatichinzwai kuti according to Scripture, zvinobvumirana here zvavari kutaura nezvinodzidzisa Mwa…? [Congregation says, “Mwari.”] Hativerengei tione. Verse 7, 17 tese: Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ndoda Amen akadarika Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika Amen ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika ipapo! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nhasi uno kana VaManyere chaivo ku Botswana vakawana VaMandiya, ndiye anenge atovawo munhu wavowo iyeye. Makambozviona izvozvo? Murandu nhasi akawana izvo, a—akawana Manyuchi, akawana Marima, akawana Ma—Marisa, atowanawo makwa…? [Congregation says, “makwayi.”] Vachibva pamuti wakadii…? [Congregation says, “waka...”] Tongai ndimi.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ko sei ndiine raki rekuti panobva vanhu vakanaka pandiri? Heh? Why? Hazvina mhosva kuti ndiani. Even ari musikana. Ivo vana sister vatiri kutaura vari kutiza panapa, vakanopinda kuchechi kwanaChitsinde munovanzwa kunzi vatova number one ikoko. Vana Madovi, vakashanyirwa kudzimba vachisvika kuchechi idzo dziye. Kuzoonekwa kunzi, “Hah, muri vafu—muri vanhu chaivo chaivo.” Vachi parker motokari dzekuma company kudai. “But mufundisi wenyu, mufundisi wenyu.”

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Manje Madovi ndakamuwana ari muhedheni. Handina kutanga kuparidzira Madovi. Ndakatanga kuparidzira hanzvadzi yake yainzi, Perestenzia. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Perestenzia ndiye akatanga kunamata, ndokunokwezva ruzevha rwe… [Congregation says, “rwese.”] Ndokuuya kwaMadovi manje uya uyu. Vaiva vapfanha vomuShurugwi umu. Ndeve kumusha kwana Pastor Chuma uko, heh? Mungaone dumbu riya richihwaio, hakuna zviriko. [Congregation laughs—ED] NdiMwari uya akazomeresa dumbu ri…? [Congregation says, “riya.”] Vaziva inonzi Me…? [Congregation says, “Message.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Vana Keyo ndakavatora dziri mbavha dzakanga dzine court case, vabatwa vachiba ma deo ma OK, muno mutawundi muna First Street. [Congregation laughs—ED] Aika. Isu ndisu takatovaita kuti vave va… zvavave nhasi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Asi ndisu vacho vaipa, ivo vana…? [Congregation says, “vanaka.”] Mudekwa ndakatora mu boy-sky, achipfeka chikabudura che BSA—British eh, South African eh, [Congregation says, “Police,”] Police Force. [Congregation laughs—ED] Ndopandakatora munhu waMwari uya achigara mu boy sky. Taitoti tikaenda pamba pake, ndini ndaienda pamba pake, ndichinoparidza mumba make, achigara nehanzvadzi dzake dzimwe dzashaya iyezveno. Aigara kuseri uko, ku boy sky uko. Ndokwaaigara uko. Ndopandakatanga kumuparidzira …?... Vana Sister Musasa zvazviri zvana izvi. Heeeh. Mudekwa kwakuzoti kwakwanu manje, … [1:19:56 inaudible] ndasimuka manje ndobva ndabuda. Manje kwaMudekwa kwakaoma. KwaMudekwa hakuna game iri funny.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ndosaka makaona Mai Gwe, mwana hwava. Mai Musasa, mwana hwava. Endai munoona hanzvadzi yavo ina Madzingira uyu, headache dzacho hadzidii…? [Congregation says, “hadziperi.”] Anogara achingotemwa nemusoro, chipfuva, chipfuva. Handi’taivanamatira last week. Hameno ane chinhu chake ikokoku chinonetsa vanhu. But ukauya pano muZita raJeso, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha’moona kuti brother, vakadzimaidzwa naSatani paya? Ndokutorwa kwakuenda kune imwe chechi. He did not pray for revela…? [Congregation says, “revelation, Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Vana Brother Musharu… Musharu ndakavinga ndega ku Fretcher, Bernard Mizeki yavharwa, ndokuuya kwa—kwaMusharu. Joyina ndakatochengeta kubva kubudirwa nemudzimu, aida kuiswa zita ro—ro—romusha. Ndichivigira ma cassettes kuDhayadhaya. Hah? Ndosaka kana ukaona munhu achitaura kuti, “Brother Gumbura havana Mwari,” chinongozonakidza ndechekuti, iye Mwari wacho haavadii…? [Apostle and Congregation say, “haavazive.”] Ndiyaniko akati Mwari wakavasiya? [Congregation laughs—ED] Ndiyani wakati…

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: [Apostle laughs—ED] Heh, hanzi, “Ndiyani wakavati Mwari wakavadii…?” [Congregation says, “wakavasiya.”] Heh? Ndichisiiwa naMwari kupiko, ini? Inini I… Mukaona ha—ha—haku… Mukaona zvichinzi Mwari andisiya handitika? Hakuna atorwa. Ndozvazvinodii…? [Congregation says, “zvazvinoreva.”] Ehe, tafoira to…? [Congregation says, “tose, Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Hongu ndoziva kuti ma brothers nema sisters mazhinji ari muno anonamata. Handishore kunamata kwenyu. But handifungi kuti vaviri vanonamata seni. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nekuti ini ndinoziva kuti kana ndikapfugama ndichinamata; zvandinonzwa, nezvinodaira Mwari, nezvinoita denga, ini ndikanamata denga rinodaira. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Aaamen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvandotoziva kuti Mwari vada…? [Congregation says, “vadaira.”] Iko kutova pano patiri ipo panapa, mut—kudairwa kweyi uku? [Congregation says, “kwemunamato/muteuro, Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Moti ndaizoimbireiko, Madairiro Enyu Emui…? [Congregation says, “Emunamato, Amen.”] Fungai marwisirwo andinoitwa nevanhu vese, asi ndine congregation yakadaio muHarare. Heh? I don’t care about their thousands but this quality iri muno yevapfanha …?... nema sisters ari munomu, any pastor would die to have a Church like this. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndochokwadi chizere icho…? [Congregation says, “ichocho, Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Loyalty yacho. Commitment yacho. Cleanliness yacho. Holiness ya…? [Apostle and Congregation says, “yacho.”] Kubva kwavakaita kumushonga, kumudzimu, hadzizi mbiri chechi dzaunosvika uchiwana dzakaita seinoyi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Muno unotarisa munhu uchinyatsoziva kuti mupfanha uyu zango haa…? [Congregation says, “haana.”] Mucheka mutema haa...? [Congregation says, “haana.”] Makuva haadii uyu…? [Congregation says, “haarove.”] He has no charm! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] He lives by God’s grace every day. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ndosaka makwayi angu vanhu vaya. Ndosaka mukaona nyangwe… Hakuna mwana anotuka baba zvikashanda. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosaka mukaona vanenge vachingoti, “Gumbura uya achafa. Gumbura uya achaparara.” Handiparari. Anoparara ndiani? [Congregation says, “ndivo, Amen.”] VaChitsinde vakati vaaona makwayi aya zvikanzi, “Vakomana, vakomana, vakoma…”

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Vaone Crosby, havazive kupona kwake. Vana Fombe; Francis, havazive kupona kwavo. Ha’moona? Vanoziva kupona kwana Francis Fombe? Havavazive. Kungokumba vanhu chete. Womira pa purupiti manje wotanga kutema varume vacho. “Ndimi vanhu chete vauya pano imimi nekuti makurumbidza kujekerwa. Rume riya riya…” Zvino iye… anobva adaidza muchato wake. Woti, “Huyai kumuchato. Huyai kumuchato, musi we Saturday.” Brother? Kwakaita muchato ne Saturday kuHarare kunhingi ku—ku—ku church ikoko last week. Hakuna kana munhu one akadii…? [Congregation says, “akaenda.”] Vaipopota ne Sunday. “Manga muri kupi? Makanga muri kupi?”

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Kwakayenda vedu. Idzidziso yani iyoyo? [Congregation says, “yenyu/yepano.”] Idzidziso yemuRevhi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Idzidziso ya Pastor Gumbura. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosaka nanhasi ndino challenger chechi dziri mu Message, muno muZimbabwe muno... Haumbowane chechi dzakabatana sei…? [Congregation says, “seino.”] Hakuna. Isu parufu. [Apostle claps once in demonstration of unity—ED] Pamuchato. [Apostle claps once in demonstration of unity—ED] Pama service. [Apostle claps once in demonstration of unity—ED]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: “What do you give them?” We give them Go…? [Congregation says, “Gospills.”] Tingaite Amen here ipapo hama? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handisi kumunzwa Amen iyeye? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosaka mukaona ha’moona? Mwari vakabva vanyora zvikanzi, “Aah ah. Murume wese muti.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ini ndotori muti. Iwe uri chii? [Congregation says, “chibereko.”] But kana muti uri wenhundurwa, unotemha chii pauri? [Congregation says, “ndundurwa.”] Kana muti uri mu orange, unotemha chii? [Congregation says, “ma orange.”] Kana muti uri ma guava, unotemha chii? [Congregation says, “ma guava.”] Hapana munhu anotemha ma guava, panhundurwa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatiitei Amen varanda vaMwari! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika ipapo! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handisi kumunzwa Amen iyeye? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ende mese munogamuchira kuti makadzidza kunamata pano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosaka ndinonakidzwa pese pandinoona vana Kiro. [Crosby—ED] Paakauya… “Sekuru, hakuna munhu aikukundai kuparidza imi panyika pano. Maiparidza imimi.” Ha’moona zvaari kutaura? Ari kuti mayi…? Ko zvanhasi anozviziva sei? Ha’moona mafungiro evanhu ava? Nezuro tete, zvikanzi, “Ndasangana nevanhu vatiri kuda, vanoita zve construction, vana Mugugu. Eh, vanoita zve construction. Saka vanga vachiti vanokuzivai, makamboparidza pane rumwe rufu kudai. Vachiti, ‘Haah, murume uya dai asina kuparidza polygamy, i number one. Kwakazobva ne polygamy ndokupiko?’”

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Muri kuona pfungwa dzavo? Zvekugona kuparidza kana kusagona kuparidza haisi nyaya. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nyaya hombe ndeyekuti panopona vanhu here ipapo? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatiitei Amen ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Panorerwa here vana, nevakomana, nevasikana, varume nemadzimai? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vachikudza mhuri dzavo, makuva vasingaro...? [Congregation says, “vasingarove.”] Mazango vasingaba...? [Congregation says, “vasingabati.”] Mishonga vasingabate. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Asi Mwari achivapa mabasa nemari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zviri kuitika here pano izvozvo? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ndosaka ini ndinotenda kuti [Apostle knocks pulpit twice—ED] vanhu vandakatanga navo chaivo chaivo, dai ndakanga ndisiri waMwari ndakangofanana navo. Takatanga nana Brother Musharu, ndovana baba vana Zipporah ava, havachanamata. Vana Emmanuel Runyanga havachanamata. Takanamata navo vakomana ivavo, vakawanda. Hameno zvakavawana mukukura umu, vakangosiyana nechekunamata. Ko isu chakatichengeta…? [Apostle and Congregation say, “chii?”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Hamuzirimi makwayi edu ekutanga. Makwayi edu ekutanga akadzokera kumai…? [Congregation says, “kumashure.”] Ko chii chinoita kuti kurambe kuchiuya vanhu? Handidi kukunyeperai, “Beware of false prophets...” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mu Message ma false prophets awa...? [Congregation says, “awanda.”] Kuma denomination, it goes without sa...? [Congregation says, “say.”] But muporofita wechokwadi, pastor vechokwadi, unovaziva nezvibereko zvaani…? [Congregation says, “zvavo, Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Saka unofanira kuti ukasvika kuna Thembi, woti, “Nhai Thembi, wakanyatsopona here pawakauya pasi peshumiro yaVaGumbura?” Kana Thembi akaita sister uyu, chimwe chinhu chakaitika muchipfuva chake, ndini ndakachiita? Ndiani? [Congregation says, “NdiMwari.”] That’s how you know a pastor. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Wosvika woti, “Keith kana kuti Nyaude, wakapona here chaizvo chai…?” [Congregation says “chaizvo.”] Kana vapfanha vakapona zvekuti vakaregera mbanje, vakaregera vasikana, vakatambira chipikirwa choMweya Mutsvene, akazviita ndiani? [Congregation says, “ndiMwari.”] Heh? Muri kuzvionaka varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Nhasi unoona Va Doc [doctor—ED] vachibva ku Botswana, kuuya kuShoko raani…? [Congregation says, “raMwari.”] Kubva riri jaya, kusvika aroora. Iye zvino atarisira mhuri yake. Nei? Tarirai vana brother ava, kubva Bindura uko, Botswana. Vadii kubuda kuenda kunorova eeh, beer, hah? Kutamba nevasikana. Mari yavapozve? Muzvambarara wemo…? [Congregation says, “wemota,”] wemota. Hm? Chii chinenge chakaitika? Ndiri kuvabata nenyanga yangu vakomana ava? Kune nyanga inoita kuti munhu agare akatendeka, aite conscience, arare anamata, averenge Bhaibhiri, akunde mahure, akunde zvikomba, nyanga? “Ho-o? Nyanga dza’akuponesa?”

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Chinoponesa iRopa! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen varanda vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chinoporesa chii varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “iRopa, Amen, Hallelujah, Amen.”] Chinoporesa iRopa. Ndosaka munhu nemunhu akapona panapa, i confirmation yekuti wakaparidzirwa, nemunhu anenge akatumwa noMweya waani…? [Apostle knocks on the pulpit and Congregation says, “waMwari.”] Ndokupona kwawakadii…? [Apostle knocks on the pulpit and Congregation says, “kwawakaita.”] Hativerengei tone. Right tichipedza hedu. Verse 18 tese, handei pa verse 18 tese: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit. Verse 19: Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire. Verse 20: Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Toda Amen akadarika Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika ipapo! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chechi ine mweya wetsvina uchaiwona nema—nemakwayi anobuda ipa…? [Congregation says, “ipapo.”] Chechi ine Mweya waMwari uchawona nemakwayi anobuda ipa…? [Congregation says, “ipapo.”] Makwayi ndiwo anoratidza chibereko chevanhu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndozvinoratidza kuti muri pasi peshumiro yechokwadi here, kana kuti yenhe…? [Congregation says, “yenhema.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ndosaka isu tikaendesa vasikana kuma college, kunoita ma teacher kana ma Lab tech, anodzokaka? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Achiraramaka ikoko? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Anoita zvikomba? [Congregation says, “mm-mm.”] Achichengetwa na Pastor Gumbura, nechikwambo chavo? [Brother says, “no.”] Chii chinovachengeta? [Congregation says, “ndiMwari,”] God.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ini ndinotenda kuti Mwari pakati pedu vanhu vaMwari aripo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Honai ana Brother Kakunga vakatendeukaka ava? [ Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vari kuno kuZimbabwe handiti? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vakaenda kuMarawi. Vakanohedhuka? [Brother says, “kwete.”] Manje mukanzwa testimony yavo ava, kuMarawi muparidzika ava? Chechi yese yaanosvika vanonzi, “VaKakunga ngavambotigovera.”

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: [Apostle chuckles—ED] Inini ndikaparidzira munhu wese, even ukaenda ku Russia, unonoita number one ikoko. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handizivi kuti sei, bu… Hakuna munhu wandinoparidzira, akaenda anywhere, akasanorega kuita woMweya. Brother Mavhunda chaivo ku—ku South Africa uko, vanga vakukumbirwa nomumwe munhu anga angori mu evangelist angofamba achiparidza kuti, “Ita charge of this church.” Moona zvinoitika? Handichazive vamwe brother vakandi-textira vachiti, “Ndiri kukumbirwa kunzi ndiite zvakati, zvakati, zvakati nemunhu weku denomination yakati.” Ndichivati, “Hah, imi, siyanayi nazvo munhu waMwari.”

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Hakuna, even musikana wandinoparidzira ukapinda… Nhasi uno ukapinda kuchechi… Even ukaenda kunopinda ku Celebration Centre, ukangoita one-month uripo, pastor vachada kukuziva kuti ndiwe ani? Nekuti vanongoona kuti mweya une mwana uyu uri di…? [Congregation says “different, Amen.”] Ndinouwana kupiko Mweya uyu, kana ndisingaupuhwe naMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosaka ndiri kukutaurirai, hanzi, “Munovaziva nezvibereko zvavo.” [Congregation says “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Munhu nemunhu ngaanamate manheru anhasi vanhu vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nhasi izuva redu reChishanu iri. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Ndapinda paChechi apa kwemakore but handitombozive kuti mufundisi ndiani. Ndingazoitewo hupenzi hwekuti ndagara paChechi twenty years, ndongowomoka kubvapo. Ndapuhwa vana, ndapuhwa vakwasha, ndapuhwa dzimba, ndapuhwa basa. Nokubvapo ndichituka, kuzvitorera cur…? [Congregation says, “curse.”] Mwari ndipei chizaruro manheru anhasi.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatiitei Amen akadarika Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosaka ndiri kukumbira kuti, “Mwari, ndoda kuona status yemunhu wese achichinja pano.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ndakaona Brother Witness vachiuya vari mwana wechikoro, iye zvino akuzviseenzera. Vana Brother Nyaude ava, vakuzviitira zvima projects zvavo ku town uku. Vakawuya vari vana vezvikoro, vari vapfanha vatatu. Handi’moziva kuti vaiva vari vatatu vapfanha ava? Vana Brother Magunde ava, vakauya vachibva kuzvikoro handiti? Va’ava vakomana vakuru, vana Brother Opa ava. Toda kuona something chichiita happen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Vana Brother Gwendere ava, vakawuya vari vana vezviko…? [Congregation says “vezvikoro.”] Mwari akadaira muteuro here varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Inyanga ya Pastor Gumbura yakadaira muteuro yese yatiri kuona panapa? [Congregation says, “no.”] Ndiyani akadaira miteuro iyi? [Congregation says “ndiMwari.”] Ndiyani Ari kutiropafadza Uyu? [Congregation says “ndiMwari.”] Ndiyani anotipa rukanda rwakanaka? [Congregation says “ndiMwari.”] Ndiyani anotiporesa pazvirwere? [Congregation says “ndiMwari, Amen.”] “Muchavaziva nezvibereko zvavo!” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Panenge paina Mwari, Mwari vanosimbisa vo…? [Congregation says “voga, Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Until zvatinoita isusu zvinoita sevanhu vane zvikwambo, nekuti hazviitwe nemunhu asina Mwari. Kana munhu asina Mwari, unotofanira kuva musho…? [Congregation says, “mushonga.”] Kana pasina mushonga ndiyani…? [Congregation says “ndiMwari.”] Vanhu venyika kuti vatiti tina Mwari, havagone kuzvigamuchira. But mirai ndikutaurirei vanhu vaMwari, [Apostle Gumbura knocks on pulpit several times—ED] izvezvi manheru ano atiri kuparidza kudai handitika? [Apostle knocks on pulpit several times—ED] Izvozvi tichiparidza kudaiwo, God is here. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Have faith in what…? [Congregation says, “in God.”] Unowana healing yaani? [Congregation says, “yako.”] Mweya yetsvina inodzi…? [Congregation says “inodzingwa, Amen.”] Hazvimbokoni.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ndosaka iwewe iti, “Mwari ndiitirei nyasha manheru anhasi. [Congregation says, ‘Amen.’] Ndoda kubuda muno ndagamuchira chipikirwa choMweya Mui…? [Congregation says ‘Mutsvene, Amen.’] Mwari ndiporesei pachirwere chandinacho. [Congregation says, ‘Amen.’] Mwari chinjai status yandii…? [Congregation says ‘yandinayo.’] Mwari kundayi mweya yema…? [Congregation says, ‘yemadzinza.’] Mwari ndodawo mbereko. Mwari ndoda one acco…? [Congregation says, ‘accord.’] Mwari ndoda kuti mundizadze noMweya Mutsve…? [Congregation says, ‘Mutsvene.’] Mwari ndoda kuva chibereko chakanaka!” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi, “Vane nzeve dzekunzwa vanodii…? [Congregation says, ‘vanonzwa,’] vanonzwa zvinotaura Mweya kuKereke.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatisimukei hedu tese. Vakawuya, (Baba) vamwe vachibvunza (Isu) tingapone here? Hongu tinoda Muponesi we, (Hona) nesu tinodaro. (Tese) (Ini ndoda) ndoda (Ndoda) ndoda Ndoda Mwari Muyamuri, Muri wangu (Ishe)Ndakatengwa (Ini) neRopa raIshe, (Ropa raIshe) Ndava Wenyu chose. (Ini ndoda) ndoda, (Ndoda)ndoda, Ndoda Mwari Muyamuri, Muri wangu Ndakatengwa (Ini) neRopa raIshe, (Ropa raIshe) Ndava Wenyu chose.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Muranda waMwari, Mwari vari pano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Pavanouya havadzokere vasina kuzadzikisa chavavinga. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Pese pavauya, vanounza salvation. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vanounza healing. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vanoita cast out evil spirits. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vanounza maropafadzo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Maropafadzo embereko, maropafadzo epfuma. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Maropafadzo erugare muhupenyu hwako. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Haikona kubuda mu bhiridhing [this building—ED] ino manheru ano munhu waMwari, Mwari vasina kukuitira zvawavinga. [1:37:17.4-inaudible]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Izuva redu rokuti tigugudze Mwari vazarure. [Apostle knocks on pulpit several times—ED; Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Mwari tiri kuda one accord. [Apostle continues with knocking on the pulpit several times—ED; Congregation says, ‘Amen.’] Mwari tiri kuda change of status. [Apostle knocks on pulpit several times—ED; Congregation says, ‘Amen.’] Mwari toda mabasa ane mari. [Apostle knocks on pulpit several times—ED; Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari toda kuva nevana. [Apostle knocks on pulpit several times—ED; Congregation says, ‘Amen.’] Mwari dzorerai simba kuMwenga!” [Apostle knocks on pulpit several times—ED; Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hallelujah, Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Ndirwirei kuvaroyi! [Congregation says, ‘Amen.’] Ndirwirei kuma secret enemies! [Congregation says, ‘Amen.’] Ndirwirei kumasimba erima! [Congregation says, ‘Amen.’] Satan come out right now.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Manheru ano unogona kubuda muno wasunungurwa hanzvadzi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Unogona kusunungurwa nhasi manheru ano hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Iti, “Baba ndiri kuuya pamberi Penyu.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] (Reach out) Reach out and touch the Lord (Ho-o) As He goes by. (Ho-o) You will find He’s not too busy to hear your hearts cry, (Oh Lord) He’s passing by this moment (Ho-o) Your needs to supply. (Oh) Reach out and touch the Lord as He goes by. Claimer manheru ano healing yako. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Claimer ropafadzo rako. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Claimer fruitfulness. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Claimer Holy Ghost baptism. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Claimer one accord. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Claimer change of status. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Claimer manheru ano! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Iti, “Satan come out right away!” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Haikona kubuda usina manheru ano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatipindei pakunyengetera tose. …Jesu Hallelujah Amen.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Tisati tavhara nemuteuro, ndoda kuti mumwe nemumwe wedu, just for a few more minutes, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ngaaise one of the requests we have got. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Either conversion of this place to commercial. [Congregation says, “Hallelujah.”] Either desire yedu yekuti tive nemari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Either desire yedu kuti tipedze church kuKwekwe, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] titange muKadoma. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kufamba kwevatsvene kubva kuJoni, kubva Botsvana. Toda nyasha dzaMwari, pamusangano wedu mangwana. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Mwari pahanzvadzi dzedu dzatisiri kuziva kuti dzaendepi, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] kune vanoda mbereko, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] kune vari kuzono deliver. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tora zviviri kana zvitatu zvaunorangarira, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] pamanheru anhasi eChishanu ano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Hatisakanganwa mweya wa October. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mweya wekuti Mwenga udzoreredzwe. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwenga uve nesimba Rawo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatitsuurei Satani muzvinhu izvi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tikumbire Mwari vatiitire nyasha manheru ano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatipindei pakuteura zvekare once more. …we are one, Oh, demons will tremble, and sinners awake And faith in Jehovah makes anything shake. (Have faith) Faith in the Father, and faith in the Son, (Oh) Faith in the Holy Ghost these three are one. (Oh) demons will tremble, and sinners awake And faith in Jehovah makes anything shake.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Baba tinotenda manheru anhasi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari izuva ramakatipa rekuzvitsaura. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kuti Baba wakanaka tione kukundwa kwewakaipa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kune vanoti—tsvakira mazano ekutiparadza. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Asi pakuteura kwedu manheru anhasi, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ngavawire mumakomba avanoticherera. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Mwari makarurama tiri kunamata takatarisa even mweya wa October, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] Baba tichiona kunyonganisa kwaunokonzera, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] kudzorera sure kwaunoita basa Renyu, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] kusimudzira kwaunoita kudzokera sure kwevanhu, [Congregation says, “mm.”] nekuhushe hwaSatani. Baba mweya uyu tinoutsuura! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Mwari makarurama chitipai nyasha takatasirana nekuda kuvaka. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba ti-converterei [to convert—ED] nzvimbo ino into a commercial place. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba kana muchinge maona izvozvo zvisakakodzera, tipeyi stand Baba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Takatarisa kuvaka Convention Centre. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatisi kudzokera kumasure papfungwa iyoyo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari tanga tichikumbira tsvetero Yenyu imi Baba, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] kumao—vanhu vari munzvimbo dze authority, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] vati grant-e permission Baba, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] yekuti tivake musha watoda kuvaka pano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Mwari makanaka chivai nevatsvene vari mumigwagwa, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] Mwari makanaka vapei kufamba kune tsiye nyoro, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] vachibva Gweru, vachibva Botsvana, vachibva Joni. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tainyengeterera Baba wakarurama kana ma sister anoda kuzvitakura, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] vatambura kuti vawane mbereko. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Makati, “…There is no barren womb in Israel.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Satan come out right away! [Congregation says, “Amen."] In Jesus’ Name! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Takatarisa zvekare kubatsirwa Ishe wakarurama, kwema sister akazvitakura, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] vapei nyasha Baba wakanaka, parege kuva nezvinopindirapo. [Congregation says, "Amen."] Tichitenda vana vari kuporeswa mukati mezvipatara. [Congregation says, "Amen."] Baba makanaka pindirai pakati pedu Baba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Tipeiwo mari yekuvaka! [Congregation says, “Amen. "] Baba nyika ino inorarama nemari. [Congregation says, "Amen."] Kuvaka imari! [Congregation says, “Amen."] Baba dai matipawo mari iyoyi, [Congregation says, "Amen,"] taisevenzesa nekuda kweHushe hwaMwari. Tinotenda nezvamatiitira kusvika parizvino Jehovha. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari irori Shoko rataparidzirana Baba, [Congregation says, "Amen,"] nyorai pahwendefa dzemwoyo! [Congregation says, “Amen."] Tinotenda manheru ano nguva yatawana, [Congregation says, “Amen,"] Exhortation yatapanana, [Congregation says, “Amen,"] nyorai pahwendefa dzemwoyo! [Congregation says, “Amen."]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Tino claimer mweya wa Boni manheru ano, [Congregation says, "Amen,"] muZita raJeso Kristo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kuti mumudzore zvakare pakati pedu Baba. [Congregation says, "Amen."] Chibatsirai Baba wakanaka Mwenga Wenyu, udzorerwe status yawo. [Congregation says, "Amen."] Baba tinotsuura mweya yemadzinza. [Congregation says, “Amen."] Tinotsuura Baba wakanaka huroyi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotsuura secret enemies! [Congregation says, "Amen."] In Jesus’ Name. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Tichengeterei vana vedu Gweru, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] Baba makanaka kwavanenge vari, vari kuzvikoro. [Congregation says, "Amen."] Kadoma kwavanenge vari, vari kuzvikoro, vachengetedzeyi kubva kune vanhu vanobata zvisakarurama, [Congregation says, "Amen,"] zvinodya mhuri Baba wakarurama. [Congregation says, "Amen."] Tinozvitsuura muZita raJeso! [Congregation says, "Amen."] Kuti zvishaye simba pavana ava. [Congregation says, “Amen."] Ngavavande pasi peZita raJeso! [Congregation says, “Amen."] Ngavachengetwe pasi peZita raJeso! [Congregation says, “Amen."] Vana vevatendi tinova claimer Baba, [Congregation says, “Amen,"] vachengetedzei pasi paJeso! [Congregation says, “Amen."] Tichengetedzei pasi Penyu Baba. [Congregation says, “Amen."] Shoko Renyu ngaritichengete! [Congregation says, “Amen."]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Mwari makarurama chitinzvengesai Baba kune miyedzo iri mberi kwedu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tive vakundi nokudarikisa Baba. [Congregation says, "Amen."] Tinotenda nguva yatawana manheru ano. [Congregation says, “Amen."] Kudzwai, namatwai nekusingaperi Baba. [Congregation says, “Amen."] Chitipai Shoko rakatiringana pa weekend. [Congregation says, “Amen."] Taikumbira izvi nokutenda, muZita raTenzi Jeso Kristu, Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. Tigare hedu tese pasi. Aiwa, tinotenda Mwari. Kana paine vari kurwara ndiyo nguva yavo iyo ino. The Windows of Heaven are open, (Oh)The blessings are falling tonight, (Oh) There's joy, joy, joy in my heart, For Jesus makes everything right; (I gave Him) I gave Him my old, tattered garment, (He gave me) He gave me a robe of pure white, (I’m feasting) I’m feasting today on the Manna (And that’s why) And that’s why I’m happy tonight. (The Windows) The Windows of Heaven are open, (The blessings) The blessings are falling tonight, (Oh Hallelujah) There’s joy, joy, joy in my heart, (Yeah) For Jesus makes everything right; (I gave Him) I gave Him my old, tattered garment, (He gave me) He gave me a robe of pure white, (I’m feasting) I’m feasting today on the Manna (And that’s why) And that's why I’m happy tonight.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Amen, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] hama dzitore zvipo panguva inoyi. Amen. [Congregation says, "Amen.”] Tinotendazve Ishe Mwari (Ho-o) Makatipa simba ah ah ah ah (Iro) Rokukunda (Icho) chikara Nomufananidzo wacho (Tinotenda) Tinotendazve, Ishe Mwari (Ho-o) Makatipa simba ah ah ah ah! (Iro) Rokukunda, (Icho) chikara Nomufananidzo wacho (Ho-o Ishe Mwari) Ishe Mwari wamasimba ose! (Iwo) Mabasa Enyu akakura ah ah ah! (Iwo)Anoshamisa, (Iwo) anoshamisa Mambo wemarudzi (Ho-o Ishe Mwari) Ishe Mwari wamasimba ose! (Iwo)Mabasa Enyu akakura ah ah ah! Anoshamisa, (Iwo) anoshamisa Mambo wemarudzi (Tinotenda) Tinotendazve, (Ho-o) Ishe Mwari (Imi) Makatipa simba ah ah ah ah! (Iro) Rokukunda, (Icho) chikara Nomufananidzo wacho (Hoo, Tinotenda) Tinotendazve, Ishe Mwari (Imi) Makatipa simba ah ah ah ah! (Iro) Rokukunda, (Icho) chikara Nomufananidzo wacho

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Tinokutendai manheru ano Baba. [Congregation says, "Amen.”] Tinokutendai neShoko Renyu pakati pedu. [Congregation says, "Amen.”] Tinokutendai nehuMwari hwamunoratidza pakati pedu. [Congregation says, "Amen.”] Mwari tinotenda nehutano. [Congregation says, "Amen.”] Mwari tinotenda ne provision, [Congregation says, "Amen,”] madairiro Enyu emunamato. [Congregation says, "Amen.”] Mwari makarurama tinokupai mbiri nekuti makakodzera. [Congregation says, "Amen.”] Zvataona muchitidaira, hatigone kuzviverenga, [Congregation says, "Amen,”] asi kunze kwekukupai mbiri, [Congregation says, "Amen,”] nokuti makakodzera kuti muve Mwari. [Congregation says, "Amen.”] Makakodzera kuti munamatiwe. [Congregation says, "Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Chitibatsirai Tenzi wakanaka Ishe, pakuguma kokushumaira kwemanheru ano, kuti tizorore takagadzirira ramangwana. [Congregation says, "Amen.”] Kuti mangwana tive nenguva yakanaka. [Congregation says, "Amen.”] Chipai kufamba kwakanaka kuvatsvene vese vachidzokera kudzimba, nevari munzendo kuva pano. [Congregation says, "Amen.”] Ishe tiri kutarisira kunzwa kubva kwaMuri. [Congregation says, "Amen.”] Chivai nemi makomborero ezvipo izvi, [Congregation says, "Amen,”] zvakamurwa kubva kuvana Venyu. Ndimi makavapa, vakamura. “…Good measure, pressed down, shaken over…” [Congregation says, "Amen.”] Chidzoreredzai zvakare. [Congregation says, "Amen.”] Taikumbira izvi nokutenda, muZita raTenzi Jeso Kristu, Amen. [Congregation says, "Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Aiwa tinotenda Mwari chaizvo. Mwari akudzwe. Mangwana tosangana ku Church. Service yedu between twelve-thirty and o... one o’clock. Ndo arrival chii… time. Between twelve-thirty and one o’clock. Then from one o’clock to one-thirty or maybe to two, worship ti…? [Congregation says, "time,”] time. entries.text: Baba ndine dambudziko Ishe, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ramunoziva pakati pemoyo wangu, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ndidaireyi ipapo Baba, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ndigoziva hukuru hwenyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Honai Kereke yenyu yauya pamberi penyu, vari kunyengetera kwamuri Baba, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] vari kuda kutenda mamuri Ishe [Congregation says, “Amen,”] tinotsuura Satan. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tokumbirawo double portion. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotsuura hurombo, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] tinotsuura bareness, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] tinotsuura rufa, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] tinotsuura tsaona, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] tinotsuura nhamo, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] muZita raJeso, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] in the Name of Jesus! [Congregation says, “Amen.] Come out Satan! Baba tiitei vakundi manheru ano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Family Spirits Prt 1
entries.text: Toda kubuda muno tiri vakundi nekudarikisa [Congregation says, “Amen.”] toda kubuda muno taswededzwa pedyo nemi [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tirwirei hondo dzedu Baba wangu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] chipindirai muhupenyu hwemumwe nemumwe, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] tiwane double portion yedu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Family Spirits Prt 1
entries.text: Mwenga wenyu udzoreredzwe, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] tive mamanifested sons. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda nevese vauya pano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda nevafamba nenyasha. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda nevamunokundisa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Titungamirireiwo mangwana zvakare, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] tidzidze kubva paShoko renyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinokutendai Baba manheru ano, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] kudzwai namatwai nekusingapere taikumbira izvi nokutenda muZita raJeso Kristu, Amen and Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Totenda Mwari zvakare zuva remuteuro zvakare nhasi, mukana watapihwa kuti tigugudze asi ngatitendei chaizvo nekuda kwemharidzo yedu yane zuro. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hachisi chinhu chiri nyore kuti uzive kuti nzvimbo yekunamatira imwe…? [Congregation says, “imwe chete.”] Unokura uchingofunga kuti dzakawanda, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nekuti ndozvazvakaita mukati menyi…? [Congregation says, “menyika,”] menyika. But chionai nyasha dzatakawana, try and think what price you would pay just to find yourself in the right pla…? [Congregation says, “place.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Just imagine ha’moona, Mwari paanonamatiwa pamwe chete. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] And ipapo paanonamatiwa ipapo ndopa Spoken Word, ndopa Shoko rechinzvarwache…chenguva ino. Zvimwe zvose i Come out, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvimwe zvose i Come out. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nyangwe ukazoderera sei pakunamata kwako rega kumbofa wakafunga kuti uchanowana kumwe kunamata kune… imwe nzvimbo you only become reli…? [Congregation says, “religious,”] religious but chi Kristu panenge pa…? [Congregation says, “pasina.”] And like any better thing, any better thing it’s better than kuenda mukanda, it’s better than ku—kurova mai…? Makuva. You get by but pakanzi naMwari hunzai zvegumi zvenyu, farai nemhuri dzenyu nedzimba dzenyu pamunenge makaropafadzwa naMwari inzvimbo yandinenge ndaisa Zita rangu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Amen, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Saka nzvimbo yavakaisa Zita ravo i Message. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Havana kuisa Zita ravo mu Salvation Army, havana kuisa Zita ravo mu Watchtower, havana kuisa Zita ravo mu Apostolic Faith, havana kuisa Zita ravo mu ZAOGA, havana kuisa Zita ravo mu Postori vakaisa Zita ravo in a Body Word. Mu Body Word imomo ndomavakaisa Zita ravo Zita ravo hupe…? [Congregation says, “hupenyu,”] Hupenyu. Imomo ukamunamata imomo, I assure you my brother. Zvandirikukutaurirai izvi kuti they will be a change of status kune vanhu vanonamata varimo…? [Congregation says, “imomo.”] Zvinoitika chete. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ndosaka iwewe tenda Mwari kuti wakarasikira panzvimbo irinani, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kunyangwe munhu anenge arimu Church dzinenge dzinomboziva nezve Message, wakarasikira munzvimbo irinani kwakanzi ndichakutumirai mutumwa wechi no…? [Congregation says, “wechi nomwe.”] Ukarasikira imomo, vamwe varikurasikira mu Church dzinotangwa nevanhu. Ha’moona munoona nziyo yedu yatinoimba, Ma—maiona, masunungurwa nhasi. Maoina, maiona nyeredziya zvino. Ndeyekwa Mwazha, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ukanzwa vachiti maiona nyeredzi yazvino varikureva ani…? [Congregation says, “Mwazha.”] Varikureva Mwazha.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Isusu takazoiti ayewa maiona here nyeredzi yazvino tichireva chii… tichireva Malachi 4…? [Congregation says, “4:5.”] William Marrion Branha…? [Congregation says, “Branham.”] Vaya vanenge vachiti chokwadi chazvino vachireva chavo chavanoparidza ikoko hatiizivi doctrine yekwa Mwazha but isu tiri kuti chokwadi chazvini tichireva Message Spoken Word yenguva i…? [Congregation says, “inoyi.”] Dzakawanda nzvimbo dzinonzi dzinonamata Mwari but Mwari ane nzvimbo imwe chete. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Manje ndakutaura manje iye zvino inini, ndiri kutaura ndichi bhesa patestimony, It’s like a testimony when we talk about this. Kuti ndava fifty-four years handina kumbobata mushonga kana dumwa kana zango handi murikupa nzwisisa ipapo ?[Congregation says, “Amen.”] But zvandaiitirwa na Mwari inini up to now vanhu vese vanozviona, varipano vano hedhuka nevakabva vakabamuka nevane dzimwe church nevari mu Message vanofunga kuti itokoroshi. Kuti vati isimba raMwari vanonetseka kuti vazvitaure because vanonzi kokana ririsimba raMwari murikudii kuyendawo ipa…? [Congregation says, “ipapo.”] Saka vanotichii… hanzi mushonga.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Hapana waunosangana naye akakuudza kuti Brother Gumbura Mwari arikuva daira. Zvonzi, “Murume uya ane tokoroshi uya, murume uya ane zvikwambo uya, iwe mari yake inobva kupi anogara ane mari, iwe he, wamboona zvaari kuita, iye zvino atenga chakati, iye zvino atenga chakati.” Now imagine ini ndiri mumba mangu panguva iyoyo. Ndiri kunyatsoziva kuti handina chandabata kunze kweku gugudza chete. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ndakaona vanhu vachiita divisi, rekuita one tonne yechibage [Apostle chuckles—ED] Handisi kukureverai nhema. Kumamisha kwese kwamunorima uku anenge ane divisi uchiona vanhu vachiungana pamba pake nekuti wauya nezvi kochikari ten zvebo—zve—zvechibage zvichidhonzwa nemadhongi chokutuka uku, waoona vanhu kuti ,”Heyi!” And akatozviyendera kun’anga izvo…? [Congregation says, “izvozvo.”] Makaona murume akapuhwa tokoroshi neimwe n’anga yeku…Chipinge uku kwaMutare uku akazouraya mukadzi nevana. Handi vakataura zvaakanga anazvo? Wouldn’t you wonder kuti ndozvinouraira munhu. Ndosaka vakazuyaka panenge paine vanhu vari kunamata Mwari chaiye chaiye vanoti ah-ah ha ah- .

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: “Ini ndinokuziva kunamata ini baba vangu vakanga vari muPostori.” Wanzwa, “Isu toziva kunamata kumusha kwedu kwatakabva baba vangu vakanga vari mufundi we Metho…? [Congregation says, “Methodist,”] Methodist.” Wanzwa, “Ini kunamata takakura tinako kumba kwedu takanga tiri ma Dutch” Wanzwa isu kunamata ah taive madhirezi marefubaba vangu nanhasi izvozvi ndokwavanopinda kumba kwedu hakupirwe mudzimu asi zvakadai hatina kumbozviona.” Hongu zvakadai zvinowaikwa panzvimbo yakaiswa Zita naMwari [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handisi kunzwa Amen kavaranda vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Zvinowanikwa panzvimbo yakaiswa Zita nani…? [Congregation says, “naMwari.”] Hanzi ipapo ndinosangana nani… nemi. That’s where God meet the sinner, ndosaka iwewe pakuuya panapa tenda Mwari musiwe mutsanyo unowu. Namata uchiti, “Baba ndiri panzvimbo tsvene, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] ndiri panzvimbo yamakaisa Zita rani…? [Congregation says, “renyu.”] Ndiri panzvimbo yamakati munosangana nemuta…? [Congregation says, “nemutadzi.”] Ndauya pano ndine blood issue, ndauya pano ndine barren womb, ndauya pano ndinoda basa, ndauya pano ndiri kunetswa nemweya yema…? [Congregation says, “yema dzinza.”] Makati ipapo munosangana nemutendi.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ndomanamatiro andakanga ndichiita hupenyu hwangu hwe…? [Congregation says, “hwese.”] Until nhasi mukoma wangu akasvika chaanotanga kutaura, “Ah, hah kunamata kwakanaka veduwe, Mwari akakuitirai nyasha.” Vakasangana newe mu town vachingokuona wakwamira unoshaya kuti vaonei, wakangomira so. “Wonzwa, “ha kunamata kwakanaka veduwe Mwari vakakuitirai nyasha.” Vanhu kuti vaite barika, vaita barika irimishonga. Vamwe vakadzi vari vezvikwambo ,but iwe unoita rako ende vana ava ndevani… ndevako. Kwete vekuchekeresa vachifa gore negore kuti vafadze mweya yetsvi…? [Congregation says, “yetsvina.”] Handisi kukunyeperai vanhu vaMwari ndosaka ndichiti, this is more of a testimony. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Vhangeri yandinokuparidziri handisikuvhange—kuparidza Vhangeri yekungoparidza badziba, Message iyi ndakaiona ichindigadzirira vakadzi, could you think yourself lucky kuti unota vakadzi seven pasina anokudyisa, pasina muroyi, pasina hure vese vari seven vakadaro. Zvakamboitika kupi? Vakasakunetsa kubuda mumba vachiyenda kuma storo, uchingosvika mumwe ayenda mumwe achitiza nezvinhu where you have ever seen anything like that

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ugoita vana vako twenty chakuti very healthy, active and intelligent. Pagouya chikafu chavanodya vachira…? [Congregation says, “vachirasa.”] Mota dzavanofambisa jahwi, pekugara space dzimwe dzimba dzinenge dzisina vanhu muripo twenty-four kudaro dzimwe dzimba hadzina vanhu. Where have you ever seen anything like that kunze kwekuti pakadimurwa misoro yevanhu, kunze kwekuti pakarombewa hah-ah zvino hapana kuromba kwakaitwa apa hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ndiye Mwari wandiri kukuvigirai manheru echiShanu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndowandiri kuti tsvaga Mwari iye…? [Congregation says, “iyeye.”] Mukutsanya umu, ndoda kuti Mwari mundipe sadza, kunamata kumanifetswa kwehupenyu. Ndoda kuti mundipe sadza mundipe hutano, mundipe pekugara, mundipe chekufambisa, mundipe zita rakanaka, mundipe huro—huremu. Ndoda change of sta…? [Congregation says, “status.”] Don’t take what you have got for granted, fanka imimi makapinda mu Message musina kumbobata mushonga.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: It takes time for a man to realize what God is doing for him until wakura. Saka inini pandaka tanga kupinda mu Message ndichiona Mwari achindipa imba ku Lundpark, achindipa imba ku Riverside, achindipa Bluebird nyowani, achindipa imba ku Ridgemont. It never entered my head kuti that was God showing his love to me. It was after some time manje after ndaona vanhu vandakanga ndinavo kuzvikoro, vakanga vakaita intelligent kundida… kundidarika. Vakutova mazera angu aya vasina [Apostle claps his hands once—ED] chinhu, vamwe vacho [Apostle claps his hands once—ED] vane Aids, vamwe [Apostle claps his hands once—ED] vakaramba vakadzi, vamwe vane vana [Apostle claps his hands once—ED] mumatondo, vamwe varikunetswa [Apostle claps his hands once—ED] nemweya yemudzimu. Ndopandakazoti ko inini chii…?

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Could this be lucky, lucky for thirty years lucky? Ah-ah ndopandakabata kuti idzi inyasha idzi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari pane chavakandiratidza chinokosha chai…? [Congregation says, “chaizvo.”] Ndopandakati ayewa ndinotakurana nacho chinhu ichocho. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndiuye kuva tsvene ndivaudze kuti “Gugudza unozarurirwa, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tsvaka unodii…? [Congregation says, “unowana.”] Kumbira unoita sei…?” [Congregation says, “unopihwa.”] Mwari havana chavasingape, mari, dzimba hembe, chikafu, vana, madzimai. Zvose anodii…? [Congregation says, “anopa.”] Hapana chekutsvaga munyika. Munyika unonzwa ha ukanamata, ukanamataka unongoita mukadzi one but munyika unoita vakadzi hombo unofara ndiyani akakutaurira izvozvo, iyo iRoma yakakudza izvozvo ndi Satan. But kana wane zvinhu zvako madzimai unoita aunodii…? [Congregation says, “aunoda.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Murikuona kunaka kwenyasha, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mudzimai mumwe nemumwe anowana imba yani…? [Congregation says, “yake.”] Hanzi, “Vane nzeve dzekunzwa ngavanzwe…?” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvinotaura chii…? [Congregation says, “Mweya.”] Mweya kupiko…?” [Congregation says, “kukereke.”] Manheru ano brother namata nekuti change of status it’s a reality because inini ndakamira pamberi pako panapa, nekuda kwekutenda Message iyoyi I saw it ha…? [Congregation says, “happening.”] I saw it happen, hapana chimwe chinhu chandakambodzidza kana chimwe chinhu—kana imwe trick iripo kungotora mwoyo wako wowuyisa muShoko rani…? [Congregation says, “paMwari.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Message ndeye mazviro kwazvo but chiendai munotarisa vamwe vakapedza makore avo vachinamata muma denomination, Salvation Army unoraramawo ehe unoitawo zvaunotendawo Mwari but there— it’s nothing to talk about, it’s nothing to go home about it’s nothing. Its general success kakungogarawo but kwete wamu Message iyi Message iyi inokusvista pekuti iwe unotenda wega iwe hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Unotenda wega kuti Mwari ndinotenda hangu, [Apostle claps his hands nine times] nekuda kwezvamandidii…? [Congregation says, “zvamandiitira.”] Hatipindei pakunyengetera tine nzwisiso iyoyo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Manheru anha…? [Congregation says, “anhasi.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ndirikutsuura mweya yema dzinza, ndiri kutsuura hurombo, ndiri kustuura hurovha, ndoda kuiswa panzvimbo yangu chai…? [Congregation says, “chaiyo.”] SeMwenga baba toda kuva nehuremu hunoenderana nokutenda kwati…? [Congregation says, “kwatinako,”] kwatinako. Mwari pindirai, mupinde mu project yangu ive ropafadzo whether ndeyemadomasi whether ndeye huku dzenyama kana dzema zai, whether ndeye kurima. Manje ini ndinozviziva kuti Mwari haambo kanganisi…Handindakakuudzai kuti inini muchandiona pandinenge nda—ndanyatsogudzikana zvangu ndino vhura factory inonzi Mupedza Nha…? [Congregation says, “Mupedza nhamo.”] Inenge ichipeka nyama, mo—ye dze—dze huku idzi, mazai, cooking oiri ndichirima ndoga sun furawa, nzungu ndichirima ndoga ndichiita dovi inenge ichinzi Mupedza nhamo inenge yakagadzirirwa factory yayo. Now vazhinji venyu hamuna kuziva kuti ndatodairwa kudhara.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ndakazvitaura, Hillsi—Hi—Hilltop tisati tana…? [Congregation says, “tanawo.”] Manje handimoona pekuvaka factory yacho tatovana…? [Congregation says, “napo.”] Pekuita huku dzacho tatovana…? [Congregation says, “napo.”] Takutogadzira izvozvi zvozvi, handi ndakakutaurirai kuti haikona kuzoshamisika kana zvadii…? Mavakirwo achaitwa pa Hilltop paya kana iwe ucharohwa nehana, ndirikuisa factory yedovi, factory ye cooking oil ipopaya, packing yemazai, dzi—dzihuku dzenyama slaughter house everything zvatakataura zvese. Ndendichi supl-ya muma town zvichibva pa farm yangu.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ende pandakazvitaura Hillsi—Hilltop ndangandisati ndaio…? Yangaisati yavapo, I never knew kuti ndine ndinayo. Kwaingova kuparidza nokutenda. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvino iye zvino the only reason why we have delayed, we were clearing a space panapa yekuti ti kriyete [to create—ED] dzimba dzekurara toisa convention centre yedu, whether convention centre inoita or haite pano ikasaita pano ndinenge ndine five acres land muno mu Harare dzatinoisa Convention Centre iyo…? [Congregation says, “iyoyo.”] Kunze kwaizvozvo tinoita pano. Tichibva pano tinotenda papurazi paya tirikuno ruka mari zveruka mari zviya Mwari vakati, “Sirivhera nendarama ndezvani…?” [Congregation says, “ndezvangu.”] [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Vanotaura kuti tokoroshi vachanyarara kuti zi! Ndosaka muchiona isu hatinetseki nevanotisiya, when you see me next year, I will be better. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tatichitaura naamai vatakatenga tinavo pano gogo vaya, Gogo Francis vaichengeta—vaigara mu cottage umu patakauya tichitenga panapa. Vakauya last time ndikavati ratidzwai naMai Zani, “ah ndachifunga kuti,” vavachitenga muriwo nema seedlings.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Zvikanzi, “Ndandichifunga kuti iyo imba iriuko iyi yatova imwe stand maka sub divi-dha mukatengesa.” Ndikati, “Ayehwa ndepanapa.” Zvikanzi, “Zvamaita panapa nenguva dukuduku.”

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Saka nhasi vauya futi, saka nhasi vapinda mu lounge yangu iyo yandakaisa pine nemudenga umu vakapinda zvikanzi, “Ah” vakubuda naMai Zani. Zvikanzi, “Nhai imi Pastor muri Pastor here kana kuti muri architecture?” [Congregation laughs—ED] Muri kuona muhedheni uyu handiti. Hanzi mu…Ndikati, “Hindava?” Zvikanzi, “Makaita.”

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ndikati, “Ah, ndikati hoo right imi munopaziva riri varanda, ehe paive varanda I put three ho—three rooms pavaranda apa.” Zvikanzi, “Pastor zvamuri kuita panapa.” Ndikati, “Ah vangadai vakakuratidzai.” Zvikanzi, “Do you know what I want to do pamba panapa.” Ndikati… Zvikanzi, zvikanzi “Ndoda kuuya every two three months ndichi…, ndoziva every ti—every two three months pandinouya panouya. I will be supri…?” [Congregation says, “surprised,”] surprised. [Congregation laughs—ED]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Hamoona munhu wemunyika uyu? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]Ndiye woga arikuona izvozvo? Ah, saka ndiri kukutaurirai kuti kana munhu mukanamata Message, Message yechizvarwa chenguva inoyi. Message inodarika mishonga, Message inodarika midzimu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] But isa mwoyo wako pai…? [Congregation says, “pairi.”] We should die what…? [Congregation says, “daily.”] Ehe, nyatsotendeuka chaizvo chaizvo Message inokupa mota dzese dzaunoda panyika pano. Message inokupa dzimba dzaunoda dze…? [Congregation says, “dzese.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Hamuna kumbosanga ne verse kuma Pisarema rinoti, “The Lord will give your hearts what…?” [Congregation says, “desire.”] Your wildest imagination God can make it rea…? [Congregation says, “reality,Amen.”] Hatiitei Amen varanda vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Unless if you have no sense of imagination and that’s why I have always challenged you to say when you ask God think bi…? [Congregation says, “big.”] Ukauya gore rinouya pano you will be shocked regardless yekuti ta…Handi muna 2000 vakataura muchavaka here kuKwekwe nuchadii…? Vakazoti kudii Kwekwe yavakwa, makavanzwa vachitaura futi? Kunyarara kuti zii. [Apostle claps his hands twice—ED]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Vakabva vana Brother Musharu nana Mai Madovi, nana Brother Mudekwa pavakauya parufu rwaamai vangu kunyarara kuti zii. “Ah ndo cream yatinonzwa neva…nembiri iyi, cream raunji ii yakanaka Pastor.” Mai Matapura vatakasiyana navo kudhara. Zvikanzi, “Pastor mune nzvimbo yenyu yakanaka. Pastor inga Mwari haana kumbokusiyayi kubva paya.” [Congregation chuckles—ED]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Hanzi, “Mwari haana kumbokudii…? [Congregation says, “ kukusiyai.”] Kubva papi…? [Congregation says, “paya.”] Hanzi, “Vane nzeve dzekunzwa ngavanzwe.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Hasha dzaMwari dziri pamusoro pevese vanobata zvokwadi yake mukudii…?” [Congregation says, “mukusarurama.”] Hameno zvavo vanenge vachiuya ku Church vachindinzwa ndichiparidza kudai ivo vachataura mm ha hmm ha hmm, you will always have something to a man who is sent of God chokuti unogona ku critici-za, it could be a weakness ha’moona. Jeso chaiye Kristu achiuya, vanhu vamuti nekuti anonwa wine hanzi, “Haihwaho ngaati nyararire he is wine briber,” hanzi he was a wine bri…? [Congregation says, “briber.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ehe, vaimusvora but chinoshamisa ndechekuti guva raakavigwa akarisiya risina chi…? [Congregation says, “chinhu.”] Ndo the same nhasi mu church munomu hazvirevi kuti tinenge tichitenda tose. Vamwe vanenge vachitngoti, “Hmm zvipi ko zvatinoona, haihawo zvipi zvacho.” Anenge achikutiyi zvipi zvacho but iye pese paakazvarwa haana kumbozviona. Mweya, we smearing, they smear in their hearts ha’moona? But iwe rega kuteerera vakadaro. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Iti, Mwari ndinoda nya…? [Congregation says, “nyasha.”] One day ini ndanguri ndafa murivadiki kaimi, uchatenda kuti Pastor vakatinongedzera kune… [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Urikunzi naMwari munonamatiwa mukore uno mu Message yechizvarwa che…? [Congregation says, “chenguva.”] Ndomurikunamatiwa mukore uno, mukore unowu hakuna kumwe kuri kunamatiwa mukore unowu kunze kwemu Message. Whatever happens in the Message does not change the fact. Ndomuri kunamatiwa pachizvarwa chi…? [Congregation says, “chino.”] Hakuna ngozi, huroyi, mushonga, mudzimu usinga kurirwe kana hurombo usinga kurirwe mu Message yenguva inoyi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chinongodiwa have faith in God. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Hatisimukei tese… Vakauya (Baba) vamwe vachibvunza (Isu) Tingapone here Hongu tinoda (Tinoda) muponisiwe (Baba) Nesu tinodaro (Ini ndoda) Ndoda (Ndoda) ndoda Mwari muyamuri Muri wangu Ndakatengwa (Baba) neRopa raIshe (Ropa raIshe) Ndava wenyu chose

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Breakthrough! My brother, this evening. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari i reality kwatiri. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Pano vanoda kuti tive pano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vanokuregerera zvivi zvako zvose. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vanodaira muteuro wako. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatipindei pakunyengetera tose. [Pentecostal prayer—ED] …in the oil and the wine. (Apostle says, “Tese one more time.”) (Hallelujah) He poured in the oil and the wine (Hallelujah) The time He restoreth my soul (My Lord) I was sick and dying on the Jericho road When He poured in the oil and the wine.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Mwari vaAbrahama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari vebarika. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] God of polygamy. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mudimu wasithembo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba tinotenda nezvamuri kutiitira. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda nekuva pano manheru anhasi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tariro yatinayo yekuenda kunoparidzirana, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] muGweru, kutenda kwatinako negoho ratakawana gore rino. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kufara kwatinako nehutano hwatinahwo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari hondo dzamabva kurwa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Baba ma prospects amuri kuvhura mberi kwedu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari muri Mwari vakanaka. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] You are a good God. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Worthy of worship. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Here Lord, we all believe and understand, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ndopamunosangana nevahedheni. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mu Gentile wese muShoko remutumwa wechinomwe, munomuwanira nyasha. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndopatiri manheru ano, Baba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Chitsuurai mweya yemadzinza, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] nokuti Shoko iri rine simba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tsuurai hurombo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tsuurai barrenness. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mweya we discord in the Name of Jesus! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chitibatsirai Mwari wakanaka pakufamba kwedu mune ramangwana zuva, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] Baba kugadzirira kwedu kwa August. [Congregation says, “Amen,”] Vatsvene vari kufamba mangwana kubva Botswana, kubva Joni, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] vaitirei nyasha. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Baba vari Britain. Baba makanaka vari kuronga, Amereka, kuti tive navo muna August, vaitirei nyasha. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari tinotenda nevana vedu, totenda nemadzimai edu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Totenda Mwari wakanaka nepamunotitsvakira pekugara. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari zvokufambisa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotsuura mweya wendufu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Totsuura mweya wehurwere. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Batsirai vose Baba wakarurama vasiri kunzwa zvakanaka, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] vakazvitakura, Baba vanonoka kubatsirwa, vana vari underweight, vasina mbereko vari kudzichemera, Baba makanaka pindirai. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari makanaka chipindai mukati memba ino Jehovah. Baba makanaka mharidzo yedu ive mharidzo yenyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Taikumbira izvi nokutenda, muZita raTenzi Jeso Kristu, Amen and Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tigare hedu tese pasi.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Tinokwazisana tose muZita raTenzi Jeso Kristu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tokwazisana tose muZita raTenzi Jeso Kristu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Totenda Mwari chaizvo kuti tava muimba yaMwari zvakare musi weChishanu. Every time we come, we are–we complete a fast like this, kana tanga taswera zvechokwadi tiri committed, you have your request answered. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Let every man be a…? [Congregation says, ‘a liar,’] and God’s Word be…? [Congregation says, ‘true,’] true.”

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Zvaaku depender nekuti waswera uri mu condition yakadii. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vamwe havawoni chekunamatira nekuti cho–cho–chomweya chagara ha–ha–ha–hachisati chajeka kwavari. But kunesu takaziva hedu kuti Mwari anodaira miteuro, Mwari anopa, Mwari anokunda mweya yemadzinza, zuva rakadai tino… Izvozvi tichitoburuka so, taakutoita look forward to next Wednesday. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Inenge ichitori kure kwandiri nekuti takazvipira kuti gore rese tinopinda pakute…? [Congregation says, “pakuteura.”] Tatova halfway through the year.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Tichipinda muna July, handitika, tatova mu seven months. Handi’moona kuti gore riri–hachisi chinhu chihombe? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] But toda kuti rapera gore iroro utarise kumasure kwako, wana mhinduro muzvinhu zvaunoda. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nhasi ndoda kuti ndingoenda mberi ne message yedu yanezuro yeNzvimbo Tsvene, handi’moona. But ndoda kupa emphasis pavana, paNzvimbo Tsvene iyi. Tichibuda nezuro, Pastor vakabva vandivinga vachinditi, “Ah, message yamamuchiparidza,” Pastor Chuma, zvikanzi, “Ko zvayanga iripo kana kumba kwangu uku.” Ndikati, “Hindava?” Zvikanzi, “Ah, Tsitsi akauya akandikumbira kuti baba ndoda kuenda ku S.U.”

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Do you know kuti they don’t see why anything wrong with that? [Congregation says, “mmm.”] Ehe. Vada kuenda ku S.U. Saka iwe unoshaya kuti unomurambidza sei kuti usaende here kana kuti enda. Hau–you do–you don’t know what to do. But as a parent you know kuti hakuna chaanonodii…? [Congregation says, “chaanonodzidza,”] chaanonodzidza ikoko. But kwaari kunamata kwese. So, what we need to do as a church, ma parents ese, is to over drill your children, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] in what is proper. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinganzwa Amen here ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Saka while tine burden yedu iyi, yekudanwa kwatakaita naMwari, ende tichitaura kuti nzvimbo inonamatiwa imwe chete kunyangwe dzikawanda mu Message handitika, nzvimbo idzi? But nhamo yatinayo huru ndeyekudzidzisa vana vedu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vana vedu kuti vazive kuti zvatakapinda mazviri izvi iShoko rani…? [Congregation says, “raMwari,”] raMwari. Vana ka, havazi vanhu vekungorasharasha. Right. Hatingoverengayi MaGwaro mambichana anotaridza nezvekukosha kwevana.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Vanofanira kuziva nezveNzvimbo Tsvene. Handei kuna Jobhi chapter 30. Rotanga nekuti–tiratidza, kuregerera vana zvakunoita. Job 30. I just want a–a Scripture there. Right. Hatitarisei muone pa verse ya 5 muone. Ndoda kuti mungotora pfungwa yenyu mega zvinoitika. Hativerengeyi kubva pa verse 5 tese: They were driven forth from among men,

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ndoda Amen munhu wese. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengeyi: They were driven forth from among men, (they cried after them as after a thief;) Handei mberi: To dwell in the clifts of the valleys, in caves of the earth, and in the rocks.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Handei muone: Among the bushes they brayed; under the nettles they were gathered together. Why? Handei muone pa verse 8: They were children of fools, yea, children of base men: they were viler than the earth.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Muri kuona kuti kudhara kwanga kusina ma streets, kwaive nemakomo. Vana vemapenzi ndovaiwanikwa vari kumakomo iko…? [Congregation says, “ikoko.”] Vaiwana vanhu vachivatandanisa vachivamhanyira vachivati, “Mbavha! Mbavha!” Vana vemapenzi nhasi ndovanowanikwa muma streets futi nanha…? [Congregation says, “nanhasi.”] Ehe. Ma street kids. Kana baba vakasava munhu kwaye, mwana wako rinoita rombe che…? [Congregation says, “chete.”] Muri kupabata ipapo? Ehe.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ukaona vana vakazara muma street vaya vaya, mwana webenzi nekuti dai baba vake vakanga vari munhu kwaye vangadei vakamuudza kuti izvi hazviitwe izvi. Ende vangadei vakagadzirira vana vavo pekuga…? [Congregation says, “pekugara.”] Tinganzwa Amen here ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Aiwa Amen handisi kumunzwa iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe. Gadzirira mwana wako pokugara. It has never been the desire of God that vana vazvigadzirire. Mwari akada kuti baba vashingairire vana vawane pekudii…? [Congregation says, “pekugara,”] pekugara, handi’moona.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Saka already ndatoona chinhu one. Ndopane dzidziso yangu apa. Baba vakava rombe, mwana akakura, anovashora. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handisi kunzwa Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Aiwa ngaapfuure ipapo Amen ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba vakava rombe, mwana akakura akatanga kuita zvinhu zvine musoro anosvora ba…? [Congregation says, “baba,”] baba. Saka baba ngavave something chekuti vana kana vakura vanotarisa kuna baba kuti baba ngavatipewo ichi, ngavatibatsire apa, ngavatibatsire apa. Vane chavanoona chakaitwa naba…? [Congregation says, “nababa.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ndosaka nyaya yedu ye change of status, we can never over emphasize it hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handisi kunzwa Amen iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kana uri murume ane zvinhu zvake hapana mwana anoku challenger kuti baba muri kuita zvinhu zvisiri izvo. Ndosaka vana vevanhu vane vanhu–vane zvinhu zvavo, vana baba vavo kana vakazviwana nematokoroshi, kana vakazviwana nezvikwambo, vana ava tokoroshi idzi vachadzodzitambira che…? [Congregation says, “chete,”] chete nekuda kwezvinhu zvepanya…?

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Zvodanira nyasha dzakawandisa chaizvo chaizvo kuti mwana ana baba vanoita tokoroshi afuratire benz yababa so yetokoroshi, afure double s–afuratire double storey yeku Borrowdale yakatengwa netokoro…? [Congregation says, “netokoroshi.”] Afuratire purazi rababa retokoroshi, hazvigoneke izvo. Mupfanha uya anongopedzesera aita give in kuzvinhu i…? [Congregation says, “izvozvo.”] Arikuda kurarama, ari kuti baba vangu tokoroshi yavo ndopayakavasvitsa apa. Ndoyakatiendesa kuchikoro tokoroshi iyi. Nhasi ndozoti zvinhu zvababa vangu…Ukanzwa vanhu vachiti musha umwe neumwe une zvinhu zvawo, ndozvinenge zvichireva vanhu izvo…? [Congregation says, “izvozvo.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ndopandiri kuti vanhu vaMwari imimi mune duty iye zvino muri vapfanha so kuti wana zvinhu zvako neShoko raani…? [Congregation says, “raMwari.”] Tingaita Amen here ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vana vako vanenge vaakuti ukamira uchitaura kuti ndakawana pfuma iyi naMwari, hapana anouya nemushonga kana kukuudza kuti handei tinopira mudzimu kana tirove guva ranhingi. Hapana anouya achitaura kuti handei tinoshopera. But mupfanha unenge akakurira mumakomo saizvozvi izvi, akasangana netokoroshi anoramba?

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ndooka vapfanha ka ava, vana vemapenzi, vana ve base men. Anosvika pane benz yakasiiwa neumwe ine tokoroshi yakagaramo makuseni, heh. Anosvika achivhura benz iyoyo achifamba nayo. Kwaakutoitora kuenda nayo pamba pake. Ko ana baba? Ende nhamo ndoyamutungamirira kuti anotora benz iyoyo. Vamwe vese vachiyiwona benz vachiyitiza, ine katokoroshi kanogara kumasure. Handi makainzwa nyaya yakaitika kuKadoma yetokoroshi yaka… yakasiiwa ine benz?

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Hanzi tokoroshi yakasiiwa ine benz kudai. Muchinda wacho akati ah-ah, benz yanga yamu… tokoroshi yanga yamuuraira hama dzake dzese, akairamba akasiya zvikanzi, “Anoda benz iyi nezviri mairi ngaatore.” Tokoroshi iyi yaigara mu benz imomo ichimuka kuseni ichisumuka achiti “Shaina kana zuva richisa–richibuda.” [Congregation laughs—ED] … [Inaudible 30:39] Nziyo iya inonzi, [Apostle sings briefly—ED] “Shaina kana zuva richibuda …” [Apostle and Congregation laugh—ED] Yaimuka ichiita–ichiti shainawo… [Inaudible 30:46]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Vanhu vakawanda vakairamba kuitora benz iyoyo vakaisiya yakadaro but, munofunga kuti yakaramba yakadaro kwenguva? Pakaita m–mwana webenzi, mwana we a base fe…? [Congregation says, “fellow,”] akanga anzwa nenha…? [Congregation says, “nenhamo.”] Benz iyoyo akaidii…? [Congregation says, “akaitora.”] Tingaita Amen here ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosaka munhu anodimbura munhu musoro kuenda kunopuhwa kombi uchiti munhu wawadimbura musoro mweya wake uchaita sei? Achateera kombi iyoyo yaatengwa nemusoro wake. Ropa ratotanga mu yard iyo…? [Apostle claps four times—ED] [Congregation says, “iyoyo.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ndosaka isu tinoti kwamuri mose, set footprints on the sands of time. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda kuti vana Munesu kana vakura, vana John Junior, vana Ngoni, vana Jayden, vanongoziva Mwari wavari kuratidzwa nana baba vaani…? [Congregation says, “vavo.”] Baba vanenge vachiti, “Mupfanha ndakatenga apa, ndikatenga apa. Mupfanha ndakaita farming yangu apa, mupfanha. Apa ndakaita…Mwari wandinonamata uyu ndiMwari wemuna…?” [Congregation says, “wemunana.”] Zvekuti akanzwa vamwe vachitaura tokoroshi anoseka, kuti, “Hoo, zvenyu ndezvetokoroshi? Aah isu kwatinobva…”

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Wonzi, “Ko imimi munozviwana…?” “Haa isusu tiri vekunamata.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvonzi, “Haa ibva manhi iwe. Kunamata kwakambobatsira munhu here?” Zvonzi, “Ehe.” Zvonzi, “But baba vangu vainamata ka ini vari mu Methodist preacher. But takanga tiri varombo vasingaite.” Zvonzi, “Ah-ah, hamuna kuziva nzvimbo tsvene.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ndoda Amen akadarika Amen ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Pane nzvimbo tsvene yekuti ukaiziva iyo…? [Congregation says, “iyoyo,”] Mwari vanokupa ma desires ako o…? [Congregation says, “ose.”] Handei munoona ruGwaro. Handei tinoona pa Proverbs. Ndoda Proverbs 17. Tiri kuona kukosha kwevana chete. Tasvika pa Proverbs 17? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tarirai muone verse ya 6 tione. Ndoda munhu wese ati Amen ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ngatiitei Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengeyi verse a— [Blank spot on tape—ED] …verse 6 tese, hativerengeyi tese: Children's children are the crown of old men; and the glory of children are their fathers.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Handisi kunzwa Amen ka varanda vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi, “Children’s children mufaro wasekuru. [Congregation says, Amen.’] Asi vana kubwinya kwababa vavo.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tingaita Amen here ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handi’moona kudada kwaunoita kana mwana wako achigona kuita zvinhu? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi mwana anogona kuita zvinhu zvake, baba vasumudzirwa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Mwana wese anobata zvinhu nemayi…? [Congregation says, “nemazvo,”] kubwinya kwaani…? [Congregation says, “kwababa,”] kwababa. But muzukuru kubwinya kwemudhara. Baba vababa… Baba vangu zvavakaita, baba vangu vakaona vazukuru, it’s his glory, it’s his crown. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] But inini ndichafara ndichiona vana Tito, vana Munesu, vachi runner zvinhu zvako zvawakavatangira iwewe.
