entries.text: Tinotenda kunaka kwenyu nemufaro watinawo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kurwirwa munharaunda ino Baba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kudzwai namatwai nekusingaperi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chiitai kuti ma hearts desires edu ese akachena, azadzikiswe. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Taikumbira izvi nokutenda muZita raTenzi Jeso Kristu, Amen and Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Tigare hedu tese pasi.

entries.text: Inguva ino yekutora zvipo nekunamatira vanorwara kana varipo. (Oh, hallelujah) He poured in the oil and the wine (Hallelujah) The time He restoreth my soul (Oh, my Lord) I was sick and dying On the Jericho road, When He poured in the oil and the wine.

entries.text: Hatiisei zvipo.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Baba tinotenda nezvipo. Zvabuda muhomwe dzevana venyu, ropafadzai. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Good measure, pressed down, shaken over,” tozvisevenzesa kubasa renyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chititungamirirai pazvinhu zvedu zvose kunyanya kufamba kwedu kwamangwana, nemharidzo yeko, muZita raTenzi Jeso Kristu, Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ayihwa tinotenda. Mwari vakuitirei nyasha mangwana service yedu, nhaika hama. Saka tongobva kuno kuseni tichingomuka takananga ikoko. Tonoita service yedu mangwana kuGweru ne Sunday, then todzoka hedu. It’s part of our agreement with the Lord, handitika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Saka handei tinozadzikisa kutsanya nema service edu eGweru. Mwari vagozoita minana yavo vega. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kwete kuti, “Ha, Mwari havana kuzoita munana nekuti isu hatina kuzo…”Ah-ah. Let’s fulfil our quarter, God will never fail His. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.text: Mwari vakuitirei nyasha chai...? [Congregation says, “chaizvo,”] chaizvo. I don’t know whether we have any announcement from anybody? Okay, hatisimukei hedu. entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Heemeni! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mukana mumwe watapihwa zvakare kuswedera pedyo naMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari vanopa makomborero! [Congregation says, “Amen!”] Mwari vanoponesa asthma, [Congregation says, “Amen!”] TB! [Congregation says, “Amen!”] Mukondombera! [Congregation says, “Amen!”] Stroke! [Congregation says, “Amen!”] Headache! [Congregation says, “Amen!”] Vari pano Mwari ivavo. [Congregation says, “Amen/Yes Lord!”] Mwari vemunana! [Congregation says, “Amen!”] Mwari vanodzinga mweya yemadzinza! [Congregation says, “Amen/Yes Lord!”] Mwari vanodzinga hurombo! [Congregation says, “Amen!”] Mwari vanodzinga nyonganiso! [Congregation says, “Amen!”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Mwari vechizaruro! [Congregation says, “Amen!”] Mwari vebarika! [Congregation says, “Amen!”] Vari pano manheru anhasi! [Congregation says, “Amen!”] “Pane vaviri kana vatatu [Congregation says, ‘Amen!’] Ini ndiripowo ipapo.” [Congregation says, “Amen!”] “Ukakumbira ne Zita rangu [Congregation says, ‘Amen,’] ndinokupai.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Gugudza unozarurirwa [Congregation says, ‘Amen,’] tsvaka unowana [Congregation says, ‘Amen,’] kumbira unopihwa.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Regai munhu wese ave murevi wenhema [Congregation says, ‘Amen,’] Mwari vave murevi wechokwadi.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatirairei Satani manheru ano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatipindei pakunyengetera tose. [Apostle and Congregation enters Pentecostal prayer__ED] ….Jesu (Hallelujah)Tinotenda (Tinotenda) Jesu (Hallelujah) Tinotenda Jesu (Hallelujah) Hallelujah Amen. (Tinotenda)Tinotenda (Tinotenda) Jesu. (Hallelujah) Tinotenda Jesu. (Hallelujah) Tinotenda Jesu. (Hallelujah) Hallelujah Amen.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Mwari vaAbrahama. [Congregation says, “Amen,”] Mwari vaMozisi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari vaJakobho. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinokutendai nenyasha dzekufamba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinofara kuona vatsvene vese vari pano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari vese vafamba nedzimotokari nemabhazi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mavatarisira mumigwagwa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari makanaka tinopa mbiri kuZita renyu nekuda kwaizvozvo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Pakati pedu Baba taunganira Shoko renyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tipei zvakatiringana pazuva ranhasi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Shoko renyu rikawana kuparidzwa pazuva ranhasi, tinokunda mweya yemadzinza, [Congregation says, “Amen!”] tinotsiura hurombo, [Congregation says, “Amen!”] tinowana healing, [Congregation says, “Amen!”] tinowana tariro. [Congregation says, “Amen!”] Tipeiwo zvikumbirwa izvi Baba, [Congregation says, “Amen!”] tibude muno mwoyo yedu yakazara nekufara. [Congregation says, “Amen!”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Chibatsirai Baba wakanaka vese vari kurwara. [Congregation says, “Amen,”] Vanonoka kubatsirwa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Variku…?...mbuka ne stroke Baba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari makarurama vane effects ema accidents. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda kubuda muno tava nenyasha. [Congregation says, “Amen!”] Tichipa mbiri kuZita raMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen!”] Baba tauya kuzodairwa matambudziko edu. [Congregation says, “Amen!”] Tauya kuzodzidziswa nemi. [Congregation says, “Amen!”] Pindirai manheru anhasi.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Baba makanaka chivai nevatsvene, Baba wakanaka vatadza kuvapano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kana kungadai—kungadai kune avo vachiri mumugwagwa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari tinopa mbiri kuZita renyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndimi muchengeti wevanhu vese ivavo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chitigadzirirai August yedu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba titarirai mudeuro yedu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Sanduko gore rino. [Congregation says, “Amen!”] Toda change of status. [Congregation says, “Amen!”] Satan come out of everybody, muZita raJeso! [Congregation says, “Amen!”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Chiuyai mubatsire mumwe [Apostle claps his hands multiple times—ED] nemumwe ari mukati memba ino Tenzi wangu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda kubuda muno tichiti zvanga zvakanaka kuti tive muimba yaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chivai nevatsvena varikugadzirira August Britain ne America. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Isusuwo pano chitipaiwo gadziriro yakanaka. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda ne gohwo Baba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda nevakabatsirwa zvakanaka. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda nevazvitakura iye zvino. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tenderai kuti mimba idzodzo dzisabve. [Congregation says, “Amen,”] nekuti makati, “ No barren in Israel.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vasina vana vapei. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda negohwo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba makanaka kune vanokudai. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Zvinhu zvese zvinofamba mukanaka kune vanokunamatai. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Satani come out. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] In the Name of Jesus. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] I bind you right away! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tadza kuwana chaunoita mukati memba yaMwari. Baba chibatsirai muyenzi mumwe ne mumwe auya pakati pedu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Awane nyasha mukati memaoko enyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Tinokutendai Baba wakanaka kuva mukati memba ino. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chitiparidzirai imimi manheru ano, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] taikumbira izvi Ishe wekururama nekutenda. Chitichengeterai kwatafuratira kwose, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] muZita raTenzi Jeso Kristu, Amen and Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tigare tese pasi.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: ….. muZita Tenzi Jeso Kristu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tafara zvakare kusanganiswa, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] zuva ranhasi muimba yaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hazvisi nyore , inyasha dzani…? [Congregation says, “dzaMwari,”] dzaMwari. You might take it for granted coming every time and having services and going back. It’s not that easy. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari vanotiitira nyasha zuva rimwe nei…? [Congregation says, “nerimwe,”] nerimwe.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Totenda hama dzafamba zvakanaka. Tichitenda kuona Brother Tino after a long time. Vanogara kure vanotadza kuuya nguva zhinji, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] tine mufaro kuva navo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hama dzedu dze Botswana we are happy to seeing you all of you. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Then hama dzedu dzeJoni vakwanisa kuuya tinotenda nyasha chaizvo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari ngavakuitirei zvakanaka. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Mwari vanokoshesa Shoko ravo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Effort iyoyo yekuuya iyoyiyi, inoratidza kuti warikoshesa chai…? [Congregation says, “chaizvo,”] chaizvoo. Ha’maona? Neniwo ndakudzidza kukoshesa Shoko raMwari nekuda kwevamwe vano sacrifi-sawo [to sacrifice—ED] Ndandichitaura kuti ndaka ndakaneta for the past two- two weeks or so ndichinzwa kuti aah. Iyoyi weekend ino iyi ndandakaneta zvekufa chaizvo. Zvokuti dai kwanga kusiri kuti kuda Mwari nekuremekedza kuti ah vamwe vafamba ndingadei ndangoto haa Pastor Chuma torai imwe yanhasi, Brother Rusono torai imwe mangwana. Kuti ungo—ungo nyama dzibatane uzorore. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: But unongozvisimbisa kuti aihwa takavimbisa Mwari kuti gore rose. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Heemeni. Ichauya hayo nguva yatichatora marivhi chai…chaizvo. But iye zvino hatidi kuti titi kana zvinhu zvatinenge takakumbira pamberi paMwari zvikarega kuitika wowana chimwe chinokuudza kuti wakanga wakuita slake. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] I would never want that to be an excuse. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Saka tirikuti dai Mwari akatiitira nyasha. Tadzimara tauya hanti’maona?

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Saka unozviona kuti kunyangwe wakaneta ukada, Mwari vanoita nyasha. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hauterere nyama yakoba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Unozozviona wapokuti aihwa Mwari vane ngoni. Uchinyatsoona kuti aihwa nhau yakaoma iyi. But unozozviona kuti Mwari vane nyasha, handitika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vanopindira so…? [Congregation says, “somehow,”] somehow, hanti’maona? Saka kuuya ku Chuch it’s a thing that we should never underestimate. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Nehama dzose dzafamba kubva Bruwayo, tinotenda Mwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hama dzabva Harare, Kwekwe, Kadoma. Kwese kwabviwa, tinokudza Zita raMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Do not forsake the assembling’s of one another to…? [Congregation says, “together,”] as you see the day a…?” [Congregation says, “approaching .”] Hanti’maona? Vanhu ngavaungane vachinamata nguva dzo…? [Congregation says, “dzose,”] dzose, hanti’moona ? Izvozvi zvatirikuita izvozvizvi zvinesimba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvine simba risingaite, hanti’maona? Saka mufaro wedu kuti tiri muimba yaMwari.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Tinotenda Mwari takawana gowo rakanaka funny. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Taitarisira hedu hundred ma—tonne, asi takazoita seventy-three tonnes. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Still seventy-three tonnes is not a Joke. [Congregation claps ululates, claps and says, “Amen.”]Saka hatina kuendera Mainga pasina. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Taifambira zviri…? [Congregation says, “zviripo,”] zviripo. We have seventy-three tonnes, and we thank God for those seventy-three tonnes. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ende totenda Mwari because hapana chasiyana. Seventy-three tonnes idzodzo gore rakapera patakanga tine hundred ten, hundred and twenty. We couldn’t finish twenty-five, dze last chii…? [Congregation says, “year.”] So, if we have seventy-three this year, then twenty-five tonnes dze last year. That gives us ninety-eight. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Saka tadzokera futi pa hundred paya. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Yataingoda iyoyo Mwari aizviziva kuti zvamati munoda hundred ka dzimwe twenty-five munadzo kudha…?[Congregation says, “kudhara, Amen.” Apostle chuckles—ED] Saka tinotenda Mwari chaizvo ehe, tinotenada Mwari chaizvo. Ende mapimiro edu kana ariwo avaiita ma brother egore rakapera, it’s definitely more than seventy-three. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Kana vaiita mapekero ataiita last year but I think our— we were not there, and we don’t know how there were packing these brothers. Kana vainyatsoti saga chaa three mabaghidhi handitika, maiisa mabhanghindi matatu pasaga rimwe chete handiti? Vaivepo? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndozvamaiita? Saka you were putting more than fifty kg’s handitika? Kureva kuti generally we are over a hundred slightly, slightly . Ndozvazviri nguva dzo…? [Congregation says, “dzose .”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Saka isu tinopima manje, tinotora masaga. Rinenge richifanira kuti ripinde two and half buckets. Isu tinoisa mangani…? [Congregation says, “three.”] three, ndo seventy-three tonnes yedu. Ukanzwa tichiti tawana hundred it’s more. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tikawana seventy-three tonnes it will—it’s definitely…? [Congregation says, “more.”] Over eighty. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Dzinenge dzirimo imo…? [Congregation says, “imomo,”] imomo plus last year twenty-five. Which is not really twenty-five, futi futi dze dziri more. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Saka ngatipei kutenda kuna Mwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda chai…? [Congregation says, “chaizvo,”] chaizvo hanti’moona ehe? Mwari vakaita nyasha. Saka still if we decide to sell some which will tinokwanisa kutenga futi mbeu yedu yegore rino nedhiziri redu nefetiraiza yedu from our last year’s har…? [Congregation says, “harvest,”] harvest. Which is wonderful. Tobhadharawo magetsi a few dates here and… here and there. I will not be able to thank God with my mouth. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] The Lord has been indeed gra…? [Congregation says, “gracious.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ranga riri gore rakanaka chai…? [Congregation says, “chaizvo,”] chaizvo. Now let’s start praying for next season. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Next season yangosarirwa ne three months. August, September, October, November tinenge takungodyara. We only have three months, ha’maona? For the next eeh season Saka haaa tiri kutarisira chai…? [Congregation says, “chaizvo.”] Gore rino takawana planter nyowani. Tikawana muromo wegejo munyowani watakatenga.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Saka marimiro acho achatipfuurei gore raka—rakapera. Ende tirikutarisa kuti tikatanga kunamatira mvura nekuti ndiko kurarama kwedu. Mwari anotiropafadza kubudikidza nemuzvirimwa, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] nemuzvipfuwo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Heemeni [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Takawona pa last week’s message yedu, murume akanga ainee hwai seven thou…? [Congregation says, “seven thousand.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Hanti’ takamuona murume aive me hwai seven thousand. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndiani murume uyu? [Congregation says, “Job.”] Kureva kuti Jobho waigona kudya hwai imwe chete pazu…? [Congregation says, “pazuva .”] Akasazvi filler, nokuti seven thousand ka unongotora tochingoti four hundred dzawatora pagore panosara eeh six thousand. [Congregation says, “six hundred,”] six hundred. Tochingoti pa six hundred chete ndodzobereka gore iroro. Seven thousand dzovhara dzese. Hanti’moona kuti dzadzokera futi pa seven thousand. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] But munofunga kuti kuti aiti akauraya four hundred pagore iroro pobereka three thousand. Hazvina [Apostle claps once—ED] zvazvachinja. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vaitokwikwidzana nekudzidya, but hapana zvavaidii….? [Congregation says, “zvavaiita.”] Mombe anga aine five hundred mombe, manje a family of Job which was ten people vanga vari ten handiti? He had seven sons and three daughters ndizvoka? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Then ivo varimukadzi nemui… nemurume then ne household.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Vakauraya mombe yaichovha zvisingadii…? [Congregation says, “zvisingaite.”] Vakadonhedza one mombe, two weeks vainayo. Zvino vaibva vati mombe voti hwai aaah pamwe nengarikuni pamuso…? [Congregation says, “pamusoro.”] Vanhu vainzi vakapfuma kare—kare vaipfuma nezvipfuwo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndopfuma chai…? [Congregation says, “chaiyo.”] Now we have learnt that when you saw the dollar become ba… bankrupt Zimbabwe became bankrupt and the dollar became moneyless, valueless, until un—noona Beira Cheque rakadonhera apa anodi…? [Congregation says, “anorinonga.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: But mbudzi panguva iyoyo pane musi unomuka mbudzi isina value? [Bother laughs and says, “hayaya kana,” congregation laughs—ED] Muri kuzvionaka kuti pfuma inoramba iri yakanzi naMwari ndiyo chii…? [Congregation says, “pfuma.”] Tingaita Amen here ipapo? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe mombe haimuke kuseni ichinzi nhasi mombe haisisina basa. Hapana pamunoti mombe ingashaya munhu anoiba. Mombe inogara yakadaro, but Bheira Cheque rakashaya munhu akarinhonga mu road. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Iyezvino unovhura drawer so yakazara nema Bheira cheque hapana kana one anoribata mumba mangu. [Apostle claps his hands five times—ED] But pane piece yenyama vanotora. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Saka pfuma taiziva. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tirikuti dai Mwari akatiitira nyasha, tikaziva izvozvo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mumwe nemumwe wedu akakwanisa kuti ane mhuri yake uwane ka portion kaunoita huku, ka portion kaunoita mbudzi, ka portion kaunoita mangarikuni, ka portion kaunoita nyama—huku dzemazai pfuma chaiyo chaiyo i huku dziripa yard, mbudzi kwete mari iri ku bank.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Takadzidza kuti unomuka kuseni mari iyoyo isisareve chii…? [Congregation says, “chinhu.”] Unomuka ku bank zvonzi mari yako haichareva chinhu. “Ndine one trillion.” Zvonzi, “Ehe one trillion iyoyo haitengi kana imba.” “Saka mati ndodyei” Voti, “Hameno.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: But kana une kumusha kune mbudzi unodii… ? [Congregation says, “unoenda .”] Wonodimbura humbudzi yenyu musoro. Saka vanepfuma vanhu vanezvipfuwo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vane pfuma vanhu vane zvirimwa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Takapihwa zvisingaite naMwari gore rino. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Moona? Ndosaka ngatitendei chaizvo. Tiende mberi nekuramba tichinyengetera kuti Mwari tiitirei nyasha,hanti’moona?

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Then toda kuratidza chinhu one zuva ranhasi uno service yedu yanhasi. It’s the same thing that we will be talking about but tichingo tryer kutora ma angles akawanda kuti kunzwisisa kwako kukure. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda kutaura about a Father’s Right, ma rights aba… ababa. A Father’s Right, Father’s Rights or a Father’s Right hm. Now with that in mind, ndoda kuti munhu wese azive heritage yevanhu vaMwari. Nhaka yevanhu vaMwari kuti ko, nhaka yevanhu vaMwari chiiko? Heritage yavo, tetichingobata hedu maGwaro apo nepapo tichibata maGwaro apo nepapo, tichibata maGwaro apo nepapo. But pfungwa yangu yandinayo tetichida kuita summary yezvatinenge tambogoverena nevamwe Svondo iyi kuti uite picture yezvatirikudya tese. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Mukaona ha’moona, munhu wese panyika akauya panyika anoda chinhu one, kugara zvakadii…? [Congregation says, “zvakanaka.”] Ndochinangwa chekunamata, ndoda Ameni ipapa kahama, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chinangwa chekunamata kugara zvakadii…? [Congregation says, “zvakanaka.”] Hatitaurei tose, chinangwa chekunamata…? [Congregation says, “chinangwa chekunamata,”] kugara zvakadii…? [Congregation says, “kugara zvakanaka,”] imba yakanaka…? [Congregation says, “imba yakanaka,”] mota yakanaka…? [Congregation says, “mota yakanaka,”] hembe dzakanaka…? [Congregation says, “hembe dzakanaka,”] chikafu chakanaka…? [Congregation says, “chikafu chakanaka,”] hutano…? [Congregation says, “hutano,”] furniture…? [Congregation says, “furniture,”] mhuri hombe…? [Congregation says, “mhuri hombe.”] Ndozvatinonamatira… ? [Congregation says, “ndozvatinonamatira,”] pasi pano…? [Congregation says, “pasi pano,”] kana izvozvo zvapfuura zvepasi pano…? [Congregation says, “kana izvozvo zvapfuura zvepasi pano,”] hupenyu husingapere…? [Congregation says, “hupenyu husingapere.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Tinganzwa Ameni here ipapa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha’moona zvatinouyira ku Church, saka ukanzwa munhu achiti nganditambure, haazive zvaari kunamatira. Ndozvandaiyedza kuratidza kuti Mwari vakagara vati vanhu vanondinamata ndichakupai zvamunoda me…? [Congregation says, “mese,”] mese. Ndosaka muchiona ndichifarira nziyo yevana kuti, Nezuva iro tichaziva Mwari kana tose taropafadzwa. Nezuva iro tichaziva Mwari kana tose takomborerwa

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Saka hurombo inhaka yekunamata mudzimu. Hurombo inhaka yekusaziva ani…? [Congregation says, “Mwari.”] Vana vasinga teerere vana vakakudzwa kunzwe kwe Bhaibhiri. Mwari havamudii… havamuzive, vakakudzwa kunze kweBhaibhiri. Saka vana ava vanoteera tsika dzekunzvimbo dzavakurira.Vanemararamiro vakakopa muma rokisheni, avakakopa muma village. Asi mwa…munhu…mwana wemunhu waMwari haakope mararamiro anoitwa muma raini. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwana wemunhu waMwari anokopa mararamiro aanodzidziswa nababa vake. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handisi kunzwa Ameni ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ende vana vedu havasi vekutaurira kuti Mwari akadai, it’s very difficult now the world is chao—chaotic very chaotic. You can’t go, woyenda wonoudza mwana wako kuti Mwari ndeuyu, Mwari ndeuyu havachateerera vana vedu. Vana vedu vakuda Mwari wavanoona. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Paive nekamwana kakanga kachitya mabhanan’ana husiku. Huh? Ndobva kwatibikira husiku manje mhenhi dzakurira pava pava pava, hova hova hova kamwana kabva katanga kuchema mhamha vacho ndobva vayenda ikoko zvikanzi, “Nyarara kani.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Zvikanzi, “Ndiri kutya ini panze apa, ” Zvikanzi, “Ayiwa, ko uchatyei ko nhai. Mwari vanokuchengeta muno.’’ Zvikanzi, ‘’Ah-ah ndoda Mwari wandinobata. Zvekuti mundisiye pano muchindiudza kuti Mwari [Apostle chuckles—ED ] hapana, izvozvo chimbondisiyai. Ndoda Mwari wandinodii… ? [Congregation says, “wandinobata.”] Ndoda kumunzwa Mwari uyu.” Yes! Man want God with skin all. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hakuna munhu anoda kunamata Mwari waasingadii…? [Congregation says, “waasingaone.”] Ah…ndosaka nanhasi wese isusu panapa, tikatanga kunamata tichingotaura kuti tina Mwari tina Mwari asi hupenyu hwaMwari hwacho husinga ratidze tinoreva chii…? [Congregation says, “nhema,”] nhema! Kana Mwari varipano ngativaonei, munhu wese ngaarege kuti ndinoziva Mwari nenharo dzema Gwaro, munhu wese ngaarege kuti ndinoziva Mwari nezvaanogona kukota. Toda kuti munhu ati ndinoona…ndakaoana Mwari kuti vanondida A, B, C, D. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handisikunzwa Ameni iyeye hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha’moona?

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndosaka kana iwewe wakutauriraka vana vako ndo right yababa unofanira kuvaudza kuti mwanangu unoziva pakati paya? NdiMwari uyu. Unoziva pakati paya? NdiMwari uyu. Unoziva pakati paya? entries.text: But kana baba vakaziva Shoko iri, ndokubva vapinda mariri nesimba, vanogovera kuvana vavo zvavanodii ivo...? [Congregation says, “zvavanoda,”] zvavanoda. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kungoenda pamuteuro votaura kuti, “Uyu, baba, ndatsamwa uyu. Haaite chakati. Uyuyuyu, achaita chakati uyu. Uyo uyo haaite uyo.” Zvawatongotaura izvozvo zvinongomira zvakadii...? [Congregation says, “zvakadaro.”] Tingaita Amen here varanda vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen handisi kumunzwa iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Inyaya yakaoma kuona but ndeye mazviro kwazvo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vakadzi vakanga vakangwara vaiyiziva. Ndosaka vana—mukadzi waJakobho akatsvetera ja—eh, mukadzi wa Isaac akatsvetera Isaac kumupa chikafu chaanoda, kubatsira mwana wake kuti ropafadzo riende pana Jako...? [Congregation says, “pana Jakobho.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Because aizviziva kuti kana mudhara uyu akasaisa ropafadzo apa, nyangwe ndikada uyu mwana uyu nemwoyo wangu wese hapana zvinodii...? [Congregation says, “zvinobuda/Amen.”] Vakadzi vakangwara vanoziva kunobva ropafadzo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Bathsheba chaiye chaiye akabata Mambo Dhavhidhi zvakanaka, Mambo Dhavhidhi vakatora Soromoni mwana wake wedangwe vakamuita mambo weIsira...? [Congregation says, “Isiraeri.”] Nekuti mukadzi uyu aiziva kuti baba ava ndovanokwanisa kutaura zvinochinja hupenyu hweu...? [Congregation says, “hwe...Inaudible 43:22/Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Zvino tukai vana baba mugoona kuti muchabura chii. Baba vane right yavo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndopaya pandiri kukutii imimi vanhu vaMwari vari kunamata iye zvino, kumbira kuti Mwari ndipeiwo maropafadzo, Mwari ndipeiwo sanduko, Mwari ndipeiwo zvakakwana ndichengete nekupa ropafadzo pamhuri yangu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengei muone. Huyai muone pano. Chionai, verse 5, hativerengei tese verse 5, tese. Tese, toda munhu wese ati Amen, tese. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengei verse 5 tese tione: But unto the place which the LORD your God shall choose out of all your tribes to put his name there, even unto his habitation shall ye seek, and thither thou shalt come:

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Chionai zvinoitika pa verse 6 apo. Ndiri—Tiri tese here? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatiitei Amen tese. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengei verse 6 tione tese: And thither ye shall bring your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and heave offerings of your hand, and your vows, and your freewill offerings, and the firstlings of your herds and of your flocks:

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ipapo ndopamunounza zvinhu zvese zvinonzi naMwari wunzai. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ipapo bhadhara chegu...? [Congregation says, “chegumi.”] Hapabiwe chegumi ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hapabiwe offering ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hapabiwe missionary fund ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hapabiwe building fund ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ipapo kana wapasvika ipapo, hunza zvinhu zvako ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ayehwa Amen handisi kumunzwa iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Hanzi ipapa apo kana ukange waita izvozvo, ndinokuita sei...? Handei pa verse inotevera tese. Tingawana Amen here?— Ngaapfuure ipapo Amen iyeye? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ayehwa ngaapfuure ipapo Amen iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengei verse 7 tese: And there ye shall eat before the LORD your God, and ye shall rejoice in all that ye put your hand unto, ye and your households, wherein the LORD thy God hath blessed thee.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Mungaita Amen here varanda vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi ipapa apo ndopamuchatenda Mwari ipapo. Ipapo ndopamuchafara kufara chai...? [Congregation says, “chaiko.”] Ende uchati ukatenga huku dzemazai dzinodii...? [Congregation says, “dzino...Inaudible 45:37] Ukati ndoda huku dzenyama dzinodii...? [Congregation says, “dzinoita.”] Ukati ndoda mombe, dzinodii...? [Congregation says, “dzinoita.”] 84Verengai, ririkutaura Bhaibhiri. Haikonai kuverenga Bhaibhiri musingabati. Handei pa verse 7 muone, pa ve—[Blank spot on tape—ED] …re ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengei verse 7 tese: And there ye shall eat before the LORD your God, and ye shall rejoice in all that ye put your hand unto…

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi, “You shall rejoice in everything that you put your hand o...?” [Congregation says, “on.”] [Apostle chuckles] [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ukati ndoda kutanga cha—ukati ndiri kuda garage rezvemagetsi, God will bless you. Kana ukaunza—Zvinofambirana ne verse 6 ka izvi? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] You bring your tithes, you bring your offering, you bring your commitment. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndobva–waita izvozvo, chiuyai ipapa apo muchitanga ku rejoicer muri...? [Congregation says, “muripo.”] Zvatinoita izvi tichiimba izvi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] [Apostle starts to sing—ED] Tauya kuzomutenda vana Baba wee, tauya kuzomutenda.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Moziva kuti ndinogomera kuti zvakandiwana ndati kurei. [Congregation laughs—ED] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvakandiwana ndati kurei but dai ndaive mudiki brother, nde’chishaya kuti ko zvino dhanzi [dance—ED] yacho yoitwa sei. Because ini ndakaona baba vangu vachitambira masvikiro, nemaziso angu aya. Kwete ivo voga, nevakoma vavo. Zviya zvekutamba zvekubuda munhu achipfeke—achifemereka kudai, achitambira mudzimu wababa vake.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: “Unoziva kuti mudzimu wakatichengeta kuBhuruwayo uyu. Mudzimu uyu wakatichengeta kuBhuruwayo.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Vana babamukuru vachitaura. Takakura tichiudzwa izvozvo. Ndosaka mukaona munhu mutema, hakuna munhu mutema asingagoni kutaura nezvemudzimu nokuti vana baba vake ndozvavaimudii izvozvo...? [Congregation says, “zvavaimuudza.”] Ko imimi munotaurira vana venyu chii? Venyu munovaudzei? Isu takakura tichiziva mudzimu waVaGumbura, mudzimu waaK—wa’aMakwenya. VaMakwenya vaive nemudzimu, waityisa mudzimu wa’aMakwenya, waisika mhondoro. Mhondoro yainzi Nyamuzwa.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Haa! Takakura tichiudzwa zvese zveku—Ah! Mukanzi mugomo iro rinonzi Zumba iro, mune mapako aunoti ukapinda ikoko anenge achivhurika oga so. Achiti giba, achiti—mune mari imomomo, goridhe, mune… ah, mune hari dzizere negoridhe. And I grew up ndichiti one day ndichatakura gaba hwani chete. [Congregation laughs—ED]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Hanzi kana uchienda ikoko huswa hunenge huchivhurika hwega kudai, uchienda ikoko. Wosvika panenge paine kaburi kudai, moita kekuomberera kaburi kacho koti pfedu, wopinda imomo. Kunenge kune nyoka dziri uku dze—hadzikurume kana uriwo munhu anofanira kupinda imo...? [Congregation says, “imomo.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Moona zvatakakura tichiudzwa? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] But ndaona rudzi rwedu kuKenzamba uko, ndinogara ndichirikoka, ndinozviona. Kana mabako iwayo zviri’zvo zvaanogona kuita ikoko uku, ngaagare akadaro mapako iwayo. [Congregation laughs—ED] Handidi kuaona futi mapako iwayo muhupenyu hwangu, ehe. Mapako akaipa chai...? [Congregation says, “chaizvo.”] Apedza vanhu nemukondombera, apedza vanhu nembanje, apedza vanhu nedoro. Mapako asina chaanobatsira. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: But kubva zvandakaziva Jeso, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] mufaro wandinawo uyu ndewani uyu...? [Congregation says, “ndewa Jesu.”] Hausisiri wedzinza rekwandakabva. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Wa’amufaro waJeso chai...? [Congregation says, “chaiwo,”] chaiwo, ha’moona.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndosaka tava ipapo, hanzi ipapo manje, nde’chida kuti ndiine madzimai angu tichitenda Mwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tichifara kuti Mwari akatichengeta uyu. Mwari anotipa mota, Mwari anotiti handipindi muchipatara. I have never known a hospital for all these years. Mwari akandirwira muhondo dzese dzandakasangana nadzo mu Mini...? mu Ministry.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Mwari akandipa vana twenty-three, Mwari atipa gohwo re seventy-three, Mwari anotifambisa every weekend, up and down. Every weekend tiri pa road. Hama dzinongo texter kuti, “Nenyasha tasvika. [Congregation says, ‘Amen.’]Mwari webarika atichengeta. [Congregation says, ‘Amen.’] Mwari wenyasha atisvitsa.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Zuva rimwe nei...? [Congregation says, “nerimwe,”] nerimwe. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hallelujah. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] But enda kuhama dzako uone.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: “Mateere ndakarwara zvamunoona kudai. Kundiona ndiri mupenyu kudai, mudzimu yenyu yakasimba Mateere.” Woti uri mupenyu papi iwe?

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: “Mateere nzeve iyi, haisi kunzva izvozvi, hainzve.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Vanotaura zvinonyadzisira. “Mateere ndakanyisiwa nzeve iyi. Kunyisiwa nezvinhu zviya izvi.” [Apostle and Congregation laugh—ED] Ndopandakaona kuti... [Apostle continues laughing—ED] Ndopandakabata kuti kana Mwari akasakuitira nyasha unofa uri bhamu, uchiteera culture, handiti. Uchida ku identifier ne culture zuva rimwe nei...? [Congregation says, “nerimwe.”] Haina chainoburitsa culture muhupenyu hwako. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] A man who has known what God can do should be able to tell those that are blinded, dim witted, kuti there is a God in heaven. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndakaona baba—hama dzangu dzichipinda mun’anga, ndakaona hama dzangu dzichirova makuva, ndakaona hama dzangu dzichiita mabira, dzichipira mudzimu, vachipera kufa munhu one, one nemukondombera. Vachisiya vana vaine mukondombera futi kumashure kwazvo. Vamwe vachitadza kuita mhuri. Achifa aine vana one, obva afawo mwana wacho. Vachifa vaine vana two, vobva vawanikwa vari positive futi zvakare.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndopandakaziva kuti ayehwa, vana vane hutano vakaita twenty, [Apostle sings—ED] “Tauya kuzomutenda...” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Iye zvino ta’ane vazuku...? [Congregation says, “vazukuru.”] Muri kuona nyasha dzaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Uchinyatsoona vana vako kuti ndofunga uyu Esther acharoorwawo zvakanaka. Ndofungawo Blessing acharoorwawo zvakanaka. Ndofungawo Zoe acharorwa zvakanaka.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ende vakadzi vangu vanenge vanhu kwavo. Haisi type inobuda ichimhanya mhanya kuenda chero kwayaenda, vanozvichengeta. Vanhu vane tsika dzakana...? [Congregation says, “dzakanaka.”] Havazi vanongoti gii negotsi nemuhu wese wese in ten minutes time. Havana kudaro, handi’moona.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Saka unenge uchinyatsoona kuti manje kwamateere manje, nyaya dzinotongwa padare kwa chief ndedzekutorerana vai...? [Congregation says, “vakadzi.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: “Mateere, ndakasvika kumba ndekugugudza door kudai, ndekugugudza door. [Congregation laughs—ED] Door harina kuvhuriwa, Mateere. Ndopandakati nditenderere kudai ndiende kuchiburi chehwindo kuye, ndopandakanzwa door riye revhurika paya. Pandakanoti ndiyehe dzoka kuye, Mateere, ndokuoona aika, ko zvakunobuda zi-i-i-ndi-ndo-ndomaibuda iyeye uyo. [Congregation laughs—ED] Mudzimai wangu achitevera ikoko kumashure kwake. Ndikati, “Manga musiitei mu yard yangu ende manga musiitei muri mumba umu?” [Apostle and Congregation laugh—ED]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndakakura ndichongoti, [Apostle laughs—ED] urwu rudzi urwu. Dzaive mhuka dzevanhu maitiro avo vose, handi’moona, ehe. Ndomhuka chaidzo unonyatsoona kuti ndidzo mhuka idzi. Pasina nyasha ka, muri mhuka.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ehe wanzwa, “Iwe taka—takunzwa iwe. Saka iwe wakatora mukadzi wemunhu kaiwe? Wakatora mukadzi wemunhu iwe. Toda mombe pana apa, mbiri. Wakatora mukadzi wemunhu.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: “Maita Mateere,[Apostle claps four times—ED] maita Mambo, maita.” Ehe, osimuka ouya-kouya.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: “Mateere, ndakabirwa chibaho changu. [Congregation laughs—ED] Ndakasvika vamudura, vanga vari mudenga muya. Ndakatanga ndisinga—nda’ndiri kure ndisina kuona kuti, ndakafunga kuti kunge ibveni. [Congregation laughs—ED] Ndazoona...” [Apostle and Congregation laugh—ED]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Paramendi yekwa Mateere inonakidza stereki, paramendi yacho. [Congregation laughs—ED] Unoona vamwe vakashinga kana kuchitongwa ikoko, unoseka. Unosekwa ukaburitswa mu court namambo, ayizve. [Congregation laughs—ED] Ndopandakaona, [Apostle laughs—ED] Mwari akandiitira nyasha dzisingadii...? [Congregation says, “dzisingaiti.”] Ha’moona. Tazomuziva Mwari uya uya, haiwa, kana ivo vana baba unonzwa vachitaura kuti, “Ah, kunamata kwakakuba...?” [Congregation says, “...batsira.”] Saka ndosiya ndanongedzera vana vangu chii? Ndovanongedzere chii vana vangu vaya?

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Mwari uya uya zveshuwa, ndingarege kumuropafadza kana kuti ndimutende ndiri muimba yaakandipa? Ndiine hutano hwaakandipa? Vakadzi vanogona kubika? Uchirara pari smart, mumba makatsvairwa, vanhu vakachena, heh? Kwete panyama chete, nepamweya. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]Hapana mupfuhwira, hapana datya, hapana chi-chi-chidhambakura, hapana chii, heh. Hapana mucheka muchena, hamuna bute mu yard iyoyo. Mune simba reWedenga. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndosaka munhu waMwari, hanzi masvika ipapo pacho pandinenge ndakaisa Zita rangu ipapo, ndopandakasvika kaini, ndo Message. Brother Branham vakato—vatumwa naMwari kuita mutumwa wechinomwe zvakanzi, “Nenguva yemanheru kuchava nechaye...? [Congregation says, ‘chayedza,’] nechayedza.” Kwete Savadha, kwete Salvation Army, chayedza. Vanenge vari muchayedza ichocho hanzi ipapo ndopandinosangana nemuta...? [Congregation says, “nemutadzi.”] Ndakazvionera ndoga ini ndatenda Message muGweru munomu ndiri kakomana.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndakauya muGweru munomu ndisati ndaroora ka ini, ndiri kakomana. But Mwari wandiri kukutaurira uyu ndewe munana iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndakauya muGweru munomu ndiri one, ndichiuya pa G.T.C apa. Nda’akudzokera, chitarirai. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndakauya ndichizoenda ku G.T.C, nenguva yandakazenge ndavaka Church iyi. Nenguva yandakazenge ndaroora, heh, ndatova nemadzimai angu. Ndakazobva kuGweru kunoku ndatova ne four.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndabva Harare ndiri one, ndakazodzokera ndaane chii...? [Congregation says, “four.”] Ndakabva Harare ndisina kana spare underwear. [Congregation laughs—ED] Ndangandisina spare underwear, spare shoe ndangandisina. Ndangandisina spare vest, ndangandiri stude...? [Congregation says, “student.”] When I went back I had households, wardrobes, shelves. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] [Apostle starts to sing—ED] Ndewe munana, ndewe munana, Jehovah ndewe munana.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndakazodzokera, ndakazodzokera nda’anana Shiphra, nda’anana Esther, nda’anana Mozi, nda’anana Zoe, nda’anana—nana Zinhle, nda’anana Gari, ndaakudzokera nda’anana Kombo, ndaakudzokera nda’ana Tito. I came one band, I go back nda’ane gurusvusvu reva...? [Congregation says, “revanhu.”] Nenyasha dzaani...? [Congregation says, “dzaMwari.”] Kure nemapako ezumba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handina kuzodzokera kwaari zvakare.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndopaunofana kunge uchiudza vana vako kuti, “Vanangu chigarai ndikutaurirei, Mwari uyu wandiri kukuudza uyu, haazi Mwari anoreva nhema. Ndaakutaura ndakura zvandakadai, handizive hospitoro ini, handizive nhamo. Kusadya nama—nyama every day, kugonekana nani...? [Congregation says, “nayo.”] Kufamba netsoka, heh.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Nda’ndichiseka amwe ma sister anga achiti nhasi hanzi-hanzi, “Haa hatidi kukwira mu dhabhuru [double—ED] cab.Dhabhuru cab mota yakashata stereki.” Ndikati, “Ah ah ah!” Ndatsamwa imi. Ndikati, “Iwe kumusha kwenyu iriko?” [Congregation laughs—ED]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ende vafundisi vauya vari mumakombi manheru a... manheru ano vamwe. Vapinda mumabhazi vafundisi kuuya ku Chur...? [Congregation says, “ku Church.”] Iye otoramba paanogara zvake ototaura kuti [Apostle makes a whining sound] Ini ndakati... ndakati kubva Svondo inouya ndoda kumbokwidza vanhu mabhazi. Kuvati endai mese pa Show Ground apo uwone kunetsa kwazvinodii...? [Congregation says, “kwazvinoita.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Unonzwa hama ichiti, “Brother ndamirira na twelve, ndazowana bhazi kuma four.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Anonoka kusvika ku service, heh. Ndopaunonzwa minana yakadaro makuseni seni uchiuya ku Church. Ndopandakaona kuti munoziva kuzo appreciater Mwari kunouya nenyasha? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Unoziva kuti unopinda murugare rwaMwari ukasarwudii...? [Congregation says, “ukasarwuona.”] “Vane nzeve dzekunzwa ngavanzwe...” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Brother kana uchitokwanisa kutowana kombi chaiyo, mari yekombi kuuya kuChechi, vamwe vanhu mari—kuti vabve kuBhuruwayo vauye muno zviri kudii...? [Congregation says, “zviri kunetsa.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Vamwe kuti vabve muKwekwe vauye pano, kukombi, chinenge chaka—chiine hutsi, chichingo pwititika kusvika wasvika, haachikwanisi ichocho. Kudzimara anotorovha service. Ngatiuyei pano kuzomutenda. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengei muone verse 7 iya iya. Tese, hativerengei: And there ye shall eat before the LORD your God, and ye shall rejoice in all that ye put your hand unto, ye and your households, wherein the LORD thy God hath blessed thee.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Handei pa verse 13: Ye shall... Verse 13, ndoda Amen munhu wese. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handisi kumunzwa Amen iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ngaapfuure ipapo Amen iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengei verse 13 tese: Take heed to thyself…

entries.text: Ah-ah, verse-verse 11, tese. entries.text: Ndoda verse 12, tese: And ye shall rejoice before the LORD your God, ye, and your sons, and your daughters, and your menservants, and your maidservants, and the Levite that is within your gates; forasmuch as he hath no part nor inheritance with you.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Hatiitei Amen tese. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Panenge pane murevhi wamunenge muinaye ipa...? [Congregation says, “ipapo.”] Farai ipapo nemwoyo wenyu we...? [Congregation says, “wese/Amen.”] Nzvimbo iyi takaiwana here varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Aihwa, ndoda kubvunza genuinely, takaiwana here nzvimbo iyi? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoinonzi Message of the Ho...? [Congregation says, “the Hour/Amen.”] Tingaita Amen here? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen akapfuura ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen, hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen, Hallelujah.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Takaiwana nzvimbo iyi. Ndonzvimbo inoita kuti urege kuroyeka. Ndonzvimbo inoita kuti urambe uchikomborerwa. Ndonzvimbo inoita kuti ug—urege kugara wakashanyira chipatara. Ndonzvimbo inoita kuti urege kugara wakapinda mumatorongo, uchibuda. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndonzvimbo inodzinga hurombo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndonzvimbo inoita kuti uve nehutano hwauina…? [Congregation says, “hwauinahwo.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Zvino kana wauya pana apa, ungamunate kuti Mwari arikukuchengeta wakasuwa? [Apostle Gumbura claps hands once—ED] Pana Mwari anoita chishamiso kune munhu asingamu appreciate? Kana tauya pano vanhu vaMwari, hakuna ane chimiro pano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatitendei Mwari nemwoyo inoda! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Now, Mwari uyu, ndiye Mwari akaonekwa naJakobho pa Luz. Hatidzokerei kuna 48 yedu, Genesis 48. Right, handi’mazviona? Ndopakanzi: And Jacob said unto Joseph…

entries.text: Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha’moona. Ndopa… Handi… And said unto me, Behold, I will make thee fruitful, and multiply…

entries.text: And all that. Now, now… And thy issue, which thou begeseth…

entries.text: Aakutaurirwa kwakafira amai vaani…? [Congregation says, “vake.”] Verse 6—verse 8. And Israel beheld Joseph's sons, and said, Who are these?

entries.text: Hativerengei verse 9 tese: And Joseph said unto his father, They are my sons, whom God hath given me in this place. And he said, Bring them, I pray thee, unto me, and I will bless them.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Vaunze kwandiri ndivadii…?” [Congregation says, “ndivaropafadze.”] Ende murikuona here kuti Josefa aiziva kuti vana apihwa nani…?[Congregation says, “naMwari.”] “Vana vandakapihwa naMwari munzvimbo ino yandi…?” [Congregation says, “yandiri.”] “Vaunze kuno ndivaropafadze.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Handei mberi muone. Inondinakidza chaizvo nyaya iyi. Verse ya…10 tese: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he could not see. And he brought them near unto him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.

entries.text: And embra—Handei pamberi. And Israel said unto Joseph, I had not thought to see thy face: and, lo, God hath shewed me also thy seed.

entries.text: Murikuona mashoko a’ataura? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Pawakanzi wafa, vakandiratidza chinguwo chako, handina kuzofunga kuti face yako ndichaidi…? [Congregation says, ‘ndichaiona,’] but iye zvino ndakutoona vana vaani…? [Congregation says, ‘vako,’] nekuda kwaMwari wandinonama…?” [Congregation says, “wandinonamata/ Amen.”]

entries.text: Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] [inaudible 1:03:22—ED] “Tariro yekukuona yakanga yarasika zvacho…? [Congregation says, ‘zvachose.’] But look, I’m now seeing your children.” Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.text: Handei pa verse 12 tese: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.

entries.text: Handei mberi: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel's left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel's right hand, and brought them near unto him.

entries.text: Atora Manasseh, mukomana mukuru, amunangisa paruoko rwerudyi rwababa vaani…? [Congregation says, “vake.”] Havachaonika baba ava? “Chiiko ichi?” Ayiita zvekubata achifeela, [to feel through sense of touch—ED] right ranga raadhara.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Zvikanzi, “Horaiti, chiuya tione apa, hm.” Ndokuendesa Manasseh mukuru kune right hand yababa handitika. Ndokutora Ephraim chipfanha, ndokuendesa kuruboshe rwaani…? [Congregation says, “rwababa,”] rwababa. Handei muone. Tiripo tose? [Blank spot—ED] [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Right handei verse 14 tese: And Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it upon Ephraim's head, who was the younger, and his left hand upon Manasseh's head, guiding his hands wittingly; for Manasseh was the firstborn.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Murikuona zvakaitika apo? Apihwa dangwe ka uko, handitika? Uku apihwa mupfanha uku, handitika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vauya vana vaya vaya, mm-mm… Baba vanyatsoti, “First born yangu iyi,” ndobva yaiendesa kurudyika uko. Maropafadzo auye akawa…? [Congregation says, “akawanda.”] Ndokutora mupfanha ndokuendesa kuruboshweka? Dhara iya iya, yasvika yaakufeela [as he felt by sense of touch—ED] so, ndobva yarova cross yayo. Yega! Hanzi, “…guiding hands wi…?” [Congregation says, “wittingly.” Apostle Gumbura laughs—ED]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “He guided his hands wi…?” [Congregation says, “wittingly.”] Ku crosser oga kudaiwo. Kwaakutora right hand, yoenda pamupfanha Ephraim. Kwaakutora left hand, yoenda pa first bor…? [Congregation says, “first born.”] That’s the right of a father. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika Amen hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndopaya pandaitaura kuti baba ka, vanogona kutora munhu a—mwana anga asiri first born, vakamuti, “Ndiwe waa first born pamusha uno.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Vakangotaura izvozvo, ndizvo…? [Congregation says, “ndizvozvo.”] Ndivozve, vakakuberekai panyika pano. Mwari wavanonamata ndiye anokupai ropafadzo rimwe neri…? [Congregation says, “nerimwe.”] Muri kuona here kuti iye Josefa uyu, kuti azova dangwe muimba ya… yaJakobho, baba vakamuda kubva achizva…? [Congregation says, “achizvarwa.”] Vaida Josefa. Ndobva vatora makomborero aifanira kuenda pana Reuben na Judah, akaenda ese pana ani…? [Congregation says, “pana Josefa.”] Ende Josefa ndiye akabva awana shumiro ino vachengeta ve…? [Congregation says, “vese.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: That’s what the father wanted. Kureva kuti ndongona kutora last born yemumba mangu chai—kamukomana kachazo… Pamwe hakasati kazvarwa. Ndangokafarira, kana k-kauya kamupfanha ikako. Kane mweya wakanaka. Ndogona kuti, “Iwe mupfanha mu-o…” Kaa kuma fifteen years. “Iwewe, uchatonga vakoma vako ve…? [Congregation says, ‘vese,’] vese. Ukanditeerera inini, vakoma vako vese vachaenda pasi paani…? [Congregation says, ‘pako.’] Vana mai vako vese vacheremekedza iwe…? [Congregation says, ‘iwewe.’] Hanzvadzi dzako dzese dzichatarisa kwau…?” [Congregation says, “kwauri.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndozvakaitwa apa. Ndoda kuti muchiona manje muteuro. Kuti kunamata, hazvisi zvinhu zvepamweya, zvamunogara muchitaura pamweya. Kana takapona, handi’takaponeswa neRopa raJeso? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] That goes without say, ndinenge ndiri kudenga ini. Ndakawana Hupenyu Husingapere nekugamuchira Je…? [Congregation says, “Jesu.”] Ndokwandiri kuenda, ndiri kuenda kudenga. But ndofanira kuratidza vanhu ndichiri pasi pa…? [Congregation says, “pano.”] Kuti ndine chandakatambira, chakasiyana nechavainacho ivo ava! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo hama.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndohondo yandiinayo pano, but pandakatambirwa naJeso Kristu, ndikaiswa papa pachipfuva changu apa, it’s obvious ndiri kuenda kudenga izvozvi. Ndiri mwana waMwari ini. Handivigwe kunovigwa vana Mateere. Kana vakaisa mutumbi wangu ikoko, mweya wangu hau…? [Congregation says, “hauko.”] Ini ndinoenda kupi…? [Congregation says, “kudenga.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: “Vane nzeve dzekunzwa, ngavanzwe.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen handisi kumunzwa iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen, Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen, Hallelujah.”] Chionai munamato uyo—[Blank spot on tape—ED] …zvakanyanyisa uyo. Huyai muone a’akunyengetera manje.

entries.text: Unomuudza kuti, “Mwana wangu, kukura kwawakaita, kukuguta so nehutano so, ndiye Mwari iyeyu uyu. Waitipa chekudya zuva rimwe nei…? [Congregation says, ‘nerimwe.’] It’s an insult kuti undiudze kuti waakutsvaga umwe mwari wako waunozi…?” [Congregation says, “waunoziva.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Hakuna zvakadaro. Ndosaka right yababa kana vachinge vasvika panzvimbo ine Zita raMwari, ukaona mwana wako akati, “Inini ndaakunopinda ku denominaton,” muregere. Kuvhaira kusingadii…? [Congregation says, “kusingaite.”] Ane pride isingaite, ha’moona. Ende gumo yake inonyadzisa zvisingadii…? [Congregation says, “zvisingaite.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Nokuti ndiudzei kutikana akanga…a … m… Shiphra akati ini ndakupinda Christ Embassy, handi muchaona kuti Esther achatizira ikoko opindawo, muchaona Blessing omhanyira ikoko opindawo, saka Kakunga achava Blessing mumhuri mangu? Ha’moona atova muyedzo wandakapindira mumhuri yangu? Huh? Une right yekunamatira rufu rwavo. Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tingaita Amen here varanda vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.text: Zvirinani kuti vafe pane kuti vakuuraire rudzi rwe…? [Congregation says, “rweseAmen.”] Unofana kupinda pakutotsanya kuti, “Mwari ndirikukumbira kuti muchinditorera uyu nekuti hamungambondipe munhu anouya kuzondidzidzisa inini. Pandakamuzvara, ndakamuzvara nekuda kwekukuzivayi nhasi wakura wakunditi baba itai so.” Hmm? Zvinhu zvakadaro hazviitwe vanhu vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.text: Manje ndiri kuzviona mu Message zvichinyanya chai…? [Congregation says, “chaizvo.”] Pastor Chuma vaitoti mwana ava kumbira Tsitsi kuti ndingaende here ku SU? [Congregation says, “hapana.”] Unofanira kuva nechaunonongedzera kuti, “Mwanangu, Mwari uyo.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Abatwe nekutya iyeye Mwari iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.text: But vana vanouya ku Church havadi, vamwe vana vedu tinotomanikidza kuti handei ku Church tese, iye anenge achida here? Church yababa venyu munoiti i church,”

Maiwe…wofunga kuti zvapera ndobva…ka—katevera kamwe futi dhi! Huh? Paunozosara wava one manje unenge wakuita tsotsi rinenge Judha. Hauchatoenda kuna Tamar tibereke m—m—vana sekuvimbisa kwakadii…? [Congregation says, “kwawakaita.”] Vapera. Judha takaibata nyaya iyoyo, “Touch not the Lord’s a…?” [Congregation says, “anointed.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Tingaita Amen here varanda vaMwari...? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Unenge wazviuraya wega hama. Ndosaka iye zvino mu Message matiri munomu matakapinda umu munhu waMwari muno hamutambiwe ini ndakazviona ndoga. Vakasimuka vatsvene vakati 2000 murume uya tinomukanyakanya tikamuita zvatinotsika, tikamutsika tsika, tikamutsika tsika. Ndinotonamata pandinouya mu Gweru, do you know I pray kuti I don’t want to see them. I don’t want to meet them because ndikavaona unenge uchachema nekunzwira chii…? [Congregation says, “tsitsi,”] tsitsi eh. And Mwari akaremekedza munamato iwoyo ndoti, “Lord, I don’t want to see them. Why would I be reminded of what they would be, ndichiona zvanenge vari iyezvi…?” [Congregation says, “iyezvino.”]

entries.text: Ndakaona Marisa ka one ndiri mu Benz yangu ndokusangana naye pa corner apo aina Marima, iye akubva aona mota ndobva amira pa corner pe wire so akadai. Ndakashaya kuti chitokoroshi here? Ndikati chii? Tundebvu, tuma girazi tutema tema and katsonga kuita goritoto, ah. Ndikati vakomana. Ndakabva ipapo brother I was so depressed, ndakato tadza kudya kumba manheru.

entries.text: Kuti akomanaka why people are like this? nNdikati Mwari chindibatsirai ndoku… [Apostle chuckles] I don’t want to meet them when I get there.Hee? [Congregation laughs—ED]

entries.text: Ndomubhedha yatakakura tichiziva isu, Mwari vasati vaita nya…? entries.text: Kana wauya mu Church kuuya kuzofara, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] kuzotenda Mwari nenyasha dzaani…? [Congregation says, “dzavo.”] Uchiona vasikana nevakomana vaurikuumba. Vamwe varikuita ma teacher, ma nurse, ma Labtech, ma Bank man ma…dzimba dzaurikuumba uchibatanidza iwewe. entries.text: Mwari akandichengeta mazuva angu ose… [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Panguva iye yataiitirwa chimuchongoyo panapa tangatisina kana purazi nenguva yatakaripihwa, nenguva yatakawana ma trick-ta, nenguva yatakutaura magoho. entries.text: Chionai next statement yake, honai next statement. Hativerengei, “The God who richly fed me…” tese …the God which fed me all my life long unto this day Verse 16 tese. The Angel which redeemed me from all evil…

entries.text: Ndakaona Mwari achikunda kurova makuva, ndakaona Mwari achikunda ngozi, ndakaona Mwari achikunda kushaya mbereko, ndakaona Mwari achikunda mbanje, ndakaona Mwari achikunda doro, ndakaona Mwari achikunda hurwere, ndaenda pazvimbo yavakaisa Zita rani…?[Congregation says, “ravo,”] ravo. [Congregation says, “unopora.”] Huya wanonoka ku delivery mandakaisa Zita raani…?[Congregation says, “rangu.”] Zita rangu hupe…? [Congregation says, “hepenyu.”] Kana washaiwa basa huaya pandakaisa Zita raani…? [Congregation says, “rangu.”] Zita raMwari hupe…? [Congregation says, “hupenyu.”] In Jesus Name. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Tirikuuya kuzokunda mweya yema dzi…? [Congregation says, “yemadzinza, Amen.”] Hanzi, vana vemunhu akanaka vanosara vachiropafadza iye aye…? [Congregation says, “ayenda,Amen”] Ko chikoro chakasara zve, akasiya arairaka. Vanobuda mu Church here? Ndopachabuda vana vemunhu anonamata voyenda vononoshopera. Ndopachabuda vana vemunhu vanonamata vononyenga mahure kana kuti sister vonyengwa nemukomana anonwa doro, anoputa fodya anopira mudzimu, anotamba hip hop music.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: If you’re a father with a daughter or a son like that, you’re a total fai…? [Congregation says, “failure.”] Brother Branham vakabva vauya zvikanzi, “Zvinoitika kuti mwana anoita nharo, Billy Paul akaita nharo akaroora mu Roman Catholic handitika,” Brother Branham vakati, “leave that girl.” Maiona right of a father! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi, “Siyana nemusikana iye…?” [Congregation says, “iyeye.”] Mupfanha akatichii…? “I will go on.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Zvikanzi, “I will not have my grandchildren become Ca…?” [Congregation says, “Catholics.”] You marry a Catholic, they vow to raise the children Catholic if you marry one of them. I don’t want you to marry that Catholic girl leave her.” Bill Paul akati, “I won’t come home anymore.” Ndobva ayenda Billy Paul, Brother Branham vakamutora se Church zvikanzi, ‘’vanhu vaMwari mwana wangu aita musikanzwa ndoda kukuratidza kuti inini handinzaro.’’ [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndobva vatora mwana uya uya Billy Paul ndokumisa mumaoko ani…? [Congregation says, “a Satan.”] Ah kweche! Brother Branham ndobva vayenda ku hunting phone ndobva yatevera ikoko. Zvikanzi, “Billy Paul is sick he can’t even get out of bed.” Zvikanzi, “I know.’’ Zvikanzi, “I know, yeah I know he is sick, I know he is sick.” Zvikanzi, “He is dying.” Zvikanzi, “No he won’t die, no he won’t die” [Apostle chuckles—ED] no he won’t die Zvikanzi, “What… Zvikanzi, “He only needs to repent.” Zvikanzi, “Chiuyayi mumunamatire.” Zvikanzi, “No he did he the si…? [Congregation says, ‘sinning.’] he should do the…?” [Congregation says, “praying; Amen”] Toda Amen akadarika Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ngaapfuure Amen iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndobva vapa example of a brother akanga aine mwana wake akanga aita musika…? [Congregation says, “musikanzwa.”] 215Zvikanzi, “I told him that you don’t need me to talk to your child. There’s a way that is put in the Bi…?” [Congregation says, “in the Bible.”] Ma brother munonyanyonzwira vana venyu chii…? [Congregation says, “tsitsi,”] tsitsi. Hakuna pastor anouya okuti isa vana vako mumaoko aSatani, he wouldn’t. But that’s a decision you take on your o…? [Congregation says, “own,”] kana waona kuti iwe hauchazvigo…? [Congregation says, “hauchazvigona.”] 216Regai kuregera vana venyu vachiku embarrasayi. [to embarrass—ED] Unomuti, “Shamwari, regera zvauri kudii izvozvo…?” [Congregation says, “zvauri kuita.”] Oramba kuteerera, woti, “Horaiti. I’m giving you one-month kuti ukande pasi zvauri kutaura izvozvo izvo or you will reap the consequences.” 217Woti, “Baba, haa ini handina basa na...” Wobva wauya zvako so wongotora ka… [Inaudible 1:45:57] wongorova ka one chaiko… [Apostle makes a sound to demonstrate—ED] wonyarara zvako woenda kumba. Iwe chienda unovhima. Unoriwona radzvova rume guru, “Iiii.” 218Woti, “Aiwa ka, muna Jehovah. Taura naJehovah wenyu ikoko.” Ehe, woti, “Kana uchida kuti usununguke nditaurire kuti Jehovah munowa…Ndimi muna Jehovah [Apostle laughs—ED] ikoko.” 219Anotendeuka munhu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] It’s the right of fa…? [Congregation says, “fathers.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handei munoona titarise futi kuna…Handei kuna Ephesians, munyatsoona. Handei kuna Ephesians muone. Ephesians chapter 6, verse 1. Hativerengeyi tese verse 1 chete, chete, chete, chete, chete, chete, chete, chete, chete, chete. Hativerengeseyi tose. Hatiitiyi Amen tese. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengeyi verse 1 tose: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatidzokororei ruGwaro irworwo irwo. Hatidzokororei ruGwaro iro. Hativerengeyi tese ruGwaro iro, tese: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right. 220“Vana vane vabereki vari mukutenda, teererai vabereki venyu nekuti zvakarura…?” [Congregation says, “zvakarurama.”] Vana vari pano vane ma parents ari kunamata, tendai Mwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nekuti chaunorairwa chese unorairwa chichikoterwa ma ve…? [Congregation says, “ma verse,”] ende unonongedzerwa kuShoko raani…? [Congregation says, “raMwari,”] ende vabereki vako vateere…? [Congregation says, “vateerere,”] nekuti zvanzi neBhaibhiri zviri ri…? [Congregation says, “zviri right.”] Tingaita Amen here. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen Hallelujah!”] 221And this is very important instruction kuvana vebarika nekuti mubarika mune competition isingadii…? [Congregation says, “isingaiti.”] Umwe parent inenge ichingoti, “Haa, inini vana vanhingi handidi inini.” Umwe parent yoti, “Vana vanhingi handidi inini.” Vana vaya vodhivhaidhaniswa. [to be divided—ED] “Hee, munofevha [to favour—ED] vanhingi.” Uya obva ati, “Hona iwewe unovengwa. Baba vako vakagara vada uyu.” 222Uya uya obva atora attitude yekuti ini handisinawo basa nababa. Handi’munoona zvavanotaura vana vaya? You are killing your children. Gadziranai so…somehow! Huyai nenyaya dzenyu kune vabereki venyu mogara pasi. Rega kutendera kuti vana vako vafunge kuti vana, vana, va…vaMai Shiphra vanofevhewa kudarika vana vaMai Zane. Zvikangouya izvozvo izvo, zvakanganisika. 223Ende vana vanotaura. I remember ndichiudzwa nevangu zvichinzi ah, eh…Vana vanga vachitaura mashoko ekuti mumwe anga achiti kana kuti eh… “Mu–mwa–mwana webarika uyu haazi munin’ina wangu.” Moona zvavanenge vachitaura vana? Heh.Unoona Tanya naNaka twakangodai. Waona Vongai naKeke twakangodai. Munoona zvavanenge vachiita vana vaya? Dzatova team dzebhora ka iri Brazil, Swaziland neSouth Africa ne…?... [Congregation laughs—ED] 224Iwe uchiti uri kuitei? Iwe wakatarisa zvinhu zvakadaro uchiti uri kuitei, handi’moona. Vana ava ndevako ve…? [Congregation says, “vese.”] Ndiwe baba, vavabva mauri vese. Why are you going to allow such kind of a happening pa yard yako? Zviputse. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndopanoda kuti munhu waMwari ange akaropafadzwa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] 225Saizvozvi ndikangoona…ndine’ndichigara navo ivavo Ndikaona kuti mu–mukadzi uyu anoda kuti aite favour kuvana vake, ndomuti, “Iwe chibva pano udzokere kwako. Vana vako vachasara vaine vakadzi vacho vauri kurwisana nani…? [Congregation says, ‘navo,’] navo. Iwewe urikuda kuita zvekuda kuita dzvene nevana vako, ibva pano uyende kumwe.” Ukavaregera ka… Zvino manje kana usina chinhu unozviita kupi? Hauna kana pekuketera vana vacho kuti ukete uti…nekwokudzingira umwe wacho uyo kuti ayende. [Congregation laughs—ED] Uri hwava. 226Zvino kana une zvinhu zvako manje wakati Mwari rino igore resanduko! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Unotaura kuti, “Mai Shiphra ka, huvahosi hwako hwakukanganisa. Chidzokera ku Ridgemont. But Zinzi anosara pa…? [Congregation says, ‘pano.’] Ropafadzo anosara pa…? [Congregation says, ‘pano.’] Zoe anosara pano. Iwe enda. Ende ku holiday havachauya.” Unenge waakungogarira pafoni, “Kwakadii ikoko?” Ndikaona twanyanya tufoni twacho ndotutora futi twufoni twacho twese. Handi’moona kuti munhu waMwari akada kuronga musha wake? But vazhinji venyu mune tsitsi stereki. Hamuzive pokuperera tsitsi. 227Handisati ndakamboona vanhu vakakanganisika nekunamata sevasema Gentiles. Vakabatira kunamata pamuso…? [Congregation says, “pamusoro.”] Anonzwa tsitsi pasina need yetsitsi, wonzwa, “That man is hard. That man is hard. If you listen to that man, he’s hard. Haa, chiita so.” 228Unozozvishora manje vana vaya vakanganiswa ve…? [Congregation says, “vese.”] Kana makaziva anonzi Mwari chaiye chaiye… Brother, kana munhu aina Mwari chaiye chaiye, chaiye—whether whether even mudzimai wako, kana mudzimai ari iye akawana pane ZitaZita—anoita anoita simba kukudii…? kukudarika. Kana ari murume akawana pane Zita, anoita simba kudarika madzimai aya. Vana vanotofanira kuti vatende zvinhu izvozvo izvo. 229But kana paakuti manje hapana differentiation, hapana, hapana. Inongori disorder mu yard yose yemu… Vakadzi vanoita zvavanoda, baba vanoita zvavanoda, vana vanoita zvavanoda. Imba iyoyo? Huh. There is no name for that. Babylon referred to the religiousness., I don’t know what we would call this one. Anarchy. [Congregation laughs—ED] But kana munhu achiziva zvaanoda anouya oti, “Ah, pamba pano tinodai,” hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Haikona kuregera even vakadzi vachitukana, handi’moona. Ndosaka muchiona Mwari akaparidza barika. 230Barika charakanakira ndechokuti unogona kuroora mukadzi benzi, ende roku threaten-a kuti ndaakuenda. Benzi rikayenda rinonoitei? Rega ridii…?” [Congregation says, “riyende.”] Pano kuuraya vana vese? “… [Inaudible 1:52:31] Hee, andimbozvida izvi. Munondibatira stereki. Barika renyu ndariwona. Harishande. Madhimoni, mweya yetsvina. Iwe uri Bherizabhabha wemunhu.” Iwe haikona kutaura. Unozvipedzerei simba? Heh. Pedza, woti, “Wapedza? Saka uri kugarirei naBherizabhabhu?” “Hee, mondibatira nokuti handina kwokuenda…?...” Woti, “Kana usina kwokuenda unotaurisa sei so?” [Congregation laughs—ED] Ha’moona. Womuti, “Chienda.” 231Unongomuona achidzoka zvakanakanaka fani akapfava chaizvo, chaizvo, zviye zvokupfava zviya. Anotanga kuchema ari kughedhi. Zvokuti achisvika mune muchitarisa muri kumba kuya kuti ndiani. Hamumbomuzivi. Anenge Rigiyoni kana akamira ikokoko zvaanenge akaita ikoko. [Congregation laughs—ED] Mweya yetsvina yakamukonzera yamupinda manje, heh. Muchiti, “Ndiani munhu uyu?” Wazoona kamwe kacho kadiki kazoti, “Ah, ndimhamha.” [Apostle and Congregation laugh—ED] “Wati ndimhamha vako avo?” 232Wanzwa, “Ndimhamha. Ndimhamha, daddy, ndimhamha.” Twomhanyira kugedhe iwe. Unotuwona tuchinyatsokukutarisa so kuti, “Haa. [Congregation laughs—ED] Vana mhamha vari pano havana kudii…?” [Congregation says, “havana kudai.”] 233Mwari ane marangiro aanoita. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha’moona. Kunamata brother, it’s not a game. Kunamata it’s a principle. Kunamata it’s a body of life. Kunamata i–there are commandments ende kunamata it’s a life that you ma…you manifest. Hazvigone kuti kunamata kuregere ku manifest-a life saizvozvo, hazvigone, ha’moona. Hatitarisei muone kuva Efeso kuno uku tione. Verse six…eh…verse 1 tese hativerengeyi: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right. Verse 2 hativerengeyi tose: Honour thy father and mother; (which is the first commandment with a promise;) 234Toda Amen akadarika Amen ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi ndiyo commandment yekutanga ine vimbi…? [Congregation says, “ine vimbiso.”] Hationeyi kuti vimbiso yacho ndeyekuti kudii, yakauya—inouya ipapo. Hativerengeyi tese: [Blank spot on tape—ED] … it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth. 235Ndinganzwa Amen here. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndinganzwa Amen akadarika ipapo here. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ngaapfuure ipapo Amen iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kutuka baba zvinoreva mazuva mashoma panyi…? [Congregation says, “panyika.”] Pasina kuiswa mumaoko aSatani kana kuroyiwa uchangokurumidza kufa. Iro Bhaibhiri riri kutaura iro. Kana kurara muChechi kwakangofanana nekusaremekedza baba vachitaura. [Congregation laughs—ED] Unokurumbidza kufa. [Apostle and Congregation laugh—ED] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] [Apostle laughs—ED] 236Ungati baba vachitaura iwe wakavata kudai cha… Makambozviwona kwani? Ndovanhu vanofa muChechi ivavo. Haikona kuvata muKereke yaMwari, handitika hama ehe. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe, svunura maziso ese uchiteerera. Hanzi mazuva ako anowanda. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handei mberi tione pa verse ya 5. Verse 4–verse 4 tese: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord. 237Tingaita Amen here ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen Hallelujah. [Congregation says, “Amen Hallelujah.”] Hanzi kudzai–musaprovhoke [to provoke—ED] vana venyu. Vadei nemwoyo wenyu we…? [Congregation says, “wese,”] wese. Verse 21 ya Colossians chapter 3, muone kuti ndoimwe chete iyoyo. [Blank spot on tape—ED] chapter 3. Tasvika kuna Colossians chapter 3? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tingaita Amen here ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] 238Vamwe vanhu vanokanganisa hakuzi kuti kuda, kKusangoziva Shoko raani…? [Congregation says, “raMwari.”] Right. Handei kuna Colossians chapter 3. Tasvika here tose? Hatiitei Amen tese ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengeyi verse 18 tese. Ah, Colossians chapter 3? Tiripo ipapo? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Verse 18 tese. Verse 18: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord. 239Zvakakodzera muShoko raMwa…? [Congregation says, “raMwari.”] Kureva kuti mudzimai anoteerera murume wake parairo. Anenge achi spearhead-a murume, mukadzi achiteera kumasu…? [Congregation says, “kumasure.”] Handei mberi. Handei tiende pamberi tione. Verse ha–ve–verse 19: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them. 240Tingaita Amen here. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosaka haufaniri kuramba une root of bitterness against your wife. Kana mati maregererana zvaakumusana kwenyu, zvapfuu…? [Congregation says, “zvapfuura.”] Chiraramai hupenyu huri no…? [Congregation says, “normal.”] Don’t be bitter. Uri Mwari ka iwe. But zvanzi varume idai vakadzi venyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vadeyi chai…? [Congregation says, “chaizvo.”] andei tinoona pamberi pacho. Yauya zvakare iya [Blank spot on tape—ED] Hativerengeyi: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord. 241Tingaita Amen here. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handisi kunzwa Amen iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen, Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen, Hallelujah!”] Kana une mubereki anonamata, Shoko rinokusungira kti umuteere…? [Congregation says, “umuteerere.”] Kunze kwemubereki anoti, “Usaende kuchechi. Handei tinorova makuva. Kunwa doro hakuna kuipa. Kuenda kuchechi kwakupusisa.” 242If you have a parent like that, defy him. Tingaita Amen here ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] But kana achikukurudzira kunamata mubereki achiti, “Mashoko aMwari akanaka. Kuenda kuchechi kwakanaka. Uri mwanasikana akanaka. Uri mwanakomana akanaka.” And akavawo mubereki anonamata, muteerere. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinoakanganwa MaGwaro aya. Then isusu vana baba tinotarisirwawo. Handei pa verse rinotevera racho iro. Hativerengeyi verse rinoteera racho: Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged. 243Tingaita Amen here ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handisi kumunzwa Amen iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen, Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen, Hallelujah.”] Ndosaka mumwe nemumwe wedu tinofanira kuti vana vedu tivasimudzire, tivaumbe, tivaitire. Apapa pa…nzi manje apa tisaprovhoke vana vedu, haufaniri kuprovhoka mwana wako nekumumanikidza kuita zvinhu zvisiri izvo. Akakanganisa muudze saba…? [Congregation says, “sababa.”] 244Ende meka shuwa kuti uri kuprovhaidha [to provide—ED] for your children. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kusaprovhaidha for children kunovaprovhoka kuti vakutsamwi…? [Congregation says, “vakutsamwire.”] Handei kuva Korinde vechipiri. VaKorinde vechipiri chapter 12, tasvika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tasvika here tese? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengeyi verse 14 tese. Ndoda verse 14. Tese hativerengeyi tione verse 14, tese: Behold, the third time I am ready to come to you; and I will not be burdensome to you: for I seek not yours, but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children. 245[Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handisi kunzwa Amen ka vanhu vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi vana baba chi–chi–unganidzirai va…? [Congregation says, “vana.”] Ndosaka baba vese vachibva panyika vanofanira kunge vaine kakuunganidza kavanenge vakaita. Handi’muri kupaona vanhu vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mubereki wese anenge ane kakuunganidza kwaakaita kekuti paunobva panyika vana vanosara vakatarisa ipa…? [Congregation says, “ipapo.”] 246Dzingava dzimba, dzingava mota, dzingava mombe, dzingava huku, dzingavaungava musha, ingava minda. Wana something chaunosiira waunganidzira mhuri yaani…? [Congregation says, “yako.”] Mwana ngaaregere kuti ana baba mupenyu aite sekuti inherera yakasiiwa ine three years. Imi ma brother imimi tangai kunamatira izvozvo iye zvino. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] 247Right, ndoda kuti munhu wese ati Amen ipapa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handisi kunzwa Amen iyeye hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Meka shuwa kuti mwana wako haakwangwaye. Ndosaka mukaona vanhu vaMwari, ini ndine pfungwa iyi yekuti munhu wese ari pano anofanira kuti aropafadzwe. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hazvifaniri kuenda nepamwe. Tikadzokera kuBhaibhiri, tinoona kuti Mwari, madaniro anoita Mwari munhu kuuya munyika, eh…kuuya muchechi, haambomudane nekuti ndichakuzadza neMweya Mutsvene. 248Haambomudane nekuti ndichakuregerera zvivi. Mwari anoti kana ukanditevera, ndichakupa zvaunodii…? [Congregation says, “zvaunoda.”] Ende zviri kurehwa izvi ndezvepanya…? [Congregation says, “ndezvepanyama.”] Vanotsvaga zvikwambowo vanenge vaudzwa nechikwambo kuti kana ukandichengeta ndinokupa mari yauri kudii futi iwe…? [Congregation says, “yauri kuda.”] Muri kuona maitikiro azvinenge zvichiitika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] 249Mwari anotidaidza nekuti ndinokuropafadzai. Zvikwambo zvinokudaidzai nekuti munopfumawo. But zvikwambo hazvizokuudzi kuti, “Ukaromba vana vako vachapera, ndichatora vakadzi vako. U–uchavaviga vana ivavo.” Chikwambo hachikutaurire izvozvo. But zvaMwari ukauya uka…ukaropafadzwa naMwari, hu–anoti, “My peace I give unto you.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] 250Ndosaka mutendi wese anodaidzwa naMwari ane right yekuropafa…? [Congregation says, “yekuropafadzwa,”] nekuti Mwari vakakudaidza vachiti huya ndizokuropafa…? [Congregation says, “kukuropafadza.”] Hatitarisei kuna Genesis chapter 12. Ndoda kuti munyatsoo—… [Blank spot on tape—ED] … —chapter 12. Handei kuna Genesis chapter 12 tinyatsoona. Tasvika kuna Genesis chapter 12? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Right. Verse 1. Hatiiti Amen tese. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handisi kumunzwa Amen iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ngaapfuure— [Blank spot on tape—ED] [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengeyi from verse 1 tese, hativerengeyi tese: Now the LORD had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father's house, unto a land that I will shew thee: 251Right, hationei maropafadzo aakavimbiswa paakadaidzwa. Handei pa verse 2: And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing: 252Tingaita Hallelujah here. [Congregation says, “Hallelujah.”] Ndichakuita rudzi ruku…? [Congregation says, “rwukuru.”] Ndichakupa zita gu…? [Congregation says, “guru.”] Ko sei kuma Gentiles kuchidaidzwa vanhu vachiramba dziri shuro? Ndekupi kwamunonzwa kwakambodaidzwa munhu naMwari akaramba ari shuro? Ndokupi? “Inini hazvina mhosva sha–mwanangu. Isu tiri vekutambura mwanangu. Ndezvemumhuri medu zvokutambura.” 253Inhema, baba ivavo havasi kunamata nemayi…? [Congregation says, “nemazvo,”] ende havana kuwana pakanzi naMwari ndakaisa Zita raani…? [Congregation says, “rangu.”] Kana vakapawana havazi kuunza zvipiriso zvavakanzi vadii…?
