entries.text: Iyo ndiyo nhaka yedu iyo. Ndiyo nhaka yedu iyo iya, ndonhaka yedu iyoyo. Takadanwa kuzoropafadzwa saAbrahama, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] saJakobho, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] semaJuta, vana veIsiraeri. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Imi ma Gentiles mauyawo mukunamata, ropafadzwaiwo! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Kwete kungoboira maziso muchechi pasina chinoitika. Heh? Ropafadzo revazhinji kuroorwa kana kuroora. Zvino munozogova… munozogocha mbeva here imomo kana maroorana? Mofanira kuuyawo kuChechi nemotaka? Vana vanoda kuendawo kuchikoro chakana…? [Congregation says, “chakanaka.”] Vanoda kupfekawo hembe dzakana…? [Congregation says, “dzakanaka.”] Vanodawo winter clothing ka varanda vaMwari?

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Imi baba hamufaniri kugara muchirwara-rwara. Eh, regai kuprovhoka [do not provoke—ED] vana venyu nokuda kwekutadza kuvariritira. Regai kuti vashore Message, nekuda kwe behaviour dzevabere…? [Congregation says, “dzevabereki.”] Vachiona mumba muchigochewa mbeva nguva nenguva, muchidyiwa mhandire.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Woenda kuimba yaKombai wosvika kuchifraiwa [to fry—ED] sausage. Vouya kwababa vavo, vanodya nemutetenerwa. Voenda kwaKombai, kune hwayi yechikwambo. Vana vodii ava? Vana vangani vanogona kuita withstand a father ane pfuma yake yemushonga? Anopedzisira aita give in nekuda kwenhamo handiti? Otora zvinhu zvababa zviye zvavakashanda zviya.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: But iwewe, rongera mhuri yako zvinhu zvakanaka. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vana vemunhu kwaye havasari vachibata zvikwambo nekuti havana kwavakazvidzidza. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Havana kwavakazviona zvichidii…? [Apostle and Congregation say, “zvichiitwa.”] Vanosara vachibata vaya; nhamo! Aone anotenga… ari kugara muka one room. Kamubhedha katataura kano dhirikira pakati. Anobikira mugabha, anomwira tea mugaba. Heh? Akati, “Hah!” N’anga ikati, “Tora apo, unozoitawo imba yako, nemunda wako, wonokohwa.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Heh? Vanhu vakaenda divisi rokuchekeresa vana, kuremadza vana; kuti akohwe one tonne. Chikochikari chemadhongi chichienda kudai, vanhu vachiwokera. [Congregation laughs—ED]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: But kune vanoziva Jehovha! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari ha’a kuti ita divisi rekuku—rekutora zvikochikari ten kuita one tonne. Kuuraira vanhu one tonne? Hamuna kuona vanhu vachu-chekeresera vanhu chi hot dhogi chepanze apapapa? Ha’moona zvi hot dog zvamunoona izvi zviya? Vanochekeresaka ipo paya kuti atengerwe masa—masamba iwaya.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Zvinorarira vamwe vakasvunura, Mwari anokupa uvete! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “My peace I give unto…?” [Congregation says, “unto you.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatichinzwai apa. Verse 29 tese, hativerengei verse 29 tese. Verse 29 tose. And Jesus answered and said, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for My sake, and the Gospel's, But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time,

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Hatimirirei ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi, “He will receive what…?” [Congregation says, ‘a hundred fold,’] when…? [Congregation says, ‘now,’] in this what…?” [Congregation says, “time: Amen.”; Apostle Gumbura chuckles—ED] When I saw that Scripture, It excited me so much, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] kuti Jesus actually said it. Kuti, “Hakuna munhu akasiya, hupenyu hwepasi pano, nekuda Kwangu, nekuda kweVhangeri Iri; anofanira kutambira a hundred what…?” [Congregation says, “fold.”] Hanzi, “Panguva ipi…?” [Congregation says, “now/ino; Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndiani vaya vanoda kutinyepera kuti pakunamata kwemu Tu… Testamendi ndezvomweya? Ndozvomweya zvima… Zvanzi, “…houses…” naJeso? Vati houses? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vati wife here futi? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi, “Ukatiziwa ne wife unorisivha chii…?” [Congregation says, “hundred fold.”; Apostle Gumbura chuckles—ED. Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen!”] Toda Amen akadarika Amen hama! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Dzimba unoita hundred kana ukaruza imwe che…? [Congregation says, “imwe chete.”] Mota ukaruza hwani uchaita dzimwe hundre…? [Congregation says, “hundred.”] Ndokunge wairuzira Vhange…? [Congregation says, “Vhangeri; Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Hanzi, “Kana kune akaruza imba, kana kune akaruza mota, kana kune akaruza mukadzi, kana kune akaruza vana, nekuda kweVhangeri, nekuda kweZita Rangu; uchawana times hundred!” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatiite Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Hallelujah!”] Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Hallelujah.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Heh? Murikuona Shoko raMwari, kuti harinyepe? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi, “…you will receive it,” usati wa…? Wafa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kwete kuti, “Ini hangu ndichadya doma—madora. Inini ndiri pasi pano, ndichadya zvangu derere, zvose ndichadya kana nemunyu, nekuda kwaJeso wangu.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: “Ah! Ah! Ah! Ah! Ah! Ah-ah! Iwe! Iwe! Thula wena, thula, thula, thula, thula, thula. [Congregation laughs—ED] Kanti wena uyazi mm, [Congregation laughs—ED] kuti ukhukhuluma? Uri kukhukhuluma ndaba zonhema zoga zoga.” [Congregation and Apostle Gumbura laughs—ED]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Uri kunyepa iwe, handi’moona, eh? Hakuna zvakafanana nayi…? [Congregation says, “naizvozvo.”] Eh. Mwari ukava—uka… Mombe yako chaiyo chaiyo, ukaisacrifaiza [if you sacrifice—ED] kuna Jehovha. Dzinofanira kudzoka dziri ngaani mombe idzi? [Congregation says, “hundred fold.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Masofa ako akaparara achigarwa nevatsvene, anofana kudzoka ava ma sets mangani? [Congregation says, “ hundred fold; Amen.”] “…Let every man be a liar! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] And God’s Word be what…?” [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation say, “true.”; Congregation says, “ Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndosaka isu takati tichipihwa naMwari, takatora ma 504, ma Bluebird. Tikapa vana Andrew. Tikapa vana Marisa motikari idzi, vakadzisakadza, vakadzichembedza. But tinombozviziva kuti kwakaitikei? Did God fulfil His Word? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Takavhura imba yedu yeku Ridgemondi iyo, sabhabha raityisa ku Ridgemondi iro, rikakanyiwa-kanyiwa. Rakanga rine si…Rine kitchen yesimbi, but vanhu vakakwachura simbi, kukwachura kudonhedza ku… nekuwanda. Ha’moona?

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Kuenda vapedza kukwachura simbi dzichidonha. Vaienda pama door acho, vachiita kupara pendi kudaiwo nemaoko avo. [Congregation laughs—ED] Pendi ye green kupera [Apostle Gumbura chuckles—ED] yose. Haah! Handisati ndakamboona zvakadaro. Matoireti ese ma seats aya kutyoka, kukwachuka. Tichiripresa [we replaced—ED] matoireti, kukwachuka. Ma carpets, kubvisa tichiisa mamwe! But Mwari akazoti wopa dzimba idzodzo dzodzoka zvino. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Masadza ese akanga achidyiwa mumba imomo, iye zvino nemuchato yese yatai…yana—yana brother vaya vaiti vachichata nhasi, mangwana vachitiza. Michato yese iya. Ndoma tonne aakudii aya…? [Congregation says, “a’akuuya; Amen.”] Nde’emunana, Jehovha ndeve munana! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Aaamen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Let every man be a lia…? [Congregation says, ‘a liar,'] and God’s Word be ye…?” [Congregation says, “true.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Saka munhu, ha’moona akawuya muno muzonamata orasikirwa kana nechikoro chaicho, God should be able to give you back what is more than educa…? [Congregation says, “education.”] Ukarasikirwa ne husband, God will replace. Ukarasikirwa ne wife, God will replace. Chawarasikirwa nacho uri mukunamata, Mwari vanodzorere…? [Congregation says, “vanodzoreredza.”] Ukarasikirwa nem—nemukadzi, nevana; Mwari achakupa vaka—vakadzi vevana. Ukarasikirwa nemurume, Mwari achakupa mumwe kana uri mukadzi, nevana futi hobho.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Kana wazviitira Vhangeri, “Rejoice in the Lord! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] And again I say re…?” [Congregation says, “rejoice; Amen.”] Brother ndakatenga furniture sebenzi. Imwe mibhedha ndichiisa mumba maVaWagusiwa. Imwe ndichiisa mumba maMarisa, imwe ndichiiisa mumba ma aKatewe, ndichiisa… Kutenga furniture sebenzi! Zvokuti payakapararaka, waichema kufunga kuti handichagona kuriplesa [to replace—ED] imwe. Iye zvino, vanhu handicha… ya… I realise that was no…? [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation say, “nothing.”; Congregation says, “Amen!”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Inini hapana chinhu changu chakandakaisa kubasa raMwari, Mwari chavasina kudzo…? [Congregation says, “kudzosa.”] Vana Brother vatakanamata navo vana Brother Chrispen Dombo, vese vana Brother vaya vaya, vakatibira magumbezi nezvitofu ku Bluffhill. But nhasi vakasvika pamba pangu, zvikwatara-kwatara zvezvinhu izvi, handitomboziva kuti zvakafa zvitofu zvingani, zvinogona kungot—swa tambo mbi… Kungodimurwa tambo negonzo ndasendeka. Ndakunotsvaga chimwe.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Kungotsva hot plate che… zvekuswera ndichinama hot place, ndichiisa madhaka hobho hobho, mukati handina nguva iyoyo. [Congregation laughs—ED] Ndinonobura chinyo…? [Congregation says, “chinyowani.”] A hundred fold! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndofunga ndikanyora pasi zvitofu zvandakatenga panyika pano kana iwewe, unoshokekana [you will be shocked—ED] iwe. Ndaingopinda ndoti, chinyowani, chakutodzoka kumba. Chinyowani, chino—zvitofu mafriji. [refrigerators—ED] Mamwe takapa vakahedhuka vakaenda nawo. Iye zvino havasisina fridge dzakafa idzodzo.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: But ini ndakasara ndichiona dzi…? [Congregation says, “dzimwe.”] “…et every man be a liar!” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosaka Mwari wandinonamata vanhu vaMwari, ndiMwari wemunana. Ukaenda kuMaenga neku Hilltop unozviona. Ukaudzwa history ya 2000, unozviona. Ukaona vana vechikoro vakauya pano vachiqualifaya [qualifying—ED] vari vana vezvikoro, zvavave nhasi, unozviona. Ukaona nyasha dzekufamba, “…Your going out and your coming in,…” unozviona. Ukauya muChechi medu ukaona Mweya urimo, unozviona. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Wudzai vana venyu! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvinhu izvo…? [Congregation says, “izvozvo.”] Vataurirei vana venyu zvinhu izvozvo. Hanzi, “…Panyika pano unowana dzimba, motokari vakadzi, zvose vana, everything.” But after wafa, Hupenyu husingadii…? [Congregation says, “Husingaperi.”] That’s what that Scripture says. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Saka imimi chiendai munoudza vana vako.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Vana vako unenge uchavataurira kuti, “Mwanangu, ndiMwari akatibatsira pana 2000. NdiMwari akatipa Maenga. NdiMwari akatipa Hilltop. NdiMwari aunza shumiro iyoyo yaungana vanhu vaMwari ava. Ukaona mukomana uyo, akauya akadai, akadai, akadai. Iye zvino wava munhu mukuru chaizvo. Akauya asina chinhu ipo paya. Uyu akauya achangopedza chikoro musikana uyu. Akanga akashata kudaiwo, usashamisike nezvaave izvo, aporishiwa neMweya Mutsvene. [Congregation laughs—ED] Uyo anga akadai…”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Unenge uchimuudza history yemunhu wese ari ipa…? [Congregation says, “ari ipapo.”] Tichitaura manana aJehovha! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ende te’tichireva nhema here? Te’chireva chokwadi.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Kuti, “Uri kuona Caro uyo, akuuya ari kasikana kanozwisa tsitsi kanga kapupurirwa naRudo but iye zvino tarirawo atopedza course yake ari pabasa, eh. Uri kuona Lolo uyo, takamutora kuma yard ekurukisheni yeku Mkobha. Ndokwaaishanda but ezvino honai ava nurse uyu, eh. Hona Tanatsirwa uyo, wakanga achinetswa nemadzisekuru ku-kunhingi uku, kumusha uko. Iye zvino vakamuona murungu wavo uyo nhasi uyo. Hona Luckson uyo, akauya, aingogara ari kamupfanha kadiki, nhereraka but tarira zvaaitigwa.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Unenge uchitaura hwani, hwani. Woti, “Ah! Uri kuona mupfanha uyo anonzi Keith uyo. Waipenda tupu—papepa rakaki. Achipenda pama cardboard box mupfanha uyu. Iye zvino, waakurova canvas. Ukuona, ahh Welly uyu, waifamba netsoka uyu, anga ari mukaradhi wekwaChiundura uyo. Achiuya panapa achita te… pa Technical College.” [Congregation laughs—ED] Ahh! Unovapedza vese hwani hwani kudaiwo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: But mugore iroro tichaziva Mwari nekuti tese tinenge taropafadzwa! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] NdiMwari wemina…? [Congregation says, “weminana.”] What happened to a... to your master should happen to every disci…? [Congregation says, “disciple.”] Handi’maona? Saka, zvinotofanira kuitika kwauri. That… ndokunge mwoyo wako waroohwa nekutenda. Ndokunge wajekerwa, ndokunge warega kufurirwa nevanokusejusayi, [those who seduce—ED] nevanoda kukubvisai mu path yechokunamata.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Woramba wakabata nemaoko maviri. Rega kuzunguzwa, rega kubviswa. Follow those Commandments. You heard Abraham, achiropafadzwa. You heard Jacob, achiropafadzwa. You heard Moses, achi- exhorta [exhorting—ED] vana veIziraeri. Then you heard Jesus achitaura zvinhu zvimwe chete. “At the mouth of two or three witnesses, let everything be esta…?” [Congregation says, “established.”] Let everything be taught as a do…? [Congregation says, “doctrine.”] Tingaita Amen here varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: I-Shoko raMwari rechokwadi iri, hapana kana exaggeration. NdoShoko raMwari chairo, chai…? [Congregation says, “chairo.”] Chidzokera unotanga kutaura, “Pandakauya paChechi…” Brother ava, ndozvavanenge vakutaura, Brother Magunde.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: “Unoziva Crysta, ndakauya paChechi ipo paya paya, ndichingori kamupfanha kanobva ku—ku—ku kuMagunje uku. Heh? Ndandakudzwa na step mother. Ndakakura ndichirarama hupenyu hwakaoma fani but tarira zvandakitirwa naMwari. Ndakazobva ipapapa pashumiro [02:37:34.2-inaudible] tiri pasi peshumiro iyoyo tikaenda Botswana. Hah, ndopatakazovaka imba iyo. Ndakatenga mota ikokoko. Ehe, munin’ina wako uyo anga asati azvarwa nguva iyoyoyo. Mwari watinonamata uyo.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Vanenge vachidraivha [they will be driving—ED] Benz yavo, vachiuya havo kuchechi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Heh? Vachiisa nziyo yaJoze. Nezuva iro, ti…

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Dzimba hadzi… dzimbo hadzingoimbwi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvinoitwa nevana vemapenzi izvozvo. [Congregation laughs—ED] Nziyo ngaive ne history handitika eh? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kwete kuti changouya chingoti, “Tindindindi, tindindindi… tindindindi… tindindi… tindi…” [Apostle Gumbura demonstrates and Congregation laughs—ED]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: U—Uri kuita chii? Uri kuti chii? Wakuto… Chakutekenyedza ipapo chii? Hamusati makamboona mapenzi mumabhawa umo. Anongobvinyinguka nezvinhu zvisina nebasa ro…? [Congregation says, “rose.”] Changorira chese chete. [Apostle Gumbura demonstrates the dance moves; Congregation laughs—ED]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: But vana veIsiraeri vaiimba Pisarema pamusoro peBhabhironi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vachirangarira kwavakabviswa naMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Iwewe nyatsorangarira nziyo yako iti, “Ah, takaparidzirwa nziyo iyi takaimbirwa nevana.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Eh. Iye zvino Mwenga unenge wabatana manje, takunyatsoratidza simba reMwenga. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Zvonzi, “Takaimbirwa mwe—nziyo nekamwana kadiki-diki kainzi Tafadzwa, imi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Heh?? Kuti dai Mwenga wabata…?” [Congregation says, “wabatana.”] Eh, inonzi chii nziyo iya hanzii…? [A brother from the Congregation says, “Mwari Batanidzai Mwenga.”] Mwari batanidzai Mwenga, mwoyo yedu yaizofara. Mwari batanidzai Mwenga, chiporofita chaizozadzikiswa.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndakamuvhunza ndikati, “Iwe iwe, ndiani akakucompozera [composed for you—ED] nziyo iyi? Hauna kuudzwa na aChigova here?” Zvikanzi, “VaChigova vakatobvunzawo.” [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation laughs—ED] Ndakangoona ndi Brother Kudzai. Zvikanzi, “Brother Kudzai,” hanzi, “Vakatondivhunzawo kuti, ‘Iwe ma words aya apihwa nani?’”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Patakaabvunza muno, sekuru vake vakafunga kuti ndiani…? Ndi Esther, nekuti Esther ane yake ye fasting yekuti, “Batanidzai Mwenga.” Vakafunga kuti ndiye anyora iyoyo. But chimwana chiya chakanyora che…? [Congregation says, “chega.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ukaona Mweya Mutsvene woenda kuzera riya iri, kureva kuti vana mai vari muno Mweya wapfuura. [Congregation laughs—ED] Wakaedza kupinda munana mai vakawanda, ukaona kuti, “Ah-ah, hamuna …?…” Ndobva waenda pawakanozorora zvawo, Mweya wacho uya. But ukaiona nziyo yacho haina zera nemwana uya. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Iya nziyo ndeye Mweya Mutsvene iya! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Aaamen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] I rebuke kune vasinganamate Mwari muMweya nemui…? [Congregation says, “nemuzvokwadi.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndosaka isusu manje ngatichikumbirai ropafadzo iri. Toda ropafadzo. Chinangwa chatirikudira ropafadzo nechekuti, “Baba, ndiro simba ratinoita pamusoro pevana vedu.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Mwana anenge achirwirawo kuti asiirwe imba, asiirwe business, asiirwe motokari, nekudaro anoteerera zvaanoudzwa nababa vaani…? [Congregation say, “vake,”] vake. Anenge achiona baba vake kuti vakagona, hupenyu hwavo achikompeya [comparing—ED] vamwe vana baba vemapenzi uko, oona kuti aah! Vake vakagona kumuwanira chikoro. Vakagona kumudyi—kumupfekedza. Vakagona kumupa chekudya.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Saka at least anoteere…? [Congregation says, “anoteerera,”] anoteerera. Saka unogona kuchimuudza kuti, “Mwanangu chiita zvakati. Chiita zvakati.” Saka tiri kuti Mwari chinjai status, kuitira kuti patinokudza vana vedu, vawane chatinovanongedzera! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vawane chekutaura! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vawane chekutarisa! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ende unenge waakuvaudza history yechinhu chimwe nechimwe chawakaitirwa naMwa…? [Congregation says, “naMwari.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Hatichipedzai naipapo. Handei kuna Deuteronomy, … Deuteronomy chapter 4. Handei kuna Deuteronomy chapter 4. Tasvika hedu kuna Deuteronomy chapter 4. Wonderful Scripture. Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Deuteronomy chapter 4. Hatitangei kuverenga hedu pa verse ya… Right. Verse 9. Muri kuona kuti vanga vari pa most [02:41:51.5-inaudible] obedience. Handei pa verse 9, muone, zvatinofanira kuita isusu vape—vabereki tese. Tingaita Amen here ipapo? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengei verse 9 tese. Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently, lest thou forget the things which thine eyes have seen, and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life: but teach them thy sons, and thy sons' sons;

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handisi kunzwa Amen iyeye? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ngaapfuure ipapa Amen iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi, “Haikonai kukanganwa zvamunenge maitirwa naMwa…? [Congregation says, “naMwari.”] Zvidzidzisei vana vaani…? [Congregation says, “venyu/ vevana.”] Vagodzidzisawo vana vaani…? [Congregation says, “vako.”] Murikupaona here varanda vaMwari handiti?

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Mwari aida kuti kana iwewe ukange wasimudzwa, iwe…Mwari akatikudanai mese panapa ma brothers. Arikuda kutokusimudzai zvamusingambofe makaimajena. [to imagine—ED] Inini ndiri kuzviona pachangu kuti, Mwari did that. I wasn’t aware of it when it was happening but that’s what God was doing. Saka iwewe rega kuneta manje nekuti wanonoka kuropafadzwa. But wedzera manamatiro aani…? [Congregation says, “ako.”] Tendeuka nezvaunongofunga zvese kuti hazvisakarurama. “…We die what…?” [Congregation says, “daily.”] Kusvika Mwari vakuropafadza.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Kana Mwari vakakuropafadza une chekudzokera kuvana vako nacho. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Unovasiyira panyika, a good name, nhaka yakana…? [Congregation says, “yakanaka.”] A good background. But vana baba vakaramba kunamata, havana chavakasiyira vana vavo. Vana vakasara vozviumbira pfuma dzavo voga. Vana baba vakatozodzoka votora kubva kuva…? [Congregation says, “kuvana.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Hativerengei verse 10 tione. Handei pa verse 10 tese, hative… Specially the day that thou stoodest before the LORD thy God in Horeb, when the LORD said unto me, Gather me the people together, and I will make them hear My words, that they may learn to fear Me all the days that they shall live upon the earth, and that they may teach their children.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen handisi kumunzwa iyeye? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hama ngadzigare dzakaudza vana pamusoro pekubva paChechi, tichitanga kudzokera panyaya ya October 2…?[Congregation says, “2 000.”] Tozobva toratidza ma officer mamwe nemamwe ekubva kwaanoita paChechi. Dzidzisa vana vako. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kuuraya kwazvinoita vanhu. Vakabva vanhu ma officers paya, takaviga vana Mhare, [Apostle Gumbura claps hands once—ED] vana Bonde, [Apostle Gumbura claps hands once—ED] vana Machaya, [Apostle Gumbura claps hands once—ED] vana Samuel, [Apostle Gumbura claps hands once—ED] vana—v—vana Ebenezer. [Apostle Gumbura claps hands once—ED] The list is e…? [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation say, “endless.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Vamwe zva’azvirema. Vari muma wheel chair. Nyaya haizi yokutamba nayo iyi. Dzidzisa vana vako nokuti uchazomuchema mwana iyeye aakufa nemukondombera. Uchazomuchema mwana iyeye achembedzwa nenyi…? [Congregation says, “nenyika.”] Muchazoita chi—murume wekutsvaga nekudyisa, pasina achada mwana wako, achembera. “Vane nzeve dzekunzwa ngavanzwe!” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen angabude here muchipfuva chevatendi? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Unofana kudzokera kuvana vako uvadzidzise. Uchaona mwana wako aroorwa nechimunhu chisingamboite, chinoputa fodya, chinonwa doro. Umwe anoroorwa ne rasta.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Woti, “Ko chii ko nhai mwanangu? Ko chii nhai mwanangu handiti?” Achararama hupenyu hunonzwisa [Apostle Gumbura claps hands once—ED] tsitsi because hauna kumuraira. Hapana hupenyu hunobuda kumunhu asingazive Je…? [Congregation says, “Jeso.”] Ha’maona? Munhu wese asingazive Jeso, hupenyu hwenyu hunotozongova hunonyadzisa chete.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Murikuona? Kuti muone zvandiri kutaura, endai kumusha kwenyu, mugoona kuti vari outstanding vangani? Vamunenge muchiti vapfumi kumusha kwenyu, imombe kana four or five or ten mudanga. Imo muno muMkoba tarira uone zvayakaita yose rakasha. Kuramba kunamata uko! Kunamata ku Salvation Army neku Baptist.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Saka you live an average li…? [Congregation says, “life.”] Yekusustainwa [of being sustained by—ED] nehurumende. Kupihwa ma implements, kupihwa fetiraiza [fertilizer—ED] kupihwa mbeu nehurumende. Ku scai—kuita scratch a living. Struggle to send children through to schoo...? [Congregation says, “school.”] But Mwari akati, “Kwete kana mauya Kwandiri hazvidaro!” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Hapana, munhu mutema ari pano asina kudzidza nehutsava-tsava. Handi’tozviziva tese? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hupenyu hwedu hwanga hwakao…? [Congregation says, “hwakaoma.”] But mumusha mairohwa maku…? [Congregation says, “makuva.”] Midzimu yaidii…? Kun’anga kwaidii…? [Congregation says, “kwaiendwa.”] The best that witch doctors, ancestral worship could give in your family, is the life you grew up in. That’s the best that they could offer. Hupenyu hwawakakura mahuri iwewe, ndohunopuhwa nemudzimu yekumusha kwenyu.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Hupenyu hwawaakurarama iye zvino uhwu, hausisiri hwemudzimu uhwu. Mwari akati, “Ndinozarura window redenga...” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika Amen ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Isu takakura hupenyu hwekudya sadza ne-ne-nedoro. Kudya sadza nedoro, kudya sadza nemaheu, kudya sadza ne… ne-nenzungu. Kudya sadza ne [02:46:47.7-inaudible] 444Waimuka mumba mune katsi, mune nyoka, hah-hah! Tairarama hupenyu hwenhamo. Waikura uri chikomana chikuru-kuru zvokuti unenge waakutoziva kuti vakadzi vakanditarisa, but miviri yese iri panze iyi. [Congregation laughs—ED] Magaro ese ari panze aya, wo-uchimhanya uchidaidza, uchinodzora mombe. Ah, m-magaro ese ari panze va—vana mai vemusha [Apostle Gumbura claps hands once—ED] vanongotarisa kuti, “Ahh!” [Apostle Gumbura claps hands once—ED] Nekuti anenge atofoma asimba, magaro aya. [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation laugh—ED] Hazvichaita kuti agare ari pa…? [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation laugh. Apostle Gumbura demonstrates—ED] Kau-kau-kau-kau, uchinodzora mombe.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Aaah! Nhasi maakuda kuona so… Hupenyu hwatino uhwu, hupenyu hwatinahwo inyasha dzaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ta’akukwanisa kupfekedza vana vedu matarauzi, hah-hah. Kuendesa vana nekuchikoro, hatizvizivi isu, ha’moona. Isu takakura tichingokwira mumiti, kubva kuchikoro masikati ta’a kuHarare. Kuzadza dumbu nemabrosi. [mulberries—ED; Congregation laughs—ED] Aah! Kurova dumbu nemabrosi [mulberries—ED] womu-wopinda mu kitchen, wonotora girazi rako remvura, dhegu! Womhaya kutoireti, [Congregation laughs—ED] torieti yese yoita purple, yese toireti yese purple. [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation laugh—ED]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Haaah! Vazhinji venyu ndofunga hamuzvizive, kuda hamuna kumboita zvakadaro. But Mwari kana akudana, ukamuziva Mwari, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] unomunamata nemwoyo unoda hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndohupenyu hwatakura isu. Zvaingova, zvigamba. Hapana Christmas yataitamba nechinhu chinyowani. Ha’maona? Ndotorangarira Christmas yandakasekwa neraini rose! Ndatengerwa short, trousers ya businessman. [Congregation laughs—ED] Yanga yakapfekwa, [02:48:27-inaudible] ndobva yarova kusvika kunoku ahh! [02:48:34-inaudible] Ini ndaingonzwa kuti ndakadema ipapo. [Congregation laughs—ED] Ndomidzimu zvainoita izvozvo. Eh.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: But Mwari iye zvino nenyasha dzake. Handi’moona? Hanzi, “Dzidzisai vana venyu!” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Aaamen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vana ngavaone kuti hupenyu hwata’a kurarama hwa’a hwenya…? [Congregation says, “hwenyasha,”] hwenyasha.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Nguva iyoyo, tiri kuTsungai pa Pri… Tsungai Primary School apa, taive nestaira yekuti kana wakapfeka uniform, then waitora trousers woridai. [Apostle Gumbura demonstrates—ED] Moziva zvaiitwa zviya? Kaive kastaira. Ka trouser kuti mudenga taa! [Congregation laughs—ED] Zvino ndanga ndakadaro manje pachikoro kudaiwo. Ah, inda ndobva yafamba manje pa [02:49:11-inaudible] [Congregation laughs—ED] Ndopaunozoona kuti kune chinonzi nyasha. Ahh! Imi vanhu hamuna chamakaponeswa kwachiri. Ndosaka muchibata Jehovha neminwe handitika?

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Kana mamuziva Jehovha unomuda nemwoyo wese! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Unomunamata. Ndopandakaona kuti haaah, ini Mwari vakandiitira nyasha. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mufaro wandinawo ndewaJeso! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Aaamen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Unenge uchiona dza’a nyasha dzaMwari manje idzi. Ndohupenyu hwatakazopa vana vedu. Handina kuzoda kuona vana vangu vachitambura futi.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndakati, “Aihwa. Ndoda kuti vana vangu vakure vaine zvinhu zvo…? [Congregation says, “zvose,”] zvose.” Because I knew how I grew up. Taisekwa kuchikoro. [Apostle Gumbura claps hands once—ED] Tainyara kuunza ma friends kumba. [Apostle Gumbura claps hands once—ED] We lived a hard life. Apa mudzimu taidii…? Toenda kumusha midzimu wobuda togezeswa nemidzimu. Bha! Bha! Tichisvipirwa mvura. Topuhwa ma five cents ekuisa muho… muhomwe ye good raki but kurohwa ikoko. [Congregation laughs—ED]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ahh! Haaah! Mwari ane nyasha. Ndopandakati iye zvino, ayehwa regai tive vaparidzi veVhangeri! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvose zvatiri nhasi, inini zvose zvandiri nhasi, zvakauya nekuda kwekuziva aani…? [Congregation says, “Mwari.”] Ndosaka, ndoda kuti, “Esther ziva zvimwe chete izvozvo. Munesu, ziva zvimwe chete izvozvo. Tito! Ziva zvimwe che… Jemima…”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Then ndogara pasi nevakadzi vangu, “Vakadzi vangu, do you really realise the grace of God. I know how hard it wa… They are many times when my father wanted to commit suicide, nekutadza kuita provide for u…? [Congregation says, “for us,”] for us. He couldn’t provide for us. He would want to kill himself. Ha’moona.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Tikapotsa tapondwa taenda kunokwereta mari kuna babamunini vedu, yekunyora ma O ’level exams yashaikwa. [Apostle Gumbura claps hands once—ED] Mm? But tazova munyasha manje, ndozvinhu zvaunofanira kuraira vana vako. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kuti, “Munorara makaguta vanangu inyasha dzaani…? [Congregation says, “dzaMwari.”] Hamuende kuchipatara, hamubaiwe majekiseni, hamunwe mapiritsi, hamurware-rware; inyasha dzaani…? [Congregation says, “dzaMwari.”] Honai mapfekero amunoita? Honai kurasa kwamunoita chingwa? Honai kurasa kwamunoita manhuchu?454 I never grew up ndichiziva zvinhu zvakadai. Izvi ndakazviitirwa nenyasha dzaani…?” [Congregation says, “dzaMwari.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Wudzai vana venyu! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Aaamen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi, “Vadzidzisei zuva rimwe nerimwe.” Handei kuna Deuteronomy chapter 6 muone. Tasvika here kuna Deuteronomy chapter 6? Verse 5, handei pa verse 5 tese. Hativerengei verse 5 tese. And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Handei mberi. And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thine heart:

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Verse 7. And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and thou shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up. And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thine hand, and they shall be as frontlets between thine eyes. And thou shalt write them upon the posts of thy house, and on thy gates.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika Amen hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ma brothers ese ane duty rekudzidzisa vana vavo, kukosha kwe Messa…? [Congregation says, “kwe Message.”] Ha’murikuona varanda vaMwari? Then kana wadaro saizvozvo, wagona kuchidaro manje, ukavadzidzisa Shoko raMwari anorebella [whoever rebels—ED] ya’a mhosva yaani…? [Congregation says, “yake.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Genesis chapter 48, tichipedza naipapo. Genesis 48. Chapter yedu iya. Tasvika? Verse 19, hativerengei [02:53:19-inaudible] tese. Hativerengei verse 19 tese. And his father…

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Verse 19 hativerengei. And his father refused, and said, I know it, my son, I know it: he also shall become a people, and he also shall be great: but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations. And he blessed them that day…

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Murikupaona apo? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] … saying, In thee shall Israel bless, saying, God make thee as Ephraim and as Manasseh: and he set Ephraim before Manasseh.

entries.text: [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tingaita Amen here varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Akatora second born akaiita da…? [Congregation says, “dangwe.”] The right of a father. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosaka baba manje, vanofanira kuropafadzwa. Kana varopafadzwa, vowana chavanonongedzera vana vavo kuti tarisai kwaka…? [Congregation says, “kwakati,”] kwakati. Matarisa kwakati ikoko, wa’a kufa, unopa vana vako sokupa kwawakaitwa iwewe naMwa…? [Congregation says, “naMwari.”] Mwari anokuvimba kuti sezvo wanga uri mwana wangu, wanga uchindiraramira, chironga vana vako zvaunoda iwewe. Wotanga kuronga vana vako, marongero aunodii…? [Congregation says, “aunoda.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndosaka vana baba vese vari muno, vari mu Message, Right iyi, iri mumaoko ako iye zvino. You can choose to exercise it or lose it comple…? [Congregation says, “completely,”] nekubuda mu Message. Ukabuda mu Message, this right you lose it. Unotozochengetwa nevana. Kuzofira pavana. Kunzwisa tsitsi. Ende vana havana chaunosi—chaunovasiira. Ende havana chavanoda kubva kwauri. Iwe ndiwe unenge uchida zvinhu zvavo. Ndozvichaitika.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: But kana ukada iwewe unovasetera [to set—ED] path, “Footprints on the sands of…?” [Congregation says, “of time.”] Vana vako vachatevera mutsoka dzaani…? [Congregation says, “dzako.”] Hanzi, “Vane nzeve dzekunzwa ngavanzwe! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ngavanzwe zvinotaura chii…? [Congregation says, ‘Mweya.’] Mweya kupiko?” [Congregation says, “kuKereke.”]

entries.text: Ndosaka takadanwa kuti tive tinoita dzimba, magonyeti, mabhazi, minda, mombe, makombi, zvigayo, ma supermarket. Takanzi tiite zvinhu zvese i…? [Congregation says, “izvozvo.”] Wa’akufa, woronga vana vako muzvinhu izvo…? [Congregation says, “izvozvo.”] Ende kana uri a …?... a man of integrity, vanosara vachiropafadzwa iwe wanguri waye…? [Congregation says, “wayenda.”] Tingaita Ameni here ipapa? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Ameni akadarika ipapo hama? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ameni, Hallelujah!! [Congregation says, “Amen, Hallelujah!!”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: But vese vanoramba imhosva dzaani…? [Congregation says, “dzavo.”] dzavo. NdoChokwadi chaMwari ichi. Teerera vabereki. Ita zvakati, zvakati... Ndozvazvinenge zvichireva izvi. Handi’moona?

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndosaka mukaona, achibva ipapa Jacob, akanoropafadza mhuri yake yo…? [Congregation says, “yose.”] yose. He blessed his whole family. Tarisai muone pane chapter inotevera iyi. To…Unongoona… Hatiende pa verse 21. Verse 21. Tese. Hativerenge verse 21, tese : And Israel said unto the…

[Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengeyi tese muone verse 21: And Israel said unto Joseph, Behold, I die: but God shall be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers. Muri kuzviona? Hatidzokororeyi. Verse 21, hatidzokororeyi: And Israel said unto Joseph, Behold, I die: but God shall be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Muri kuona kuti audzwa kunzi, “Uchaenda kunyika yemadzibaba ako? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Uchavigwa iko…?” [Congregation says, “ikoko.”] A’akufa Jakobho akati, “Mekayi shuwa kuti mabonzo angu kana makubuda muno munoataku…?” [Congregation says, “munoatakura.”] Akanga akudzwa nani izvozvo? entries.text: Vana vasina basa nana baba ndeve mazuva ano. Vanofunga kuti vanongoita raki [lucky—ED] mutaundi. Anongopinda pinda muma office. Achingopinda pinda muma office, nemuma fri [flea—ED] market, nemuma fri [flea—ED] market. Ongobuda mangwana aane zvinhu. Hede! It doesn’t happen that…? [Congregation says, “that way.”] Vanopa ndiani? entries.text: [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndakupa zvinodarika vamwe vako vese! Because chidhara chaive nezvinhuka ichi? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Murume ndimambo uyu. But hanzi, “I have given you, one portion above your bre…? [Congregation says, “brethren.”] Kureva kuti ma brother kana anga ane ten, iye anga ane ele…? [Congregation says, “eleven.”] Ha ha ha. entries.text: Kana Mwari ada munhu, baba vakada munhu, Ja… Josefa akangodiwa nababa vake kubva ari mudiki. Yakava type yokuti, Mwari ndokudawo kwaakaitawo Josefa iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Akava mwana wemuhudhara hwake, akamufarira.

entries.text: Ndosaka isusu tese panapa, tine right yekuti tiise vana vedu mu—mumu—mumaonero atinenge tinawo. entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: Now, look what am using as an example, just because we are poor. I use myself as an example. But do you know, in normal standards, hapana zvandati ndamboita. entries.text: Ndosaka patiri kunamatira change of status, you will be surprised kuti, neniwowo! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndiri kuda a hundredfold Jehovha! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kunze kwezvandinazvo iye zvi…? [Congregation says, “iye zvino.”] Whether ndikaita vana fifty, ndoda kukwanisa kuvagovera mumwe nemumwe chaani…? [Congregation says, “chake.”] Mumwe nemumwe ndiwane nhaka yandinomudii…? [Congregation says, “yandinomusiira.”]

entries.text: Manje here is a surprise. Ndoda kusiira Chechi zvinhu futi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! entries.text: Unenge uchipinda kana muhoro yandinenge ndakavaka yeku donator kuChechi chete chete. Yekungoti, “Hall ino yakavakwa na Apostle for us to use.” Mwana wako iwewe, kana muzukuru wako ozochatira ikoko. Hah.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 1)
entries.text: You remember ndichikuparidzirai kuti tarirai zvakanga zvakaita vanhu vaiwana mari. Vaienda vonovaka inonzi, John Mark Hall. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndakakuparidzirai izvozvo kudhara, imi mokanganwa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] But ini I don’t forget. Ndoda kusiya chikoro. Ndoda kusiya chipatara. Ndoda kusiya something! Or orphanage. I must leave something, “Footprints on the sands of time.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

(Then sings my soul) Then sings my soul, my Saviour God to Thee; (How great Thou art) How great Thou art, (How great Thou art) how great Thou art! (Then sings my soul) Then sings my soul, my Saviour God to Thee; (How great Thou art) How great Thou art, … A Father’s Right 10-0626E This Message by Apostle Robert Martin Gumbura was delivered on Saturday evening, June 26, 2010, at Mkoba 17 Church, Gweru, Zimbabwe. This sermon, number 10-0626E, is Three hours, Twenty-eight minutes and sixteen seconds. entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda Mwari zvakare nemumwe mukana. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mukana wokuti utsvake nyasha pamberi paMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mukana wokuti kana usina kunzwika nezuro, nhasi unzwike pamberi paMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Pano ndoMwari panoda kuti mu Gentile anamate. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari akati, “Budai muma kere...? [Congregation says, ‘muma kereke.’] Bhabhironi radii...?” [Congregation says, “rawa.”] Tiendepi? Tiendepi? Havana kutiudza pekuenda kunze kwe Spoken Word chete. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndosaka hama zhinji dzakabuda pa Chechi panapa dzikaenda dzikanotsvaga dzimwe church dze Message dzemu-dzemu Harare. Ndobva vanomuwana ikoko? [Congregation says, “ah-ah/kwete.”] Vakatoona kuti pano pavakabva vachiramba kudya tsuro nenguruve, vachiita nharo dzekuti toda kudya tsuro nenguruve, zvaive nani pane zvavakazonosangana nani...? [Congregation says, “nazvo.”] Hanzi, “Vane nzeve dzekunzwa ngavadii...? [Congregation says, ‘ngavanzwe,’] zvinotaura chii...?” [Congregation says, “Mweya.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Vamwe vakatiza barika pano, vakasvika kuno paridzirwa nevafundisi vakanga vaine ma girlfriends emuma Avenues, sixteen. Hm. Iye kwakuzotaura oga kuti, “Havazi sixteen, ini ndinoziva seventeen.” Handi’munoona zvaakanga achitaura iye ari oga? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndokuenda kuno porofitirwa nevanhu vakanga vaine ma girlfriends hobho. Ndokuenda kunodzidziswa nema teacher akanga aine ma girlfriends e secret, asi vabva pano vachitiza ba...? [Congregation says, “barika.”] Dzidza paku beha-vha [to behave—ED] kwemapenzi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ngatizvibatei mukati meShoko raMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Pano patakauya panaapa ndipo patinogona ku achiever zvirongwa zvatinazvo zvo...? [Congregation says, “zvose.”] Ukauya panaapa nehunyengeri, “Hasha dzaMwari dziri pamusoro pavose vanobata zvokwadi yake mukudii...? [Congregation says, ‘mukusarurama,’] mukusarurama.” Hatikuzive, hatikunongedzere, tinongokuparidzira. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Asi iwe mwoyo wako unoudii...? [Congregation says, “unouziva.”] Dai zuva ranhasi ratawana mumwe mukana iri, rava zuva raunoenzana naMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Enzanisa hupenyu hwako nani...? [Congregation says, “naMwari/Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Iti, “Baba ndiri boka riya revaya vanoshoropodza, ndiri boka reuya asingatende, ndiri boka reuya anouya mu Church kuzotapa, ndiri boka reuya anouya mu Church kuzoshora. Asi zuva rimwe nerimwe randinobva mu Church imomo, Mweya waMwari unenge wandipomera mhosva. [Congregation says, ‘Amen.’] Zviri zvanhasi, gadziranai neni Jehovah. [Congregation says, ‘Amen.’] Ndoda kubuda muno ndiri mwana wenyu chai...? [Congregation says, ‘chaiye.’] Zvinobva pamwo...? [Congregation says, ‘pamwoyo,’] ndichiti ndava waKristu.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Hanzi zvinobva payi...? [Congregation says, “pamwoyo.”] Ehe, ndichiti ndava waani...? [Congregation says, “waKristu.”] Waakufamba, “Holy, holy to the Lord, God Al...?” [Congregation says, “Almighty.”] Manheru ano iti Mwari ndipeiwo Mweya Mutsvene. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari ndoda double portion manheru ano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari ndoda nyasha dzebasa idzva. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari ndoda nyasha dzekuno deliver. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari ndoda nyasha dzekukunda hurwere. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari ndoda nyasha dzekuti ndive nembereko. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Mwari ndoda nyasha dzekuti ndinyatsoziva kuti ndiri panzvimbo yakaiswa Zita naMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Panzvimbo chii...? [Congregation says, “tsvene,”] tsvene, yakanzi naMwari mukauya ipapo ndinokuitirai zvamunoda zve...? [Congregation says, “zvese.”] Ichocho chauri kuda ichocho, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] panzvimbo tsvene Mwari vakati ndinosangana nani...? [Congregation says, “newe.”] Hatisimukei manheru anhasi. ([Blank spot on tape—ED] …ni ndoda), ndoda, (ndoda), ndoda, Ndoda Mwari Muyamuri (Baba) Muri wangu, Ndakatengwa (Ini) neRopa raIshe, (Hona) Ndava (va) wenyu chose.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Hatipindei mukuteura tose. [Congregation enters into Pentecostal Prayer] ...am happy…[Song leader sings inaudibly—ED] (At the cross) At the cross, at the cross Where I first saw the light, And the burden of my heart rolled away, (Rolled away) It was there by faith I received my sight, And now I am happy all the day! (At the cross) At the cross, at the cross Where I first saw the light, (Oh) And the burden of my heart rolled away, (Rolled away) It was there by faith, (Oh) I received my sight, And now I am happy all the day! (Oh, at the cross) At the cross, at the cross (Oh) Where I first saw the light, (Oh) And the burden of my heart rolled away, (Rolled away) It was there by faith, (Oh) I received my sight, (Oh) And now I am happy all the day!

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Baba wedu tinokutendai. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari vaAbrahama, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] Mwari vaJakobho, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] Mwari vaDhavhidha. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba, Mwari webarika, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] God of polygamy, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] Mdimo wasitembo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba tinokutendai nenyasha dzenyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda nekuimbirwa, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] tinotenda ne worship, Baba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda neShoko razuro, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] tinotenda nenyasha dzekufamba kuva pano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Mwari tinokukudzai manheru ano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba tinotenda kuva panzvimbo tsvene, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] kuva panzvimbo yamakaisa Zita renyu, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] kuva panzvimbo yamunosangana nemutadzi, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] kuva panzvimbo yamunodaira muteuro yose. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nekudaro Baba, vese vakazvitakura ngavabatsirwe nenyasha. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vanonoka Baba, ngavasunungurwe, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] muZita raJeso. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Vari kunetseka nemitoro mumisoro yavo, poresai Baba wakarurama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tenzi makanaka tatarisa kwamuri musimboti wedu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tenzi makanaka chitiitirai nyasha. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Pakuguma kwekushumaira kwezuva ranhasi, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] toda kufamba nenyasha. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tichidzokera kwatabva, tiruramisei, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] titungamirirei, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] tibatsirei Baba, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] tinzvenge tsaona. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Mwari makanaka tinoisa Jehovah wakarurama vese vasara kudzimba. Tichinoyanana navo, ngativasimudzireiwo, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] tive mumweya mumwe chete, Baba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tiri kunyengeterera August yedu pindirai, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] tiri kunyengeterera gore resanduko. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinoziva kuti zvinoitika. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mabasa anowanikwa, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] hapana baren womb mu Isiraeri, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] status inochinja, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] tinokunda vavengi, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] tichawana pekuvaka, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] tichavaka Jerusarema, Home of the Bride. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Baba makati, “Munozarura hwindo redenga kusvika tinoshaya pokuisa maropafadzo.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chivai nevatsvene vari Britain ne Amereka. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chivai Baba wakanaka navo kugadzirira kwavanoita August. August tiitirei nyasha. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chiuyai mumba muno Baba wakanaka mubate mumwe nemumwe. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Vayenzi Baba, vanobata zvokwadi iyi nepfungwa, Baba, vari papfungwa yekudzokera kumasure, tishandei tose, Baba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda kubuda muno tabatikana. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda kubuda muno takunda makuhwa, takunda zvitaurwa taurwa, takunda zvinyeyewa nyeyewa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari ndinokutendai Jehovah wangu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chipindai mumharidzo yamasikati ano, Baba tigobuda munomu mwoyo yedu yakasimudzirwa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Tinotenda negohwo, Jehovah. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tatarisa kurima kwegore rino. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda nehutano, kuchengeta kwamunoita vana vedu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba tinotenda nechokufuka nechokudya. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda nepekugara nechekufambisa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda nemweya wakanaka. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kudzwai namatwai nekusingapere, taikumbira izvi nokutenda, muZita raTenzi Jeso Kristu, Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Tigare hedu tese pasi.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Tinokwazisana tose muZita raTenzi Jeso Kristu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mufaro wedu chaiwo kuva mukati meimba yaMwari nemusi we Sunday kudai. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Saka... Mufaro wedu chaiwo kuva muimba yaMwari pazuva ranhasi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. Totenda Mwari chaizvo, tawana ma service akanaka chaizvo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] I think this is the best service in Zimbabwe today. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] As far as praise and wor...? [Congregation says, “worship,”] worship is concerned. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: I don’t think you could go anywhere and get any-any better. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda Mwari chai...? [Congregation says, “chaizvo,”] chaizvo. It was a wonderful service of praise, wonderful service of worship. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tarumbidza Mwari, tatenda Mwari. Munomu ndofunga kunyangwe vasingagoni kutamba vachadzidzira. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Unotozongowanawo mazunguziro aunozviitawo, [Congregation laughs—ED] kana wanga uri munhu uya ari stiff, handitika. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Unodzimara ukawana mazunguziro aunozviitawo. Inzira yekutenda ani...? [Congregation says, “Mwari,”] Mwari, handi’moona. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vazhinji vedu tinofunga kuti aah, maybe kutambira Mwari hayi-hatifaniri—No. In the house of the Lord... Vanhu vanoenda kubhawa kunokanganwa nhamo dzavo, kunoenda mumatondo kunoputa mbanje, kukanganwa nhamo dzavo.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: But munhu anopinda mu Church akasuwa. Agoimba, agoparidzirwa akasuwa kusvika abuda akangodaro. Kokutenda kwako kuripi? Zvokwadi vanhu vakaisa kutenda mudoro vava nani kune vakaisa kutenda muna Mwari? Ndosaka kana uchiuya pano nedambudziko, huya ufare. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Wasiya kumba kusina kumira zvakadii...? [Congregation says, “zvakanaka.”] Ehe, huya ufare muimba yaani...? [Congregation says, “yaMwari,”] yaMwari. Nekuti pauno dzokera kumba kunenge kwanaka. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] It’s a promise. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Hanzi ukarumbidza Mwari, paunodzokera kumba ikoko kunenge kwanaka. Nekuti pauri kurumbidza paya paya, nziyo dziya dziya, dzese chiporofita. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mufaro watinawo ndehwa Je...? [Congregation says, “ndehwa Jeso.”] Unozosvika mufaro iwoyo wagadzirwa, wavawo kumba kwakowo futi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen, handi’moona, ehe. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kana usinganzwe zvakanaka... Imagine yesterday, I came here, I was half dead with tiredness. I’ve been tired now for almost about two to three weeks. But kana Mwari vapindira munyaya. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndaitova nepfungwa dzokuti aah, takatozvi discusser kumba ndikati akomana ma service aya eku Gweru aya tombofanira kuenda but ndendiripo hangu, ndombogara ndichinzwa vamwe vachidii...? Vachiparidza. Nokuti unenge wakunzwa kuti nyama dzaakudaira, ha’moona. But wangomira apo, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ayihwa, inenge yaimwe nyaya. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ukangomira ipapo unoita fanika, unozonzwa-uno—Imagine, ndopaunoona kuti i anointing. Unopedza kuparidza woto feeler pressure, than zvawanzwa uchita...? [Congregation says, “uchitanga.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Wotoenda mu office umu, kukurukura kukanganwa. Paunosvika kumba manje, zvobva zvakudhonora. Annointing inenge yakudii manje...? [Congregation says, “yadzikama/yakusiya.”] [Apostle chuckles—ED] Wobva wachizvambarara manje. Like yesterday, I don’t even remember what I dreamt. Ndarara sendakafa. “How sweet and good is the sleep of a labouring man.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndafarira kupinda mumachira kudaiwo, kufa. [Apostle claps once—ED] Ndamuka na exactly six thirty-nine. Dzanga dza twenty-one minutes to seven, ndopandapepuka. Kubva ndichinorara, handi’moona. Unongoenda uchibva wangofira ipapo kamwe chete.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Haurote, haurumwe ne mosquito, hauitwe sei, haumharwe nenzunzi, hauzvizivi. [Congregation laughs—ED] Nda’ndakafa zvekuti dhuu. Zvokuti nda’ndichifunga kuti ah kuseni unomuka usingambogoni, ah. “They that wait upon the Lord…” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Totenda Mwari chaizvo nenyasha dzavo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] It’s a service that when... ukaipedza, handitika, aah unenge watogomera, nekuti inenge ichinakidza.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Zvandotaura ndikati ah, kana ndichiuya kuno kuGweru ne benz yangu, handimbofari because journey yacho inondiitira chii...? Pfupi. [Congregation laughs—ED] Mota inenge ichinakidza zvisingaiti, zvekuti by the time I get here nde’ndakutoti ah manje vakomana, heh. Manje ini nda-dai nda’chienda kuBhuruwayo.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: [Congregation laughs] Chinenge chichifamba kuti... [Apostle imitates the sound his car makes—ED] Chinonakidza mu road umu zvokuti unosvika uri-u-usinga-ha—unenge wangogarawo wakazvinetera but iyo haina chainowedzera pakuneta. Inonakidza zvekuti dhuu. Saka ndo complain yangu all the time kuti the moment we use this car, we will be enjoying our drive until we get there, and we will be very angry when we are there.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Because—And ndaka-ndakavaudza tichisimuka, ndichivaudza ta—ndikavaudza ta’amu Kadoma. Taakusvika tose, everyone wandandinaye akasuwawo nekuti mota yaidii...? [Congregation says, “yainakidza.”] Ndikati, “Ko Mai Tito ka?” Zvikanzi, “Haa shuwa, dai ta’tichisvika hedu kana pa Joburg apo.” [Apostle and Congregation laugh—ED]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Handi’muri kuzviona. Ndozvinoita service yakanaka. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kana une service yakanakaka, inokunakidza zvekuti you can’t wait for the next one. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] You can’t wait to get the next to the service again. Ino inopera wakutoti aah, dai tasvika kune imwe. Saka ma brothers, lets really pray for our August Convention. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda kuti iite Convention yakanaka chai...? [Congregation says, “chaizvo,”] ehe. Ngaive Convention yakanaka chaizvo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Yakanyanyisa nekuna...? [Congregation says, “nekunaka,”] nekunaka.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Zvikuru, toda kuti Mwari vatidzidzise Shoko ravo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vanoimba ngavarege kutirasira pasi, vati compo-zere [to compose—ED] nziyo dzinonakidza, ha’moona. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vaite concentrate, va porishe [to polish up—ED]. Hama dzaakugona kuridza hudimbwa but there is always a notch higher. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] There is always a no...? [Congregation says, “notch higher.”] Ehe, aim for perfection. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handitika hama, ehe, ha’moona.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndaiona ma rehearsals e-ayiitwa na Michael Jackson. Anga achibuda pa Movie Magic 2, vachingotaura. Yanga iri period yema rehearsals ake. Kwanga kune almost three or four. The man would rehearse. He would rehearse even a dance. Ndosaka ndichiti haikona kumhanya kuisa munhu panaapa anenge asina practice iri enough. Anokukanganisira zvinhu zvakawanda, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ha’moona.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ukaita practice, you deliver a perfect thing. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] The good thing about delivering a perfect thing, it means you value your listeners. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] They will always a-appreciate a perfect thi...? [Congregation says, “thing,”] thing. But ukauya ukati kanyira pano, to’ona sekuti hauna kuti remekedza. Wauyirei usiri rea...? [Congregation says, “ready,”] ready. There is nothing as irritating as bad music, munzeve umu. It’s like bad food on a tummy. It’s like a smell on a nose.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndozvakaita bad mu...? [Congregation says, “music.”] Inokutsamwisai mese. Munongoti, “Ha iwe, nyarara!” [Congregation laughs] Ha’moona. Hamusati mamboona kuti munhu ukaimba zvakaipa vanhu vanopopota? “Iwe shut up mhani. Heyi, heyi, heyi, shut up! Ibva apo, ibva apo!”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Kana kune chinhu chino provoker, i music. But music can urge you to be nice. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Inokusunungura zvakanaka. It provokes all emotions in our bo...? [Congregation says, “body,”] in our body. Iriko music inongokuti haaaa! Muchaziva nziyo yakambouya yaiimbwa, pane imwe television station yakanga yavhurwa, yaiimbwa neumwe mukadzi. Ayiimba i-iri yechishona. [Apostle starts singing the song—ED] “Ndakaenda kuMhondoro. Iyoo iyoyo. Howowowowowo.” Muchaiziva nziyo iyo? [Congregation laughs—ED] Kana kune nziyo yainditsamwisa pasi pano. [Apostle and Congregation laugh—ED] Ndaishaya kuti kuimba here? Vadzidza here chord dzacho? Handiti.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: How can a—How can somebody put that one as a record. [Apostle imitates the artists singing—ED] Achiimba achiti, [Apostle imitates the artists singing—ED] mukadzi wacho. Mukadzi wacho zvaanenge akaita, vanhu vacho unongoona kuti ha! What’s wrong with these guys? Ha’moona. But music, God made it accompany us. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Pane worship and sacrifice panoda mu...? [Congregation says, “music,”] music, handi’maona. Saka, we want brothers to really do good practice and-and-and-and give us wonders. Handi’moona, ehe. Pa…pa…pa Convention yedu. Hatiigadzirirei chai...? [Congregation says, “chaizvo,”] chaizvo. Nhaika vanhu vaMwari, handi’moona, ehe.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Saka tichiimba hedu, Bring them in, Brother Mupa ngavaunze mwana wavo. Doctor Mupa vaane mwana. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ayihwa tinoona manana—munana ya Jehovah. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! Hanti, ehe. Ngavauye havo Brother Mupa nejaya ravo, Bezel. Chorus Bring them in, bring them in, Bring them in from the fields of sin; Bring them in, bring them in, Bring the little ones to Jesus. (Bring them in) Bring them in, (Bring them in) Bring them in, (In) Bring them in from the fields of sin; Bring them in, bring them in, Bring the little ones to Jesus.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe, kamwana kakanaka chaizvo aka. Saka nda’achivayeuchidza kuti muzukuru wangu akanaka. [Apostle and Congregation laughs—ED] Totenda Mwari chaizvo na Bezelel. Very beautiful boy. We really enjoyed having him, we also, among us, kumba uko. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Totenda Mwari neropafadzo rakadai. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] I never could foresee a day Brother Mupa would have a baby. Saka tinotenda Mwari chaizvo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatinyengeterei.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Baba mufaro wangu kubata mwana uyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari makarurama hatina kumbenge takazvitarisira senguva iyo ino. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Taitoona Baba roora chairo riri impossible. Now, like Jacob said to Joseph, “I never thought I could see your face. Now, I have your seed.” Lord, we thank thee for this boy. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Father may he be a bez-a-a-a-a blessing. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Bezel ngaakure kuva sababa vake namai vake. Baba namai, ngavachiramba vari mukunamata. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Tenzi makanaka, mukomana uyu agorerekera kune zvechitendero. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Munzvengesei kumweya yemadzinza. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kana yakambonetsa vabereki, kumwana uyu nokuti aberekerwa mukutenda ende tamubvuta achiri mucheche, dzingai mweya iyoyo yese. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinomuisa mumaoko enyu Baba wakanaka. Ngaave nehutano, ngaakure zvakanaka, ngaachengetedzwe. Baba namai ngavachengetedzwe, vagonongedza mwana uyu kuShoko raMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tamudzorera mumaoko enyu, tirererei, muZita raTenzi Jeso Kristu, Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Mwari akuropafadzei, munhu waMwari. God bless you, sister. Chorus Bring them in, bring them in, Bring the little from the fields of sin; Bring them in, bring them in, Bring the little ones to Jesus.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Brother Moyo vane muni’ina wavo, Brother Moyo, Zvishavane. Kwete Zvishavane, Brother Moyo. Simukai Brother Moyo ava. Ava, handi’tovaziva avo? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Avo tovaziva muni’ina wavo ava. Avava, handi’munovaziva futi ava? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndivana Moyo vese ivavo but vakasiyana siyana. [Apostle laughs—ED] Amen, garai henyu pasi hama. Vakabva vese but tinotenda Mwari. Muni’ina wa brother ava vepamberi ava, ndiye a-atumira three hundred dollars iyi. Ha-akaona brother... maiiteiko paakakupai three hundred dollars?

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: [A brother responds in the Congregation—ED] Makateerera tape yainzi, Revelation? Ehe, muchiteerera tape, ndopaakati ndiendeserei mari iyi ndinonamatirwa ku Church kwenyu. Handi’moona. Ndobva atumira three hundred dollars iyi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvikanzi, “Endai kune Mu-Mufundisi wenyu andinyengeterere mari iyo.” So, I thought that was wonderful. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kumunhu anenge asingauye pa Chur...? [Congregation says, “pa Church.”] Kunyanya mune vanhu vanotadza kubhadhara zveyi...? [Congregation says, “zvegumi.”] [Apostle laughs—ED] Saka, I thought I should make this one a really—a lesson to everybody. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Handi’maona kuti vanhu vaMwari ukasavachengeta vanochengetwawo nemunhu wausingazivi? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Inongouya kuvanhu vanenge vangonzwa tape kunzi endai munopa murume uyu five hundred uyu. Saka akatumira three hundred zvikanzi, “Ndoda kuti inonamatirwa ku Church kwenyu. Endai munonamatirwa na Pastor. Endai munopa Pastor mari iyi.” So, I thought I would request prayer from the Church. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Itai kuti mari yake, inamatirei hundred fold. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nekuti ayiunza kubasa raani...? [Congregation says, “raMwari.”] Amen. [The Congregation claps and ululates—ED] Ngaiite a hundred fold. Saka hatiinyengetererei mari iyi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ishe Baba wedu vari kumusoro kudenga. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinoshama nevanhu vakadai, vanongonzwa kuti dai mari yaenda kuimba yaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vanongori ne consciousness yezvinhu zvaMwari, vasina kudzidziswa kana kuparidzirwa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Imo muno mu Church tiine vanhu vasingadi kana ku supporter, kana kupa chinhu kuna Jehovah. Mwari i rebuke yakaomarara. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Dai Ishe tadzidza kubva kune murume uyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mumuropafadzire mari yake, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] idzorere a hundred fold, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] nekuti ayiunza kubasa raMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari makanaka mukomborerei, chiikomborerai. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Taikumbira izvi nokutenda muZita raTenzi Jeso Kristu, Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ayihwa tinotenda hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Then pakati pedu tine vayenzi, ndivo vana Brother-Brother F. Moyo, young brother va brother ava ngavasimuke havo. Avo. Ndivo muni’ina wa Brother Moyo, handitika. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinovakwazisa muZita raTenzi Jeso Kristu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Then, tina Mr Makomborero Mandera, sekuru va Brother Chichaya, ngavasimuke tivaone. Ayihwa, tinokukwazisai mose muZita raTenzi Jeso Kristu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari akuitirei zvakanaka, tigare hedu pasi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ayihwa, tinotenda Mwari chaizvo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatichipedzesai message yedu ye Rights of Fathers. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. It was a wonderful message; I really enjoyed it. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ta’atichiiparidza iri zvidimbu, zvidimbu, zvidimbu, zvidimbu, zvidimbu, kuHarare but It’s a wonderful message. You can learn a lot from all angles muzvinhu zvaani...? [Congregation says, “zvaMwari,”] zvaMwari, handi’moona. You can learn a lot from all angles muzvinhu zvaJehovah, handi’moona. This is something wonderful that I have learned of late, ha’moona.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Saka taikumbira kuti dai Mwari, handi’moona, aititi tikadzidza, tiregere kuva ma forgetful hear...? [Congregation says, “hearers.”] Pano tinofanira kuva neropafadzo raJehovah tichifara. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vana vedu vadzidze izvozvo vachifara. Hativerengei P—eh...eh… [Blank spot on tape—ED] –47. Handei kuna Psalm 147. Tione kuti rinoti kudii Shoko raMwari. Pisarema 147, tasvika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] But yekutanga, hatitangei na 149, munyatsoona zvinotaura Mwari. Ndozvatanga tichiita muno zvatinofanira kuva nguva nenguva muimba yaMwari. These, what we have just gone through now.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: MaJuta anotamba kana achirumbidza Mwari wavo. Takaona kubva kuna Dhavhidha, handitika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hationei pa verse ya... Tasvika pana Psalm 149? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengei from verse 1 tese, hativerengei tose: Praise ye the LORD. Sing unto the LORD a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatidzokororei ipapo futi tione. Hativerengei tose: Praise ye the LORD. Sing unto the LORD a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: We want new songs in August. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Sing unto the Lord a...?” [Congregation says, “new song.”] Munhu akaita effort kukumbira chiri chipo chako, you always have a wonderful time. Saka munhu wese ane chipo chake, hapana chakaoma. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Hapana chakaoma, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] We want knew songs from every singer. Tipe masterpiece yako pana August. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handizvo here vanhu vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Every singer ngayitipe ma…? [Congregation says, “masterpiece,”] ehe, masterpiece yake. Get together ma Saturdays, handitika and do your practice all the ti…? [Congregation says, “time.”] Kana muri free, muchiziva kuti muri free make sure you come on a Saturday. We make the Church available do practice for us. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Toda kuwana nguva yakana…? [Congregation says, “yakanaka.”] yakanaka muimba yaMwari handitika ehe. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] For August we want to really enjoy ha’moona. Do your masterpiece try and do good practice, dzidzirai, make a day ha’moona ehe. And eh eeh munogona kana kuita practice kana kumba kwa Brother ava, kwa Brother Chigova pamba pavo. Muchinda aive pa next dooraita practice every time achitiitira noise Mujuru haangambo compureni [Apostle claps his hands once—ED] Uku hakuna compureini [to complain—ED] yakawanda ye noise munogona kuswera zuva rose re Saturday muchiita practice [Apostle claps hands once—ED] ha’moona. [Apostle claps his hands once—ED]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Muchida—kana mukadaowo kuuya kweduwo ku Malbrough zvakangonaka. [Apostle claps hands—ED] But what we want is good product at the end. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]Amen handitika ehe, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe, toda product yakanaka. Hativerengei 145 tese hativerengei verse 145 tese: Praise ye the LORD. Sing unto the LORD a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.

entries.text: Ndiyo congregation of the saints kaiyi? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handei munoona zvinozoitika ipapa, handei pa verse 2. I like verse 2 so much hativerengei tose: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him… 55[Congregation says, “Amen.” Apostle chuckles—ED] Hanzi, “Munhu ngaafare kune mu—achifarira munhu akamusi…?” [Congregation says, “akamusika.”] huh, saka handi’muoona kuti kana uchitambira Mwari uri kutambira musiki waani…? Enda unoona paidhakwa, enda unoona pairidza Tomas Mapfumo, enda unoona paiitwa ma all night dhindindi ema independence celebration aya hee. Ndopauchaona kuti ah, rume raitamba iri raizvityora Gadzi raivhiringuka iri nekutamba. Richiita kuvhinyinguka gadzi iri, riri muSho—riri—riri muShoko raMwari here? [Congregation says, “ah—ah.”]

entries.text: Asi tava muShoko zvonzi, “Ah mu Church ah, mu Church ah.” I—I verse ripi iroro tiverengere verse rinoti imbai makasuwa suwa, muchichema muchwisa tsitsi makarereka misoro yenyu. Kana yasvika nguva yekurumbidza Mwari hanzi, “Isirairi ngaifare munaakaisika.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! “Isirairi ngaifare mune akaidii…?” [Congregation says, “akaisika.”] Ndosaka ukaona munhu asingagoni kutamba mune—muna Mwari haaa kuhedhuka.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Torai the same person muyende kudhindindi renyika ha’moona. Isu taizviona kaiisu waiona brother varipanapa vakangodaio pa Church kusuwa so. entries.text: Ndakaona kuti chisiri kuwirirana apa mwe…? [Congregation says, “mweya.”] Kune vanhu vasinga fari muimba yaMwari but be assured kune kwavanodii…? entries.text: [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi, “Let the children of Zion be what…? entries.text: But dzidza kusaseka, usaseka vamwe handiti ehe. [Apostle laughs—ED] Akakutarisa akakuti, “Iwe.” [Apostle and Congregation laughs—ED] Mwana waMwari kauyu handitika ehe. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hapana munhu ano enjo-ya [enjoy-Ed] hutano, ano enjo-ya [enjoy –Ed] food anotadza ku rejoi-sa [to rejoice-Ed] muna Mwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: But mirai ndikutaurirei hama, mafariro atiri kuita iwaya aya munhu ane mweya wetsvina anotsamwa zvisingadii…? [Congregation says, “yarebesa.”] Ini ndotora sekuti time yedu ye worship ipfupi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.text: I have noticed kuti time ye worship yedu tinoita gagaga,ma brother… taisiimba three songs before an item i cut ndobva ndati ngatiisei chii…? Two per—per—per item. [Congregation laughs—ED] Takaidimbura futi handitika ehe tichiedza kuti zvikwane handitika ehe. So we cut that again we…length ye song inoimbwa we cut it, the number of songs we wha… we cut so they is nothing,ha’maona.

entries.text: Then the other thing that I have realize to…kana ta—taanenzvimbo yakatambanuka. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nzimbo—nzvimbo iri crowded so ka inonetesa and haitambi…? [Congregation says, “haitambike.”] Ehe, haitambike inoiyi.Panoda nzvimbo inechii…? [Congregation says, “ine space,”] ine space. Ehe, zvekuti mudhuri uyu unofanira kubva pauri apa. entries.text: Zvino izvino ndikati eh… tikatanga kudai o—o—o [Apostle demonstrates the dance] unobaya vamwe handitika ehe. entries.text: Zvomumwe musi rinongoramba [Apostle laughs—ED] mukaona magara two, four, six, seven iri reripamberi iri. Mukuona kuti we are overloaded? And ndomagariro edu kusvika tasvika uko. entries.text: Mari pano iripo, munoziva kana une mari unogona kusaziva kuti unayo ? Mmm but unayo. Zvinongo dhipenda [it depends—ED] nemaonero aunodii…? entries.text: Mwari waachapa dhora rine nharo pano, varipo Mwari ivavo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ende vanozivikanwa nani vanhu ivavo? [Congregation says, “naMwari,”] naMwari. entries.text: Haazi munhu waunofungira iwewe kana kuti akafitwa naro, Mwari vanotarisa mwoyo wemunhu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nezvaunoda kuita nemari iyo…? entries.text: Isu tirikutarisira kuti gore iro rino richipera iri zvinhu zvakawanda zvinenge zvaitwa nedenga. entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)

Hanzi, “Nziyo dzavanoimba hatidzizive. Toda dzatakatenga ku Britain nedzatakatenga kuAmereka nekuti hakuna munhu mutema anonyora nziyo inogamuchirwa naMwari. Hakuna munhu mutema anodaidza Mweya Mutsvene kana achiimba, hakuna.” Mm. Zvinongoda… [Apostle sings “Amazing Grace”—ED] Amazing grace how sweet the sound That saved a wretch like me…

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Tikawunza yedu manje… [Apostle sings “Tinotendazve”—ED] Tinotenda zvedu Mwari Baba Makatipa simba…

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndosaka mukaona manje, ukabata nziyo dzechirungu, handitika, unodhanza sezvavanoita ivo muchechi dzaani…? [Congregation says, “dzavo.”] Yava culture iyi. [Apostle sings while demonstrating an English dance style—ED] Amazing grace how sweet the sound… [Apostle sings again while demonstrating an African dance style—ED] Tinotendazve Ishe Mwari… [Congregation laughs—ED]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Handi’moona? [Apostle and Congregation laugh—ED] [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvaakuyenderana nedzinza nerudzi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe, handitika ehe. Ukaendawo ku Nigeria…[Apostle sings a Nigerian song demonstrating a Nigerian dance style—ED] My God is good oh Eh, my God is good oh Eh, God is good oh… Ehe. Hee, God is good oh ye…[Congregation laughs—ED]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Saka munhu nemunhu ngaarege kushora zverudzi rwake. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatirumbidzei Mwari nerudzi rweduwo zvakare handiti. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda kuti hama dzekuAmereka dzikauya dzikaona tichiimba nziyo dzedu vanozvi importer kuenda nazvo kwaani…? [Congregation says, “kwavo,”] seku importer kwatakaitawo tanakidzwa nedzani…? [Congregation says, “nedzavo.”] Tingaita Amen here varanda vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Pano ticharamba tichidi…Tichadzimara tikanyora hymn book ye…? [Congregation says, “yedu.”] Hymn book iyoyo muchaiona kuti vana vedu vachasara vachiyidii…? [Congregation says, “vachiyiimba.”] Vachasara vachiyishandisa hymn book iyoyo. Vana vedu vachasara vachishandisa hymn book iyoyo iyo, vasisatombozive kuti dzakaimbwa nani. Yavanenge vari…Toda kumeka shuwa kuti pano kana paine revival muchipfuva, mweya mumwe chete wakapinda mune vakanyora ma hymn book revival yaitika munguva dzaani…? [Congregation says, “dzavo,”] kuri kuparidza kwemutumwa wa–wenguva yavo.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: John Wesley anga ari mutumwa wechi six, ku Philadelphia. Akaparidza pa–Ndopakabuda vana “Amazing Grace” ava. Ndopakabuda vana–vana, [Apostle sings briefly—ED] “Tsitsi dzinondishamisa…” Ndopavakanga vachinyora vana John Wesley vachinyora nziyo dzamunofarira imimi. Aive mutumwa wechinomwe. Ko zvatakapihwawo mutumwa wenguva yedu hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Sei muMwenga musina music, yemuno medu muno umu?

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Vanhu vanofanira kuita hymn book ravo rokutanga ndisu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] We must introduce a new hymn book in the Bride. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika Amen ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ngaapfuure ipapo Amen iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosaka mukaona, we had to sit down kuti titsvage worship, toita worship yakadii…? And we are rejoicing…[Inaudible 01:04:05] [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nokuti tanga tangogamuchira zvinongo handwa [to hand over-ED] over kuchechi kwana Brother Billy Paul, handi’moona.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Tongogamuchira zvinoitwa kuchechi kwa Brother Peary Green. Saka ivo ndovakaita sei? Can’t we do something here? Ndosaka isusu vanhu vaMwari isusu, vana vaMwari makaropafadzwa kuti vatungamirirwe muzvinhu zvavanoita vanhu ava. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Hapana munhu anofanira kuti anetseke kana chinhu chauya chichirumbidza Mwari chiri mumweya wakanaka, chiine mwoyo wakanaka. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinofanira kupinda mukurumbidza Mwari te…? [Congregation says, “tese.”] Ndosaka mukaona vana “Ngatijekerwe” vaya, handitika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Aiwa, inziyo dzakanaka dziya. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe. [Apostle sings “Ngatijekerwe.”—ED] Ngatijekerwe (ngatijekerwe) Ngatijekerwe (ngatijekerwe) Ngatijekerwe (ngatijekerwe)…

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Handi’muri kuzviona hama, handi’moona? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Inziyo yakanaka chaizvo iya. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha’moona. Zvokuti unenge uchinyatsoona kuti murume uyo ka uyu, ari kuti dai tanga tajekerwa nokuti vanenge vasina kujekerwa muChechi vakawanda chai…? [Congregation says, “chaizvo.”] Vari kungotevera, gundamusaira. Kungouya chete kuzongogara muChechi. Ndosaka isusu vanhu vaMwari, isusu muno umu, we are the Church of the first borns. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tofanira ku introducer zvinhu zvinyowani nguva dzo…? [Congregation says, “dzose.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Early church structure, akaitanga ndiani? [Congregation says, “tisu.”] Marriage and divorce, vakaitanga ndivanani? [Congregation says, “tisu.”] Way of worship yatiri kutanga iyi ichateedzerwa nevanhu ve…? [Congregation says, “vese.”] Hakuna chatisingatange. Hymn book yedu tichaita nyowani futi ndisu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ukaona kwaakuitwa ma convention anywhere kunenge kwaakuitwa, vanenge vachiteedzera isusu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tiri Kereke yematangwe. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: I right yevatsvene iyoyo iyo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndo right yevatsvene yakazara chaiyo chaiyo iyoyo. Toda kutanga…Tais–ta zvinhu zvedu isusu pana apa taropafadzwa, tavaka chechi dzedu…Iyo chechi ino inofanira ku improve-wa [to be improved—ED] zvakanyanya fani.
