Kufara i number two. “…multiply and replenish the earth…” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Be a fruitful vow. Zvirikuturirwa Josefa izvi. Mumwe nemumwe ngaati kana ndaita vana vangu ngaive Kereke.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Mukadzi mumwe nemumwe ngaumbe Church. Mukadzi mumwe nemumwe ngaaumbe Church. “…where two or three are…? [Congregation says, “gathered .”] there I am in their mi…?” [Congregation says, “midst.”] Ndosaka takati minimum number yemukadzi wese wese yekubereka yakanaka ivana five. Mukadzi mumwe nemumwe ngaave ne Church pacha…? [Congregation says, “pachake.”] Tingaita Amen here varanda vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ngaapfure ipapa Amen iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen Hallelujah. [Congregation says, “Amen, Hallelujah.”]

entries.text: Ndosaka vanhu vaMwari tinofanira kuva vanhu vano… Kuropafadzwa it’s our right. Madanirwo anoitwa vanhu kuti vawane pfuma munyika nemishonga ndomadanirwo atinongoitawo kuti isu tiwane pfuma neShoko raMwa…? [Congregation says, “raMwari.”] Zvedu zvine rugare. Zvemunyika zvine ropa, zvemunyika hazvina zororo. Iti Mwari ndoda kutambira zvedenga. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndagamuchira zvedenga! [Congregation says, ‘Mweya.’] Mweya kupiko…?” [Congregation says, “kuKereke.”] Hatisimukei hedu tese. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.text: Takakotamisa musoro yedu tose. Unotenda here kunaka Kwavo Mwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Unonamata here Zita Ravo? entries.text: Ndoda kunamata Zita Renyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndiripa nzvimbo tsvene. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zita Renyu hupenyu Baba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Bisai mbanje, bisai doro, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] bisai hupfeve, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] bisai kuromba, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] bisai mweya yetsvina. Ndipei kutendeuka. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndibatsirei ndi kriyete [to create—ED] dzinza. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Dzinza rangu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Mwari …?... zvinhu kwazvo. Mwari mune pamunotiisa patinodzidza from the ancient of days. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda kuti vana vedu vawane footprints on the saints of time. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vana vatende kuti vakaropafadzwa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nekuda kwababa vainamata. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba vaifarirwa naMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndodakuva munhu iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.text: Ndakakura mumhuri yakanga isina direction. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vana baba vaitenda mudzimu nen’anga. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Pfuma ne hurombo makanga mu—mu… Maive nehurombo makanga musina pfuma. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndakakura ndichizvidzidzisa ndega. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndichiita ma peace job. Asi ndoda kuitira vana vangu zvinhu kwazvo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] SaDhavhidha wamakachengetera Solomon afa. Akasara achinyora Proverbs. Ndodawo kuti parudzi rwangu, vana vangu vasare vachiita zvinhu. [Congregation says, “Amen,”] Zvinosimudza Zita raMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari vanozvigona Mwari vanozvihwa. Ndoda masimba iyawo anobva Kwamuri.

entries.text: Simudza ruoko kuna Mwari uti ndochikumbiro changu Baba. Ndichibva pano ndoda change of status. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndichibva pano ndoda double portion. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndichibva pano ndoda mbereko. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndichibva pano ndoda a peaceful home. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndichibva pano ndoda victory. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndichibva pano ndoda kukunda. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari ndiitirei nyasha manheru anhasi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.text: Ndipei masimba Baba wakanaka. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndipei kukunda Mwari wakanaka. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndipei kukuraramirai Jehovha. entries.text: Dzingai hurombo! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Dzingai mweya yemadzinza. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] MuZita raJeso! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chitibatsirai Baba wakarurama manheru ano. Shoko Renyu taridya nezuro na nhasi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba makanaka taikumbira Mweya Wenyu Mutsvene. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.text: Toda kukumbirawo kuti nesuwowo, tisiye madzinza. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Evanhu vanonamata. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatidi kuti Baba vachifa kunamata kuchipera. entries.text: Aiwa tinotenda Mwari. Totenda Mwari chaizvo . [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kunamata ngakurege kuguma nemusi unofa baba. Amen. entries.text: But nevertheless, you can pray through. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ukave nekutenda munaMwa…? [Congregation says, “Mwari.”] Ehe kuti Mwari vakutungamirire uve negomborero rakana…? entries.title: Ratidziro Part 1
entries.text: One of the biggest problems children face is understanding division. Many pupils can divide simple numbers, but they struggle when the numbers become bigger. Some children do not fully understand that division means sharing equally or grouping items. For example, when asked to divide 24 by 6, they may not know how to group the numbers correctly. Long division is even more difficult because it involves several steps. If a child misses one step, the whole answer becomes wrong. This often makes learners frustrated and discouraged.

entries.title: Ratidziro Part 1
entries.text: Multiplication is another challenge for many primary school children. Learners are expected to memorize multiplication tables, but some children find it hard to remember them. Without knowing multiplication tables well, solving mathematical problems becomes slow and difficult. Some pupils also fail to understand the meaning of multiplication itself. Instead of seeing it as repeated addition, they only try to memorize answers. This causes problems when they meet difficult questions in higher grades. Lack of practice and fear of making mistakes also make multiplication harder for many learners.

entries.title: Ratidziro Part 1
entries.text: Fractions are among the most confusing topics in mathematics. Children often struggle to understand what fractions represent. Terms such as one-half, one-quarter, and three-quarters may seem simple, but many learners mix them up. Comparing fractions is also difficult because pupils may not understand why one-half is bigger than one-quarter. Adding and subtracting fractions can be even more challenging, especially when denominators are different. Some children become confused because fractions involve both whole numbers and parts of numbers at the same time

entries.title: Ratidziro Part 1
entries.text: There are several reasons why children face these difficulties. Some schools do not have enough learning materials such as charts, counters, and visual aids to help learners understand mathematical concepts. In some cases, classes are overcrowded, making it difficult for teachers to give individual attention to struggling pupils. At home, some parents may not have enough time or knowledge to help their children with homework. Fear and anxiety also play a big role because some learners believe mathematics is too hard before they even try.
